store_data.about_the_game:
DEAD KEYS

Your keyboard is the weapon.

Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action game set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Every correct key fires a shot, every mistake costs you time, and the horde does not care how quickly you can find the right letter.

Fight alone, survive together, build increasingly powerful runs, or race another player and find out whose hands give out first.

BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE - THANK YOU

We can code. We cannot draw. What we did, you'll notice xd.

Dead Keys looks the way it does because a handful of pixel artists put their work out into the world and let people like us build with it. Every zombie you put down, every tile you stand on, every explosion, every letter of the font you are about to stare at for hours - theirs, not ours.

fkgcluster · Cute SCKR · Ansimuz · Seliel the Shaper · handekaya23 · ToffeeCraft · CraftPix · YukiPixels · Helton Yan

This game does not exist without you. Thank you, genuinely.

TYPE TO SURVIVE

Combat is controlled through typing.

Words and sentences replace traditional shooting controls. Type correctly to attack, keep your rhythm to stay in control, and improve your speed and accuracy as the pressure rises.

The better you type, the better you fight. The better you fight, the stronger you get.

CLASSIC

Classic is the main roguelite experience.

Hold the barricade for fifty waves. Choose a survivor, build your run through augments and upgrades, and adapt as new enemies and bosses begin to overwhelm the battlefield.

Five survivors bring their own abilities and playstyles, while randomised run choices make each attempt develop differently. Between runs you train your survivors, buy kits and unlock starter augments, so a losing run still moves you forward.

Play solo, or with a friend over Steam or LAN.

ENDLESS

No builds. No abilities. No excuses.

Endless strips the game back to pure typing performance.

Type continuous sentences while every correct character feeds your minigun. Maintain your rhythm to spin the weapon faster, keep the horde away, and survive as long as your hands can keep up.

Track your:

  • Live WPM

  • Average WPM

  • Accuracy

  • Clean streaks

  • Survival time

  • Personal records

There is also a Daily run: one seed a day, the same sentences, the same horde and the same ruleset for every player in the world, so your number actually means something next to someone else's.

The longer you survive, the harder the horde pushes back.

SHORT CAMPAIGN

Dead Keys also features a short story-driven campaign, playable solo or in co-op.

Fight your way through the outbreak alongside a small cast of survivors, move through handcrafted scenarios, face unique encounters, and see the world behind the endless hordes.

The campaign is still in development and is planned to ship as part of Dead Keys at launch.

RACE ANOTHER PLAYER

Endless can also be played competitively.

Two players face the same escalating challenge under the same conditions. Watch your opponent's progress, keep your own lane alive, and outlast them.

Type fast to put pressure on your opponent - but when one of you finally breaks, there is only one thing left to do:

Say that your cat walked across your keyboard.

BUILT AROUND YOUR KEYBOARD

Dead Keys is not a shooter with typing bolted on top. Typing is the combat system.

Your speed controls your firepower.

Your accuracy keeps you alive.

Your consistency determines how far you get.

Whether you are chasing a new personal WPM record or trying to survive one more wave with a friend, getting better at the game means getting better at typing - which is the entire point.

FEATURES

  • Typing-driven zombie combat

  • Classic: a fifty-wave roguelite with augments, upgrades and boss fights

  • Endless: continuous sentence typing, no builds, no abilities

  • A short story campaign, solo or co-op

  • Co-op over Steam or LAN

  • Competitive online Endless VS

  • A shared Daily run, same seed for everyone

  • Five playable survivors with their own abilities

  • WPM, accuracy and personal-record tracking

  • Pixel-art zombie apocalypse

  • No mouse needed once the typing starts

这里没有你想要的一切。

你将无法在这里体验到甜蜜的恋爱，伤感或者激昂的情绪；那些看上去美好真挚、抑或是能帮助你锻炼泪腺的情节这里一概没有。

这里什么都没有。

这是一个枯燥的，自我感动的，毫无营养的，无法被称作故事的故事。

所以，如果你能听见我的话，请远离。

请不要，触碰他的记忆。

游戏简介

你将以主角的记忆为载体体验整个故事。你所经历的一切未必真实发生，你和她们之间的关系也未必同你认知的一致。

梦境与现实，自我认知与他人意志之间的边界被不断模糊，最终在未知的恐惧中被迫走向终点。

是妥协？是逃避？是爆发？

又或者，你会以自己的方式，抓住只属于你一人的结局？

友情提示

本游戏基于1920*1080p分辨率设计，为了确保设备能够准确呈现像素，推荐使用整数倍分辨率的显示设备，即1080p、4k分辨率显示器以无边框模式，或在设置中开启整数倍缩放游玩。

游戏已发布Demo版本，推荐在观看玩家评测或游玩Demo后再考虑购入正式版。有任何对游戏内容的疑问和建议，欢迎私信B站@人理说工作室账号反馈，感谢您的支持！

Build Furniture. Complete Contracts. Create Your Own Workshop.

Take charge of your own woodworking shop and craft tables, benches, crates, and much more for your customers. Earn money, buy new lumber, hinges, and paint—and expand your workshop step by step, just the way you want it.

From Board to Finished Furniture

Use the table saw, planer, and workbench to shape your lumber. Work on each part, then assemble everything into creations of your own.

A Freeform Nailing System

Join pieces of wood wherever you choose. Select the nail length and hammer every nail into the wood yourself. Turn simple components into sturdy tables, chairs, crates, and many other projects.

Mix Your Own Colors

Buy primary colors along with white and black, then mix exactly the shade you need. Paint furniture, lumber, walls, or even the floor to give your workshop a personal touch.

The Entire Workshop Is Your Canvas

Design not only your furniture, but the entire space. Put up new walls, build platforms, create storage rooms, shelves, and supply crates, or set up a break room. You can even clad the walls and ceilings entirely in wood—what your workshop ultimately looks like is up to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE BEACON IS STILL TRANSMITTING

STILLTRACE is a single-player top-down survival horror game about exploring an infected sector, managing scarce resources, and defending one of the last safe outposts.

Leave the base in search of ammunition, medicine, and spare parts. Explore abandoned locations, follow unsettling radio signals, and decide which risks are worth taking.

Not every event will happen twice. Not every story will wait for you. Some choices may return much later.

• Explore the infected sector

• Scavenge supplies and upgrade your gear

• Fortify your base and defensive turrets

• Defend the beacon against increasingly dangerous attacks

• Discover optional stories, encounters, and mysteries

Few people remain out there.

But the radio is still picking up voices.

store_data.about_the_game:
HOW LONG WILL YOUR HULL LAST?

HULLSTORM is a space survival shooter where you’ll fight through increasingly aggressive waves of enemies. Aim, fire, boost your ship, and collect as much XP as possible before the enemy fleet turns the arena into hell.

The mission? Survive.
The plan? Become absurdly overpowered.

CREATE A DEVASTATING BUILD

Destroy enemies, collect XP, and choose a new upgrade whenever you level up. Reinforce your hull, increase your firepower, deploy support units, or transform your weapons with evolutions that can completely change the run.

Overheated beams, minefields, plasma, missiles, defenses, companions… Combine them all and discover just how far your build can go.

store_data.about_the_game:
From Watching Fireworks to Creating Them.

BURST NOIR - Fireworks Simulator is a fireworks show creation game where you design your own displays and bring them to life across the night sky.

Choose from fireworks with different colors, shapes, and visual characteristics, then arrange them along a timeline.
Control when they launch, how they overlap, and how the show builds from one moment to the next.

You can let a single firework bloom in the silence of the night.
Or launch wave after wave until the entire sky erupts into a spectacular finale.

Once your show is complete, play it back and watch your creation unfold against a nighttime landscape of mountains and water.

Create Your Own Fireworks Show

Choose from a library of fireworks with different visual characteristics and freely arrange them along the timeline.

You decide:

  • Which fireworks to use

  • When each one launches

  • How much time to leave between bursts

  • When to suddenly fill the entire sky

Even when using the same fireworks, changing their combinations and timing can completely transform the atmosphere of a show.

Create anything from quiet compositions built around space and silence to dense sequences of explosions that illuminate the entire night sky.

Complete Missions and Unlock New Fireworks

BURST NOIR features missions that challenge you to create fireworks shows under a variety of conditions.

Work within limited budgets, available fireworks, launch counts, timing requirements, and other restrictions as you build a show that satisfies each mission.

Progress through the missions to unlock new fireworks and new challenges.

It is not simply about launching as many fireworks as possible.

Choosing which firework to use and exactly when to launch it is part of the experience.

20 Original Music Tracks

BURST NOIR includes 20 original music tracks created to accompany your fireworks shows.

Play music in the background while your fireworks launch and enjoy your completed show together with its soundtrack.

Colors, density, timing, and music.
Combine them to create a night sky that feels entirely your own.

Create It. Then Watch It.

When you finish editing, play your fireworks show from beginning to end.

Light spreading across the night sky.
Mountains silhouetted against the glow.
Fireworks reflected across the surface of the water.

Individual launches placed in the editor become a complete performance the moment the show begins.

Create overwhelming chains of explosions.
Or make use of silence and empty space to build a more restrained display.

Design the night sky.

Create your own fireworks show in BURST NOIR.

Videos, Livestreaming, and Monetization

Gameplay videos, livestreams, commentary, reviews, and other video content featuring BURST NOIR may be freely published by both individuals and organizations.

Monetization through the standard features provided by video and streaming platforms is permitted.

All in-game music is original and is not registered with YouTube Content ID.

Gameplay videos and livestreams that include the in-game music may also be published and monetized.

store_data.about_the_game:
Arcade Vault Manager : Game Sell Simulator is a cozy shop management simulation where you turn an empty space into the retro game store you have always imagined.

Place shelves and displays, organize games and consoles, shape a layout that works for your customers, and give every corner of the shop your own style

Open the doors when you are ready and run each day on your own terms. Buy new and second-hand stock, inspect every item's condition, estimate its real value, and set prices that balance quick sales with higher profits. Follow demand, new releases, and market trends to decide what to sell, what to hold, and which deals are worth taking.

Some products are more than ordinary stock. Examine games and consoles closely to uncover rare editions, valuable hardware, and collectible treasures. As new console generations arrive, older products may fade from the spotlight or become sought-after pieces of gaming history.

Reinvest your profits to upgrade the store, unlock new areas, expand your inventory, and hire staff as the business grows. Adapt to every generation and changing market demand. When you are ready to move beyond retail, open a game development office, build and improve your team, and create original games to release and sell through your own store.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIDGERIDOO MAN – The Legend of the Hill

One man. One hill. One didgeridoo. Zero explanations.

On that green hill you've half-noticed out of the corner of your eye your whole life sits a big man in an undershirt. He has no plan. But he has a didgeridoo. And he's playing the game's entire soundtrack on it — live, note by note, whether you like it or not.

Your job: shoot everything that flies, hops or wobbles across the screen, exactly in time with the music. Sounds simple. It isn't. Because this game has one iron rule:

DO NOT MISS.

Every stray shot makes the man angrier. He blows louder. His cheeks swell. His face turns red. Steam starts rising from his head. And if you keep missing... well, let's just say the hill is going to need a new tenant soon.

Work your way through a campaign of 10 wildly different levels, unlock content, and hunt down 33 achievements — and once the story isn't enough for you anymore, dive into ENDLESS MODE: 63 songs, 15 rotating theme worlds, randomized difficulty, and no end in sight except your own inevitable meltdown.

FEATURES

- A 10-level campaign, each level exactly as long as its song, each with its own theme, costumes and flying targets — from a night train to pumpkin night to a moon landing

- ENDLESS MODE: 63 original tracks, played back-to-back in random order across 15 rotating theme worlds, with difficulty re-rolled for every single song

- THE ANGER SYSTEM: miss your shots and watch the man turn red, start steaming, and eventually explode at full anger. The flying sausage calms him down reliably and has genuine therapeutic value

- A fully hand-animated band that actually performs every single note of the soundtrack live, on their didgeridoos

- 33 unlockable achievements, including a few secret ones hidden somewhere in the menus

- FULL MOD SUPPORT: build your own levels with your own music, your own characters (SVG/PNG), your own backgrounds and your own Windows-style popup texts — no coding required

- Cinematic boot intro, an animated main menu, adjustable graphics quality and a high-contrast mode for accessibility

- Separate volume sliders for master, main-menu music, in-game music and sound effects

- Persistent highscore, saved campaign progress and Discord Rich Presence support

- Authentic error messages from a beloved operating system of the early 2000s

HOW TO PLAY

Mouse — aim & shoot

ESC / P — pause (the man waits. reluctantly.)

F11 — toggle fullscreen

Reach the target score before the song ends. Don't miss. Feed the man a sausage when things get heated. That's it. That's the game.

A game by Studio Justin Braun.

No plumbers, cartoon characters or didgeridoo players were permanently harmed in the making of this game. Permanently.

C:\ > Immersive_File_Sorting_Simulator <

It's 1998 and lighting hit some family's PC. Every file survived... just not in the right places. It's up to you, the IT professional, to put it all back.

Navigate ~3,000 files across a deep, branching tree of folders, each themed around which files belong there. Games in games, taxes in taxes, and "homework" in homework.

D:\ > Take_Your_Time <

  • Cozy and satisfying, take as long as you need

  • Light detective work as some files are more obvious than others

  • Tools are buried in the mess, dig them out to help you sort and file with ease

  • Sometimes things just go in the trash

E:\ > Choose_Your_Era <

  • Pick from 3 themes: Cleaner 98, Cleaner XP, and iCleaner

  • Relax to a 90's-inspired liquid DnB Soundtrack

  • Collect music also buried within the files to play on the media player and visualizer

F:\ > Ways_To_Play <

  • The main campaign is single player, with the goal of putting away ~3000 files

  • Each campaign is procedurally generated, so no two hunts are the same

  • There is also an abridged Speedrun Time-Attack mode with a leaderboard

store_data.about_the_game:
You have one presidential term to preserve the republic.

Over 48 months, ministers, diplomats, investigators, military officers, activists, and ordinary citizens will bring urgent issues to your desk. Each case offers two defensible choices. Neither guarantees safety, and every signature changes the country's future.

Information is incomplete. Decisions are final. Consequences remember everything.

Behind a confident report may lie a disputed source, an unaccounted cost, or a warning hidden in an appendix. Open the supporting documents and examine them with a pixel-art magnifying glass before choosing a political course.

Evidence can reveal what the speaker left unsaid. You may request a second opinion, postpone certain decisions, or act immediately - but delay carries a political price of its own.

Your decisions continuously affect five indicators:

  • Public trust

  • Economy

  • State capacity

  • World standing

  • Tension

Keeping only one indicator high is not enough. A prosperous country can lose the trust of its citizens. A powerful state can provoke a crisis. International success sometimes demands concessions at home. If one of the critical systems collapses, your presidency may end early.

The cabinet is more than a list of names. Ministers have their own skills, loyalties, and political views. Request second opinions, deal with internal disagreements, and reshuffle the government when it needs a new direction.

Your allies remember whose advice you followed, which promises you broke, and who was forced to pay for your decisions.

Your presidential tools expand as the game progresses:

  • Examine evidence and classified documents

  • Manage a cabinet of recurring political characters

  • Pass laws with immediate and long-term effects

  • Build relations with fictional states

  • Face multi-stage crises under time pressure

  • Track previous decisions, active consequences, and the history of your term

Early decisions can unlock follow-up events several months later. Reforms create delayed consequences, allies remember previous agreements, and unresolved problems return in more dangerous forms.

Each new game uses a reproducible world seed and creates a different sequence of events, consequences, and character stories across the 48-month term. The complete pool contains hundreds of political events and documents in Russian and English.

It is impossible to see everything in one playthrough. Different priorities, cabinet relationships, and national conditions lead to new crises, opportunities, and endings.

Reach the election—or lose power before it arrives.

Your final legacy is determined not only by the state of the republic, but also by the history of your actions. You may be remembered as an architect of peace, a constitutional reformer, or the president of a stable republic. Your term may also end in economic collapse, international isolation, a cabinet revolt, or catastrophe.

store_data.detailed_description:
You have one presidential term to preserve the republic.

Over 48 months, ministers, diplomats, investigators, military officers, activists, and ordinary citizens will bring urgent issues to your desk. Each case offers two defensible choices. Neither guarantees safety, and every signature changes the country's future.

Information is incomplete. Decisions are final. Consequences remember everything.

Behind a confident report may lie a disputed source, an unaccounted cost, or a warning hidden in an appendix. Open the supporting documents and examine them with a pixel-art magnifying glass before choosing a political course.

Evidence can reveal what the speaker left unsaid. You may request a second opinion, postpone certain decisions, or act immediately - but delay carries a political price of its own.

Your decisions continuously affect five indicators:

  • Public trust

  • Economy

  • State capacity

  • World standing

  • Tension

Keeping only one indicator high is not enough. A prosperous country can lose the trust of its citizens. A powerful state can provoke a crisis. International success sometimes demands concessions at home. If one of the critical systems collapses, your presidency may end early.

The cabinet is more than a list of names. Ministers have their own skills, loyalties, and political views. Request second opinions, deal with internal disagreements, and reshuffle the government when it needs a new direction.

Your allies remember whose advice you followed, which promises you broke, and who was forced to pay for your decisions.

Your presidential tools expand as the game progresses:

  • Manage a cabinet of recurring political characters

  • Pass laws with immediate and long-term effects

  • Build relations with fictional states

  • Face multi-stage crises under time pressure

  • Track previous decisions, active consequences, and the history of your term

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

Smoke Keeper is a cozy first-person organizing simulator set in a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. The night's delivery has been scattered across the shop, and 4,316 boxes, cartons, tins, jars, pouches and accessories must be put back where they belong before morning.

Every item carries a number, and every place on every shelf carries the matching engraved plate. Read the stock, find its bay and shelf, and turn complete chaos into perfect order.

Gameplay

Pick stock up by the armful, cycle through the stack in your hands, and carry each piece to its correct place. The shop itself is your guide: gilt bay letters, shelf plates and a detailed plan help you navigate the building rather than follow a quest list.

Cigars are a job of their own. Find a key for a locked shipping case, open it, then pack each house's cigars by hand into its display boxes.

Make the Shop Your Own

In Cozy mode, completed rows earn skill points. Unlock and improve helpful abilities including Quick Order, Target Hint, Spot Matches, Auto-Place and Batch Grab to make every route through the shop more efficient.

Prefer a challenge? Speedrun removes the help, starts the clock on your first step, and records your best time on the leaderboard.

Features

  • Sort 4,316 pieces of stock across one hand-built two-storey shop

  • Match every item to its numbered bay, shelf and display

  • Unlock five efficiency skills in relaxed Cozy mode

  • Pack cigars from locked shipping cases into their correct display boxes

  • Race in Speedrun mode and compete for a faster finishing time

  • Save your progress and return to the same night whenever you like

  • Full controller support plus rebindable keyboard and mouse controls

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is available in Japanese only. It is a mahjong game where tiles show single kanji characters, and you form the names of real Japanese municipalities instead of standard melds.

漢字を組み合わせて、市町村の名前をつくる

市町村麻雀の牌には、数字も萬子も筒子もありません。書かれているのは漢字1文字だけです。

手牌に「阪」を持っているとき、「大」を引けば大阪市。面子を作る代わりに、実在する市町村の名前を揃えて和了します。

牌は114種136枚。この漢字の組み合わせで、実在する606の市町村名をつくることができます。

麻雀として遊べる

リーチ、ツモ、ロン、チー、ポン、カン。ドラと裏ドラ。東風戦と東南戦。麻雀の骨格はそのまま残してあります。牌の意味だけが入れ替わっている、と考えてください。

対局はひとりで完結します。3人のコンピュータが相手をします。

市町村ならではの役

  • 連泊 … 同じ都道府県の市町村で揃える

  • 地一色 … 同じ地方の市町村で揃える

  • 断本州 … 本州の市町村を1つも使わずに和了する

和了すると「四連泊（長野県）」「地一色（九州）」のように、どこで成立したかまで表示されます。

安易な和了はできない

「山」「川」「田」のように、多くの市町村名に含まれる頻出の漢字があります。こうした文字を手牌に残しておいて、あとから何かをくっつけるだけで和了することはできません。2文字の市町村を作るとき、手牌側に残っていた文字が使われすぎている場合は和了が認められないルールになっています。

使われやすさは牌に数字で書かれているので、盤面を見れば判断できます。

「異議あり」

14枚の牌を市町村に分ける方法は、ひとつとは限りません。自動判定が選んだ分け方が、あなたの狙っていた分け方と違うことがあります。

そのために「異議あり」ボタンを用意しました。押すと、14枚をどの市町村に分けたかったのかを自分で指定し直せます。同じ表記で都道府県が違う市町村も、選び分けられます。

対戦相手

6タイプの対戦相手から選んで遊べます。

記録が残る

着順、和了率、放銃率などの戦歴を記録します。どの役を何回和了したかを集める役コレクションもあります。対局の途中でやめても、次に起動したときに続きから再開できます。

動作環境について

本作はWindows専用です。表示言語は日本語のみで、日本の市町村名を題材にしています。

store_data.about_the_game:
Embrace the Potato is a nothing simulator with a trap built into the wait. A potato floats in deep space. It looks fine at first. Time does not care.

Every PC player knows the rule. You get a short window to decide if a purchase was a mistake. Embrace the Potato leans into that window on purpose. A grandfather clock ticks while dark ambient fills the void. The potato slowly darkens, shrivels, and grows mold as the clock runs toward one hundred twenty one minutes.

In the corner sits [ ABORT AND REFUND ]. It looks like an exit. It is part of the joke. This is not a skill game. It is a patience game about whether you leave early or sit through the whole collapse. Make it far enough and refund eligibility turns hostile. Finish the wait and the potato reaches its end state. From there you can reverse the decay and restore the potato. Restoration is possible. Easy escape is not the point.

You can tumble the potato freely while nothing else demands your attention. Local save keeps your progress if you close the game and come back later.

Key features:

A single potato in a cosmic void as the entire game.

Real time decay across a long AFK session, including skin change, shriveling, and mold.

360 degree tumble controls against a deep space starfield.

Oppressive audio with ambient pressure and a relentless tick.

A hostile refund and abort joke that escalates as you approach the point of no return.

Timed “Embrace the Potato” voice cues. Click the potato within ten seconds to earn the timed achievements.

Achievements for the major wait milestones, full decomposition, and a complete reversal back to the potato’s original form.

Embrace the Potato is for players who want to buy the bit, feel the clock, and live with what the wait costs.

The world won't tell you everything.

Some places won't tell you anything.
Nobody agrees on the details.

Nobody wants to talk about it.

And everyone is doing their very best to ignore the dragons...

...because nobody wants another Great Scorching.

But clues are scattered throughout dungeons, castles, taverns, and forgotten corners of Samgood.

Your job?

Find out what's really happening.

Preferably without dying.

Build Your Party

Create and name a party of four heroes, choosing from seven unique classes—each with their own abilities, strengths, and wonderfully terrible ideas.

Rogue – Shadow Ledger, poison, stealth strikes, cutpurse tricks

store_data.about_the_game:
BLEAK COORDINATES is a psychological survival horror game set deep within a remote mountain valley, where a missing person investigation leads to a place that should not exist.

You take the role of an investigator following a trail of disappearances to an isolated village hidden far from civilization. The coordinates are real. The village is there. But something about it is terribly wrong.

Abandoned homes stand frozen in time. Strange symbols appear throughout the village. Bodies are found in places they should never have reached, and the deeper you investigate, the more the line between a serial murder case and something far more disturbing begins to disappear.

Explore the village and its surrounding wilderness, search abandoned buildings, uncover documents and evidence, solve environmental puzzles, and survive encounters with those who still wander the valley.

But the village is only the beginning.

Something lies beneath it.

And someone has gone to great lengths to make sure no one discovers the truth.

FEATURES

  • Atmospheric Survival Horror — Explore an isolated mountain village filled with oppressive environments and constant uncertainty.

  • Investigation & Exploration — Search crime scenes, abandoned buildings, hidden paths, and underground locations for clues.

  • Environmental Puzzles — Use evidence and objects found throughout the world to uncover new areas and secrets.

  • Limited Resources — Manage your supplies carefully and decide when to fight, hide, or escape.

  • A Dark Mystery — Follow a seemingly ordinary investigation into something far larger and more horrifying.

  • Connected Horror Universe — Discover subtle connections to events beyond the village and uncover another piece of a much larger story.

Some coordinates were never meant to be found.

A Giant Pile of Bricks Is Waiting

Brick by Brick is a first-person sorting and building sandbox filled with thousands of colorful bricks just waiting to be organized.

Start with piles containing roughly 4,000 loose pieces and a room full of empty shelves. Pick up each brick, figure out where it belongs, and watch the room slowly transform as the shelves fill piece by piece.

There is no timer and no need to rush. Sort a few pieces when you have a few minutes, or settle in and organize the whole collection.

SORT IT YOUR WAY

Every brick has a proper place based on its style and color. Find the right shelf, put it away, and earn points based on the studs on the piece.

As your collection grows, unlock abilities that make tackling the piles a little easier.

Finder helps you locate the brick you are searching for.

Summon pulls bricks directly toward you when you need a helping hand.

The more you sort, the more useful your abilities become.

THEN BUILD SOMETHING

The bricks are not only there to be organized.

Use build plates and free-building areas to create your own designs piece by piece. Experiment with different bricks, colors, shapes, and structures without being limited to a predetermined set of instructions.

Finish sorting the collection to open up even more room for building and experimenting.

OR MAKE A MESS AGAIN

Finally got everything exactly where it belongs?

Good.

Now shake it all up.

Trigger an earthquake and send the collection tumbling back into chaos, then start sorting all over again. You can also return pieces to the shelves when you want to reset without the destruction.

PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

Brick by Brick can be enjoyed entirely on your own, but you do not have to sort alone.

Host an online room and share the room code with a friend so they can join your game. Sort, explore, and build together over the internet.

FEATURES

• Thousands of individual bricks to sort

• Shelves that visibly fill as you organize the collection

• Sorting by brick style and color

• Points based on each brick's stud count

• Finder and Summon abilities

• First-person free building

• Multiple building areas

• Physics-based brick interaction

• Earthquakes that turn an organized room back into a giant mess

• Persistent save files

• Single-player play

• Online multiplayer

• Keyboard and mouse support

• Full controller gameplay

• Steam achievements and statistics

• No timers or pressure to finish

Whether you want the satisfaction of turning chaos into order, the freedom to build something new, or the questionable decision to destroy hours of organization with an earthquake, Brick by Brick lets you do it one piece at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
DRIVE EVERYWHERE

CLINK is a red versus blue vehicle combat game set on a single continuous driving surface. The floor, walls, and ceiling are interconnected, allowing you to drive straight up a wall, continue onto the ceiling, and fight upside down. Everyone uses the same surfaces, so opponents can approach from the front, behind, or above.

Your grip keeps you attached to the arena. A Rammer can break it with a boost charge, while a Minelayer can blast you off a surface with a mine. If you lose your grip, you will fall, and the same happens to your wrecked vehicle.



SIX CLASSES

  • Tank — A balanced all-rounder with an aiming turret and no real weaknesses.

  • Sniper — Slow and fragile, it deals high damage at long range, has a zoom scope, and fires flat shots with little bullet drop.

  • Bruiser — The toughest class, it carries a short-range shotgun that is devastating up close and weak at a distance.

  • Kart — Fast and fragile, it has rapid-fire guns fixed forward and uses car-style steering.

  • Minelayer — Carries no gun and deals damage with proximity mines that stick to floors, walls, and ceilings.

  • Rammer — Carries no gun and attacks using a short boost charge that causes heavy contact damage.

The classes counter each other. Snipers punish players caught in the open. Karts and Rammers can get inside their range. Minelayers and Rammers can punish fast flankers.



USE THE ARENA

Mines can be destroyed by gunfire. Shoot an enemy mine to clear a path, or shoot your own mine when an opponent is nearby.

Arenas contain bounce pads, boost pads, conveyors, breakable cover, moving platforms, and hazards. A bounce pad can launch you from the floor to the ceiling or from one wall to another. A conveyor can carry you upside down along the ceiling. Breakable cover can create new routes during a match.

Some arenas are structures drifting in open space. You can drive around their outside, over the top, along the sides, and underneath, with a starfield extending beyond the edge. Weapons fire perfectly flat at any range. A Rammer can launch you far away from the structure. You have about five seconds to get back or you will die.



PLAY YOUR WAY

Team Deathmatch, Free-for-all, and Four-team cover the standard fights. Surface Paint uses the arena itself as the scoreboard. Floor Is Lava floods the floor, forcing everyone to climb onto the walls. Invasion is a cooperative survival mode against alien waves that crawl on the walls and ceilings. In WYRM, one player becomes a growing snake of tank segments that wraps across every surface and kills on contact. King of the Hill, Gun Game, Infection, and Racing complete the list.

Bots drive every class and use every surface, so they never sit idle on the floor. Difficulty ranges from an easy warm-up to a level that can defeat you. The entire game can be played offline against bots.

You can play through single-player story missions, practice against target dummies and spawnable bots, or take it online. A one-click scan finds LAN games on your network, and local splitscreen works in any mode on a single screen.



BUILD AND SHARE

A variety of hand-built arenas range from tight duel boxes to open fields and drifting wrecks. The built-in map editor allows you to create an arena and play it immediately, then share it through Steam Workshop.

You can design your own emblem, and it will appear on your vehicle for everyone online to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
Speed is the weapon.

Rior's Arena is a multiplayer movement shooter where positioning is something you do at 30 metres per second. Wallrun to hold height, slide cancel to keep speed through corners, grapple to close a gap or escape one, double jump to rewrite a duel. Use abilities and perks to define your loadout. 

What's actually in the build

  • 38 weapons, Magic grimoires, standard rifles, launchers, melee variations, the whole suite.

  • 16 abilities, 12 ultimates, 6 grenades, 46 perks — Unique character builds and player concepts.

  • 4 modes + a range: Team Deathmatch, FFA, Hardpoint, and Showdown a round based elimination mode where you start with one pistol and draft weapons, abilities, perks, and an ultimate as the rounds escalate.

  • 12 maps, from a night suburb to a canyon cut for grapple routes.

  • Bots that play the game: loadout archetypes, wallriding, grenades, objective anchoring, and Showdown lives. Host a lobby alone and you still get a match.

  • Cosmetics without a shop: 8 hats, 5 faceware, 6 body skins, 5 pilot models. Earned through natural progression

The feel

Fast TTKS, hero shooter style abilities to define your own kit, creativity is rewarded by strengthening a play style of your choice ^_^

store_data.about_the_game:
NEBULA BLINK is a real-time space-fleet tactics game where positioning is firepower. Command warships, carriers, strike craft and orbital installations through a 35-operation campaign fought from both sides of a galactic war.

A FLEET, NOT A DOOM STACK

  • Command formations: select several ships and they preserve their relative spacing around the lead vessel. Keep a battle line intact, split it to envelop, or concentrate it for a breakthrough.

  • Bring weapons to bear: guns fire from their actual mounts and arcs. Broadside launchers, all-round point defense and a front-only spinal beam all demand different headings.

  • Read the whole sector: radar, fog of war, contact records and terrain matter as much as the ship directly under your cursor.

EVERY SHOT HAS CONSEQUENCES

  • The Solray-class beam battleship's spinal weapon has an extremely narrow forward arc. Its beam pierces every unit on the line, including friendly ships.

  • Gravity lances are slow, scarce and punishing. Lead the target or turn the hull before the firing window closes.

  • Damage persists: fire slows reloads, fuel leaks shorten aircraft endurance, flight decks can be knocked offline, weapon mounts can be disabled or destroyed, and accumulated speed loss can stop a ship outright.

RUN THE CARRIER WAR

Carriers and orbital fortresses launch three kinds of craft: space-superiority fighters, humanoid assault craft and lance/bomb attackers. Choose aircraft and launch strength by hangar slot. Attackers can switch between Lance, Bomb and unarmed loadouts; changing the loadout imposes maintenance time, so commit before the next wave launches.

TEN TERRAIN TYPES

Fight across deep space, plasma belts, asteroids, asteroid fields, dark nebula masses, fortress walls, giant asteroids, debris fields, fortress cores and plasma streams. Depending on the terrain, ships may slow, accuracy may fall, projectiles may be blocked or detonated, and plasma streams can physically push ships and lances out of the flow.

35 OPERATIONS, TWO PERSPECTIVES

  • The first five operations are guided tutorials.

  • Complete all 35 operations as the Planetary Union to unlock the Galactic Empire campaign.

  • Replay the same war from the Empire side with its own progression and alternate briefings.

  • Each faction fields 16 unit types spanning warships, support vessels, facilities and strike craft.

POST-CAMPAIGN CREATION TOOLS

These tools unlock after completing both faction campaigns.

  • Unit Arsenal: edit hull, shield, speed, turn rate, armor, visibility, hangars, weapon statistics, firing arcs and mount positions.

  • Scenario Editor: paint a 360x270 sector, place both fleets, and configure victory conditions, time limits and reinforcements.

The configuration menu also includes editable terminology dictionaries for Japanese, English and Italian.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

Minimum target: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), 1280x720 display, HTML5 Canvas-capable graphics.

Single-player game. Network multiplayer is not included in this release.

AI USE, MODS AND RIGHTS

Parts of this work's production use AI-generated or AI-assisted content and tools, including Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude.

Purchasers may use this work with AI tools, including for AI learning or training, and may create, distribute or sell MODs and modified products at their own responsibility. You are responsible for legal compliance, third-party rights and the rules of any service or marketplace you use.

Copyright is not waived. Where reasonably possible, please identify NEBULA BLINK as the source and preserve relevant credits.

store_data.about_the_game:
Here is the text translated into English, maintaining the same structured formatting:

About the Game

Rise from nothing amidst a turbulent era to become a regional lord or the supreme ruler of the realm. "Revival of the Three Kingdoms" is an indie game combining strategic team battles and role-playing, featuring a unique visual aesthetic where ink wash art collides with minimalist tactics. Players will carve out their path in a chaotic world starting from scratch, with no territory, no army, and no fame. You can choose to develop quietly, pledge allegiance to a monarch, or venture out independently to conquer and plunder. This is a war simulation game that blends large-scale real-time combat, deep role management, dynamic faction interactions, and authentic sandbox strategy. The interface and battles adopt a visual style of circular unit collisions, where both soldiers and generals are represented as circular entities, delivering intense impact and a chaotic, realistic battlefield.

Journey of a Chaotic Era: Starting from Scratch

  • Choose different background origins before the game begins, which affect your starting location, attributes, and life starting point.

  • Character attributes include Strength (melee), Agility (ranged), Charisma (reduces soldier expenses and food consumption), and Intelligence (increases siege weapon power), with free point and skill allocation upon leveling up.

  • You can slowly build up your forces and get rich through trade, or directly pledge allegiance to a monarch, stepping up from a humble foot soldier to a high-ranking official.

Dynamic Factions and Moral Choices

  • There are five major factions on the map: Xuanheng, Qingwu, Chuanchuan, Yinyue, and Yunshao, each with unique unit types and dominant directions.

  • A favorability system exists with monarchs, generals, and villagers. Completing tasks increases favorability, while refusing decreases it. With sufficient favorability, you can officially join a monarch's command, and with high enough prestige, you can even be granted territory.

  • You can choose to rebel and become independent at any time; occupied villages and cities remain yours, allowing you to establish your own country name.

  • Dialogues and interactions with other characters genuinely affect your relationships with them, and characters with different personalities require different approaches.

Large-Scale Circular Unit Battles

  • Soldiers and generals on the battlefield are represented as circular entities, with up to hundreds of thousands of units appearing simultaneously, creating intense collision and impact sensations.

  • Field skirmishes and siege battles feature different scenarios and mechanics. During sieges, city gates have health pools, and troops automatically act according to unit traits (e.g., ranged units prioritizing distance maintenance).

  • Battles include a detailed statistics list displaying kills, damage output, and other data for each unit type and general.

  • Casualties are split evenly between deaths and severe injuries, with severely injured units requiring time to recover before re-entering battle.

  • Generals possess energy-charge skills, unleashing ultimate moves with dialogue special effects when their rage is full.

Deep Management and Sandbox Control

  • Recruitment: Villages can perform regular recruitment or forced conscription (the latter is fast but lowers favorability and prosperity), while city conscription has a larger scale but higher costs. Unit types can be upgraded along branches, with costs increasing by tier.

  • Trade: Inventory space is limited, though soldiers can increase carrying capacity. Commodity price differences among the five major nations are significant, allowing wealth to be accumulated through trade, though you will encounter bandits on the road.

  • Construction: After occupying a village, you can arrange villagers to chop wood, quarry stone, reclaim farmland, and build defense facilities; cities can construct blacksmith shops, upgrade city gates, and build arrow towers, etc.

  • Food and Morale: Without food, soldiers will desert or even starve to death; heavy casualties or prolonged food shortages will drastically lower morale, thereby affecting combat effectiveness.

  • Captives: After winning, you can capture enemy troops, sell them to slave merchants, or attempt to persuade them to surrender.

Rich General and Quest Systems

  • A large number of wandering generals exist on the world map; some have turned to banditry, while others wait in taverns for a discerning master. They can be recruited through money or persuaded after defeat.

  • Generals have moral alignments, and player actions influence who is willing to follow them. Recruited generals may also leave due to ideological differences, requiring interactions to change their attitude.

  • The quest system includes beginner tutorials, tavern commissions, and monarch orders (such as grain transport, troop recruitment, and attacking villages), which can be checked at any time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Paint the World. Master the Elements. Rescue Your Sister.

Bassai-Dai is a stylized single-player action-adventure where ink is more than a power: it is your language, your weapon, and your way forward. Wield a legendary brush to reshape the world in real time, draw paths across the landscape, solve elemental puzzles, and unleash expressive combat in a vibrant universe inspired by Greek and Japanese aesthetics.
Every stroke matters. Every battle rewards creativity. Every kingdom hides secrets waiting to be revealed by ink.

A Single-Player Adventure With Creativity at Its Core

Bassai-Dai is made for players who love:

  • Action-adventure games

  • Puzzle exploration

  • Elemental powers

  • Expressive combat

  • Secrets, lore, and progression-driven discovery

Step into a world where brushstrokes become power, puzzles become language, and every kingdom invites you to paint your own path.

Solve challenging environemental puzzles with your ink

In Bassai-Dai, ink is the primary language of puzzles. Each kingdom teaches a different elemental logic, and each challenge invites you to think, experiment, and combine powers in clever ways.
Master the forces of nature through puzzles based on:

  • Fire : ignition, heat, timing, melting

  • Water : flow, freezing, reflection, buoyancy

  • Earth : weight, stability, ancient machinery, hidden paths

  • Wind : momentum, air currents, balance, vertical traversal

A Journey Through a Hand-Painted World

Bassai-Dai features regional hubs connected to branching sub-areas, encouraging exploration and return visits as new powers unlock new possibilities.
Return to earlier areas with stronger elemental abilities to:

  • Discover hidden shortcuts

  • Uncover optional challenges

  • Access new secret routes

  • Solve previously unreachable puzzles

  • Reveal lore and worldbuilding details

A character-driven story

In a world where only a chosen few can wield the 5 elements of nature, Void and his sister Rainbow live quietly near a small town rebuilding after a natural disaster.

Reserved and withdrawn, Void finds comfort in Rainbow’s warmth and adventurous curiosity.

But their fragile peace is shattered when a mysterious enemy invades the village and kidnaps Rainbow.

Void must now step outside his comfort zone, face a world he tried to avoid, and find the courage to rescue his sister while uncovering the truth behind the elemental powers within him.

store_data.about_the_game:
Follow Eclipse—

Following those words left behind in a letter, Rozet sets out on a journey to find Philae, the childhood friend he grew up with. In a society where the order built by the mafia has been torn down by the people's violence and a new order is taking shape, his journey becomes entangled with the lives of others who carry pasts they cannot cut away. Io, unable to escape a world of violence; Tethys, consumed by revenge—theirs were paths that should never have crossed, yet, told across shifting points of view, they gradually converge into one.

Novel × Card Battle

This is a card RPG divided into a novel part and a battle part.

  • Battles are a card game built on blackjack and dice.

  • Use the attack and defense cards in your hand to fight enemies.

  • Each card's value shifts depending on your dice rolls.

  • The closer your cards total to 21, the more effects you gain to turn the battle in your favor.

  • Take down enemies by making full use of character and card skills—while being careful not to bust.

This is a single-player game.
Playtime is around 5 hours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Subcraft is a co-op submarine adventure. Pilot your submarine beneath a frozen alien world, explore dangerous caves, mine valuable resources and fight the creatures lurking below.

Bring what you find back to the surface, help rebuild a civilisation trapped in an endless ice age, then prepare your crew to dive even deeper.

Dive Into the Unknown

Your submarine is your crew's lifeline.

Travel together into a vast underground world, navigating submerged caves and stopping along the way to explore on foot. Leave the safety of the sub to mine resources, investigate strange locations and deal with whatever you find down there.

The deeper you go, the more dangerous things become.
Work Together as a Crew

Subcraft is built around multiplayer crews of up to 5 players.

Explore with friends or join other adventurers, then work together to keep your expedition moving. One moment you're peacefully travelling through the depths, the next your crew is scrambling to deal with whatever has gone horribly wrong

Discover a Strange Frozen World

Long ago, humans colonised this planet when it was a lush paradise.

Then they disturbed something living deep beneath the surface.

The creature plunged the planet into an endless ice age, destroying its natural plants and animals and leaving much of civilisation in ruins. The survivors turned to machinery, building mechanical creatures and artificial life to replace what had been lost.

Now, generations later, adventurers are descending beneath the ice in search of the resources needed to rebuild.

Key Features

  • Online multiplayer - Explore the world together aboard a shared submarine.

  • Submarine expeditions - Descend beneath the frozen surface and navigate an underground world.

  • Explore outside the sub - Leave your vessel to explore caves, mine resources, and discover new areas.

  • Fight strange creatures - The depths aren't as empty as humanity once thought.

  • Gather resources - Bring valuable materials back from your expeditions.

  • Quests and characters - Meet the unusual people and mechanical inhabitants of the frozen world.

  • Fishing! - Because saving civilisation can wait when the fish are biting.

  • An expanding world - Discover new places, creatures and mysteries as you venture deeper.

store_data.about_the_game:
Greedy and arrogant heroes care only about treasure and glory. They don't care that they're invading your home and disturbing your sleep - or that all you want is a quiet, peaceful life.

Grumpy Hero Grinder is a tower defense roguelite with real-time top-down combat. Build a deadly defense, shape enemy routes, and personally smash the crowds.

BUILD THE GRINDER

Each wave, draft traps and fortifications from a random selection, then combine them with each other and with the dungeon itself. Slow heroes in narrow passages, launch them into pits or lava, and let ballistas, slam plates, sawblades, and other defenses finish the job. Upgrade your traps to change how they work and make your grinder even deadlier!

STRATEGY AND EXPLORATION

Expand your randomly generated dungeon. Every new sector brings a reward and a challenge, changing the dungeon you must defend. Choose where to go next and encounter quests, traders, treasures, hidden passages, and more.

Build mines and forts, reinforce key positions with your minions, and pull levers to change routes. Redirect the heroes into a trap or simply cause a few extra casualties.

FIGHT AS THE BOSS

When your traps and minions are not enough, step in and do the dirty work yourself. Shape your playstyle by choosing perks, spells, weapons, and other equipment. Fight from a distance or charge into melee and smash through the crowd.

Knock heroes into hazards, rally your minions, and protect your Spark.

PERMANENT PROGRESSION AND LORE

Defeat is not the end. Return to your underworld base, where Mother Abyss will give you another Spark. Help those you meet, unlock permanent upgrades, return stronger, and uncover what is going on down there…

Grind heroes and get back to your well-deserved nap.

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE INSTALL. EVERYONE ELSE SCANS THE CODE.

Space Couch Command turns your living room into a starship's bridge. Install it once on the computer attached to your TV, and that screen becomes the viewscreen.

  • Your crew installs nothing. They scan the code on the screen and their own device becomes their station: phone, tablet, old laptop, anything with a modern browser on your network.
  • No second copy, no controllers to buy, no accounts, no app store.
  • Not all in one room? Invite friends through Steam and crew up from anywhere; remote players run the game themselves, so those need a copy each.

Just people and the screens already in your house.

A CREW OF 1 TO 9

Pick a hull to fit the room.

  • Five stations for a full bridge. Helm, Tactical, Engineering, Science, Comms.
  • Smaller hulls merge those duties into fewer consoles — a pilot-gunner, a science-and-comms officer — so four, three or two people still crew a whole ship.
  • A one-seat skiff puts the whole ship under one pair of hands when you fly alone.
  • Four extra gun seats on every hull. Nine people fit on one ship.

THE BRIDGE ONLY WORKS IF YOU TALK

Science's scan is what reveals an enemy's subsystems — so Tactical can't pick a target apart until Science calls out what's there.

Engineering decides who gets power while the core heat climbs toward the red line, and life support is a breaker one person is responsible for. Comms hears the pirate's demand and has to relay it before the window drains.

When the shields buckle and the reactor's redlining and someone's yelling "HARD TO STARBOARD," nobody is looking at their own screen any more.

YOUR STATION

  • Helm. Fly, run evasive, jump, and plot the next system. Carries the forward-fixed railgun, aimed by pointing the whole hull, plus flares and a jammer against incoming missiles. Flip the map to the PARASCOPE cockpit view and put it on the big screen, so the whole room flies with you.
  • Tactical. Hold the lock, and pick an enemy apart subsystem by subsystem once Science has resolved it. Phaser banks, torpedo tubes with a real arming delay to set, a missile rack, a rocket pod.
  • Engineering. A live power budget, reactor heat, overclock and a deliberate vent cycle, damage control that spends salvage, and a conduit-rerouting minigame when something knocks a system offline.
  • Science. Scan anomalies, derelicts and unknown contacts, chase quest threads, decode the archive, and fly the probe when it is time to go inside.
  • Comms. Pirates demand tribute; pay, refuse, or bluff about what ship this is. Beaten enemies hail to surrender, and sometimes they are lying. Jam their calls for reinforcements, and work the passive ears channel where enemy chatter leaks intent. Factions remember how you treat them. And when something not human opens a channel, what you say next is the whole encounter.
  • Cannoneer seats. Dead-simple gun seats for the youngest hands. A cannoneer takes over a phaser bank and fires it at Tactical's lock. Aiming stays Tactical's job, so a kid with one button is adding real damage.

DEATH IS PERMANENT

Every session is a run through a procedural galaxy: jump between systems, follow faint signals, and slip through wormholes to the edges of the map. Name your ship before you launch; that name is your save slot, and the run waits while the crew sleeps.

Death is permanent and deletes the ship. But banked salvage, refits and every fragment of the alien archive you recover carry forward. The next crew starts with the guns you paid for.

THE VOID

An amber CRT flickers awake: PRIORITY ONE, from Fleet Command. Something is out there, a patch of pure nothing that returns no mass, no light, no signal, on a heading for the inner colonies. Your ship is the closest.

What you find is a cloaked ark the size of a small moon, and a sleeping people inside it: the Ossari, fleeing something that takes matter apart and does not stop. The crew stops translating the record's word for it aloud.

Investigation becomes evacuation. You cannot win this. The hulls it converts turn up in the enemy packs, and the truth surfaces piece by piece: a half-decoded transmission, a scrap of salvage that shouldn't exist.

Nothing gory: the enemy eats matter, not people. The horror is what the instruments don't show you.

SEND THE PROBE

Some wrecks won't give up what's inside them from the outside. You carry two survey probes. That is it, until you find or buy more.

  • Science flies it. A real-time crawl through a venting, collapsing interior on a bare vision cone, in the dark. Everything you do makes noise, and the noise meter is the whole game.
  • Comms runs the scope. Fuzzed echoes, never exact, of whatever is down there. Plus a manual PING that lights up every hazard, cache and exit, and pulls the hunter straight to you.
  • Something is in there with it — and you don't know until it moves. It wakes to noise, prowls, and shadows the edge of your cone. Corners, silence and the loops in the map are how you survive it.

ONE INSTALL. EVERYONE ELSE SCANS THE CODE.

Space Couch Command turns your living room into a starship's bridge. Install it once on the computer attached to your TV, and that screen becomes the viewscreen.

  • Your crew installs nothing. They scan the code on the screen and their own device becomes their station: phone, tablet, old laptop, anything with a modern browser on your network.
  • No second copy, no controllers to buy, no accounts, no app store.
  • Not all in one room? Invite friends through Steam and crew up from anywhere; remote players run the game themselves, so those need a copy each.

Just people and the screens already in your house.

A CREW OF 1 TO 9

Pick a hull to fit the room.

  • Five stations for a full bridge. Helm, Tactical, Engineering, Science, Comms.
  • Smaller hulls merge those duties into fewer consoles — a pilot-gunner, a science-and-comms officer — so four, three or two people still crew a whole ship.
  • A one-seat skiff puts the whole ship under one pair of hands when you fly alone.
  • Four extra gun seats on every hull. Nine people fit on one ship.

THE BRIDGE ONLY WORKS IF YOU TALK

Science's scan is what reveals an enemy's subsystems — so Tactical can't pick a target apart until Science calls out what's there.

Engineering decides who gets power while the core heat climbs toward the red line, and life support is a breaker one person is responsible for. Comms hears the pirate's demand and has to relay it before the window drains.

When the shields buckle and the reactor's redlining and someone's yelling "HARD TO STARBOARD," nobody is looking at their own screen any more.

YOUR STATION

  • Helm. Fly, run evasive, jump, and plot the next system. Carries the forward-fixed railgun, aimed by pointing the whole hull, plus flares and a jammer against incoming missiles. Flip the map to the PARASCOPE cockpit view and put it on the big screen, so the whole room flies with you.
  • Tactical. Hold the lock, and pick an enemy apart subsystem by subsystem once Science has resolved it. Phaser banks, torpedo tubes with a real arming delay to set, a missile rack, a rocket pod.
  • Engineering. A live power budget, reactor heat, overclock and a deliberate vent cycle, damage control that spends salvage, and a conduit-rerouting minigame when something knocks a system offline.
  • Science. Scan anomalies, derelicts and unknown contacts, chase quest threads, decode the archive, and fly the probe when it is time to go inside.
  • Comms. Pirates demand tribute; pay, refuse, or bluff about what ship this is. Beaten enemies hail to surrender, and sometimes they are lying. Jam their calls for reinforcements, and work the passive ears channel where enemy chatter leaks intent. Factions remember how you treat them. And when something not human opens a channel, what you say next is the whole encounter.
  • Cannoneer seats. Dead-simple gun seats for the youngest hands. A cannoneer takes over a phaser bank and fires it at Tactical's lock. Aiming stays Tactical's job, so a kid with one button is adding real damage.

DEATH IS PERMANENT

Every session is a run through a procedural galaxy: jump between systems, follow faint signals, and slip through wormholes to the edges of the map. Name your ship before you launch; that name is your save slot, and the run waits while the crew sleeps.

Death is permanent and deletes the ship. But banked salvage, refits and every fragment of the alien archive you recover carry forward. The next crew starts with the guns you paid for.

THE VOID

An amber CRT flickers awake: PRIORITY ONE, from Fleet Command. Something is out there, a patch of pure nothing that returns no mass, no light, no signal, on a heading for the inner colonies. Your ship is the closest.

What you find is a cloaked ark the size of a small moon, and a sleeping people inside it: the Ossari, fleeing something that takes matter apart and does not stop. The crew stops translating the record's word for it aloud.

Investigation becomes evacuation. You cannot win this. The hulls it converts turn up in the enemy packs, and the truth surfaces piece by piece: a half-decoded transmission, a scrap of salvage that shouldn't exist.

Nothing gory: the enemy eats matter, not people. The horror is what the instruments don't show you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shattered‑Realm Corridor is a fast-paced first-person action roguelike set in a decaying post-apocalyptic world built for high-speed parkour and combat.

Core Gameplay

- Fluid fast-paced combat & movement：Slide, dash, and run across walls while engaging enemies in relentless high-speed combat.

- Loot extraction & gear progression loop：Collect loot during each run. Successfully extract to sell your spoils for funds and purchase new equipment for your next attempt. If you die, all collected loot and your carried gear will be lost completely.

- Procedurally assembled levels：Every run features uniquely stitched terrain layouts, paired with a diverse arsenal of weapons and distinct enemy types.

- Score-based endless challenge：Push your limits, refine your movement and combat skills, and strive for higher scores in every trial.

World Lore

Abyssglow：Mysterious luminous blue particles descending from the void, weaving mesmerizing illusions and silently eroding all living matter. The surface world is entirely engulfed by Abyssglow. Beautiful yet deadly, the once vibrant land has become a forbidden zone for all life. Humanity has abandoned the surface entirely, retreating into massive underground realms to survive on remnants of old-world resources.

Trapped in dim, resource-scarcity underground sanctuaries, humans dare not step foot on the Abyssglow-corrupted surface. Thus, a new profession was born — the Machine Tamer.

Machine Tamer：Abyssglow severely disrupts all wireless signals, rendering remote real-time control of surface machines impossible. Every combat and resource-collection robot deployed to the surface must undergo complete independent training inside a virtual simulator, developing its own autonomous behavioral logic before deployment.

This simulated training ground is known as Shattered‑Realm Corridor.

Shattered‑Realm Corridor：An infinitely extending realm constructed from procedurally stitched terrain. The simulator replicates all deadly threats of the Abyssglow surface: floating luminous particles, dynamically spawning corrupted AI enemies, and hazardous terrain.

As a Machine Tamer, you train robot AIs through endless trials — guiding them through high-speed parkour, complex terrain traversal, intense combat, weapon proficiency, and the elimination of Abyssglow-corrupted creatures.

This process is not rigid coding, but genuine taming. You observe, correct, and polish the AI’s instincts and combat judgment. Some AIs fall into Abyssglow-induced virtual delusions, suffering program-level “spiritual corruption” and failing their training permanently.

Only AIs that overcome all trials of the Shattered‑Realm Corridor earn deployment rights to the perilous surface.

store_data.about_the_game:
A small indie game made by a solo developer. A roguelike card battler where you gather cards to advance through endless rooms. Violet Stardust is a roguelike card game where both the creatures you command and the places you explore are cards.

Build a deck of strange creatures, play Room Cards to determine where your journey takes you, and fight your way through an unpredictable world filled with dangerous enemies, valuable discoveries, and powerful opportunities to reshape your deck.

EXPLORE THROUGH CARDS

Your Room Deck determines the path ahead. Play Room Cards to travel to new locations, encounter enemies, search for new cards, recover from previous battles, and discover opportunities to craft.

When it's time to move on, choose new rooms to add to your deck and gradually shape the world you'll encounter.

But danger follows you. Certain rooms bring you closer to a powerful boss, forcing you to decide how far you're willing to push your run before facing what awaits.

BUILD YOUR CREATURE DECK

Collect creature cards with different attack values, health, and special abilities.

Combat takes place across a battlefield of lanes where positioning matters. Place your creatures carefully, block incoming attacks, break through enemy defenses, and strike your opponent directly.

Some cards are powerful on their own. Others become dangerous when combined with the right abilities and strategies.

CRAFT SOMETHING NEW

Cards aren't always permanent.

Combine Room Cards to create entirely new locations, transfer abilities between creature cards, and merge matching cards to strengthen your deck.

Experiment with different combinations and turn the cards you find during each run into a deck capable of surviving increasingly dangerous encounters.

DISCOVER CARDS FOR FUTURE RUNS

Not everything disappears when a run ends.

Discover the mysterious Printing Press and use it to preserve cards you've found, permanently unlocking them as options for your future starting decks.

With each run, you'll discover more of Violet Stardust's world and gain new possibilities for the next.

FEATURES

  • Roguelike deck building with randomized runs

  • Two interconnected decks: Room Cards and Creature Cards

  • Lane based tactical card combat

  • Dozens of creatures with unique stats and abilities

  • Room crafting that creates new locations

  • Creature crafting and ability combinations

  • Boss encounters that build throughout each run

  • Permanent card discovery and starter deck progression

  • Retro pixel art presentation

  • A strange world filled with secrets, creatures, and unexpected combinations

It’s time you outsmarted a chess engine. Computers have reigned supreme in humanity’s most prestigious strategy game for too long. Level the playing field with digestible insights into chess engine strategy and game-changing Techniques.

Matches play like normal chess, but the opponent’s moves are telegraphed and they won’t know what you’ve got up your sleeve. Analyze upcoming moves and come up with crushing tactics to gain an insurmountable advantage.

With each victory gain Insight based on the Tributes you’ve given the engine and spend them to unlock new Techniques. With smart choices and careful planning, you just might be able to beat Stockfish.

  • Focus on setting up tactics without getting bogged down in calculations

  • Ramp up the difficulty of each run with Edicts

  • Finish runs in 15-40 minutes

  • Set high scores in challenge mode

store_data.about_the_game:
"Pray that your god makes me choose the number you have chosen."

The Inquisitor says it every time. He is not being cruel. He is being thorough.

FOUND A CULT. BRING SPARES.

Name your cult. Name your followers. Choose two sacred colours, and decide how large a flock to bring along. Ten, if you like a brisk service. Sixty-nine, for an exact coin flip. A million, if you intend to be remembered.

Then you pray. You choose a number, one of a hundred; the Inquisitor chooses one too, after you, always after you, with a die that does not cheat. Miss, and a follower is quietly removed from the register, with a footnote. Miss again, and he reaches for a fresh form.

HIT, AND HEAVEN DOES THE REST

Guess right and your god finally answers, by removing the Inquisitor from the premises. Lightning from a clear sky, to begin with. There are 16 ways for this to happen, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, and you do not get to choose which one you get. Not usually.

THE HALL OF FAME REMEMBERS

Every cult you found gets an entry, and every cult that doesn't work out gets a slightly longer one. Six plaques for six kinds of misfortune: the swiftest miracle, the longest calvary, the largest flock ever misplaced, the most numbers missed by exactly one. The crypt files your former cults in their own sacred colours. It is the tidiest cemetery in the business.

Your god keeps no records. The Inquisitor does.

THE DIE IS HONEST. THAT IS THE JOKE.

No rigged odds, no hidden mercy, no difficulty quietly helping you along. The number is drawn after you commit, and reloading a save will not let you try your luck twice. Everything that happens to you is exactly as likely as it looks, which is the funniest and least comforting fact in this game.

ALSO INCLUDED

  • 36 achievements, most of them awarded for things that went badly

  • A new cult every two to four minutes, and about a hundred prayers filed before one is granted

  • A chiptune organ that takes all of this far too seriously

  • Ten save slots, autosaved, and no way to un-pray a prayer

  • An Inquisitor with over fifty ways of telling you no

HOW MANY PRAYERS?

A prayer takes seconds. A miracle takes about a hundred prayers. I keep sixteen obituaries on file, all of them mine, and which one you get is drawn, never chosen. I am in no hurry to show you the rest. Some cults I close before your coffee goes cold. Others outlive their founder's patience. There is no last page to reach. There are sixteen, and they arrive when they see fit.

Pray Your God! A game of faith, numbers and mild irreverence.

No rigged odds, no hidden mercy, no difficulty quietly helping you along. The number is drawn after you commit, and reloading a save will not let you try your luck twice. Everything that happens to you is exactly as likely as it looks, which is the funniest and least comforting fact in this game.

ALSO INCLUDED

  • 36 achievements, most of them awarded for things that went badly

  • A new cult every two to four minutes, and about a hundred prayers filed before one is granted

  • A chiptune organ that takes all of this far too seriously

  • Ten save slots, autosaved, and no way to un-pray a prayer

  • An Inquisitor with over fifty ways of telling you no

HOW MANY PRAYERS?

A prayer takes seconds. A miracle takes about a hundred prayers. I keep sixteen obituaries on file, all of them mine, and which one you get is drawn, never chosen. I am in no hurry to show you the rest. Some cults I close before your coffee goes cold. Others outlive their founder's patience. There is no last page to reach. There are sixteen, and they arrive when they see fit.

Pray Your God! A game of faith, numbers and mild irreverence.
store_data.short_description: You will choose a number. I will choose one too. Should your god make them agree, heaven removes me in ways I would rather not describe. Should it not, and it will not, you lose a follower. Found your cult. The paperwork is ready.

store_data.about_the_game:
Five childhood friends, lending a hand for the town where they grew up.

A provincial town wrapped in quiet stagnation.
In one corner stands a fading secondhand bookshop.
The five childhood friends who gather here unravel the small scandals brought to their door.

Their only weapons are the books on the shelves.
Confronted with evidence,
people will not let go of their own story.
Only when books from distant fields say the same thing does the other's claim fall apart.

During Investigation, decide where to send each of the five friends to gather information.
Where you dispatch whom changes how the case unfolds — reading each friend's chemistry
with the people involved is the key to cracking a case.

Once the clues are in hand, it's time for Confrontation.
Armed with what the books have taught you,
choose your words and break down the suspect's walls.
The goal isn't to corner them — it's to reach the real reason hidden behind their story.

Each case runs about 5–10 minutes.
Across these easygoing short stories, the five leads, the world of books,
and the lives of the townspeople quietly unfold.

Features

- 15 cases, 60 books across 14 shelves, 21 suspects — every case rewards a different combination of clues

- Three difficulty levels (Easy / Normal / Hard). Hard hides the predicted outcome, leaving you to rely on instinct and experience

- Full controller support — navigate, confirm, and even quit entirely with a gamepad

- Available in 11 languages, including English, Japanese, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Indonesian, and Georgian

This game was made with the help of generative AI. Character and background art were created with ChatGPT (image generation), music with SOUNDRAW (AI music generation), and translations other than Japanese are machine-generated via ChatGPT (in languages other than English and Chinese, some wording may read unnaturally). All of these were generated during development and are bundled with the game — no AI runs while you play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to CiaoCARGO

Experience the satisfaction of flawless maneuvering. Set against the charming, narrow streets of Italy, this is a highly polished, minimalist 2D top-down truck driving simulator that tests your spatial awareness and precision.

It’s not just about getting from point A to point B. It’s about mastering the physics of a heavy vehicle. Calculate your turning radius, manage complex reverse maneuvers with a semi-trailer, and squeeze through tight alleys where every millimeter counts.

Two Distinct Game Modes:

  • Zen Mode: A purely relaxing, cozy experience. No timers, no pressure, no fail states. Just you, the truck, and the pure joy of solving spatial puzzles at your own pace.

  • Time Attack: For the hardcore drivers. Race against the clock, optimize your routes, master the throttle, and push your precision driving to the absolute limit.

Key Features:

  • Pure Physics-Based Maneuvering: Realistic trailer articulation and weight feel that rewards methodical driving.

  • Minimalist Italian Aesthetics: A clean, zero-clutter 2D vector art style that reads perfectly and never distracts from the gameplay.

  • Highly Polished Experience: Built from the ground up for maximum performance. Enjoy a flawlessly smooth, stutter-free experience with an ultra-lightweight memory footprint.

store_data.about_the_game:
RIPGRAZE is a short arcade score-attack set in a shifting deep sea.

One click or Space flips gravity. You do not survive by staying in the middle. You survive by grazing — slipping past reefs and jellyfish close enough to steal power.

Graze to charge OVERDRIVE. When the gauge is full, right-click to fire it. Time stretches, the world inverts, and your score multiplies. Fail to graze and you stall.

The deeper you dive, the more the sea changes: color, creatures, rock silhouettes. Easy, Normal, and Hard share the same loop with different bite. Three lives. Instant retry. Unlock skins as you go.

This is a few-minute run you can replay. Keyboard and mouse only. No in-app purchases.

store_data.about_the_game:
When Totality Ends, Loureira Has to Live With What Comes Next


On the Atlantic cliffs of Galicia, Nuno Ferreiro built a quiet life around eight guest rooms and an old telescope. Then his twenty-year pursuit of a perfect total eclipse put Loureira on the world's map. Thirty-eight thousand visitors arrive in a village built for eight hundred, and after 106 seconds of totality, the only road out collapses into the sea.

Stranded behind the festival perimeter, Nuno must face a village under pressure, the consequences of his own enthusiasm, and three women who challenge what he thought this impossible week would mean.

Meet the Cast




Candela Mouriño — The Till

The owner of Bar Mouriño and a parish councillor, Candela has spent fifteen years arguing with Nuno in public. Fiercely competent and brutally funny, she knows every favor, debt, and grudge in Loureira. Their route begins with friction, pride, and a shared decision they both must answer for.



Bruna Vidal — The Gate

Umbra Live's site and access producer is the face the village has decided to hate. Bruna keeps people safe through headcounts, wristbands, and hard decisions, but the stranded community will barely sell her bread. Nuno opens his door, beginning a forbidden relationship under constant public scrutiny.



Sabela Caeiro — The Line

A rope-access technician and eclipse-chaser, Sabela left Loureira at nineteen and built a life around height, movement, and departure. Her return begins as an effortless friendship with Nuno, then becomes more complicated when they recognize how much they share—and how ready she remains to leave.

Key Features


  • Experience an adult romance visual novel set during the aftermath of a total eclipse.
  • Choose among three distinct romance routes: Bruna, Sabela, and Candela.
  • Navigate a Galician village strained by overtourism, rationed water, crowded streets, and community conflict.
  • Make choices that shape Nuno's relationships and who he stands beside when Loureira votes on its future.
  • Follow character-driven dialogue mixing tension, grounded humor, and romance.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes. All characters are adults.

store_data.about_the_game:
凡人寿数有尽，大道仙途无穷。

你将从练气境的一介修士开始，在吐纳修炼与一次次突破中积累道行。前往十五处历练之地迎战妖兽与首领，深入上古秘境和诸天秘域寻找机缘；也可回到洞府，播种灵田、开采灵矿、炼制丹药、锻造装备，为下一次渡劫做好准备。

《万古仙途》以持续成长为核心，但决定你能走多远的并不只有时间。五行灵根塑造人物根基，主动技能与被动功法决定战斗方向，随机属性装备、法宝、神石与套装仙宝带来层层构筑。不同系统彼此相连：历练所得可以支撑洞府经营，洞府产出又会帮助你突破境界、打造装备并挑战更深层的敌人。

当这一世抵达难以跨越的瓶颈，你可以选择重修。修为、资源与装备将重新开始，但此世成就会化作仙缘，带来永久修炼、人物属性、掉落、资源产出与灵根强化。重修不是简单归零，而是以一世积累换取下一世更广阔的可能。

从练气、筑基、金丹，一路跨越凡仙之隔，直至太乙金仙。有人一世登临绝巅，也有人以万世叩问大道——这条仙途，由你自己书写。

游戏特色

从练气到太乙金仙

十五个大境界构成完整成长阶梯。积累修为、炼制渡劫丹、承受天劫代价，在循序渐进的节奏中不断解锁新的地图、资源与养成系统。

五行灵根与多线构筑

金、木、水、火、土灵根共同影响人物的气血、根骨、身形与神识。创角天赋、后天灵根、主动技能、被动功法和仙缘能力可以相互组合，形成不同的修炼与战斗路线。

修炼之外，也要经营自己的洞府

种植渡劫所需灵药，开采锻造矿材，升级丹炉、炼制修为丹与属性丹。洞府不是独立小游戏，而是支撑突破、装备打造和长期成长的重要一环。

层层深入的回合战斗

从常规历练到上古秘境、诸天秘域与道途挑战，不同层级的敌人带来持续推进的战斗目标。搭配技能、调整属性、积累回复与爆发能力，突破下一道战力门槛。

装备、法宝与稀有至宝

收集带有随机品质和属性的装备，进行强化、重铸、打孔与神石镶嵌；激活各具效果的法宝与套装仙宝，追寻境界唯一的稀有至宝。每一次掉落，都可能改变当前构筑。

一世结束，是下一世的开始

通过重修获得永久保留的仙缘点，强化修炼速度、人物属性、掉落效率、资源收益与灵根潜力，并解锁改变后续轮回的道果天赋。不断优化成长路线，挑战比上一世更远的仙途。

离线也在修行

无需持续盯住屏幕。离线期间修为与部分经营资源会继续结算；重新归来后，你可以集中处理突破、装备、洞府与挑战选择。

十五个大境界构成完整成长阶梯。积累修为、炼制渡劫丹、承受天劫代价，在循序渐进的节奏中不断解锁新的地图、资源与养成系统。

五行灵根与多线构筑

金、木、水、火、土灵根共同影响人物的气血、根骨、身形与神识。创角天赋、后天灵根、主动技能、被动功法和仙缘能力可以相互组合，形成不同的修炼与战斗路线。

修炼之外，也要经营自己的洞府

种植渡劫所需灵药，开采锻造矿材，升级丹炉、炼制修为丹与属性丹。洞府不是独立小游戏，而是支撑突破、装备打造和长期成长的重要一环。

层层深入的回合战斗

从常规历练到上古秘境、诸天秘域与道途挑战，不同层级的敌人带来持续推进的战斗目标。搭配技能、调整属性、积累回复与爆发能力，突破下一道战力门槛。

装备、法宝与稀有至宝

收集带有随机品质和属性的装备，进行强化、重铸、打孔与神石镶嵌；激活各具效果的法宝与套装仙宝，追寻境界唯一的稀有至宝。每一次掉落，都可能改变当前构筑。

一世结束，是下一世的开始

通过重修获得永久保留的仙缘点，强化修炼速度、人物属性、掉落效率、资源收益与灵根潜力，并解锁改变后续轮回的道果天赋。不断优化成长路线，挑战比上一世更远的仙途。

离线也在修行

无需持续盯住屏幕。离线期间修为与部分经营资源会继续结算；重新归来后，你可以集中处理突破、装备、洞府与挑战选择。
store_data.short_description: 览凡仙迢迢道境，观万灵碌碌浮生。 从练气起步，在修炼、经营、战斗与收集之间建立自己的成长循环；当此世仙途抵达瓶颈，便以重修换取永久仙缘，让下一世走得更远。
