store_data.about_the_game:
Blackmere is a dark, ever changing dungeon where the corridors don't simply lead somewhere they respond to you. The deeper you go, the more the dungeon seems to understand that you're there.

EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN

Descend through five dangerous floors, searching abandoned expeditions, solving environmental challenges, and discovering the fate of those who came before you.

THE BLACK SUN

Carry the Black Sun, a mysterious artifact that reveals what ordinary light cannot.

Its strange power can expose hidden paths and phantom ledges, but its answers are temporary.

Move while it is speaking.

FACE WHAT CAME BEFORE

The creatures haunting Blackmere may not be monsters in the traditional sense.

They are remnants of the expeditions that came before you — explorers who entered the depths and never returned.

Each encounter reveals another piece of what happened below.

OPEN THE GATE

At the deepest point lies an ancient iron gate.

It has been holding something back for a very long time.

Find what you need, open the gate, and face whatever has been waiting beyond it.

But remember: the gate was built to keep something inside.

DESCEND. DISCOVER. SURVIVE.

  • Five floors.

  • Lost explorers.

  • One sealed gate.

  • And something waiting in the dark.

Blackmere is listening

store_data.about_the_game:
In 2020, at the height of the rainy season, a massive system failure struck a major sorting facility. Every single robotic worker broke down simultaneously. While the cause remains unknown, the assembly line cannot stand idle. You've been brought in as temporary help for just 5 days while tech support restores the system. Your directive is simple: clock in for 5 shifts, complete a few minor tasks, and head back home to your family with a clean conscience.

But don't expect easy money. The facility is long overdue for a major overhaul, the power grid is pushed to its absolute limit, and strange noises echo through the pitch-black corridors. These 5 days will become a true test of survival.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE CLOSED WORLD OF HALF HOUR RPG!

The world has been precisely designed so it doesn't need to be open.

Half Hour RPG is a hand-asset-flipped RPG designed with uncompromising respect for your time. It delivers an epic adventure without asking you to reorganize your life around it.

It's a complete RPG experience stripped of everything that might unnecessarily distract you from what truly matters in every game — seeing the end credits.

KEY FEATURES

  • Up to 30 minutes of epic adventure. We've concentrated the entire adventure into a timeframe you can still reasonably justify to your family.

  • Compact world design. The world has been carefully designed so you don't need fast travel to reach another part of it. In most cases, selecting a fast travel point would take longer than simply walking there.

  • Hand-asset-flipped world. Instead of wasting years creating everything from scratch, we used proven solutions made by people who knew what they were doing and apparently had the time.

  • ZERO CRAFTING. One of Half Hour RPG's most advanced systems. It requires absolutely no player interaction.

  • No gathering of crafting materials. Wood stays in the forest. Ore stays in the ground. Wolves get to keep their skins. We respect your time.

  • No upgrading your crafting table. Mainly because there is no crafting table.

  • Classic turn-based combat. No reflexes, perfect parries, or memorizing fourteen-button combos required. The system was chosen specifically so we wouldn't have to implement any of that — and so you can eat pizza between attacks.

  • Visible enemies. No random encounters means you always know exactly how many problems are still standing between you and the end credits.

  • Carefully limited enemy variety. Enough to provide variety without unnecessarily raising expectations that something new might appear later.

  • Zero grinding. You can't spend two hours fighting the same enemy because the game will end long before that.

  • No survival mechanics. We won't simulate hunger, thirst, temperature, exhaustion, or vitamin D deficiency during a thirty-minute adventure.

  • No base building. By the time you finished building one, you should already be watching the end credits.

  • No procedurally generated open world. Every part of the world has been placed exactly where we found it while browsing stock maps.

  • Minimalist map interface. Our world design reduces the number of possible directions to the point where map markers are no longer necessary.

  • Carefully controlled amount of side content. The control was extremely effective.

  • A real ending. At some point, the game simply ends. We decided to treat this as a feature.

  • And still zero crafting. We don't want this point getting lost among the less important features.


Half Hour RPG respects your time.

Every system we didn't have time to make was carefully analyzed and deliberately left unimplemented for design reasons.

store_data.about_the_game:
Beneath the Crown, no road is ever truly safe.

Roads Beneath the Crown is a single-player trading and management game set in a medieval fantasy world.

Begin with limited funds and travel between five distinct cities in search of opportunity. Study prices, understand supply and demand, gather intelligence, buy at the right moment, and carry your goods to the places that need them most.

But a merchant's life is about far more than buying low and selling high.

Master a Changing Market

Every city has its own goods, production, and demand.

Seasons, local events, policies, and shifting supply can reshape prices. An overlooked commodity today may become tomorrow's most valuable cargo somewhere else.

The market is unpredictable, but it is not meaningless.

Study price histories, gather information, and learn what is happening across the realm. Over time, patterns begin to emerge from the uncertainty.

Trade Beyond the Marketplace

As your capital grows, new opportunities begin to appear.

Enter auctions and compete for rare possessions.

Venture into the black market to find goods and artifacts unavailable through ordinary trade.

Acquire ancient relics and decide whether to sell them, keep them, or entrust them to scholars who may uncover their true value.

Use financial services offered by the merchant guild to expand your capital, but remember that every debt eventually comes due.

Wealth creates opportunities.

It also creates new risks.

Build Your Trading Network

You do not have to remain a lone merchant forever.

Recruit employees with different talents to assist with trading, intelligence, research, and other parts of your growing enterprise.

No single specialist is indispensable.

Different combinations of people create different advantages, leaving you to decide where your limited manpower and resources matter most.

As your business expands, you can grow from a travelling merchant personally carrying every shipment into the head of a commercial network spanning multiple cities.

Every Journey Has a Price

The roads are never completely safe.

Unexpected encounters, delays, and other events can disrupt even a carefully planned journey. Your cargo, money, reputation, and connections may all influence what happens next.

Sometimes the most profitable road is also the most dangerous.

You decide which risks are worth taking.

Become the Merchant You Choose to Be

Build your fortune through reliable trade.

Chase treasures through competitive auctions.

Step into the underground economy.

Study forgotten artifacts.

Create a commercial network stretching across the realm.

Or find your own place among the powers competing beneath the Crown.

Roads Beneath the Crown does not ask you to become one particular kind of merchant.

The roads belong to the Crown. How you travel them is up to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your deck is the alphabet

Arrange seven letter cards into a word. The word is the attack. Longer words hit harder.

If you cannot see a word, throw the letters at the enemy one at a time for 1 damage each. We allow this. We do not respect it.

The map, the fights, the rewards and the boss at the bottom of each act will look familiar if you have played a deckbuilder. What you are climbing down through is the Athenaeum Mortis, a library that died badly and kept writing. You are a Lexicographer of the Dead, and the things down here are malformed text: Misprints, Errata, Ligatures fused wrong, marginalia that crawled off the edge of a page.

Paper decides what a letter does

Every letter is printed on a stock, which is the modifier it carries into the word. Iron converts its damage into Block. Gold-Foiled adds damage, and 4 more on words of six letters or longer. Crossed doubles the damage once and then the card is gone. Volatile explodes if it is still in your hand at the end of the turn. Devilish forces a discard, hands you a random buff, and leaves you to work out whether that was a trade. Jagged is the awkward one. It cuts when you throw the letter and does nothing when you spell with it, so a hand of Jagged wants the exact opposite of what a hand of Iron wants.

18 stocks. They go onto any letter you own, so a deck of common vowels can still end a boss.

130 words you have to find first

Spellbook words are not cards you draw. They are words you collected on earlier runs, and you carry three of them into a fight. Arrange the letters and the spell fires on its own. The panel tells you LORE is somewhere in that hand. It does not tell you where the L is, and it will not stop you spelling ROLE for the smaller number.

Four people who are wrong about language in four different ways

  • The Compositor sets type. Common letters, Iron stocks, Block, patience. Start here.
  • The Etymologist opens on a long word, and every word after it must be exactly one letter shorter. Chain down to the root and the multiplier climbs as the words shrink.
  • Fever Tongue makes one letter in the Glossolalist's hand wild every turn. Wild cards, Sulfuric letters, fights that end early.
  • The Rhapsodist forges a bar of up to four words and cashes the whole bar at once. AA, AABB, ABAB, AAAA. The rhyme scheme sets the multiplier.
You start as the Compositor. Clear Act 1 to unlock the Etymologist, Act 2 for the Glossolalist, Act 3 for the Rhapsodist.

Down through the dead strata

The Pressworks, where the presses remember being built. The Scriptorium, where scribes revise you mid-fight. The Cuneiform Depths. Then Ur-Script, which was language before anyone invented a surface to put language on, and The Logos, which is language itself and is not pleased to meet you.

73 enemies, 10 of them boss fights. One of the three that can end Act 1, The Redactor, bans letters from a deck you spent the whole act building around them. It is a fair fight and you will hate it.

[hr][/hr]
43 events, 31 scrolls for the run the events made worse, 54 pieces of clothing, 10 finger slots for tattooed letters that turn up in every later combat, 40 achievements, 20 ascension levels.

Also 13 curses, which go into your letter deck like everything else. Aphasia. Stutter. Palindrome. One of them is called Normality and it is the worst one in the game.

Type the word or drag it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everything Has Its Proper Place

A once perfectly organized home has been turned upside down in an instant. Find 1,500 tidying items scattered throughout the house and return each one to its proper place.

When you pick up an object, a silhouette and compass will guide you toward where it belongs. Carry it to the right spot, put it back, and gradually restore the home to its original state.

Is Putting Things Back All It Takes?

Some tidying items belong on top of other objects or inside furniture. Before you can tidy the objects on a desk, the desk itself must be back in place. To put something inside a refrigerator or drawer, you will need to open it first.

Tidy parent objects in the correct order, open doors and drawers, and restore the structure of the home one step at a time.

Tools for Tidying

  • Silhouette Guide — See where an object belongs and use its color to check whether it can currently be placed.

store_data.about_the_game:
You Are The Painter

Sweep across bare ground and plants, flowers, stone and whole trees grow in behind the cursor. The same brush raises hills, pours ponds, paints a season into a patch of world and tints it all from a palette.

You Are Mother Nature

What you paint has to be cared for. Paint a cloud and it rains over what you grew, soaking the ground long after it has drifted off. Lift a meadow clear of rising water, warm a frozen slope, and read every plant for how it feels about where you put it.

You Are Their Home

Grow whatever life needs and it will find you. Grasshoppers burrow, bees nest, and their homes fill with fibre and honey while swarms clear ground you cannot. Keep them happy and they multiply. Let their habitat go and they thin out, but they never leave you.

You Are The Seed

Eight regions, eight curses, and each one is the exact absence of something its keeper took. Find out what happened to this forest, and be the thing that grows back in its place.

store_data.about_the_game:
Asteroid Destroyer is a fast-paced 2D arcade shoot 'em up set in deep space.

Take control of your spacecraft, destroy asteroids, survive increasingly dangerous threats, and push your score as high as you can.

Your ship moves with inertia. There is no automatic braking — accelerate with forward thrust, rotate freely, and use your momentum to maneuver through the battlefield. Staying alive means learning to control your movement, positioning, and speed while reacting to an ever-changing asteroid field.

The battlefield is more than just a collection of asteroids.

*** CRIMSON SHARDS ***

When an asteroid collides with Crimson Shards, smaller fragments can be torn away without destroying the original asteroid. These fragments can quickly turn a seemingly safe area into a dangerous one. It cannot be destroyed.

*** ROGUE COMET ***

The Rogue Comet moves through the asteroid field, deflecting asteroids and tearing smaller fragments from them as it passes. It cannot be destroyed.

*** FIVE DIFFICULTY LEVELS ***

Choose from five difficulty levels and find the challenge that suits you. Start with a more manageable pace or push your skills to the limit and fight for the highest score.

*** FUTURE UPDATES ***

The game will continue to evolve with future updates, adding new ways to play, survive and improve your ship.

Planned updates include ship upgrades, new weapons, new enemies and achievements.

*** MASTER YOUR MOVEMENT ***

Momentum is always part of the challenge. There is no automatic braking, so every acceleration, turn, and maneuver matters. Learn to use your ship's movement to avoid danger, control your position, and stay alive as the battlefield becomes increasingly chaotic.

*** HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE? ***

Destroy asteroids. Avoid deadly threats. Master your movement. Chase the highest score.

Take control. Keep moving. Destroy everything in your path.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

🐟 Cast Your Line

Tap on the shimmering fish schools in the pond to start fishing. Each successful catch rewards you with gold coins. The bigger the fish, the bigger the payout — but they're not always easy to land. Keep fishing, keep earning, and watch your coin purse grow.

🎯 Reach Your Goal

Each level comes with a target you need to hit. Sell your catch, stack up your gold, and reach the过关标准 to advance. Miss the mark? No worries — just keep casting and upgrading until you get there.

🌳 Grow Your Skills

Spend your hard-earned gold in a rich, branching skill tree. Want to cast farther? Reel faster? Catch bigger fish? It's all in there. Forge your own path and become the ultimate fishing cat.

  • Stronger Cast — reach deeper waters where the big ones hide

  • Faster Reel — land fish before they get away

  • Lucky Paw — increase your chance of rare catches

  • And many more — dozens of upgrades waiting to be unlocked

⚡ Special Abilities — Pick One

Every run, you get to choose one of three special fishing abilities. Each one changes the way you play:

  • Double Catch — chance to reel in two fish at once

  • Gold Rush — temporarily boost all gold earnings

  • Instant Reel — skip the wait and land fish instantly

Choose wisely — the right ability at the right time can make all the difference.

🌊 Rich Environments

Fish in a variety of beautiful scenes. From serene village ponds to rushing rivers, crystal-clear lakes to mysterious deep waters — every new environment brings new challenges and new opportunities.

🐠 Hundreds of Fish to Discover

A massive collection of fish awaits. Common minnows, rare golden koi, legendary giant catfish — can you catch them all? Each fish has its own value, rarity, and behavior. Fill your collection and become a true fishing master.

🔄 Never-Ending Progression

The more you fish, the stronger you become. The stronger you become, the bigger the fish you can catch. And the bigger the fish — the more gold you earn. It's a satisfying loop that keeps you coming back for one more cast.

Key Features

  • Simple, satisfying gameplay — tap to fish, earn gold, repeat

  • Deep skill tree — dozens of upgrades across multiple branching paths

  • Special ability system — choose 1 of 3 unique abilities each run

  • Multiple environments — fish in beautifully crafted scenes

  • Massive fish collection — hundreds of species to discover and collect

  • Level-based progression — clear targets, advance, and unlock more

  • Relaxing yet engaging — perfect for short sessions or long play

They stole your plushie, you are sad, but you have to get it back!


EVERY FIGHT IS A FINAL BOSS
No levels. No filler. Punch The Monkey is an action boss rush: just you, a bag of bananas, and the animal kingdom's scary tyrants. Every boss is a multi-phase spectacle that reinvents the fight mid-duel — the gorilla doesn't just throw boulders, he brings the whole cave down on your head.


LEARN THE DANCE OR GET FLATTENED
Every attack has a tell. Every pattern has a gap. Run, crouch, double-jump — your moveset is simple, surviving with it isn't. Deaths are quick, retries are quicker, and the run where it finally clicks will make you feel like the most dangerous primate alive.

GO BANANAS
Pelt bosses with bananas, spend your winnings in the shop between fights, and pick your next victim on the world map. The bosses get meaner. So do you.

Streamers and video creators: footage is welcome. Go bananas.
store_data.short_description: Action boss rush game where every fight is a final boss. Throw bananas, dodge attacks, and learn the patterns of hostile animal bosses in the zoo. You have one goal. Find your stolen plushie.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dude, Trust Me

Three friends walk into a certain wonderland. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and the way out is a run of puzzles in which nobody holds more than a third of any answer.

So you describe it wrong. You guess. You try to explain a color to someone who cannot see one, and your hands are on something while your friend across the room is reading the very symbol you need. Somebody drops a "dude, trust me", and the one who has to decide is you.

Pick your role

  • BLIND, the Hands. The world is white outlines in the dark: no color, no writing. In return, only your hands read braille and tell shapes apart, so everyone is counting on you. You hear and you speak, so say out loud what your hands just found.

  • DEAF, the Eyes. You do not hear a word your friends are saying, and you are the only one who sees the room as it really is. Start talking, and hope somebody is listening.

  • MUTE, the Brain. You are the only one who can read the Escape Guide, except that without what the Blind just felt and what the Deaf can see, the book is useless to you. And once you do know, you will not get a single word of it out. You answer in emotes alone, and the Blind cannot see emotes.

The mess is the whole point

Nobody hands you a ready made sign language. You invent one together, garble it, and slowly get better at it. Half of a run is somebody describing something else entirely with total confidence. The other half is the moment it all clicks and all three of you move at once.

What's in the box

  • Exactly three players, online.

  • Voice chat built straight into the game and shaped by the role you picked.

  • A pile of puzzles, not one of them solvable alone.

  • Dealt again every run, so nobody can look the answer up.

  • Swap roles and see how easy it looked from the other side.

  • An end of run summary, so all three of you have something to argue about.

Grab two friends and find out how well you actually understand each other.

store_data.about_the_game:
Look - it's book worm!

Look-Book-Worm! is a team vs team co-op game. Players are divided into 2 groups: moles and worms. Each team's goal is to fill score line in its favor by doing different tasks. The action is set up in library.

Just ground diggers? Nah

In this world moles somehow obtained an ability to shoot lasers which are very effective against sneaky worms. Besides that moles are capable of gripping their enemies and punishing them by locking them in a small can.

Small but mighty

Despite moles being so strong, their opponents - worms can also give a good fight... or a run. These little fellas can attach themselves to all kinds of surfaces - be it a wall or a ceiling. They also have opportunity to ruin moles' lifes by bitting them and knocking them out by pushing something heavy on them.

Shhhh

Game allows you to go fully immersive and turn on "quiet mode". This way your team would lose points if you're being too loud.

Game features

  • Voice chat

  • Physics based movement

  • Walking on every surface

  • Having a lot of fun with friends

  • Losing friends

  • Worms can bite your ahh

  • Laser eyes

  • Item seeking 

    And more and more and more...

Well... good luck!

store_data.about_the_game:
GAMBLE HUNTERS

GAMBLE HUNTERS is a fast-paced casino-action roguelite.

Hunt monsters to earn Coins, then wager them in casino games to win Tickets. Decide how much to spend on upgrades and how much to put toward your debt as you search for the perfect build to keep your run alive.

But don’t forget—your debt must be paid before the deadline...

FEATURES

  • 🔫 Fast-paced first-person monster hunting

  • 🎰 7 unpredictable games of chance

  • 🤑 Tense resource management: pay off your debt or invest in growth

  • 💎 Build-defining combinations of powerful Artifacts

  • 🔁 Go bankrupt and start your roguelite run all over again

  • 💀 Powerful bosses waiting to test your build

  • 👕 Character costumes to collect and wear

  • 🦜 A cute and colorful universe filled with space pirates

※ All casino games use virtual in-game currency only. No real-money gambling or cash-value rewards are included.

SHOOT MONSTERS, EARN COINS, AND WIN BIG AT THE CASINO!

You are a Gamble Hunter—a daring space pirate who hunts monsters for Coins and risks them at the casino for a shot at fortune!

Grow your winnings, pay down your debt, and keep your run going for as long as you can.

HUNT FOR ONE MINUTE AND BUILD YOUR BANKROLL!

Unleash your strongest firepower and defeat as many monsters as possible before time runs out!

The more monsters you defeat, the more Coins you’ll have to wager at the casino.

As you grow stronger, your firepower increases, allowing you to defeat even more monsters and earn even more Coins.

Every casino win presents another choice: invest in your growth or pay down your debt.

Lock on, let loose, and return to the casino with pockets full of Coins!

HOW FAR CAN YOU PUSH YOUR LUCK?

The clock keeps ticking—even inside the casino.

Play a variety of casino games and win as many Tickets as possible before time runs out.

Spread your bets to manage the risk, or wager big and chase a massive payout.

A lucky break could make you rich in an instant, but one greedy bet could wipe out every Coin you’ve earned!

Will you play one more game, or walk away while you’re ahead?

PAY OFF YOUR DEBT OR POWER UP?

Decide whether to use your casino winnings to repay your debt or purchase upgrades.

Upgrade your machine gun and stats to defeat more monsters and earn more Coins during your next hunt.

Just don’t forget—if you fail to pay off your debt before the deadline, you’ll go bankrupt!

CREATE YOUR OWN BUILD WITH ARTIFACTS!

Collect a wide variety of Artifacts and create a build of your own!

Boost your firepower, improve your survivability, earn more Coins, or even tilt the casino odds a little more in your favor.

Every Artifact you choose can change the way your run develops.

Combine the right Artifacts and upgrades, and even monsters that once seemed overwhelming will fall before your firepower!

TAKE ON POWERFUL BOSSES!

Powerful and varied boss monsters are waiting to challenge you.

Hunt monsters, gamble your Coins, collect Tickets, and upgrade your machine gun and Artifacts to prepare for each showdown.

Grow as strong as you can before the deadline, defeat the boss, pay off your debt, and boldly move on to your next challenge!

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep beneath the ruins of a forgotten kingdom lies a mystery that has remained hidden for generations.

When Lidi discovers strange ember fragments scattered throughout the abandoned lands, his curiosity leads him into an unexpected adventure. Explore atmospheric pixel-art environments, solve environmental puzzles, light forgotten torches, and uncover the secrets surrounding the legendary Last Ember.

Explore a Forgotten Kingdom

Journey through handcrafted levels featuring abandoned castles, forgotten sanctuaries, underground mines, and ancient ruins. Every location rewards exploration with hidden collectibles, optional discoveries, and secrets waiting to be found.

Light the Way

Use your lighter to ignite ancient torches that serve as checkpoints throughout your journey. Some torches reveal hidden paths, activate forgotten mechanisms, or guide you toward unexplored areas.

Solve Environmental Puzzles

Carefully observe your surroundings to activate ancient machinery, unlock hidden passages, and overcome environmental challenges. Exploration and curiosity are just as important as platforming skill.

Master Precision Platforming

Run, jump, climb ladders, slide through narrow passages, swing across dangerous gaps, and avoid deadly hazards while navigating the kingdom's forgotten ruins.

Search Every Corner

Collect coins, discover hidden artifacts, recover mysterious ember fragments, and explore every level to uncover its secrets. Purchase maps from the in-game shop to help locate collectibles you may have missed.

Features

  • Atmospheric pixel-art visuals

  • Eight handcrafted levels

  • Exploration-focused gameplay

  • Environmental puzzles

  • Precision platforming

  • Hidden collectibles and secrets

  • In-game map shop

  • Steam achievements

  • Full Xbox controller support

store_data.about_the_game:
Lost Cat Showa Town is a cat adventure game set in a nostalgic Japanese town inspired by the Showa era.

Take control of a cat and freely explore a town filled with narrow alleys, old houses, shops, rooftops, and hidden places. Unlike humans, a cat can slip into unexpected spaces, climb to high places, and discover the town from an entirely different perspective.

Explore the streets at your own pace, meet other cats, find places to rest, and search for food throughout the town. You might find something tasty at a local izakaya—or simply spend some time relaxing in a cozy cat bed.

The town is full of places to explore, from quiet residential neighborhoods to shops and other nostalgic locations. Look around, climb onto rooftops, wander through backyards, and see what you can discover.

Features

  • Explore a nostalgic Japanese town as a cat

  • Wander through streets, alleys, houses, backyards, and rooftops

  • Meet and interact with other cats

  • Find and eat different foods around town

  • Rest in cat beds and other comfortable spots

  • Discover hidden areas from a cat’s point of view

  • Enjoy a relaxed, lighthearted adventure inspired by Showa-era Japan

There is no need to rush. Explore the town, follow your curiosity, and enjoy life as a cat.

store_data.about_the_game:
A true hardcore ARPG. Gameplay first. Difficulty that means it. Replayability without a bottom.

Dreadmark doesn't sell you cutscenes or a tech demo — it sells a fight. A ruined pilgrim road, the horrors that took it, and a ladder of players racing to survive it better than you.

Combat with weight — Attacks commit. Blocks and recovery are real. Every horror has a tell, and the difference between reading it and eating it is your health globe. Positioning, timing, and commitment decide fights — but walk in undergeared and none of it saves you.

Difficulty that respects you — Punishing, never cheap. Elites roll affixes that change how they fight; packs punish autopilot. And for those who mean it: hardcore, where death is permanent — and public.

Built for the next run — A roster of classes growing through Early Access — five planned by 1.0 — each with skill trees of real synergy weight, runes that mutate skills into new ones, and loot affixes (on-hit, when-struck) that bend whole builds. Seasonal ladders reset the race; the only thing that carries is what you've learned.

Alone on the road — never offline — A single-player fight inside a live, connected world: server-wide seasonal leaderboards with server-verified runs, global chat, a herald crying the ladder's deeds, and the fallen lingering as ghosts whose final gear you can inspect and judge.

Built in the open, fast — Suggest it on the Dreadmark Discord, vote it up, watch it ship. Updates land in days, not quarters — the road to 1.0 is walked with the community, and the changelog proves it.

content_descriptors.notes: Dreadmark contains stylized fantasy violence: players fight undead, cultists, and gothic horrors using melee weapons, ranged attacks, and magic skills. Blood and hit effects are stylized rather than realistic, and there is no dismemberment, gore, or torture. The game's atmosphere is bleak and unsettling (graveyards, ruins, a cathedral) but is not realistic horror. Dreadmark also includes an optional Gamble Stall where players spend in-game gold — never real money — for a chance at a random item, similar to gambling mechanics found in other action RPGs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Something precious lies broken. Piece by piece, you'll put it back together.

The Golden Seam draws on kintsugi, the Japanese art of repairing pottery with gold. It doesn't hide the cracks. It fills them, traces them, makes them the most beautiful part of the object. What was once broken becomes something new and precious, its scars on display.

Turn each broken shape. Slide the pieces until they meet. Watch the seam fill with gold. One crack at a time, the chaos settles into calm, laced with the golden trace of where it once was broken.

There are no timers here. No score. No way to fail. Just your hands and the slow, steady calm of putting something back together, piece by piece. The click of each piece, the warmth of each seam sealing home.

When the last crack closes, what's left isn't what it was before. It's something that carries its history, its scars, in gold. No two are ever the same. Neither are we.

A small, quiet game to find some calm with.

Made by two people, with love.

store_data.about_the_game:
Final Armada is a space fleet real time strategy roguelike where you build your own ships block by block, command them in real-time battles, and choose your way through battles, events and discoveries as you push farther into the unknown.

Design ships from the ground up by placing hull, armor, weapons, engines, shields, reactors and other systems wherever you want. How you build actually matters. Armor can protect important systems, weapons need room to fire, and losing the wrong part of a ship can completely change how it fights.

Once your fleet is ready, take control and command it through large space battles. Give your ships movement orders, position them, and watch as armor is destroyed, weapons are blown off, and entire sections of ships break apart.

Between battles, choose your path through a branching map filled with fights, upgrades, resources and other events. As you make it farther, you’ll gain access to more of your own ship, open areas that were previously locked, and slowly uncover more about where you are, what happened before you woke up, and why you’re still fighting.

Build your ships. Explore what's left. Keep your fleet alive. Find out why you're still fighting.

store_data.about_the_game:
概要

『お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター』 は、

すごろくの盤面をデッキとして構築し、

ステージ毎に設定された目標スコアの達成を目指すゲームです。

ビルド要素

プレイヤーが構築可能なのは、すごろく盤面にとどまらず、

盤面上を移動するコマや、ボスを倒すと手に入るレリックなど多彩です！

強力な組み合わせを見つけ出し、苛烈になっていく目標スコアを乗り越えてください！

▼マス効果一例

　・通過するたびにスコアが加速度的に貯まって行き、停止すると一気にスコアが稼げる『銀行』

　・盤面上の全ての『植物』の数に応じてスコアが上昇する『世界樹』

▼コマ効果一例

　・1D20のダイスを振り、運が良ければとてつもなく進める『ジャンボジェット』

　・絶対に1が出る、『翁』

▼レリック効果一例

　・ダイスの1を強制的に5に変える『いちご』

　・特定のマスで絶対に止まれるようになるバッジが付与できる『警笛』

一定ステージ毎に現れるボス

ステージには、目標スコアをこなせばよいだけの通常ステージの他に、

プレイヤーに様々なデバフ効果を付与してくる、ボスステージが存在します。

ボスステージで付与されるデバフは、事前に確認可能ですので、

あらかじめ対策を取り、ボスのデバフにやり込められないようしましょう！

▼ボス能力一例

　・デッキに強制的に一時停止マスを挿入してくる

　・ステージ中で一度でも停止したマスの効果は２度と発動しなくなる

異なる能力を持った多数のプレイアブルキャラクター

プレイを重ねるたびに、様々な異なる能力を持ったキャラクターがアンロックされていきます。

キャラクターたちの個性豊かな能力で、さらなるハイスコアを目指しましょう！

▼キャラクター能力一例

　・最初から2D6の強力なダイスを持っている『大宇宙統合意思先輩』

　・お金を消費すればいつでも必殺奥義が発動可能な『ダーク眼鏡メイドエルフ』

　

負けても勝っても、リザルトで読まれるランダム俳句のおまけつき！
特にゲームの遊びにはなんにも意味をもたらさないけど、勝っても負けても、

リザルト画面で必ずランダムな俳句が詠まれるぞ！うれしいね！！

☣️ DECONTAMINATION PROTOCOL ☣️

Your shift is about to begin, operator. Trust no one. Quarantine every doubt.

Welcome to DECONTAMINATION PROTOCOL, an immersive, terminal-based psychological horror game that drops you directly onto the frontline of a high-security subterranean facility.

Operating from a secluded security booth overlooking the heavy airlock gates, your daily duties seem straightforward on paper: monitor incoming personnel, run diagnostic checks, analyze vital signs, and execute strict decontamination procedures. However, deep underground where containment is fragile and paranoia runs rampant, safety is merely an illusion, and every single keystroke could spell the difference between survival and a catastrophic facility-wide breach.

☣️ KEY FEATURES ☣️

  • 💻 Authentic Terminal-Driven Investigation

Immerse yourself in a retro-styled CRT workstation environment. Utilize text-based command-line inputs, examine detailed shift logs, cross-reference biometric vitals, and listen closely to tense intercom transmissions to piece together what is actually happening outside your booth.

  • ⚖️ The High-Stakes Judgment Call

    Your shift constantly tests your psychological limits. Analyze subjects against evolving directives and make the ultimate decision using three distinct verdicts:

    • 🟢 Sanitize: Clear minor contamination.

    • 🟡 Quarantine: Isolate questionable personnel.

    • 🔴 Purge: Order an immediate, lethal termination.

  • 📻 Creepy, Claustrophobic Atmosphere

    Experience an unnerving, tension-filled workspace defined by vintage terminal aesthetics, realistic CRT scanlines, eerie ambient audio, and an ever-present feeling of dread that builds with every passing minute.

  • 👁️ Grotesque Hidden Horrors

    Not everyone standing on the other side of the glass is who or what they claim to be. Uncover disturbing biological mutations, parasitic entities, and ungodly horrors lurking beneath standard security clearances.

⚠️ SYSTEM WARNING: Anomalous life-forms detected at Sector 4 Airlock. Do not open the blast doors unless clearance is verified 100%.

store_data.about_the_game:
He had already sent someone

You run a small real-estate office. A landlord calls you on an ordinary working day: the tenant in Apartment 3 has stopped answering his phone and stopped paying his rent. Someone needs to go and see.

What he mentions more quietly is that he has already sent one of his men to do exactly that.

That man went into Apartment 3. He did not come back out.

You are the second one he sent.

What you actually do

Apartment 3 is a single-player first-person horror game that takes place almost entirely inside one apartment and the building around it. It is a game about searching a place very carefully while something else is in there with you.

  • Search every room. Drawers, wardrobes, cupboards, the space under the beds. Anything you can interact with lights up when you look at it, and anything you take is kept in your inventory for the room that needs it.
  • Read what the tenant left behind. Papers are picked up and held in your hands, and turned over, because half of what they say is written on the back. Complaints nobody answered. A letter addressed to whoever reads it next. A child's drawing of a bedroom, with a tall figure standing between the beds. Nobody narrates this story to you. Everything you understand, you found yourself.
  • Solve the apartment. It does not open all at once. Four or five puzzles stand between you and the rest of it: a painting hanging where it should not be, a wardrobe heavy enough to push aside because of what is behind it, and ways through that only appear once you have understood the room you are standing in.
  • Do not get caught. Something still lives here. It hunts by sight and by sound, so stepping into its view and making noise are two separate mistakes with the same ending. You cannot kill it, and nothing you are carrying will hurt it. Once it starts coming toward you, all you have is distance and somewhere to be out of sight.

Your goal

Get inside. Find out what happened to the tenant. Get back out.

The landlord is waiting for your phone call, the same way he waited for the last one. And the further into the apartment you go, the harder that call gets to make. Every drawer you open makes "I found nothing" a harder sentence to say.

An Arabic horror game, not a translated one

Apartment 3 was written and built in Arabic from the first line. Every spoken line is performed in Arabic, the notes are handwritten in Arabic, and the subtitles are Arabic. It is not a foreign game with Arabic pasted on top of it.

Please read this before buying: the menus and interface are available in English, but the story is not translated. The voice acting, the notes and the subtitles are Arabic only. If you do not read Arabic you will be able to play it, but you will not follow the story.

At a glance

  • Single player, first person
  • Roughly an hour, meant to be played in one sitting
  • Four to five puzzles built into the apartment itself
  • No combat. You are not equipped to fight what is in the apartment
  • Arabic voice acting and Arabic subtitles, English interface
  • Windows

You are the second one he sent.

What you actually do

Apartment 3 is a single-player first-person horror game that takes place almost entirely inside one apartment and the building around it. It is a game about searching a place very carefully while something else is in there with you.

  • Search every room. Drawers, wardrobes, cupboards, the space under the beds. Anything you can interact with lights up when you look at it, and anything you take is kept in your inventory for the room that needs it.
  • Read what the tenant left behind. Papers are picked up and held in your hands, and turned over, because half of what they say is written on the back. Complaints nobody answered. A letter addressed to whoever reads it next. A child's drawing of a bedroom, with a tall figure standing between the beds. Nobody narrates this story to you. Everything you understand, you found yourself.
  • Solve the apartment. It does not open all at once. Four or five puzzles stand between you and the rest of it: a painting hanging where it should not be, a wardrobe heavy enough to push aside because of what is behind it, and ways through that only appear once you have understood the room you are standing in.
  • Do not get caught. Something still lives here. It hunts by sight and by sound, so stepping into its view and making noise are two separate mistakes with the same ending. You cannot kill it, and nothing you are carrying will hurt it. Once it starts coming toward you, all you have is distance and somewhere to be out of sight.

Your goal

Get inside. Find out what happened to the tenant. Get back out.

The landlord is waiting for your phone call, the same way he waited for the last one. And the further into the apartment you go, the harder that call gets to make. Every drawer you open makes "I found nothing" a harder sentence to say.

An Arabic horror game, not a translated one

Apartment 3 was written and built in Arabic from the first line. Every spoken line is performed in Arabic, the notes are handwritten in Arabic, and the subtitles are Arabic. It is not a foreign game with Arabic pasted on top of it.

Please read this before buying: the menus and interface are available in English, but the story is not translated. The voice acting, the notes and the subtitles are Arabic only. If you do not read Arabic you will be able to play it, but you will not follow the story.

At a glance

  • Single player, first person
  • Roughly an hour, meant to be played in one sitting
  • Four to five puzzles built into the apartment itself
  • No combat. You are not equipped to fight what is in the apartment
  • Arabic voice acting and Arabic subtitles, English interface
  • Windows

Search the apartment, read what the tenant left behind, solve your way deeper in, and stay out of reach of what still lives there.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the firewall

Packets rain down the screen, some ALLOW, some DENY, some carrying a payload that will end your run. Read the shape, read the color, read the tag, and move. HYPER ACK is a fast, reflex-driven arcade dodger.

7 ways to play

Normal — endless run. Catch good traffic, dodge bad traffic, survive as long as you can.

Hyper - pick your starting speed before the run begins, from a comfortable ramp-up to full chaos.

Time Attack — 90 seconds on the clock. Maximize your score before time runs out.

Hardcore — one life. No second chances.

Boss Rush — every level is a boss wave. Nonstop traffic storm.

Red Team — roles reversed. Hit the bad packets, dodge the good ones.

Reverse Proxy — same rules as Normal, but every control is inverted. Up is down. Left is right.

Each mode unlocks by clearing the one before it, so there's always a next challenge waiting. Hyper Mode is unlocked from the start.

Features

🔥 Seven distinct game modes with their own unlock chain, HUD identity, and tracked best-stats.

🏆 25 Steam achievements — score chases, streak records, per-mode milestones, and a few just for fun.

🎨 28 unlockable background themes, procedurally tinted as you push further into score/level/survival-time thresholds.

📜 A live scrolling "firewall log" panel that narrates every packet as it spawns, in real time, styled like an actual terminal.

🎮 Full gamepad support alongside keyboard (arrows/WASD).

🎬 One-key gameplay recordings. Capture your run to a video file any time with a single hotkey.

☁️ Steam Cloud saves, Leaderboards and Steam Achievements integration.

👁 Watch Mode — a hands-off AI attract mode if you just want to vibe to the soundtrack.

🎵 An original synth/cyber soundtrack that plays straight through from menu to game over.

store_data.about_the_game:
RUN YOUR OWN SAFARI AGENCY!

You and your friends run your own safari business. Invite tourists, organize tours, and turn your growing audience into new customers. More tourists mean more money, more trouble, and much more footage for your next episode.

KEEP THE CAMERA ROLLING!

Film rare wildlife, beautiful scenery, and the best moments of every expedition. Upload your footage to your channel, rack up views and subscribers, and bring in even more tourists.

BUILD YOUR SAFARI TRUCK!

Assemble your first safari truck and hit the road together. Its physics-based handling means every bump, collision, and wrong turn can derail the entire expedition.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE!

Explore an open world, discover points of interest, and chart your own course. Peaceful routes offer scenic views and steady income. Dangerous expeditions bring bigger payouts, more views, and far fewer guarantees that everyone will make it back in one piece.

TAKE CARE OF YOUR TOURISTS!

Tourists expect wild animals, great photo opportunities, and a comfortable ride. Sell them drinks and snacks, keep their spirits up, and try to bring everyone back.

A happy tourist may bring in new customers. An unhappy one can still make great content.

MORE THAN JUST SAFARI!

Legitimate tourism isn't the only way to make money. Take on smuggling jobs and haul contraband along especially dangerous routes.

NOTHING GOES ACCORDING TO PLAN!

Wild animals, local tribes, panicking tourists, breakdowns, and bad decisions turn an ordinary tour into a storm of physics-driven chaos and destruction.

Work together to save the tourists, the truck, the contraband, and the footage. The order is up to you.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS!

Use the money, views, and subscribers you earn to upgrade your agency and safari truck. Attract more tourists, take on more lucrative trips, and turn a small safari show into the wildest travel channel in the region.

KEY FEATURES

  • Co-op safari expeditions for 2–4 players

  • Proximity Chat

  • Online co-op

  • An open world with multiple routes and points of interest

  • Physics-based driving and destruction

  • Film your adventures and grow your video channel

  • Contraband and smuggling jobs

  • Repair and upgrade your safari truck

  • Build and expand your own safari agency

  • Wild animals and plenty of ways to ruin a perfect tour

store_data.about_the_game:
Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch is a monster-raising sim built around one idea: nothing lasts forever, and that's the point.

Raise Your Beast

Summon a spirit beast at the Shrine and bring it home to your ranch. Every week you choose how it spends its time - drills to sharpen a technique, rest to recover, feeding to keep it growing. Push too hard without rest and stress builds, and stress genuinely shortens a beast's life. That trade-off runs through the whole game, not as flavor text - it decides how long you get with each beast you raise.

Fight for Titles

Enter your beast in tournament cups and rival courts, either playing its fights yourself or letting it auto-battle while you manage the ranch. Choose from 35+ spirit beast breeds, each fighting with its own techniques drawn from 22 distinct attack archetypes, and build its record across a season of standings and placement rewards.

When a Life Ends, a Line Begins

When a beast's life ends, its story doesn't just stop. An Ascension ceremony closes it out, and Fusion lets you carry what it built into a new heir - a fresh beast that starts back at the bottom but carries the line's discoveries forward. Some Fusion combinations unlock breeds you won't find any other way.

Beyond the Ranch

Beyond the ranch, journeys through distinct regions bring new opponents, new breeds, and new reasons to keep a lineage going.

Key Features

  • 35+ spirit beast breeds spanning 22 attack archetypes

  • A living career of tournaments, cups, and rival courts

  • A training system where rest and stress genuinely shape a beast's lifespan

  • Succession: when a beast's life ends, an heir carries its line forward

  • Fusion discoveries that unlock new breeds

  • Journeys through distinct regions beyond the ranch

This game is in active development.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is an indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Enjoy a deep story and immersive action set against beautiful characters and world!

The story begins when the Archscroll created by an ancient archmage disappears.

The player must find the arcscroll and begin the adventure. 

While uncovering what the archscroll really is and why it disappeared, various incidents unfold.

Players can choose a class before embarking on an adventure.

Each class has a different combat style.

Knight - a weighty battle, clad in heavy armor and wielding a two-handed sword.

Mercenary — a swift fight where he wears leather armor and swings a one-handed sword.

Wizard - a battle where you wear a robe, hold a staff, and use ranged magic.

All classes can use a Weapon Aura that overlays mana onto weapons.

During battle, you can parry the opponent's attack or inflict a status effect.

Abilities include Normal Ability, Special Ability, and Talent.

Players can level up to improve various stats and enhance abilities.

Players can purchase equipped items and consumable items at the weapon and armor shop or the general goods shop.

These items can be used in battle.

Players can end the battle at any time during it, and progress is automatically saved upon ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
What you do


  • Place cowboys along the street which defend the town
  • Spend gold mid-fight on more men, better guns, and new buildings
  • Level up during a run and pick a skill card each time, Tier1 - Tier3 Skills
  • Bank Fortitude every run — win or lose — and spend it on permanent upgrades
  • Come back stronger and hold out longer than last time. Constant progression

Keep them out of town.


Zombies come up the road to Dead Man's Gulch in one continuous wave that never stops growing. The settlers can't fight. Your cowboys can — so put them where they'll do the most good and keep them supplied.

Hour one is a handful of shamblers. By the small hours there are hundreds on the street at once, and the things that arrive then take a magazine each.

Build the town, then hold it


  • Raise twelve buildings along the street, each with its own firing positions
  • Arm your men from a pistol up to a Sharps buffalo rifle — and dynamite, when a pistol will no longer do
  • Call in cavalry, and when the purse allows it, build the Gatling emplacement
  • Seven kinds of dead walk this road, from the shamblers of the first hour to what arrives after midnight

Lose, learn, ride again


Every run ends. What you learned does not. Fortitude carries over into a ledger of permanent upgrades — more gold, skills, and new weapons — so the next night starts a little less hopeless than the last.

  • Real progression from run to run
  • Progress saves itself
  • English, German and Spanish

A note from the developer

I'm one person, and this is my first published game.
I've played tower defense for years, and I love the idea of progress that carries across runs. Dead Man's Gulch is my attempt to put both in one game.
I built it in my spare time. If you play it and something feels off, tell me — I read everything and want to make this the best it can be.
— Matthias, Off the Clock Hermit

store_data.about_the_game:
Randventure is a turn-based tactical roguelite, drawn entirely in black and white.

You lead three heroes stacked in a column. Only the one in front acts: swipe their card left to cast one spell, right to cast the other. At the end of each round your heroes rotate, and so do the enemies facing them.

NOTHING IS HIDDEN

Every enemy displays its next move before it happens: which spell, and on which hero. Damage is fixed — there are no accuracy rolls and no critical hits. When a run ends badly, it ends on a decision you can name.

YOU CHOOSE THE ROAD

A run is three acts, each drawn from one of six biomes. You move across a branching map and pick your own path: ordinary fights, elites, an inn that heals, a rune, or an unknown node. Every act ends with a boss. A full run takes about twenty minutes.

YOUR TEAM CHANGES

Heroes gain levels and evolve. Five starting classes branch into thirty distinct forms, each with its own two spells — a Priest can become an Oracle, a Pope, or a Redeemer. Runes change the rules of the run itself: strike the back line, ignore enemy shields, survive one lethal blow per fight.

DEATH ENDS THE RUN

There is no continue. What you unlocked along the way stays for the next attempt: new spells, new runes, new heroes. Ten ascension tiers raise the difficulty once you have won.

IN THE GAME

  • 6 biomes and 36 enemies
  • 74 spells and 24 runes
  • 5 heroes, 30 evolutions
  • Online co-op
  • Nine languages

store_data.about_the_game:
—Welcome to the Star-Reading Bookstore.

Before you realize it, you are standing by the shore of a quiet lake.

A silent night. A crescent moon glimmers over the water, and the light of streetlamps filters through the gaps in the trees.

Ahead lies a single bookstore.

Tsuki, the proprietor of the shop known as the "Star-Reading Bookstore," tells you this:

—Here lie four books containing the untold histories of the stars.

"//Träumerei Nocturne" is

a quiet visual novel consisting solely of reading books and conversing within a bookstore at night.

■ Four Tales

"The City of Craft Note"

A world composed of three small nations: the Land of Weapons, the Land of Magic, and the Land of Craftsmanship.

The Land of Craftsmanship—Craft Note—is a wonderful place where culture flourishes,

boasting everything from mechanical dolls and stylish trinkets to delicious cuisine.

Noah, the king of this small nation, was living a peaceful life.

And today, too, was supposed to be just another such day.

"Chronicles of the End"

A virus—known as the "Star-Eater Virus"—suddenly appeared on a peaceful planet.

It easily destroyed nations and, eventually, wiped out humanity.

Targeting only animals and humans while leaving plants untouched,

how did the planet's inhabitants perceive this virus?

This is the story of the final records left behind by humanity on that world.

"You Are a Ghost; Choose Your Path."

A girl wakes up to find herself cast into an unfamiliar city, surrounded by strangers and an unknown space.

Unable to recall her own origins or even her name,

she encounters a mysterious woman and a man known as the "Caretaker."

This is a story that chronicles the girl's memories and the path that lies ahead for her.

"???"

Upon finishing the three stories, one unread book remains on the shelf.

What could that book possibly be...?

■ What you can do in this bookstore

Read books

Read through the stories of the stars, one by one.

To read a book is to truly face a star.

Conversation

Talk with Tsuki, the bookstore's proprietor.

Discuss dreams, time, growth, and the stars.

Share the answers that are yours alone.

Place a bookmark

You can gently close a book before you finish reading it.

You can continue the story another night.

◆ Estimated playtime

The game is designed to take between 3 and 6 hours to play.

However, one might say the time it takes to finish the story is, in a sense, eternal.

◆ Endings

The total number of endings is the product of the individual endings for each story.

◆ Note

This game is available in Japanese only.

This game contains depictions of themes such as death, loss, and separation.

◆ Regarding Streaming and Question

If you have any questions, please contact my website or X.

If you create Let's Play videos or stream the game, please include the following information in the video description or stream details:

Game Title: Traumerei Nocturne

Creator Name: 栞 / shiori

store_data.about_the_game:
The garden is dark. The pests are moving. Your light is limited.

TapTrapGrow is a 2D arcade progression game built around short, skill-driven hunts. Throw disposable light sticks to reveal hidden targets, click to swing, and keep tracking your prey while the swatter comes down. Every hit lands where your cursor is at the moment of impact.

LIGHT UP THE HUNT


Each light stick creates a temporary visibility zone. Place several at once, cover different parts of the garden, and decide when to spend your limited charges. A wounded creature stays visible for the rest of the run—but it can also bite back.

GROW AFTER EVERY RUN


Earn gold and XP, then upgrade your swatter’s power, speed, and striking area; increase your health and hunt duration; and improve the range, lifetime, and number of your light sticks.

Each creature also has its own density and reward upgrades, letting you decide what appears more often and what pays more.

DISCOVER NEW TOOLS


Collect fragments to unlock Freezing Spray and stop threats around your cursor. Gather light crystals to discover Burning Light, turning active light zones into localized damage fields.

  • Short timed hunts focused on aiming, tracking, and target priority
  • Multiple temporary light zones that can be placed at the same time
  • Persistent equipment, creature, and special-ability progression
  • Accuracy and streak tracking
  • Unlockable gardens and boss targets
  • Single-player with English and Turkish interface options

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU HAVE AN IDEA AND NO COMPANY

Type it in your own words. Not a dropdown, not a genre picker — you write what your

company does, and the game works out what kind of business you just described. Software,

manufactured, or people. Global, regional, or local. Whether anyone can fund it.

Then you go and find out how wrong you were.

LIVE IT, DON'T MANAGE IT

There is no floating dashboard. There is a garage, a coffee shop, a sauna, a trade fair

and a VC lobby with one plant and one Eames chair. You walk in, you talk to whoever is

actually there this week, and you manage the company on a laptop that exists inside the

world.

Each week is a handful of slots. Spend one on a pitch and you do not spend it on the

product. That is the whole game.

THE PEOPLE ARE THE DIFFICULTY

An angel investor is private money — his own, not a fund's. He answers to nobody, which

cuts both ways. A VC asks about cohorts because cohorts are what her fund understands,

even when your business ships pallets. A lawyer gives you free, correct advice right up

until the moment you ask him something, and then it becomes a file he has to open.

Conversations run in a chat panel and they do not repeat. Sit down with the same investor

twice and the second conversation knows what happened in the first one — including the

promise you have not kept.

THE TERM SHEET IS A DOCUMENT

Not a menu. A two-page sheet with ten live terms on it, and the bad ones are not labelled.

Liquidation preference, drag-along, a no-shop clause with a date on it. You may only

negotiate a term you have actually read.

You will sign a bad one. That is the lesson, and it is cheaper here than it is outside.

FAILURE IS A PUNCHLINE

A losing run teaches you something in under forty minutes. The death screens are better

written than the victory screens, on purpose. Every wrong door is open — the game never

tells you that you can't, it just sends the invoice.

Somebody will bill you €14,750 plus VAT for a nine-slide deck. You will pay it.

WHAT A RUN LOOKS LIKE

· One week per turn, roughly 100 weeks in a full run

· Five origins: a garage, a lecture hall, a sauna, a cubicle, a fogged bathroom mirror

· Three phases, gated by what you have done, never by the calendar:

SEED — you have an idea and no company

SCALE — you have money and no time

EXIT — you have a company and no control

· Eight endings, and the good ones are not the obvious ones

· 30-90 minutes for a typical death. 3-4 hours to actually finish.

ACCIDENTALLY EDUCATIONAL

You will finish a run knowing what a liquidation preference is, what your runway is, and

why the option pool comes out of the pre-money. Not because a tutorial explained it —

because it killed you, repeatedly, and the fourth time you saw it coming.

store_data.about_the_game:
Race through a wild jungle in Jungle Cars Trip Multiplayer, a chaotic multiplayer racing game featuring unique animal-shaped SUVs!

Choose your vehicle — from a powerful crocodile and mighty hippo to a fierce panther or mysterious bat — and take on dangerous off-road tracks packed with surprises. Crash through dense jungle, cross raging rivers, dodge wild animals, and overcome natural obstacles as you fight for the lead.

Race against friends or players from around the world, use powerful boosts and power-ups to gain an advantage, knock rivals off the track, and repair your vehicle when things go wrong.

Explore new locations as you progress, from dense tropical forests to mysterious ancient ruins. Unlock new animal cars, upgrade your vehicles, master challenging tracks, and prove that you can become the ultimate jungle racer!

Game features:

  • Multiplayer mode: compete with friends or random players in real time (Multiplayer mode is available with access to the game server and the latest version of the game).

  • Animal-shaped cars (crocodile, bat, hippo, panther, etc.)

  • Ability to choose trip destinations based on time and location (only for single player)

  • Driving mode and competition with AI car bots.

  • Mini-map with real opponents and a large map with you and landmarks.

  • Exotic tracks: tracks filled with natural hazards and unique obstacles.

  • Bonus and upgrade system: power-ups, repairs.

  • Competitions and achievements: take part in tournaments and have fun.

  • Cyclic change of day and night with moonlight and sunlight.

  • Effects from crossing rivers.

  • Effects from driving on dusty sand dunes.

  • Horn sound to signal friends.

  • Overcoming bridges.

  • Driving on a winding mountain road.

  • Driving on a snowy road.

  • Fighting wild animals (with giant spiders) with swarm intelligence.

  • Driving through underground caves with hiding places.

  • Repairing damage from spiky stones.

  • Accounting for fuel consumption and refueling with gasoline.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD THE ENGINE. BEAT THE QUOTA.

You buy sealed storage crates. You see the odds before you bid, but never the contents.

Junkpot is a roguelike about turning junk into profit fast enough to survive a debt that doubles every round.

CHARMS ARE THE GAME

Every charm changes how a crate pays out, and they stack on each other.

Dumpster Diver triples the value of worthless junk. Add Pack Rat, and any two matching items multiply the entire haul. Slot Rare Magnet to triple your odds of pulling something rare, then Blue Chip to double what those rares are worth.

Dreamcore: Liminal Spaces is an atmospheric walking simulator set inside a surreal, dreamlike world.

Explore strange and familiar places that feel like fragments of a dream. Wander through endless landscapes, mysterious environments, and impossible spaces where everything seems normal — yet somehow feels wrong.

There is no rush. No clear destination.
Just explore, wander, and get lost in the dream.

EXPLORE A WORLD BEYOND REALITY

Discover surreal environments filled with unusual places and strange structures. From endless green landscapes to impossible stairways and mysterious rooms, every location is designed to feel like something you have seen in a dream but cannot quite remember.

A DREAM WITHOUT RULES

The world of Dreamcore doesn't always follow the rules of reality.

Objects can appear where they shouldn't.
Paths can lead somewhere unexpected.
Familiar places can feel strangely unfamiliar.

TAKE YOUR TIME

Dreamcore is a relaxing exploration experience focused on atmosphere and discovery rather than traditional gameplay mechanics.

Walk. Explore. Look around.

And see where the dream takes you.

store_data.about_the_game:
ARCHEIO is about evaluating cold cases by living them. Do they deserve to stay open, or is it time to close them? The call is yours.

"Every case is inspired by a real report. Names, places, and details have been changed."

ARCHEIO: Night Shift

A 29 year old delivery rider picks up the last order of the shift from the shop he works at, working nights to support his new family. The rain won't let up, and when he reaches the apartment building, the elevator is out of service, again, and the stairwell lights flicker with every step up. He tells himself it's just a bad elevator and bad luck. Somewhere between the third floor and the door, he stops believing that. He makes it out that night. What he does next is the reason this case exists at all: he tells someone. What you're about to live through is what he told them.

The Gameplay

Night Shift is primarily a first-person walking simulator with narrative mechanics for exploration, environmental interaction, and conversation. The choices you make during the shift determine what you see, what you learn, and how the case is ultimately closed.

Key Features

  • Live the Report: Walk through the entire experience in first-person, experiencing the exact sequence of events as they were told.

  • Environmental Interaction & Dialogue: Navigate claustrophobic stairwells, inspect your surroundings, and respond to calls and messages as the shift unravels.

  • The Final Verdict: When the shift ends and you return to your desk, you decide whether this file gets archived or stays open.

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by space auto-battlers of old but wanting to bring just a dash of mid-battle influence and personality!

  • Setup your formation and sit back and watch your grand design unfold...

  • Help turn the tide of battle by ordering pilots to use their one-time unique ability

  • As the commander, pilots will occasionally ask for your input on a critical situation!

Roster of 10 pilots, each with their own unique personality and ability

​

  • Uses Ghost's elusive cloaking ability to drop an EMP payload into the midst of an enemy fleet

  • Use Mira's just-in-time healing nanites to keep a struggling ally in battle a little longer

  • Each pilot is fully voiced and you'll hear them interacting with each other throughout the battle!

Strategically design ships with 32 different modules across 4 ship classes

  • Should we melt our opponent with energy weapons -or- punch holes in them with kinetic cannons?

  • Are we placing our bets on stacking shields -or- will doubling down on thick armor be our saving grace?

  • Should we swarm them with nimble frigates -or- make a statement by bringing a Leviathan onto the battle field?

Light story elements unfold over over 4 acts with 3 unique factions 

  • Each of the three solar systems you'll visit brings its own set of challenges and an end boss fight

  • Learn about who the Heroes Guard is and how each pilot joined or was impacted by the organization

  • In the fourth act your war negotiation skills will be put to the test...

A moonlight project developed by a husband and father of two, where late evenings and early mornings sessions were made a little bit easier thanks to generative AI tooling. Always open to any constructive feedback!

store_data.about_the_game:
One room. One interrogator. Your life on the line.

In Verdict, you find yourself trapped in a high-stakes interrogation room, facing a relentless AI-driven detective who is convinced you are guilty of murder. You are not searching for clues—you are defending your own innocence.

Every answer you give is evaluated in real time. Standard excuses won't work, and lying without a solid strategy will only dig your grave deeper. The interrogator listens to every word, analyzes your consistency, and actively adapts their questioning strategy to break your defense.

KEY FEATURES

  • Dynamic AI Interrogation: Face a sophisticated interrogation system that dynamically responds to your arguments, pressures you on inconsistencies, and remembers everything you say.

  • High-Stakes Psychological Tension: Experience the suffocating atmosphere of a real suspect interview where every second counts and every word carries consequences.

  • Unpredictable Replayability: No two interrogations play out the same. The detective’s tactics and line of questioning adapt to your responses, forcing you to adjust your strategy on the fly.

  • Formulate Your Own Defense: Craft your narrative, manage your composure, and find logical loopholes in the detective's arguments to walk out a free person.

Can you maintain your composure under pressure, or will your own words convict you?

store_data.about_the_game:
NOTICE OF ASSIGNMENT

Your application has been processed. You have been placed at a desk.

The desk is not yours. The chair is not yours. The stamp is issued to the position, not to you, and will be recovered when the position is reassigned.

Report at eight. Do not be late.

THE WORK

They arrive as files.

A name, an identity number, a sector, a stated income, an amount requested, and a photograph. That is all you will ever have of them. You will not meet them, you will not hear them explain, and you will not find out what happened after you decided.

Somewhere in that paperwork is the truth, and somewhere in it, usually, is not.

You are not asked whether they deserve it. You are asked whether the paperwork holds.

Check the name against the record. Check the number, digit by digit. Check what they earn against what they are asking for. Check the deed, if there is a deed. Then drag the stamp down.

The next file is already on the desk.

THE RULES CHANGE

There is a new notice every morning.

New checks to run. Sectors that were approvable last week and are not approvable today. A watchlist that appears one morning and is longer the next. Nobody explains why, because nobody explains anything, and the notice does not care whether you read it.

What was competence yesterday is negligence today. The Department does not send a correction. It sends a deduction.

Two bad decisions and the day is written off. Meet quota or do not. Either way it is counted, and either way you are back at eight tomorrow.

TWO WAYS TO WORK

Story Mode. A fixed assignment. It is told through the files that reach your desk, the memos that arrive with them, and the work itself. Nobody sits you down and explains the plot. You will assemble it out of the paperwork, the way you assemble everything else here, and you will understand what it means somewhere around the point where it stops being deniable.

Endless Mode. The days keep coming and they keep getting worse. More checks, less time, applications whose lie is a single character in the wrong place. Your salary is your score, the leaderboard is public, and the record is held by somebody who is better at this than you.

Applications are reviewed in the order received.
Your file is also open.

store_data.about_the_game:
Soul of Slime is a strategic auto battler built around cards and elemental synergies. Each turn, acquire new cards, improve your build, and enter asynchronous PvP battles against saved builds created by other players.

CREATE YOUR BUILD

Each turn, choose from new cards and develop your slime's build. Collect three copies of the same card to upgrade it, and make the most of your limited card slots.

Different combinations of cards, levels, and elements create different strategies in every run.

MASTER SIX ELEMENTS

Create different synergies with the six elements Granite, Mercury, Ember, Frost, Astral, and Quintessence.

Pair the right elements with the right cards, build powerful combinations, and adapt your strategy to your opponent's build.

FIGHT BUILDS FROM REAL PLAYERS

Your opponent does not need to be online at the same time.

Soul of Slime saves builds created by other players and matches you against them. This lets you play at your own pace while still competing against choices made by real players.

SURVIVE 10 TURNS

Every turn brings a new opponent and a new decision.

Upgrade your cards, cover your weaknesses, and prepare for increasingly powerful builds. A strategy that works against one opponent may not be enough against the next.

Keep improving and adapting your build to reach the end of turn 10.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a botanist. You are not a pilot.

Your UFO is in a field on Earth, and it is not going anywhere without fuel. Fortunately,

this planet grows things — badly, slowly, in the wrong colors, but it grows things. Splice

what you find into something that grows fast enough to get you home.

Good Dirt is a hex-grid roguelike deckbuilder. Your deck is crops. Your board is a

field. Every run is a journey outward from the crash site, and how far you get is the score.

Plant a board, not a card

Each field is a handful of hex tiles and a harvest goal. Draw crops, spend water, and place

them — then watch how they read each other. Neighbors feed neighbors. Families stack. The

same three cards score completely differently depending on where they land.

There is no waiting for things to grow. You assemble the board, the board resolves, you take

what it made. The puzzle is the planning, not the patience.

Fuel is the whole story

Fuel does two jobs, and they fight each other:

  • [Every day you spend inside a field burns fuel. Take too long to hit the goal and the run ends right there.

  • Every step across the map burns fuel too. Distance is something you buy.

There's no shop to top up. You refuel by [b]overshooting[/b] — growing past the goal converts

the surplus into fuel. So the safe, exact-change harvest keeps you alive and gets you nowhere.

The greedy one is what moves you.

The dirt is permanent

Clear a plot and it hands you its soil. Soil doesn't get consumed — it gets banked,

and every plot you clear raises how much of it you can lay down. Placing it permanently

unlocks new tiles on your grid, for this field and every field after.

You start each run on six hexes. What the board looks like by the end is something you built.

Read the stones

Every tile you clear surveys a color. Survey enough and the map coughs up a Glyph Stone

— carved by aliens who came here before you, left behind for whoever showed up next with a

ship to decode them. Decoded glyphs are run-wide: they change how crops score, how soil

behaves, what a day costs.

The colors you chase determine which glyphs you're offered, so routing across the map is

deck-building by other means. Beat a world's boss and you're offered a cross-color legend

— the rare glyphs that belong to two colors at once, and the ones that decide what a run

actually becomes.

Choose the route, live with it

The map is one continuous hex world that grows outward as you explore it. You only ever move

outward — no backtracking, no second visit. Each step offers a small fan of choices: a safe

flatland, a hostile specialty field, a workshop to upgrade a crop, a lab to splice two into

something new.

Everything on that fan costs fuel to reach. That's the run: a series of small, honest

questions about what you can afford.

 

No villain. Nothing is hunting you. You are just very far from home, and home is expensive.

Lose and you're not punished — you're still stranded. Try a different route.

store_data.about_the_game:
Site 12. One pod, one core, and whatever you remember.

Terraform Co. runs the off-world division, and you just got posted to an unsurveyed plot on a green planet with nothing built on it. The company wants two things out of the rock, in this order: a working operation, and a profit.

You are #15 of 15 on the S&G-15, the planet's stock index. Fourteen companies are above you.

Factory feeds depot, depot feeds town, town pays for the next factory

That's the whole company, and it's the loop the entire game runs on.

Start with your hands. Clear dirt and rock with a pickaxe, tranq a native grazer and carry it back to a pen — grazers breed, and a full pen is a livelihood. Then stop doing it yourself. Belts haul while you're somewhere useful, automated miners work the ore you were chipping at, and machines turn all of it into things people will pay for.

  • Ore — crush, smelt and forge it into alloy, with sand, slag and glass falling out as byproducts you'll want to recycle rather than dump.
  • Premium metals — pulverize ingots to dust, enrich it with acid into pure alloy, and turn that into power cells.
  • Electronics — etch crystal dust into wafers and foil, assemble microchips, then smartphones, then laptops.
  • Food — the grazer line, all the way up to a suspiciously premium burger.
  • Chemicals — vats, acid, glycerin, dye and fragrance, gluing the organic and mineral sides together.
  • Five tech tiers, gated behind what you've actually produced — not a menu you buy your way through.

Then build the city that buys it

Product isn't money until somebody buys it, and nobody lives here yet. So you lay the first road.

Buy and place buildings, and the town grows on top of your factory's output. Residents move into your houses, drive and walk the streets you laid, and spend money in the shops you placed. But shops don't conjure stock — you supply them. Belt goods into a Cargo Depot and it runs vans out to every shop that wants them. New building types unlock from production milestones, so the town's growth is paced by the factory's.

It's a second economy stacked on the first, and it's alive down to street level: cars queue at junctions, pedestrians cross at the kerb, vans pull into loading bays.

Climb the S&G-15

Coins come from selling. Rank comes from contracts.

Each of the fourteen rival corporations has a fixed ladder of supply contracts in its sector. Clear a ladder and you overtake that company — a headline runs, and their trade secret becomes a permanent perk of yours. Ladder contracts are untimed, so they're the campaign; timed spot orders pay the bills in between.

A live headline engine moves sell prices with booms, bubbles and shortages, and rumours land about a day ahead of the effect — so a factory that's paying attention can build toward the spike. The market terminal puts the index board, contract ladders, spot orders, a price grid with sparklines and the news feed in one place.

Clear all fourteen ladders and Terraform Co. tops the index.

And the raiders

Alien raiders drop on the landing pad and run at your core — they want it shut down, and they'll help themselves to your stock on the way. It's an interruption to build against rather than the job itself.

Your bat never runs dry, which is the whole appeal of it. The tranq gun takes things alive. Raider types keep fixed identities from the first raid to the fortieth — runners are always faster than you, armored always shrug off the first few swings — so the pressure comes from numbers and composition, not from a stat slider quietly outpacing you.

Built to be looked at

Grounded industrial art direction: worn matte machinery, honest materials, real proportions, with saturated colour reserved strictly for the things you need to read at a glance. If it's glowing, it means something.

The build browser's icons are photographs of the actual buildings, taken by the game itself — so they can't go stale, and what you see in the menu is exactly what lands on the ground.
