store_data.about_the_game:
BRING ORDER TO THE CHAOS

The card shop is a complete mess. Over 5,000 collectible cards are scattered everywhere, waiting to be found, inspected, sorted, and returned to their correct places.

Take your time, examine every card, and turn a chaotic shop into a perfectly organized collection.

SORT 5,000+ CARDS

Every card has its own characteristics. Check its type, rarity, number, symbols, and other details to figure out exactly where it belongs.

Find the correct cabinet, choose the right shelf, and put every card in its proper place.

Some cards may be easy to identify. Others might be face-down or hidden among thousands of other cards, making you look a little closer.

FIND & OPEN CARD PACKS

Cards aren’t the only things scattered around the shop.

Discover card packs among the chaos, open them, and reveal 5 cards inside each pack.

But opening the pack is only the beginning every new card still needs to be inspected, classified, and placed where it belongs.

DISCOVER GRADED CARDS

Keep an eye out for special graded collectible cards.

Discover cards with different grades and find the highest-rated ones. A Grade 10 could be waiting somewhere among the chaos.

Find them, inspect their grades, and give these special cards the place they deserve.

FROM CHAOS TO PERFECT ORDER

At first, the shop is overwhelmed with thousands of scattered cards.

One card at a time, one shelf at a time, watch the mess disappear and the collection take shape.

Find. Inspect. Sort. Organize.

Can you put all 5,000+ cards back where they belong?

store_data.about_the_game:
Death was supposed to be the end.

For archaeologist and mythology scholar Cassian Thorne, it becomes the beginning of a journey through every answer humanity ever gave to what comes next.

After a catastrophic event tears Cassian and his younger sister Lyra from the living world, Cassian awakens in the Crossroads: an impossible realm connecting the afterlives of different civilizations. Lyra is somewhere beyond its gates, and something ancient is already rewriting the laws that govern the dead.

To find her and return to life, Cassian must travel through six mythological realms, confront the beings who rule them, recover the broken principles of the Crossroads, and discover why his soul belongs to no single divine order.

His journey brings him face to face with Persephone, Bastet, Freyja, Chang'e, Inanna, and Ame-no-Uzume. Each goddess rules a different realm, carries her own desires and conflicts, and challenges a different part of Cassian's identity.

What begins as a desperate search for Lyra gradually becomes something much larger.

Cassian has spent his entire life studying gods as stories. Now those gods can speak back.

Some will challenge him.

Some will desire him.

Some will reveal truths about death that humanity was never meant to know.

And somewhere at the center of it all waits Vareth, the Last Judge, whose vision for eternity may erase the difference between salvation and oblivion forever.

GODS OF ETERNITY: SEX & DEATH is an adult fantasy visual novel combining mythology, romance, mystery, emotional drama, and explicit sexual content in a single cinematic story.

The game features:

  • Six distinct mythological realms inspired by Greek, Egyptian, Norse, Chinese, Mesopotamian, and Japanese mythology.

  • Six adult romantic heroines with individual personalities, relationships, emotional themes, and story arcs.

  • Fully animated adult scenes integrated into each heroine's chapter.

  • Explicit sexual content and nudity between consenting adult characters.

  • A gallery system where unlocked CGs and animated adult scenes can be revisited.

  • Cinematic illustrated story scenes and large-scale mythological set pieces.

  • Dialogue choices that shape Cassian's personality, reactions, romantic tone, and smaller character moments while remaining part of a focused narrative.

  • A story centered on mortality, identity, memory, desire, freedom, sacrifice, and the value of choosing your own future.

  • A single complete narrative that builds toward a large-scale finale connecting all six mythological worlds.

Travel through Persephone's kingdom between spring and death. Follow the illuminated names of the dead through Bastet's Duat. Stand beneath the aurora with Freyja as an eternal battlefield falls silent. Face impossible memories beneath Chang'e's moon. Pass through Inanna's Seven Gates with everything that defines you stripped away. And follow Ame-no-Uzume toward the first dawn of a future that should not exist.

Cassian begins his journey believing only one thing matters:

Lyra must live, even if he does not.

The gods of eternity are going to make him question that belief.

Because saving someone you love does not mean your own life is worth less.

And when the final gate opens, even the laws of death may have to change.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cinema is not just a building. It is a weekly performance.

In Popcorn & Premieren, every screening is a decision. Rescue a closed neighborhood cinema, earn back your audience and turn a fragile opening week into a business people want to return to.

Plan the week. Read the room.


Build a schedule on a real time grid. Film runtimes, cleaning breaks, age restrictions, contracts, prices and closing time all compete for the same hours. Fill the right hall at the right moment—or discover why a seemingly perfect plan collapsed after the doors opened.

Run the whole cinema


Assign staff to ticketing, snacks, admissions, projection and cleaning. Watch queues form, follow groups through the foyer and see guests find their seats. Energy use, maintenance, projector wear, cleanliness and waiting times turn management decisions into visible consequences.

Build a film market with a memory


200 original films rotate through premieres, regular runs, last-chance weeks, pauses and budget returns. Negotiate guarantees, revenue shares, minimum screenings and premiere bonuses. A film can be a critical flop, a profitable surprise or the title that gives your cinema a reputation.

Grow from one screen to a destination


Expand from a rescued single-screen theater to a two-level multiplex with seven halls. Add an IMAX-style large-format wing with steep seating, a giant screen and dual projection. Later, step behind the camera and produce foyer spots, social trailers and prestige trailers for your own releases.

Make the audience part of the show


Genre, rating, finale, price, word of mouth and occupancy shape the room. Laughter, gasps, emotion, applause, cheers and boos are not a fixed loop—they are the audience telling you what worked.

Steam desktop features


• Mouse-first navigation with zoom, pan and a free desktop camera
• Optional higher-density cinematic crowds for powerful PCs
• Director Mode for HUD-free views and 2× screenshot captures
• Enhanced graphics profiles with higher shadows, anti-aliasing and up to 120 FPS
• Windows and macOS builds with platform-aware settings

Every film, poster, brand and character in the game is original fiction.

You are an Affluample, a member of a wealthy race that became caught in tensions with the poorer Scourgetide race because of shady business practices.

You go out foraging for food when you see a secret meeting between the top ranking Scourgetide army officials and their lunatic leader. They plan to strike back against the Affluamples and regain control of the continent by taking over every major region for themselves.

Over the course of your journey to stop the complete takeover, you will encounter many enemies and challenges that you must overcome with over a dozen powerful weapons and several gadgets that you can upgrade with frequent use, purchased by Saga Fragments you collect by exploring all over every environment and destroying breakable pieces of the world.

From a gun that shoots volcanic rock straight from the sky to a remote controlled car with TNT strapped to it, your arsenal will be very versatile to deal with any situation presented to you.

You can upgrade your health, defense, weapons, and armor and even get cosmetics for your home from the vendors found all over the world, using your Saga Fragments. 

After you complete the game you can get access to features like a Randomizer mode that shuffles locations of every item and map in the game to give you a fresh new experience, either alone or with your friends online! You can even put on Bankruptcy Gloves.. whatever they are.

Island Farm is a cozy high-score game where you unlock new plants, combine their abilities, and expand your island.

The Gameplay

You start each run with a small island, and once you've planted and harvested your starting crops, you get to select the next plant to unlock.

Some plants increase the value of others while some spread on their own. Many strategic combintions exist.

The run ends when you have no more plants remaining. Then, start a new island and try beat your best score because there's always new combinations to discover.

What this game isn't:

  • Focused on decorating your island or customizing every detail

store_data.about_the_game:
Not Ready for Service is a turn-based tactics game on a hex grid with no initiative order. Set in 2239, you are a specialized doctor, an immunician; you control a set of micro-bots to fight pathogens inside a human body. Form your squad from dozens of different units, fight pathogens, save lives, advance in your career, and learn the fundamentals of the immune system: the difference between self and other.

Fight to preserve life

Every fight takes place in a piece of living tissue. Each combat is procedurally generated for the organ it belongs to. Deploy your squad, act with your units in any order you like, and hold the Cells against the pathogens coming through. You are not protecting a health bar. You are protecting the Cells keeping a person alive. Lose the fight and the tissue is lost with it.

Analyze the Pathogens' Intent...

The Advanced External Guidance for Immune System, AEGIS, predicts every pathogen's intent with 100% accuracy, showing you the enemy's whole plan before it happens, not just the path it will take, but what it will do when it arrives and what that will cost. Perfect information is your starting point. Can you synthesize the perfect plan given your resources and the enemy's intent?

...and exploit their paths.

Drop a hazard, a mine, or a trap on an enemy's path, lure them in with various actions, let them crumble under your tactical decisions!

Use Cytokines to tilt the odds of each battle

Each patient comes with a set of Cytokines: power-ups that affect both the Player and Enemy units when picked up. Use them to improve your units, or to degrade the enemies. 

Evolve your units during each combat

Pathogens drop genetic fragments once they are eliminated. Any player unit that collects them can upgrade an action of their choosing. With carefully selected upgrades across different units, discover synergies and dominate the battlefield!

Across the patient: the clock only moves when you move

Zoom out and the patient is a map of nodes. Every node is a tissue. The infected ones carry a timer, and when it runs out, the infection spreads to neighbours. The only way to clear a node is to go in and fight for it. Win or lose, coming back out costs a tick of every timer on the map. Winning clears the tissue. Losing hands it to the infection. So which fight you take, and which one you leave alone, is a decision with a price.

Invoke the body's various defenses

Between fights, use different inflammations to reshape the node map. The battle against the infection can be won or lost with a simple decision. Are you ready to take the responsibility?

Fight across 3 different procedurally generated tissue types

Different pathogens prefer to attack different tissue types: fight them on skin, kidney, and muscle. More traditionally called biomes, the procedurally generated combat maps will challenge your tactical decisions with their layouts. Do you have what it takes to save the patient?

Unravel the story behind your character

You are an immunician trainee, recently moved to another country, curious to discover life expressed through different cultures. When you were young, you lost your mother to an infection because there were not enough immunicians to save your mother. This affected your career choice deep down. You also like being exposed to life and living things, and admire the fundamental idea underneath the immune system. The fact that those mindless cells, that used to work before the compound, could separate self from other.

In this build

  • Turn-based hex tactics with fully resolved enemy forecasts

  • Procedurally generated hex grids based on the organ being infected

  • 4 player and 6 enemy units, across 3 patients on 3 different tissue types, aka, biomes

  • 6 Cytokines that can easily tilt the odds of the fight

  • 12 action upgrades to create more synergies

  • Full interface and subtitle localization in 9 languages

Upcoming build

We plan to implement the following features in the next build:

  • 4 more player units

  • 2 more biomes

  • 6 more enemy units

  • 8 more action upgrades

store_data.about_the_game:
Start with nothing. Build an empire.

Primal Clicker is an idle city-building game where every click pushes your civilization forward. Gather resources, construct buildings, recruit workers, and transform a tiny prehistoric settlement into a thriving civilization.

Build and Grow

Start small and expand your settlement one building at a time. Increase production, unlock new opportunities, and watch your village grow as your economy becomes more powerful.

Put Your People to Work

Recruit workers and assign them to produce resources automatically. Upgrade your production and discover increasingly powerful ways to grow—even while you're away.

Explore a Primal World

Send explorers into the unknown, discover new lands, and uncover rewards that help your civilization advance.

Keep Getting Stronger

Primal Clicker is all about that satisfying idle-game loop: build, upgrade, automate, expand, and come back stronger. Whether you're actively clicking your way to the next upgrade or letting your civilization work for you, there's always another goal just within reach.

How far can you take your civilization?

store_data.about_the_game:
Night Drive is a retro ASCII driving simulator focused on late-night highway cruising. Drive into the quiet dark across infinite procedurally generated roads with dynamic pseudo-3D perspective rendering.

Key Features:

  • Solitary Atmosphere: A calm, ambient experience focused entirely on the quiet rhythm of late-night driving—no timers, no rivals, just the road ahead.

  • Pure ASCII Graphics: Rendered entirely using text characters in a clean monochrome retro style, complete with dynamic headlight illumination and a starry sky.

  • Manual Driving Mechanics: Full control over throttle, braking, steering, and a 5-speed manual transmission with RPM telemetry.

  • Multiple Track Styles: Switch between open desert highways, rolling hills, and tight mountain passes with sharp hairpin curves on the fly.

• Satisfying Crafting & Repairing: Find missing parts, fix mechanism pieces, and bring the old steam train back to life piece by piece!

store_data.about_the_game:
Start Your Hip-Hop Journey in an Underground Studio

RAP OR DIE is a hip-hop creation and music career simulation game. Play as an aspiring rapper starting out in a humble underground studio. Take on creative challenges, collaborate with producers, artists, and internet personalities, and gradually build your audience, reputation, and record label.

Complete the Full Music-Making Process

  • Write lyrics around different themes and emotions

  • Create beats with drum kits, melodies, and a variety of sounds

  • Buy melody samples from the shop and use them in your productions

  • Step into the recording booth and perform your vocals

  • Mix vocals and instrumentals together—anything can happen

  • Release your track and watch the comments, streams, and revenue roll in

Create Music That’s Truly Yours

Choose your lyrics, rhythms, melodies, and performance styles to create songs across different genres and moods. Every creative decision influences the final result and shapes how listeners respond to your music.

Some tracks may earn respect from the underground scene. Others may attract a loyal fanbase. And some might unexpectedly go viral for reasons you never saw coming.

Build Your Music Career

Start out as an unknown rapper and take on creative challenges to grow your reputation. Meet producers, singers, and online personalities, unlock new collaboration opportunities, and gradually rebuild a record label of your own.

The Internet Will Judge Your Music

Your songs won’t receive a simple score. Listeners, fellow artists, producers, and online communities will all react in their own unpredictable ways.

Your track might become an underrated hidden gem, a sudden viral hit, or an unforgettable internet spectacle.

Every release tells a different story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rhythm isn’t background music in Offsync. It’s a force that moves machines, shapes environments, and turns danger into patterns you can read.

Explore a fractured world where things have fallen out of rhythm. Wander through strange settlements, listen for what feels wrong, uncover hidden patterns, and help places settle back into harmony.

Between destinations, the journey itself becomes the challenge. Threats move toward you in rhythmic formations. Read the pattern, watch the timing close in, and parry at the right moment. Perfect timing doesn’t just block an attack: it changes what happens around you.

READ THE PATTERN. HIT THE MOMENT.

Travel through dangerous routes where rhythm replaces traditional encounters.

Time your parries perfectly, adapt to changing formations, and learn to recognize order inside the chaos. A perfect, a near miss, and a complete failure can each send the encounter in a different direction.

A WORLD POWERED BY RESONANCE

In Offsync, rhythm is part of the world itself.

Machines, environments, creatures, technology and even perception respond to resonance, a physical force that civilization has learned to harness.

But something has disrupted that rhythm.

Explore villages where machinery stutters, sounds overlap, movement falls out of step and familiar places become strangely uncomfortable. Observe what is happening, discover the pattern underneath it, and change the environment until a new balance emerges.

EVERY PLACE FEELS DIFFERENT

There isn’t one correct version of harmony.

Different characters experience the same world in different ways. What feels comfortable to one person may be overwhelming to another, and restoring a place is not about making everyone the same.

Pay attention. Listen. Notice what others miss.

CONFLICT BECOMES PERFORMANCE

Some problems cannot be resolved by adjusting the environment.

Major encounters become theatrical Counterpoint Duels: musical confrontations shaped by the personalities, emotions and rhythms of the characters involved.

These aren’t ordinary battles. They are conversations where tension, timing and response become part of the performance.

FALL OUT OF SYNC. FIND THE PATTERN.

Explore.
Listen.
Parry.
Restore.

And discover what happens when an entire world loses its rhythm.

store_data.about_the_game:
Clawstral: Claw machine roguelite

You know that claw machine at the fair that never grabs anything? This one actually does. Sometimes, at least. Clawstral is a 3D roguelite set inside a claw machine.

The physics is real: the clamp closes, the cable begins to rise, and for a few seconds you’ll remain suspended in a limbo between hope and frenzy, praying the grip holds.

After drawing the ball, you will need to drop it onto a board filled with pegs until it lands in a slot, which will determine part of the score.

You’ll earn Prizes and Buttons that will drastically change the course of the game. You place Prizes on the cabinet shelf, and they help you, among other things, boost your score. Buttons, on the other hand, are mounted on the control panel and can be pressed whenever you like: each one has a unique special effect. Over 160 items await you, with many more on the way!

Summary:

● 160+ items (Prizes + Buttons) with unique abilities and effects

● 11 different types of balls, each with its own value

● 8 distinctive ball traits

● 13 scoring holes, each with a different effect

● Display case for storing items during the match

● Classic Mode, featuring 8 rounds of play

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by the greatest incremental classics, Ascend Idle: Chronicles takes the essence of what makes a progression game deeply addictive and distills it into a pure form.

Master dozens of interconnected skills with just a click or a tap. Ascend Idle: Chronicles is a feature-rich idle and incremental RPG that combines familiar mechanics with a brand-new experience. Whether you are a veteran of incremental games or someone looking for an intense yet accessible adventure that fits easily into a busy lifestyle, this game offers an addictive experience like no other.

Every skill and system serves a purpose, interacting with one another in deep ways. This means all the effort invested in one skill ends up benefiting others. What strategy will you deploy to master all specialties?

Besides, you can discover and utilize over one thousand unique items and collect dozens of absolutely adorable pets.

Thanks to regular updates, the adventure is constantly growing with new materials, resources, and challenges. Do you have what it takes to conquer all specialties, dungeons, and monsters of Ascend Idle?

store_data.about_the_game:
You'll Be Mined is an incremental crawler about racking up points and finding your way out of a dungeon.

Each stage is a set of minesweeper fields solved against the clock. One timer runs the whole stage: opened cells give seconds back, mines take hearts. Run out of time and the stage ends. Run out of hearts and you do.

The shop between stages sells healing, spare time, and modifiers. Every third stage is locked, and the doorman charges a toll to get in.

Modifiers stack into a build: multipliers, bonuses for specific cells, explosions. Turn single 1s into hundreds and mines into hearts.

A long stay down here softens the mind unless you give it something to make. There is charcoal, and there is chalk. Draw whatever you like on the wall: other players will find it in their dungeons, and you will find theirs in yours.

You are not the first to get stuck down here. A break room waits between the stages. The merchant, the card sharp, the doorman: each of them once took a wrong turn too. They have been here a very long time. And some of them would rather you stayed as well.

And remember: statistically, you'll be fine (or mined).

store_data.about_the_game:
GET THE BALL THROUGH THEIR HOOP

BOOMSTICKS is a two-team aerial ball game for 1v1 to 4v4. Every rider has a broom, 100 HP and one loaded shotgun shell.

A clean close-range blast kills. Firing starts a 2.5-second reload, so a missed shot leaves you exposed. The recoil kicks your own broom backwards. Use it to change direction, break away or throw yourself somewhere dangerous.

THE BALL STAYS IN PLAY

Carrying the ball takes your gun out of the fight. Hold the throw button to set the distance, lock a pass onto a teammate, then release.

Shotgun pellets are real projectiles. Hit a thrown ball from the side to bend its path. Blast it from behind to drive it through the hoop. Missed balls fall for a moment, then hang in the air under a recovery spell so the fight stays above the ruins.

STEAL THE UPPER HAND

Health and movement pickups float along risky routes. Horizontal wind tunnels fire riders across gaps. Blade traps and spikes punish anyone who stops watching the arena.

The Golden Switch moves through the map during regulation. Catch it and your one-shell boomstick becomes fully automatic for 20 seconds.

If the clock ends tied, both teams return to the start line. The Switch turns gold, breaks loose and starts running. First rider to catch it wins the match.

BUILT FOR THE REMATCH

Host Custom Games in 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or 4v4. Change teams, tune the match and equip different riders, brooms and boomsticks.

BOOMSTICKS mixes chunky PSX models and pixel blood with fast third-person flight, loud hits and a cursed medieval arena hanging over a dead forest.

store_data.about_the_game:
Read the board. Win the game.

Archronica is a turn-based card battler fought across a 2×3 grid of tiles.
Each unit you summon leaves a Blessing on its tile. Gather three Blessings of one element to trigger a Minor Resonance — six for a Major Resonance that shakes the entire board.
Where you place each unit matters: Taunts wall off a column, Flyers soar over the front line, Piercing attacks punch through it. Every placement is a decision.

Five elements, five ways to fight

  • 🔥 Fire — the sprinter: reach Resonance first and finish the job with relentless pursuit
  • 💧 Water — the slow burn: chain spells, freeze and reflect, then land a game-ending payoff
  • 🌳 Forest — the ramp: accelerate Blessings and grow stronger every turn
  • ✨ Light — the wide front: heal, consecrate, and hold the board with the Holy Kingdom's host
  • 🌑 Dark — the schemer: feed the graveyard and pay in sacrifice for power
Decks are 30 cards, up to two elements. Your pairing defines your game plan.

Awaken your Legends

Every Legend carries an Awakening condition tied to its deck's win plan. Cast enough spells, land enough blows, mourn enough allies — fulfill the condition, and your Legend reveals its true form.

The tale of the Awakened

In a world shaped by five divine siblings, an ancient Demon Lord is stirring once more. Alen, a young villager from the frontier, touches a nameless shard — and awakens.
Journey through a classic sword-and-sorcery world of eight peoples in Story Chapter 1: "Awakening."

Features

  • Placement strategy on a 2×3 grid, with Blessings and Resonance to build up your board
  • 90+ cards across five elements
  • Awakening mechanics on every Legend
  • Solo battles with stepped AI difficulty + Story Mode
  • Earn cards by playing
  • Full Japanese and English support

store_data.about_the_game:
Cats Must Be Petted!

An Incremental Game About Petting Cats

Cats have one simple demand.

They must be petted.

Step onto a little patch of grass, find a cat, and give it some attention. Tap to get a cat's attention, then keep petting when it rolls over and reveals its belly. Fill its satisfaction meter and watch it happily run off...

But where did it go?

A little while later, the cat comes running back with a surprise — a fish, a toy, a shiny trinket, or something much more unexpected.

Use the gifts your cats bring you to become a better petter, unlock new abilities, discover different cats, and build a purr-fectly ridiculous petting operation.

Pet. Upgrade. Repeat.

Features

  • Pet adorable cats — Get their attention, earn their trust, and give them the belly rubs they deserve.

  • Simple, satisfying interactions — Tap, hold, watch the cats react, and enjoy immediate rewards.

  • Incremental progression — Upgrade your petting abilities and become more efficient at satisfying increasingly demanding cats.

  • Cats bring you gifts — Fish, toys, treasures, and mysterious objects can appear when your cats return from their adventures.

  • Build your own petting strategy — Choose upgrades and special abilities to create powerful combinations.

  • Meet different cats — Discover cats with different looks and personalities, each bringing a little more variety to your petting routine.

  • Short, relaxing sessions — Easy to pick up, easy to understand, and surprisingly hard to stop.

Remember:

The cats must be petted.

store_data.about_the_game:
MALEDICTION is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, environmental investigation, and narrative discovery.

You find yourself inside a quiet, foreboding house where an unspeakable tragedy occurred. With no hand-holding, you must navigate the shifting corridors, inspect hidden objects, and unlock sealed spaces to piece together the grim truth behind the curse.

KEY FEATURES

  • Atmospheric Horror: A slow-burn, psychological dread built on chilling soundscapes and visual tension, punctuated by unsettling scares.

  • Environmental Investigation: Search through the house, examine fragmented clues, and solve environmental puzzles to progress deeper.

  • Shifting Space: The house does not remain static. Pay close attention to subtle anomalies and altered rooms as you explore.

  • Multiple Endings: Unravel the mystery to discover distinct conclusions based on the clues you find and the secrets you uncover.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE RUNE CHOOSES. YOU COMMAND.

In RUNECAST, every cast changes the choices on the table. Cast runes to recruit, arrange your formation across three lanes, and watch your team turn those decisions into combat. The battle is automatic; the strategy is yours.

  • Cast runes and adapt your formation to the result.

  • Position each role freely across three lanes.

  • Merge three identical heroes to advance from level 1 to level 3.

  • Find equipment between waves and fill up to three slots per hero.

4 HEROES IN THE DEMO. 3 AFTER.

Dwarf, Archer, Healer, and Thief form the demo roster. Barbarian, Druid, and Necromancer appear in a separate section marked for after the demo.

T1 and T2 evolutions remain sealed on this page. Discover their paths by playing the demo — without spoilers for names, forms, or powers.

BOSSES THAT CHANGE THE BATTLE

Bosses are more than larger health bars. The Web Queen advances on your team, plants a cocoon, and floods the field with spiderlings. Striking the cocoon delays the next spawn; destroying it ends the brood and forces the Queen into melee.

Read the mechanic, change your target, and rebuild the formation before the arena is overrun.

FORGE EVERY RUN

  • 16 editable faces: shape the rune bag in the Forge and change the possibilities of future casts.

  • Merging: collect three identical heroes and advance from level 1 to level 3.

  • Individual equipment: distribute 12 Rare and Epic finds across your heroes, with up to three slots per team member.

  • Run bonuses: the Shop and Relic Shelf strengthen the journey without replacing each hero's equipment.

  • Four acts, forty waves: cross 10 waves per act and adapt to new enemies and bosses.

EQUIP EACH HERO

Victories can reveal new dungeon finds. Open the Team menu, select a hero, and move items from the Chest into three individual slots. Every piece has its own effect and compatibility: extra range, bleeding, first-hit protection, target changes, and other decisions that reshape a build without revealing evolutions.

PLAY THE DEMO

The demo offers Easy difficulty. Build your first formation, face the Web Queen, and wishlist RUNECAST.

store_data.about_the_game:
Listening Is the Tower's Firepower

Each word fuels the tower's assault. Catch the missing word from the audio, type it out, and a cannon blast strikes the lead enemy. The sharper your listening and the faster your fingers, the deadlier your firepower; hesitate for even a moment, and the horde pushes closer!

Tactics Win the Battle

During combat, skill cards flow into your hand in sequence, allowing you to input a command code at any split second to unleash an assault:

  • Three attack trajectories: slam the front rank head-on, bombard a dense crowd, or fire a piercing laser through the threats at the rear. A flexible arsenal for diverse formations: when swift-moving runners close in, will you intercept them first, or prepare the precision shot?

  • Bosses and showdown cards: bosses deploy lethal abilities, and the showdown card is your ultimate trump card against them. While the massive cannon locks onto the boss, can your frontline hold back the minions rushing in?

  • Barracks and soldiers: when a construction slot becomes available, erect a garrison at the bottleneck. Soldiers anchor the enemy in place and expand your tactical possibilities.

  • A branching map: follow the splitting paths across each chapter, where far more than combat awaits. Confront an elite foe, restock at the shop, test your luck on the casino wheel, or risk the trial of greed. Strategy or fortune: the next move is yours to make.

  • Relics and talents: leveling up unlocks new ways to attack and new talent bonuses. Just how high can your tower's damage stack?

  • Enemy affixes: the deeper the chapters, the stronger the enemies grow. When their ability combinations turn vicious, your firepower will do the talking.

A Smart Difficulty System

Worried that basic English will slow you down, or that advanced training won't show real progress? Intelligent difficulty balancing ensures a smooth, stress-free listen-and-type journey.

  • Graded difficulty, a wealth of passages: Texts are layered by level and spread across topics, so the game stays enjoyable at every learning stage.

  • Adjustable speed and accents: British and American voices, male and female, for well-rounded listening practice.

  • Battle records, visible growth: Charts track your accuracy, speed, and difficulty curve, recorded separately for each save.

  • Word help that keeps the guns firing: Recognize the sound but blank out on the spelling? The hint assistant steps in right when you need it.

Come hold the line in Listening Post each day. The battles end; the listening stays with you.

What's Next

Trials that push past the level cap, deeper strategic synergies ready to unfold, and far deadlier foes waiting on the horizon.

store_data.about_the_game:
The dead don't need to run. There are simply more of them than you.

Lead the Living is an isometric zombie survival game about keeping a group of people alive — and you're the one making the calls. Scavenge what's left of the world, build a base worth defending, and hold a community together while the crowds outside only get bigger.

THE ROUTINE

Go out with an empty bag. Come back with food, water, fuel and materials. Spend it on walls, on supplies, on the people who need feeding. Then the dead arrive, and you find out what you got wrong.
That's the loop, and it grows every time you survive it: more mouths to feed, more wall to hold, and less left out there to find.

YOUR PEOPLE

Survivors aren't followers with a health bar. Each one is a person who's good at something, has a job at your base, and has an opinion about how you're running it.
  • Take in people you find on the road, and the ones who turn up at your gate
  • Put them to work scavenging, building or looking after the wounded
  • Feed them every day — hungry people stop trusting whoever's in charge
  • Death is permanent — you don't replace anyone, you just recruit someone else

YOUR BASE

Develop your base. Walls, fences, defenses — placed by hand. None of it is decoration: it gets hit, it breaks, and a hole in your perimeter is tomorrow's emergency.

THE DEAD

No runners. No screamers. No boss fights. Just slow walkers that never stop and never lose interest — and they come to noise.
So noise is what you're really managing. A gunshot is a decision. So is a car engine, or a fight you didn't have to start. Out on the map the dead drift together into herds that move on their own, and a herd that finds your walls doesn't wander off.

ONE LIFE

There's nothing to win. Loot doesn't come back, fuel runs out, and eventually something goes wrong that you can't fix. When you die, the run dies with you — and the next one starts from nothing.

Somebody has to keep these people alive.

It's going to be you.

Tight Turn is all about driving something far too big through spaces that feel just a little too small. Drive on carefully designed levels, come close to hitting parked cars, dodge barriers, and make those awkward turns without destroying everything around you.

Each level is a carefully designed course, filled with tight turns, obstacles and tricky sections that will test your ability to maneuver.

Speed isn't everything. Plan your turns, find the right angle, and pretend that everything was under control when you finally make it around the corner.

Features:

  • Levels: Explore handcrafted levels, each with its own challenges

  • Progress: Unlock levels one by one

  • Medals: Chase the best time possible on every level

  • Leaderboard: Set personal records, and climb the leaderboard

  • Multiplayer: Challenge your friends in multiplayer time attac

How close can you get to the wall without touching it? How many obstacles can you avoid before you get a little too confident? Can you get a good time without getting stuck on every single turn?

There is only one way to find out.

store_data.about_the_game:
WANTED: NIGHT STAFF — BELLWEATHER PUBLIC LIBRARY

Four positions. Cash paid nightly. Duties: front desk, returns, closing. Ask for the boss. Do not ask about the previous night staff.

OVERDUE is a 1–4 player co-op horror game about working the night shift at a small-town library in the year 2000.

The work is real: scan cards at the CRT terminal, hunt down requests in the stacks, shelve whatever the return chute spits out, and lock up at close. The pay is per task — and per photo, because the boss wants pictures of anything in the building that changed while your back was turned. He will not discuss what's in them.

Each night the patrons get stranger, and the rules on the desk note get longer:

• Damaged books go to the bin in the cellar. Not the shelves.

• Shelf 9 is closed.

• The Curse of Bellweather is unavailable. It has always been unavailable.

• The crying in aisle nine is the pipes. Do not go and look at the pipes.

• After midnight, that knocking is not a patron.

Follow the rules and you'll be fine. Probably. For a while. Three nights — most don't do three.

Bring coworkers: proximity voice chat means you'll hear exactly where your friend was standing when they stopped talking, and Steam invites drop them straight into your shift. Playing alone counts as fully staffed, legally speaking.

• 1–4 player online co-op, or solo

• Three escalating nights, choices, and a finale

• Photograph anomalies for cash — notice what changed

• Proximity voice, Steam invites, achievements, night-by-night saves

• The year 2000, fully committed: CRTs, polaroids, card catalogs, no cell phones

• Interface and subtitles in 18 languages

store_data.about_the_game:
A Strange Story in a Stranger Town

Passion is a story-driven, party-based JRPG inspired by the 16-bit era, mixing noir mystery, comedy, horror, and psychedelic weirdness.

You play as a private investigator who quickly makes one thing clear:

This isn't really his story.

What begins as an investigation gradually opens into something much stranger, as you explore an increasingly bizarre world filled with suspicious characters, dangerous places, and things that probably shouldn't exist.

Classic JRPG Combat, With More Control

Passion uses an ATB-inspired battle system built around giving you time to think without taking away the pressure of combat.

When a character is ready to act, the battle pauses. You can issue their command immediately, or hold their action and allow the rest of the party's gauges to fill, giving you control over when and how your team acts.

Combat emphasizes:

  • Status effects that actually matter

  • Elemental strengths and weaknesses

  • Party composition and character-specific abilities

  • Timing and action management

  • Preparation instead of simply grinding bigger numbers

Winning isn't just about having the highest stats. Knowing what you're fighting, and bringing the right tools for the job, can make all the difference.

Explore, Investigate, and Get Distracted

Travel through towns, dungeons, corrupted places, and other locations while uncovering what is happening around you.

Talk to people. Investigate suspicious situations. Find equipment and secrets. Wander off the obvious path.

As the game opens up, you'll have more freedom to decide where to go and what to pursue, with optional content and discoveries waiting for players willing to poke around.

Noir, Comedy, Horror, and Something Else Entirely

Passion doesn't stay in one genre for very long.

One moment you may be dealing with deadpan detective dialogue or an absurd situation in town. The next, something has gone profoundly wrong.

The game's 1990s-inspired world blends noir storytelling, comedy, horror, and psychedelic imagery with the structure of a classic console RPG.

Underneath all of it is a character-driven mystery about people pulled into something far stranger than they expected.

A workbench, a cardboard game board & a pile of paper pieces.

Every puzzle piece in KNICK is a chain of paper segments held together by fasteners. Each fastener is a hinge: pieces can be folded, turned, taken apart and put back together. A flat chain becomes an angle, a hook, or a staircase — whatever you're still missing to solve the level.

The first levels come easy. Later on, it takes a few detours in your head before everything fits just right.

  • A daily puzzle on the side

  • No timer, no score, and you can undo any misstep at any time

store_data.about_the_game:
A narrative adventure about collecting phrases and expressions

Calliope is an awkward, Elven girl who never grew up with the grace that Elven society expected her to have. Determined to be true to herself and find her own way of connecting with others, she writes down expressions as she hears them to later use in conversations. If she doesn't collect enough, she'll be left with the rude and awkward options when speaking with others.

Develop meaningful relationships with a rich & diverse cast of characters

The problem is, the villagers have their own issues to worry about. Will you choose to support and connect with them through the trials while being true to yourself, be a straight-up people-pleaser, go the lone wolf route, or mess with them for funsies? It all depends on the words you choose, the choices you make, and even the thoughts you have. Will you resolve the issues with your seemingly toxic father or go your separate ways? Support the mysterious mayor who doesn't trust you with his plans for the village or just spy on him from the sidelines? Immerse yourself in these and many other stories with a diverse cast of characters set in a lore-rich, fantasy world.

Manage your energy and emotions

Socializing can be stressful for an introvert like Calliope. She'll lose HP with every line of dialogue, and if she gets too angry, she won't be capable of saying anything kind or courteous. Stock up on calming and energizing teas and learn other techniques to help your conversations turn out the way you want.

Bring the town back to life

Aside from the stress of the villagers, the town suffers from a general lack of caretaking. When you need a break from socializing, plant flowers, nurture the family bees, and use magic to revive the village.

Key Features:

  • Emotional, character-driven stories, each with multiple endings based on your choices

  • Collect expressions and learn tips to make your conversations more engaging

  • Combine magic with gardening to revive nature and make the village a cozier place

  • 6 dateable characters with rich romance stories

5126800.name: The Phantom of the Opera: Sex & Requiem

store_data.about_the_game:
THE PHANTOM OF THE OPERA: SEX & REQUIEM is a story-driven adult visual novel that blends dark romance, mystery, psychological horror, supernatural intrigue, and explicit adult content inside the decaying grandeur of the Vesper Grand Opera.


Twenty years ago, a disastrous performance known as Silent Night changed the opera house forever. Seventeen people vanished. The building was sealed. And Elias Crowe lost his mother, Amelia, to a tragedy he never truly understood.

Now, the Vesper Grand Opera is opening its doors again.

Elias, now a renowned but creatively broken composer, returns to the place he spent most of his life trying to escape. What begins as an opportunity to confront the past soon becomes something far more dangerous. Impossible melodies echo through empty corridors. Hidden rooms reveal themselves behind walls. Voices of the dead whisper through the architecture. And somewhere beneath the opera house, a masked woman has been waiting for him.

Her name is Lyra Veyne.

Beautiful, brilliant, obsessive, and deeply connected to the secrets buried beneath the opera, Lyra knows things about Elias that no stranger should know. She has spent years listening, studying, composing, and searching for a way to complete a forbidden work known as Requiem for the Hollow.

Elias soon discovers that Lyra is not the only person hiding something.

Celeste Arden, the opera’s charismatic star soprano, draws Elias into a relationship filled with attraction, ambition, and temptation. Dr. Sabine Moreau investigates the impossible acoustic phenomena spreading through the building while struggling to separate science from something that should not exist. Vivienne Voss, the powerful woman behind the opera’s reopening, appears determined to restore Vesper to its former glory — but her interest in the building’s hidden architecture reaches far beyond art or business.

At the center of everything is the Hollow Choir: a phenomenon born from memory, grief, desire, and decades of experimentation beneath the opera house.

The deeper Elias descends, the more his understanding of his mother, Lyra, and Silent Night begins to collapse.

THE PHANTOM OF THE OPERA: SEX & REQUIEM follows one complete canonical story with a strong focus on character relationships, mystery progression, emotional development, supernatural horror, and cinematic presentation. Choices shape conversations, relationships, reactions, and intimate moments while the central narrative continues toward a single dramatic conclusion.

Adult relationships are an important part of the story rather than disconnected bonus content. Attraction develops alongside trust, jealousy, obsession, vulnerability, and conflict, giving the intimate scenes narrative context within each character arc.

The game features fully animated NSFW scenes integrated directly into the story. These sequences are presented alongside cinematic visual novel CGs and relationship-driven buildup rather than replacing the main plot.

A built-in gallery system allows unlocked CGs and adult scenes to be revisited after discovering them during the story.

Explore the Vesper Grand Opera, from its lavish stage, rehearsal halls, balconies, dressing rooms, and private suites to abandoned corridors, hidden listening chambers, mechanical acoustic systems, forgotten archives, and the enormous underground world concealed beneath the building.

Uncover the truth behind Silent Night.

Discover what really happened to Amelia Crowe.

Learn why Lyra has lived beneath the opera for twenty years.

Complete the unfinished sixth movement of Requiem for the Hollow.

And decide whether some memories are meant to be preserved...

...or finally allowed to die.

Features include a full story-driven adult visual novel experience, dark romance and mature relationships, animated NSFW scenes, an unlockable gallery system, psychological horror and supernatural mystery, cinematic anime-style CG artwork, relationship and dialogue choices, an original gothic opera setting, multiple adult characters with distinct personalities and relationships, and one complete canonical ending.

Every character appearing in sexual content is an adult aged 21 or older.

store_data.about_the_game:
Arcanefall: Darklands is a dark fantasy survivor-like game where you take on

the role of a spellcaster fighting to survive endless waves of undead horrors

in a cursed, crumbling world.

Choose your caster. Six unique wizards await. Each with their own combat

style, exclusive passive ability, and signature spell. Master the balanced

arcane bolts of the Wizard, unleash devastating fire with the Flame Witch,

or command the icy resilience of the Frost Mage.

Survive the onslaught. Waves of skeletal warriors, ranged cultists, and

flesh-hungry ghouls grow stronger and more numerous with every passing minute.

Build your build. Level up mid-battle and choose from dozens of evolving

skills like chain lightning, orbiting arcane orbs, piercing volleys, and more.

Combine and evolve your abilities to create devastating build synergies

unique to every run.

Unlock and progress. Earn coins from every run to unlock new playable

characters, each with their own strengths and playstyle.

FEATURES:

- 6 unique playable spellcasters, each with an exclusive passive skill

- Dozens of skills and evolutions to combine into unique builds

- Escalating enemy waves with melee, ranged, and boss-tier threats

- Repeating boss encounters that scale in difficulty the longer you survive

- Full controller-friendly and mouse-driven combat

- Persistent progression — unlock characters across runs

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome HØLM

It’s December 1996.

Finnish furniture giant HØLM has opened its first superstore in Norway, and you’ve been hired for the night shift. Your job is simple: get the showroom displays ready for opening. 

You have three responsibilities:

  • Build flatpack furniture

  • Furnish the display

  • STAY ALIVE

Building Flatpack Furniture

There’s nothing more relaxing than building flatpack furniture, so we know you’re going to enjoy your time at HØLM. All our furniture is modular, much like the store itself, so each shift is never quite the same. We don’t know if it’s possible to be excited and relaxed, but we bet that the HØLM night shift is as close as you can get. And don’t worry, all our furniture have manuals!

All the wood used in our store, from the building to the furniture, comes straight from Finnish old growth forests. It may not be sustainable, but it sure gives a great finish!

Furnishing the Displays

As well as furniture, you might need to add some extra items to each display. Televisions from our Electronic Department, armchairs from Soft Furnishing, shelves from Storage. And if you get tired on the job, feel free to hit our famous Restaurant to see what’s left over, or retreat to the Stockroom for a well deserved break! But don’t linger too long!

Use your creative flair and make every display a work of art!

STAY ALIVE

Due to unusually high staff turnover on our night shifts, a small number of workplace concerns have recently come to our attention:

  • Walls and ceilings suddenly leaking a mysterious red fluid

  • Spontaneous combustion of furniture and entire displays

  • Mysterious flaming rocks breaking through the floors

  • Screams/Howls/disturbing audible phenomena

  • Strange relocation of display mannequins

We’re sure these are just the delusions of sleep-deprived, disgruntled employees.

 

Your shift is complete when all your work is done, so the sooner you complete your tasks, the sooner you can leave!

Stockroom Syndrome features:

  • Procedurally generated superstore with changing departments, pathways, displays and stock each shift.

  • Modular flatpack furniture that you physically assemble from individual parts using manuals and joinery.

  • Hands-on furnishing and decoration, with furniture and props throughout the store, every item is a physics item!

  • Distinct supernatural threats, some roam the store, some haunt specific departments. Good luck!

  • Escalating hauntings and environmental events, from moving mannequins and bleeding walls to considerably worse workplace conditions.

  • An authored mystery beneath the procedural game, told through recordings, old company media, cartoons and other discoveries.

  • A full campaign set in December 1996, with changing objectives, escalating threats and new situations across repeated night shifts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Zombie-Like is an intense 2D arcade experience that challenges your reflexes and adaptability. In a hostile post-apocalyptic world, survival is just the beginning of your journey.

Survival and exploration go hand in hand. As you explore the environments, you will discover new mechanics, unlock evolutions, and secure crucial upgrades for your character. However, the world reacts to your progress: as you evolve, the environment becomes more dangerous, introducing new obstacles and even more relentless enemy variants.
store_data.detailed_description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Exploration and Discovery: Traverse the map to uncover secrets that unlock new gameplay mechanics and expand your possibilities.

  • Evolution and Upgrades: Strengthen your character and adapt your skills to cope with the ever-growing zombie threat.

  • Dynamic World: Feel the impact of your progress. As you advance, new enemy types emerge and fresh obstacles put your strategies to the test.

  • Family-Friendly Local Co-op: Don't face the despair alone! Share the journey with friends or family in a chaotic and fun local co-op mode.

  • Solo Challenge: Hone your skills in single-player mode, refine your exploration routes, and master the game mechanics.

store_data.about_the_game:
Audionaut is a 2D music composition spaceship autobattler. Taking inspiration from modular synthesis, players make music using the component parts of their ship. As you defeat ever stronger enemies and build a better ship, so too will your composition grow. Can you make it back to the ruins of a shattered Earth and heal it with your song?

Features

  • Music Composition - combat modules set parameters to generate music in real-time, creating a balance between gameplay and creativity

  • Combat - players engage in strategic autobattler encounters, hearing how their song matches up against their opponents'

  • Roguelite Progression - as players progress, their ship and composition grow increasingly complex, increasing their power with each subsequent run

  • Inventory Management - with careful planning skills and a "subpatch" system that can help condense down complex module chains, players work against spatial limitations while increasing their ship's power

  • Shop - after winning battles, players spend well-earned scrap to purchase new modules to experiment with

  • Creative Mode - players who care more about creative discovery than combat can enable a sandbox mode to gain access to all existing modules and rack size adjustments for free play

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Giusto.

Giusto (Joo-stoh) is a single-player, bidding, trick-taking card game where you'll need to be PERFECT in order to maximize your STASH.  What originated in a college dorm room decades ago and has been passed down through generations, is now a solo indie dev's first game in the industry as he decided share it with the world. 

Play at a five-seat table against four other bot opponents, and choose how long each round runs based on your mood and time constraints. Play a quick 3-round match, an easy 5, or the full 10 rounds for max stash.  Each round, every player is dealt a hand - one card fewer than the round before - and a "Clobber suit" is turned face-up in the middle.  Then comes the heart of the game, where you and every other player will secretly lock in a bid of how many "sets" (tricks) they believe they'll win that round.  Right before each round begins, everyone's bids are revealed, telling you if the table in general is fighting for sets, dumping them, or it's a balanced table.  Highest card of whatever suit leads the round, wins the round. But, a clobber beats everything (except a higher clobber card), and at the end you compare what you said you'd do vs. what you actually did.

Miss your bid in either direction and you WHIFF, and that's where you get punished.  Giusto rewards perfection. Overbidding and underbidding hurts exactly the same.  You NEED to be perfect.  Your penalty is the gap between your bid and reality, multiplied by the round number. So, the later rounds bite the hardest,  Lowest cumulative score wins. This isn't a game about winning tricks.  It's a game about knowing yourself, and the table - predicting your own hand with precision, while having the restraint not to reach for more than you can handle.

The Countdown Button.

When you earn a reward, Giusto doesn't just hand it over - it gives you a chance to make it huge.  A timer appears after 2 or 3 perfect bids in a row depending on the game you're in.  You click to start it and it ticks towards 10, at a different pace every time, and only showing you the first few numbers - then you're on your own!  Click again the instant you believe it's hit true 10.000 - there's no rounding and no mercy: the game reads your real elapsed time and shows it to 3 decimal places. The closer you land to 10, the rarer the reward you earn. Land dead on 10.000 and there's only one word for it - everybody yells "GIUSTO!!" 

Beat the Game.

Most games don't let you beat them anymore - Giusto says, "bring it on".  Everything you play feeds one lifetime number.  Here's what you need to know:

  • Stash is your lifetime total that you'll use to compare against the global leaderboard and climb tiers to beat the game.  10,000 wins.

  • Gems are earned when you hit a bid exactly - a perfectly bid round, either twice or three times in a row (depending on how long of a game you're playing).  And, each one can reduce your in-game total, bringing you closer to victory (lowest score wins)

  • Matcha is won by winning a full match outright, and it's your chance to multiply your Stash - 2x up to 20x!! But, you'd better not be too far away because a bad miss earns a punishment from your Stash, too.

As your Stash grows, you climb a six-tier prestige ladder, and the armored woodland creature that sits at the center of your table transforms with you: from The Fawn (nervous, wide-eyed, just beginning) to The Firefly, The Phoenix, The Owl, The Mushroom, and finally - cross the 10,000 lifetime ranked Stash and earn The Machine Elf.  Your win is rewarded by the elusive Machine Elf, an inter-dimensional being that traverses space, time, and worlds in order to help  the Fawn get back to its' family.

Cross that line and you're permanently immortalized in the public Forest of Fame. From there, it's your call: Bloom - reset your Stash to zero and climb all over again with 1 bloom recorded on your Forest of Fame name, or keep playing as the Machine Elf, a new unlocked character that stays uncapped for as long as the forest holds your desire to compete for the top spot in the Forest of Fame

Made to Feel Just Right.

This game is meant to be an enchanted night of healthy competition, not a battlefield. But, the competition is real, and it's not to be ignored.  Just enjoy it at your own pace. There's no clock on any moves.  Take your time, or grind through to the top. It ships fully complete: no early access, no cut corners, no waiting for the "real" version.  Any monetization will be cosmetic-based only, and will never touch the playability of the game you're playing.  That's the promise. 

Sit down, breathe, and pick your moment...perfectly.  It's Giusto.

Giusto is a tabletop, turn-based, strategy card game that rewards how well a player can predict the outcome of their hand BEFORE each round starts. store_data.about_the_game:
IT IS ALREADY BEHIND YOU


You are Moneta, the Kept One — the dearest memory of a mind that is going out.
Behind you comes the Forgetting: a wall of black ink that unpaints the world as
it touches it, leaving only bare paper. It does not chase you cleverly. It
chases you patiently, and it is never further away than one mistake.

There is no fighting it. There is only the next ledge.

RUN. DIE. GO AGAIN.


THE LONG FORGETTING is a precision chase platformer. Every level is a
60–90 second gauntlet run left to right with the wall at your back: thorn
beds, drowning pits, erupting geysers, crushing columns, carved stone mouths
that spit slow glowing bolts on fixed rhythms you learn to thread. Everything
kills in one touch — and death restarts the level instantly. No loading
screen, no lives, no mercy and no waiting: the run simply begins again, and
the wall is patient.

Twelve levels across three regions of a dying mind, each ending at a door the
Forgetting cannot pass — and a final confrontation at the source of the wound
itself.

EARN THE WAY YOU MOVE


Clearing a level grants a permanent ability — a key, never a stat. The
double jump. The wall dash. The dash that carries you through danger for
a heartbeat. The glide that turns a fall into a crossing. Deeper in, the keys
turn stranger: a light that pushes back the dark, the power to eat a bolt out
of the air, to silence the stone mouths, to survive one blow that should have
ended the run. Each key opens routes in every earlier level that were
impossible without it — going back is how you find what you were forced to
run past.

STEAL BACK WHAT IT TOOK


Off the safe line, in the shafts and drowned pits, there are memories still
burning — three hidden in every level. Reaching them costs time you do not
have, and time is the only currency the Forgetting accepts. They are never on
the way; they are always a detour with the wall closing. Carry enough of them
and their light will absorb a single killing blow — the game's only armour,
earned by greed.

INK-WASHED, DROWNED, AND LIT FROM WITHIN


Ink-and-gouache washes, glowing flora, ruined colonnades under still water, and
lantern-light that actually falls on the stone. The world drains of colour as
the Forgetting takes more of it — you are watching a mind lose its palette.
The score is part of the chase: the music swells as the wall closes and thins
when you pull ahead, so you hear how much margin you have left without ever
looking back.

FOR THE PEOPLE WHO WANT IT TO HURT


  • Three difficulties. The level never changes; only the wall's patience
    does. On Hell it never slows below your own sprint — every stumble is spent
    margin you will not get back.
  • Records. Best times per level and per difficulty, with the ghost of
    your best line kept — so there is always someone to race, even if it is you.
  • A tight 2–3 hours the first time through. Considerably longer if you
    want every memory, and far longer if you want the top of the boards.
  • Keyboard or Xbox controller — pick up and play with either.

have, and time is the only currency the Forgetting accepts. They are never on
the way; they are always a detour with the wall closing. Carry enough of them
and their light will absorb a single killing blow — the game's only armour,
earned by greed.

INK-WASHED, DROWNED, AND LIT FROM WITHIN


Ink-and-gouache washes, glowing flora, ruined colonnades under still water, and
lantern-light that actually falls on the stone. The world drains of colour as
the Forgetting takes more of it — you are watching a mind lose its palette.
The score is part of the chase: the music swells as the wall closes and thins
when you pull ahead, so you hear how much margin you have left without ever
looking back.

FOR THE PEOPLE WHO WANT IT TO HURT


  • Three difficulties. The level never changes; only the wall's patience
    does. On Hell it never slows below your own sprint — every stumble is spent
    margin you will not get back.
  • Records. Best times per level and per difficulty, with the ghost of
    your best line kept — so there is always someone to race, even if it is you.
  • A tight 2–3 hours the first time through. Considerably longer if you
    want every memory, and far longer if you want the top of the boards.
  • Keyboard or Xbox controller — pick up and play with either.
store_data.short_description: The Forgetting is eating the world behind you. Run. An ink-and-gouache chase platformer through a dying mind: four movement keys to earn, lost memories to steal back from the dark, and a wall of ink that never, ever stops.

YOU WERE ELECTED. NOW MONETIZE IT.

Congratulations, President. The Republic of Grandvia has entrusted you with its highest office, its treasury, its future, and - more importantly - a bank account containing $1,000,000.

You have one term to turn that into a billion.

FOUR PLATFORMS. ONE CONFLICT OF INTEREST.

False Social - Say something. Anything. A threat to a company nobody has heard of, a policy invented at 6am, a number you made up on the spot. The markets are listening, and they cannot tell the difference between a plan and a whim.

gambling.view - Watch what your words did. Better: be positioned before you say them. Every candle on this chart is somebody's retirement, and you are holding the match.

rug.boring - Launch a coin. Watch the holder count climb, the chat fill up with diamond hands and rent money, the price go vertical. Then decide exactly when to pull the liquidity.

monolosing - A prediction market, for people who guess. You do not guess. You place the bet, then you go and make it true.

THE FILE ON YOUR DESK IS GETTING THICKER

Every move leaves a trace. A tax inspector notices a filing that does not add up. A securities commission staffed by one intern opens a folder. A journalist nobody has bought yet starts asking about timestamps.

Profit and heat rise together. The next move is always worth it. That is the problem.

FEATURES

  • Turn $1,000,000 into $1,000,000,000 across four interconnected platforms

  • Move entire markets with a single post, then profit from the wreckage you predicted

  • Launch, hype and rug your own memecoin - and pick the moment to vanish

  • Bet on outcomes you personally intend to cause

  • Stay ahead of tax inspectors, regulators and the press as your file grows

  • Chunky pixel art and a CRT-soaked terminal aesthetic

A NOTE ON REALISM

Every person, company, country, currency and market in this game is invented. Any resemblance to real financial crime is a coincidence, and certainly not a tutorial.

store_data.about_the_game:
Eight games. One deck

Most card games on Steam are one game. This is the whole shelf: the Euchre family and the classics that share its bones, all dealt from the same deck, with the same rules for following suit, taking tricks, and counting up afterwards.

Euchre— 24 cards, four players, two teams. Order it up, go alone, get euchred.

Token Bid Euchre — bid with tokens you earn to power up bad hands. Go into debt and it follows you.

Anti-Euchre — the contract runs backwards. Every trick you take is a trick against you.

Double Trouble— one hand, two segments, bid separately and scored together. (Two things called per hand)

Triple Threat — three segments and 210 legal declarations. There is no safe bid. (Three things called per hand)

Spades — nil, blind nil, and the bags that come back for you ten hands later.

Hearts — duck every point, or take all of them and hand them to everybody else.

Oh Hell — bid your tricks exactly. One over or under and the hand is worth nothing.

You don't have to already know how to play

Every one of the eight has a guided tutorial that deals a real hand and plays it with you. The table stops and waits while you read. It points at the card it is talking about. And if you are about to make the mistake it just warned you about, it doesn't let you — it tells you why instead.

That matters most for the four Euchre variants, which you will not find anywhere else and cannot look up.

Opponents that are actually playing

Four difficulty tiers, and what separates them is what they are allowed to know — not how much they cheat.

Easy forgets what has already been played.

]Medium remembers trump, and who is out of what.

Hard counts the entire deck.

The fourth tier is a rare "mini boss" level challenge. Beating it is not meant to be routine and is a real achievement.

Your table, your rules

Every family plays it differently, and this one doesn't argue with you. Sixty house rules across the eight games — stick the dealer, screw the dealer, no-trump, bag penalties, scoring floors, what the Jack does, what happens on a misdeal. Change them, save the result as a preset, and play it.

Changing the rules doesn't lock anything off. Custom rulesets still earn achievements.

store_data.about_the_game:
Salt of the Earth is an isometric medieval settlement builder about a single manor held by charter, and the families who live on it. Houses rise from hovel to town house when the household inside is fed and looked after. Workshops take their labour from the houses within walking distance. Every building has to touch the road network.

The year turns through four seasons, and winter gives nothing back. Traders, tithe collectors, couriers from neighbouring towns and raiders with torches all arrive on their own schedule, and each of them remembers how you answered.

Key Features

  • More than forty buildings, all of them on a road — From a hovel and a well up to a cathedral, a keep, and border outposts on the edge of the shire. Placement determines output: a workshop draws its workers from the houses near enough to walk, so a yard two streets too far from housing stands idle while the one beside it runs full.

  • Housing that upgrades on needs, not money — Four tiers, hovel to peasant house to half timbered house to town house. A household climbs when its needs are met: food, water, a market in reach, a church, an inn, a school for the children. Variety counts as much as quantity, and a family living on bread alone burns through it far faster than one with bread, meat and fruit on the table. Families whose needs go unmet leave, and the yard behind the house goes unworked.

  • No research tree — There are no tech points and nothing to unlock with them. Every building becomes available off something already standing: the bakery needs a mill, the tower needs a barracks, the school needs a church and a half timbered house, the goldsmith needs a town house. Industry advances only as far as housing does.

  • Twenty eight goods and the chains between them — Grain to flour to bread, ore to iron to tools, clay to tiles, grapes to wine, wool to fabric. Surplus sells at the market square, and any good can be forbidden outright so the town stops eating what was meant for sale.

  • Seasons and weather — Winter is the point of the other three. Everything grown and stored between spring and autumn is aimed at the months that give nothing back. Rain, hail, snow and thunder run on their own schedule, and a downpour is also what saves the roofs on the night something is burning.

  • Over fifty decision events — Each one is a person at the door. A company of masons come down from an abbey works that ran out of money. The bishop's collector, after a tithe beyond the customary. Families from the manor next door, sitting at the boundary.

  • Raiders and spreading fire — A market town is a town worth robbing. Raiders walk in off the edge of the map looking for the nearest thing that will burn. Fire runs straight through anything built shoulder to shoulder and stops dead at a gap. A well buys one fire and then stands dry for weeks. What ends a raid is a tower with a soldier in it.

  • Four neighbouring towns that keep score — Couriers arrive with export offers once the manor is a market town. Each town has its own temper, one exacting and quick to take offence, another patient and slow to complain, and standing relationships build or sour across years.

  • Four charters and five honours — Charters run from rich river soil to a lean northern frontier. Five honours carry the manor from Minor Lord to Castellan, each unlocking what follows: raiders and foreign correspondence at A Proper Market Town, border outposts and knights at Seat of Power.

store_data.about_the_game:
Clickoire is a mostly click-free incremental challenge that requires precise positioning, avoiding hazards, and turning every ten-second cycle into greater power.

Guide the cursor over the right cluster at the right moment to capture valuable resources. Spend the resulting points on an expansive upgrade tree. Each purchase changes the board's pace, patterns and profit potential.

Build a Better Run

By expanding your cursor radius or increasing its charge rate or unlocking richer resources, you accelerate how quickly you earn points to upgrade your gameplay. With 43 upgrades spread across synergistic or conflicting lanes, create the build that best suits your playstyle.

Choose Your Strategy

  • A wider cursor captures more at once.

  • A faster-charging cursor captures more often.

  • A smaller cursor lets you snipe hazards for extra bounties.

  • Careful positioning lets you capture multiple targets at once.

  • Traps convert passive resources into rewards.

  • Stack escalating bonuses during longer sessions.

  • Special contracts reshape your priorities.

Start Again, Stronger

At the end of your playthrough (or at key checkpoints), begin a New Game Plus run to start over with extra power. Rebuild faster, push farther and faster, and explore upgrade combinations and synergies that require different strategies.

Experimentation, timing, and patience provide a host of methods to make every ten seconds count.

Blue Water Builders is a shipyard management game set during the golden age of shipbuilding, taking you from the early 1900s into the mid-20th century. Take control of a small shipyard startup and build it into a successful shipbuilding operation where every decision matters. Design ships piece by piece, manage contracts and production, handle finances and unexpected events, and expand your shipyard as the industry evolves. Build, adapt, and grow your way from a modest shipyard to a major force in the world of shipbuilding.

BUILD YOUR SHIPYARD

Running a successful shipyard is about more than simply building ships. Manage contracts, optimize your workforce, control finances and loans, balance resource usage, keep production moving, and expand your shipyard to take on bigger and more demanding projects. Every decision you make shapes your shipyard's growth, reputation, efficiency, and ultimately its success.

DESIGN SHIPS PIECE BY PIECE

Design ships using a modular shipbuilding system where every section is placed manually. From hull structures to deck layouts, every ship is built according to your own designs and the demands of your contracts. Be careful though, because if you don’t make sure physics are on your side, your ship could tip over, sink and fail sea trials!

Different ship designs can affect construction costs, production speed, efficiency, and overall shipyard performance.

PUT YOUR SHIP TO THE TEST

A ship isn't ready for the open seas the moment construction is complete. Take your vessels out for sea trials and put their performance, stability, and handling to the test before they enter service.

Monitor your ship as it leaves the shipyard, identify problems, and make sure everything performs as expected. A successful trial means a successful delivery, but failure can cost you time, money, and reputation.

MANAGE PRODUCTION

Keep your shipyard running efficiently by managing workforce productivity, resources, production schedules, and ship construction. Balance your available resources and manpower to keep projects moving, meet deadlines, and maximize the output of your shipyard. Every improvement you make can help you build faster, take on larger contracts, and grow your operation.

RESPOND TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS

Your shipyard will constantly face unexpected situations that can affect your shipyard, some of which are: production, finances, worker morale, efficiency, etc.

Handle workplace accidents, inspections, industrial setbacks, recessions, and other operational challenges through decision-based events where every choice can impact the future of your shipyard in different ways. Some decisions may solve immediate problems while creating larger consequences later on.

RESEARCH NEW TECHNOLOGIES

Advance through evolving industrial eras by researching new technologies, unlocking improved ship components, modern construction methods, and more advanced shipyard infrastructure.

As your shipyard grows, so does the scale, complexity, and capabilities of the ships you can produce.

GROW THROUGH DIFFERENT ERAS

Experience the evolution of shipbuilding from the dawn of the 20th century as the industry transforms around you. New technologies, construction methods, materials, and engineering breakthroughs will change how ships are designed, built, and operated. Start with the foundations of a growing shipyard and gradually expand your capabilities as the decades pass. Adapt to new demands, embrace technological advancements, modernize your facilities, and take on increasingly ambitious projects as ships grow larger, faster, and more advanced.

The industry never stands still. The shipyards that adapt are the ones that survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a rock! Craggfall is a physics-driven action and exploration game where you roll, leap, and crash a living rock through uncharted terrain. You feel every bounce, every slope, every surface—as you navigate beautiful, dynamic landscapes. Read the terrain, build speed, and turn slopes, ramps, and ravines into one unbroken line from summit to valley floor.

UNCOVER MYSTERIES OF THE WORLD

Unearth crystals to awaken dormant powers, and unlock new rock forms — each with its own mass, shape, and gloriously different physics

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

The world has noticed you, and it is not happy. Engage enemy forces with physics combat, bashing into creatures, or heaving projectiles from long-range. 

EVERY RUN IS A HIGHLIGHT REEL

Craggfall is always recording. Rewind any run, fly a free camera through your best line (or your funniest disaster), and capture the moment. Your greatest trick is never lost — it's one button away.

PLANNED FEATURES FOR LAUNCH:

  • Vast, dynamic biomes to explore

  • Rock forms - each with its own mass, shape, and personality

  • Power ups & collectibles to discover

  • Director mode for creating cinematic replays

  • Expansive arsenal of combat weapons

FROM A STUDIO OF TWO

We're a two-person team building the game we want to

play: something tactile, mysterious, and honest about what a physics sandbox can

be. The game is deep in development — a public demo is on the way, the roadmap

is taking shape, and the release date will come when the game has earned it.

Wishlist Craggfall to roll with us!

store_data.about_the_game:
Dear Gardener, prepare to get your green fingers dirty! You will find yourself trimming the hedges, mowing the lawn, watering the flowers, pulling the weeds, tidying up the garden, fixing broken parts and doing that daily garden maintenance. Oh, and maybe pick some apples, grow your own vegetables and ship them to the market? And do you like collecting beautiful cups to drink your coffee (or tea!) from? And also collecting vintage watches you can wear, depending on your mood perhaps? And collecting all sorts of cool stuff you find exploring the magnificent gardens that you will come to visit, owned by some very friendly but mysterious people that obviously is trying to hide something? Well then you are in for a treat! Lady Rosemary is already expecting your arrival as soon as possible.

A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals.
