store_data.about_the_game:
Dreadful Doodles!

You wake up inside a distorted cartoony world, with no memory of how you got there.

Odd characters reduced to archetypes roam through the darkness, some of them waiting...

There is no death, but suffering awaits.

Do what you can.

Inky Insanity!

"Nostalgiallo" is a nostalgia-horror based on old Spanish "Tebeo" slapstick comics.

Explore a cartoony but sinister world made entirely of hand-drawn doodles on pre-rendered 3D environments.

Solve point-and-click puzzles while uncovering the absurd yet-disturbing story behind this bizarre world.

But beware, you are not safe, creatures made of distorted doodles and collage art of home-taken photos await.

Democratic Dislocation!

A disease made of pure slapstick roams the world, turning its victims into chaotic aberrations.

The "Slapstills".

They only know absurd violence, so you will face them in democracy-based combat.

You have been equipped with a biomechanical device that can fight for you, but its actions are determined by a timed election.

Manipulate the votes to ensure the correct action wins, but be ready for the Slapstills to pull off some dirty tricks.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU HAVE A JOB

The company has debts. Serious ones. Your boss handed you the keys to an ice cream truck, locked the door behind you, and gave you a number to hit every single day.

Nobody said what happens if you miss it. He did say he'd call.

SCOOP, SERVE, SURVIVE

Everything happens in first person, with your hands. Grab a cone, dig into the tub, stack the scoops, hand it through the window before the customer's patience runs out. Every order is a small race, and the line does not stop.

  • Ten flavors to unlock, each worth more than the last

  • Cones and cups with upgrade tiers that change what a customer will pay

  • Angry customers who cost you reputation — three stars, and that's all you get

  • A day cycle that turns short lunch shifts into long, dark evenings

BUILD A RUN THAT LASTS

Between shifts, cards land on your counter. Take one. Prices, patience, scoop speed, queue size, flavor bonuses, and a few things that hurt as much as they help.

Golden cards are stronger than anything else on the counter. They also raise tomorrow's quota. Your call.

  • 90+ cards across four rarities

  • Reroll the offer with the coins from your own tip jar

  • Boss deals over the phone: cash now, a worse quota later

HE ALWAYS COLLECTS

Miss the quota and the shortfall comes out of your own pocket. Run out of reputation and the shutter comes down on its own.

Then the lights go red, the alarm starts, and the phone rings one last time.

EVERY RUN IS A NEW SHIFT

Die, restart, get further. Four difficulty levels, a different card offer every time, and one number that keeps you coming back: how many days you lasted.

store_data.about_the_game:
MUSTER is a Minesweeper-inspired roguelite where you dig a warband out of the earth, arm it with loot, and send it into automatic battles.

Uncover empty ground and its number tells you how many of the eight surrounding tiles still hide a monster or prize. It tells you where something is buried, treasure or not. Read overlapping clues, use flags as your own notes, and decide which risks are worth taking.

You can dig only beside ground already open. Spend limited shovels to break ground elsewhere and start a new front. Lanterns let you inspect buried tiles without triggering them. Dig carelessly and you can wake a whole connected pocket of monsters.

Dig Up Your Warband

Buried glints mark diggers trapped below. Reveal a glint and excavate all the ground around it to pull that digger free.

Build your warband from eight roles. The Barrow Widow holds the front and draws an enemy’s attention. The Bone Fletcher attacks from four cells away. The Torchbearer leaves targets burning, while the Grave Alchemist keeps allies standing.

Every role has its own class quest and three talent trees. Complete quests to earn talent points and shape each digger for the rest of the run.

Deploy, Then Watch

Battles play out automatically on a large hex arena. Place your diggers across four deployment areas, press START, and let positioning, reach, equipment, and class abilities do the work.

Give someone a Long Spear and they can attack over the Widow’s shoulder while she holds the line. Afterward, the battle report shows who dealt damage, who healed, who took the punishment, and which effects were responsible.

Win and slain enemies award coin and may drop gear in four rarities. Lose and one of your three grit is gone. You return to the same floor, with surviving diggers and monsters still carrying their wounds.

Solver-Checked Floors

Every generated layout is checked by a solver before play, and boards are rerolled when their deductions stall. Limited lanterns provide a safe reveal when logic alone gets tricky.

The solver can establish which tiles hide something, but monsters and prizes share the same clues. Knowing that a tile is occupied doesn’t tell you whether it holds treasure or enemies. That uncertainty is where the risk lives.

Two Barrows

A standard run descends through six floors. Begin in the earthen barrow; your first victory unlocks the frozen barrow, with different rooms, enemy mixes, and bosses.

In the frozen barrow, some enemies are visible from the moment the floor opens. Every dig brings their ice closer to breaking. Free one early and you take the initiative; keep digging and eventually the ice chooses the moment for you.

Once unlocked, barrow and difficulty are selected separately.

Features

  • Minesweeper-inspired excavation where monsters and prizes share clues

  • Frontier-based digging with limited shovels and lanterns

  • Solver-checked procedural layouts

  • Two six-floor barrows with distinct bosses and enemy mixes

  • Eight recruitable roles with class quests and three talent trees each

  • Automated hex-grid battles with persistent wounds

  • Gear in four rarities; weapons emphasize offense and charms defense

  • Full controller support with remappable actions

store_data.about_the_game:
Lateral Crawl is a turn-based, grid-based traditional roguelike stretched across an infinite road. You are a Cousin travelling rightward through a procedurally assembled world of changing biomes and roadside events. Your objective is to keep going and complete your search for the last nightclub.

KEEP MOVING

Your job is simple: keep travelling right.

Scavenge houses, shops, ruins and stranger places for weapons, food, clothing and anything else that might keep you alive.

SURVIVE

Combat is turn-based, grid-based and positional. Hit things with whatever is in your hands, shoot them, throw things at them, set traps, deploy turrets, push them into hazards or find some other stupid solution that happens to work.

Weapons wear out. Food may not agree with you. Hunger and thirst creep in. Disease, injury and other conditions can turn a perfectly respectable journey into a disaster. The body is another system you have to manage.

SHAPE YOUR RUN

There are no levels and no stat progression. Instead, you can gain odd skills and temporary advantages along the road. Pay attention, discover interactions and become dangerous in ways you probably didn't plan.

store_data.about_the_game:
You started as a smear on a glass dish. You will not be ending there.

Blobsorb is a game about getting bigger. Everything smaller than you is food. Everything bigger than you is future food. Swim, absorb, grow, and outlast the clock. Then spend what you've eaten on a sprawling mutation tree that turns your humble blob into something the lab is going to regret culturing.

Each strain is a short, sharp run. Your senescence timer is always ticking down, and the only way to buy more time is to keep eating. Die, and you don't lose. Instead you learn from your failings, mutate, and come back a slightly worse problem than before.

• Eat your way up the food chain. Size is everything. Watch the whole ecosystem flip from threat to snack as you swell.

• Numbers go up.

• A mutation tree that changes how you play. Grow spikes and armour, sense which creatures are safe to eat and which will end you, clone yourself, lay pheromone trails, rupture your own body for an emergency payout, or infect a monster and turn it loose on its own kind.

• Bosses are your exit. Every environment is sealed by something enormous. Beat the Rat King in the sewers and you evolve into the next, harsher world where you're small again, everything's faster, and the tech tree re-opens for the next round of upgrades.

Break out of the Petri dish and into the sewer, home to panicking rats, swimming toads, undulating centipedes, shoals of tadpoles, warp pipes, and a very large, very angry rat with a crown. More worlds await you after that, and each one resets the scale: your speed and size upgrades are re-earned in every new environment, so the tree and your DNA needs constant work to keep ahead of the curve.

This is a game for people who like watching a number climb. Escalating pickup chimes, combo-flavoured feeding surges, per-strain personal bests, a bestiary to fill, and a tree that keeps opening new branches the deeper you go.

store_data.about_the_game:
The galaxy doesn't pause when you log off. Your mines dig, your research labs hum, your fleets fly - and somewhere out there, another commander is eyeing your planet. TON Wars is the classic browser space strategy you pulled all-nighters for, rebuilt for today: persistent, server-authoritative, and fair by design.

⛏ An empire that never sleeps

Develop mines, power plants and storage on your homeworld. Resources accrue in real time, 24/7 - log in to a stockpile, not a chore list. Balance energy, expand capacity, and turn one planet into a multi-world empire.

🔬 Research is the one edge nobody can steal

Climb the tech tree - energy, lasers, plasma, drives. Ships can be shot down and resources raided, but technology is forever. Long-term planning wins galaxies.

🚀 Command real fleets against real players

From nimble Light Fighters to the dreaded Reaper. Scout with 5 tiers of espionage intel, strike where it hurts, and harvest the debris fields your battles leave behind. Combat has real drama: small skirmishes can produce upsets, massive fleet clashes stay predictable - luck you can feel, not chaos you can't plan around.

🤝 Raid together - up to 8 fleets, one battle

Join an alliance with shared diplomacy, treasury and bonuses. Coordinate combined attacks where up to eight allied fleets hit a single target as one armada and split the loot. The strongest empires are built on friends.

🏴 Conquer wild worlds, brave the unknown

NPC worlds won't just roll over - grind down their loyalty in a proper siege before you plant your flag. Send expeditions into deep space for riches or ruin. Dive into Rifts, roguelike runs that forge permanent artifacts for your empire.

🧬 16 heroes, one destiny

Four races, four classes - pick a commander whose perks bend your whole strategy: economist, warlord, explorer, spymaster. Your hero, your playstyle.

⚖️ Fair by design - enforced, not promised

No pay-to-win. Not as a slogan - as an engineering constraint. Premium currency buys convenience (speed-ups, extra queue slots, cosmetics), never raw power: no resource packs, no ship bundles, no loot boxes. Our economy is continuously verified by automated simulations that cap how far paying can ever get anyone ahead. Skill and strategy decide who rules the galaxy.

🌌 One account, everywhere

Play on Steam, continue in your browser, get raid alerts on your phone. Fresh seasonal servers mean there's always a new galaxy where everyone starts equal.

Thousands of commanders are already fighting for dominance. Your planet awaits.

Compete for real

Competitive mode is one difficulty, one clock, zero excuses. Pick up modifiers mid-run and use them as weapons against the other side. Climb the rankings or die trying (a lot).

8 worlds, one vibe

From sunny meadows to gear-grinding factories and lava-lit caves — 8 biomes with fully layered parallax backdrops that make going fast look as good as it feels.

Make it yours

Unlock skins and cosmetics for your bean. Build your own levels in the level creator and share them with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sausage Snap is a close-up physics party duel. You are the hands at the edge of the plate. Two sausages on forks are the fighters. There is no swordsman.

Aim height. Jab. The meat sags, stretches, sprays, and snaps. Rounds are short. Sets are best of 3. Rematch is the point.

Play on the couch with two gamepads (or a pad and a keyboard), or sit down alone against CPU. One plate. One kind of fight.

The plate

  • Close-up sausage-on-fork physics — stretch, spray, snap

  • Aim height and jab (a second timing strike may join later)

  • Best of 3, then rematch in seconds

  • Local 1v1, or solo vs CPU

  • Keyboard and gamepad

What this is not

A stick-fighter. A movelist. An online ladder. Extra sausage types and doodle dressing are not in the first version.

Photosensitivity notice

This game includes brief bright flashes and high-contrast juice bursts on hits and at round end. If you have photosensitive epilepsy or are sensitive to flash, play with caution. There is no in-game warning screen before the plate.

store_data.about_the_game:
AN ADDICTIVE CHALLENGE

Get ready to test the limits of your patience and determination. Tom's Last Adventure is a 2D precision platformer designed to challenge even the most experienced and stubborn players. The experience is intense and unforgiving: you will fail, you will get frustrated, and you will repeat the same screen dozens of times, which will make your victory much more rewarding. Although it is a straightforward and focused journey, the steep difficulty curve guarantees 2 to 6 hours of a gameplay flow so engaging and addictive that you will barely notice the time passing between attempts.

PRECISION AND STAR POWERS

Fluidity is your only chance of survival. Tom's basic movement kit features speed, a double jump, and a quick dash to overcome deadly traps. The great tactical advantage comes from collecting the magical stars scattered in the air, which instantly alter your movement options:

  • White Star: Triggers a flashbang that illuminates the environment, revealing secret paths and platforms hidden in the dark.

  • Blue Star: Grants a valuable extra mid-air jump, allowing you to extend maneuvers or correct routes in split seconds.

  • Green Star: Allows you to throw a small green sphere. You can instantly teleport to its location by pressing the button again or as soon as it collides with a solid surface.

  • Teleportation Mirrors: Mystical surfaces that act as portals. They can teleport Tom himself or the Green Star's sphere, creating complex movement puzzles and insane traversals.

A DESCENT FOR LOVE

Behind every millimeter-perfect jump, there is a much greater purpose. Tom is no ordinary feline; he is an angel who began a dangerous descent from the heavens with a single goal: to reach Earth to be found and adopted by a little boy. Each brutal level and impassable abyss represents the fears and barriers he must overcome. It is proof that not even the greatest challenges in the universe can prevent the meeting of two great friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hallucinophobia is an atmospheric psychological horror game where you make your way through a procedurally generated forest trail while finding ways to deal with the creatures that hunt you down. 

Gameplay

You are retrieving some things left behind in an old cabin in the middle of the woods. The only path? An old forest trail. Travel through the forest while using your given tools to avoid the creatures of the forest and make it safely back.

The Creatures - Hallucinations or Real Threats?

While traversing the forest, things are not as they seem. Creatures seem to appear and vanish as if they were never there, and it's your job to figure out if they are real threats or simply a trick of the mind.

Tools - Useful items, but at a cost

The forest is a dangerous place, luckily you have a few tools at your disposal to help out when things get rough.

The Flashlight

Your flashlight lets you see through the thick darkness of the forest without enraging its inhabitants. It can even be used to deter some creatures from attacking! Be careful though, as using it on fake creatures may alert the real thing.

The Camera

The camera is your surefire way to tell if a creature is real or not. Creatures that do not show up on the photo are hallucinations. The ones that do show up though are real threats. Be careful though, as using it too much may bring more attention to yourself.

The Shotgun

Your handy shotgun can deter most creatures from attacking. One shot and they temporarily flee. Be weary of use though, as it may make them more aggressive later one...

store_data.about_the_game:
Conehead: Earth Zero drops you and your friends into the heart of a dangerous and unpredictable ecosystem. Your mission is simple: explore the world, gather scrap, fill the shared stash, and exceed the company's quota. But nothing is easy on this planet; exhausted meteors silently crashing down to create massive craters, mutated locals, and mind-bending flora are constantly after you.

THE BIOMECHANICAL VENDOR

Trade with the colossal Biomechanical Vendor to manage your shared stash.

Call with Your Voice: Walk up to the megaphones and speak (or yell) into your microphone. Once you exceed the voice limit, you physically summon the vendor to your location.

Sell Your Scrap: Fill the vendor's massive bag with the scrap you've collected and press the button to confirm the sale. The bag closes, the vendor takes the scrap, and instantly transfers the money to your shared stash.

Physical Delivery: No menus are used when buying items either. When you confirm your order via the screens on the display cases, the vendor drops a huge bag on the ground, the lid opens like a ramp, and your purchased items physically appear inside.

Trolls are unforgivable ("Penalty Roulette"): Players who press the CONFIRM button with an empty basket instead of selecting items when calling the vendor will pay a heavy price. The vendor will become enraged, catch the troll, and throw it like a rag doll to a random, lethal spot across the map!

When selling metal, if you don't put the scrap metal you want to sell into the scrap metal bag, the vendor will punish everyone!

A DEADLY AND REACTIVE ECOSYSTEM

Toxic Plants & Spores: Toxic eggs swell and explode as you approach, leaving you in a cloud of acid. If you are exposed to the floating neon spores of the Lumen Mushrooms, you will hallucinate for few seconds, your skeleton will contort, and you will lose your balance in a "Drunk Walk".

store_data.about_the_game:
Halley's Big Catch

Halley is a cartoon cat who takes fishing seriously. He comes home to Hidden Pond for a quiet day on the dock — and finds the start of something much bigger. Relics. Waters all over the world. The old fish stories from childhood start to feel closer than they used to.

This is a cozy, readable fishing adventure: warm scenery, great water, and fights that feel like the fish, not a health bar.

On the water

  • Cast, hook, fight — timing, drag, and tackle match matter
  • Hidden Pond and beyond — ponds, creeks, reefs, open ocean, and more
  • Dozens of species — keep a bag, fill the index, chase the ones that got away
  • Gear that changes the fight — combos for still water, fly water, and blue water
  • A journal, not a lecture — the story sits in what you find

The trail

A worn medallion. Strange pieces waiting on distant shores. When Halley finds one, the medallion reacts. The rest you learn by fishing.

For players who like

  • Character fishing games with a real fight
  • Exploring a new shore instead of grinding one pond
  • A story that stays a little mysterious
  • A cartoon world that still takes the water seriously

Coming soon on Steam. Wishlist if you want to stand on the dock with Halley.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your job is simple: restore power to an abandoned hospital. Unfortunately, you are not alone.
THE NIGHT SHIFT STARTS HERE

You are an electrician called in for a routine night shift at an old hospital scheduled to return to service.

The job sounds simple.

Restore the power.
Replace damaged fuses.
Restart generators.
Repair electrical panels.
Bring the hospital back online.

But the deeper you venture into the building, the less this feels like an ordinary maintenance job.

Something is moving through the dark.

And it knows you are here.

RESTORE THE HOSPITAL

Explore abandoned wards, maintenance corridors, treatment rooms and restricted areas while bringing the hospital's electrical systems back online.

Search for fuses, repair damaged equipment, activate generators and restore power section by section.

Every completed repair opens the way deeper into the hospital.

And closer to what is waiting inside.

DON'T LET HIM FIND YOU

You are not alone.

A grotesque butcher stalks the hospital, searching its corridors and reacting to your presence.

Run.

Hide.

Turn off your flashlight.

Use the environment to stay out of sight.

When you hear him nearby, finishing the repair might not be worth the risk.

THE HOSPITAL IS HIDING SOMETHING

The building was never simply abandoned.

Locked rooms, forgotten medical areas and disturbing evidence reveal what happened before the hospital was shut down.

Eventually, the clean hospital corridors give way to something much worse.

A hidden slaughterhouse.

And its butcher is still working.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Complete your work, uncover the truth behind the hospital and find a way out before you become the next patient of THE BUTCHER WARD.

FEATURES

  • First-person horror gameplay

  • An abandoned hospital to explore

  • Electrical repair and restoration objectives

  • Generators, fuse boxes and power systems

  • A relentless enemy stalking the corridors

  • Stealth, hiding and escape sequences

  • A disturbing hidden slaughterhouse

  • Environmental storytelling and secrets

  • Atmospheric lighting and sound-driven horror

store_data.about_the_game:
Coquí Crusader: Defenders of Borikén

The island of Borikén is under siege. Mythical creatures from Puerto Rican folklore — the Chupacabra, El Cuco, restless Vejigantes, and the ghost of the pirate Cofresí — are rising across the island. Only one hero stands ready: a brave coquí in a pava hat, carrying the spirit of an entire people.

🐸 Click to Fight

Every tap is a strike. Crush enemies, send damage numbers flying, and feel your power grow with every click. Easy to pick up, deeply satisfying to master.

⚡ Energy That Never Sleeps

Each click costs energy — and here's the twist: your energy regenerates in real time, even while the game is closed. Step away, live your life, and return the next day to a full meter and a fresh assault. True offline progression that respects your time.

🗺️ Journey Across the Island

Battle through 10 hand-crafted zones inspired by real Puerto Rican landmarks:

  • El Yunque Rainforest

  • Old San Juan

  • Culebra Coast

  • La Parguera Bay

  • Cordillera Central

  • Ponce

  • Cueva del Indio

  • Castillo San Felipe del Morro

  • Vieques Island

  • The Heart of Borikén

👑 50+ Enemies & 10 Folklore Bosses

Face creatures pulled straight from Puerto Rican legend, building to epic boss battles against La Garita del Diablo, El Cuco, the Gran Vejigante, El Chupacabra, and the island-shaking Gran Huracán.

🥁 Master 6 Cultural Abilities

  • Coquí Call — your next hits strike tenfold

  • Bomba Rhythm — drum up an auto-click frenzy

  • Boricua Spirit — unleash an explosive damage surge

  • Café Boost — a shot of café instantly refills your energy

  • Plena Chorus — triple your energy regeneration

  • Taíno Fury — channel ancestral power into a devastating strike

📈 Level Up, Upgrade, Rebirth

Earn XP and coins, unlock 9 permanent upgrades, and once you've conquered the island — Rebirth. Reset your journey to earn Spirit Shards and permanent power that carries with you forever.

And the island never truly rests: clear the final zone and it begins again, harder and richer with every Endless Lap. There is always another wave, and always a reason to come back stronger.

🎵 An Original Boricua Soundtrack

Five original looping tracks — plena-inspired gameplay beats, a warm cafecito plaza theme, tense San Juan nights, and a high-energy bonus rush — all shifting dynamically with the action.

🇵🇷 A Love Letter to Puerto Rico

Coquí Crusader weaves Puerto Rican identity into everything: the coquí mascot, bomba and plena rhythms, café culture, Taíno heritage, and the islands themselves. Fully playable in English and Spanish.

Defend the island. ¡Pa'lante, Boricua!

Every tap is a strike. Crush enemies, send damage numbers flying, and feel your power grow with every click. Easy to pick up, deeply satisfying to master.

⚡ Energy That Never Sleeps

Each click costs energy — and here's the twist: your energy regenerates in real time, even while the game is closed. Step away, live your life, and return the next day to a full meter and a fresh assault. True offline progression that respects your time.

🗺️ Journey Across the Island

Battle through 10 hand-crafted zones inspired by real Puerto Rican landmarks:

  • El Yunque Rainforest

  • Old San Juan

  • Culebra Coast

  • La Parguera Bay

  • Cordillera Central

  • Ponce

  • Cueva del Indio

  • Castillo San Felipe del Morro

  • Vieques Island

  • The Heart of Borikén

👑 50+ Enemies & 10 Folklore Bosses

Face creatures pulled straight from Puerto Rican legend, building to epic boss battles against La Garita del Diablo, El Cuco, the Gran Vejigante, El Chupacabra, and the island-shaking Gran Huracán.

🥁 Master 6 Cultural Abilities

  • Coquí Call — your next hits strike tenfold

  • Bomba Rhythm — drum up an auto-click frenzy

  • Boricua Spirit — unleash an explosive damage surge

  • Café Boost — a shot of café instantly refills your energy

  • Plena Chorus — triple your energy regeneration

  • Taíno Fury — channel ancestral power into a devastating strike

📈 Level Up, Upgrade, Rebirth

Earn XP and coins, unlock 9 permanent upgrades, and once you've conquered the island — Rebirth. Reset your journey to earn Spirit Shards and permanent power that carries with you forever.

And the island never truly rests: clear the final zone and it begins again, harder and richer with every Endless Lap. There is always another wave, and always a reason to come back stronger.

🎵 An Original Boricua Soundtrack

Five original looping tracks — plena-inspired gameplay beats, a warm cafecito plaza theme, tense San Juan nights, and a high-energy bonus rush — all shifting dynamically with the action.

🇵🇷 A Love Letter to Puerto Rico

Coquí Crusader weaves Puerto Rican identity into everything: the coquí mascot, bomba and plena rhythms, café culture, Taíno heritage, and the islands themselves. Fully playable in English and Spanish.

Defend the island. ¡Pa'lante, Boricua!

Tap to crush mythical creatures from Taíno legend and folklore, master 6 culturally inspired abilities, journey through 10 iconic zones, and rebirth for endless power. Your energy regenerates even while you're away.

store_data.about_the_game:
One gnome. One pogo stick. 800 metres to the moon.

No checkpoints. No saves. No mercy.

One bad jump at 600 metres puts you back on the lawn. That is not a bug. That is the game.

Then the paperwork arrives

After every fall, the GARDEN OFFICE gets in touch. An official notice, duly served, with a reference number. It knows your name, it knows your altitude — and it knows exactly how often you have failed in that exact spot.

ASCENT PERMIT DENIED. Ref. GA-2026-0417. The site has been surveyed. There are no grounds for appeal.

Every notice is filed in your cabinet. There are hundreds. You do not want to collect them all. You will anyway.

The climb

  • Ten zones from the lawn to the moon — seven with a rule of their own

  • Spring clouds bounce you back, the wind at the antenna drags you sideways, roof tiles slide out from under you, on the moon you float

  • Height and distance share one charge — you cannot have them separately

  • The final jump to the moon has a seven percent timing window

Rank and kit

  • Ten ranks, from Applicant to Moon Clerk with Right of Appeal. Your rank never falls.

  • Eight characters, thirteen hats, thirteen coats, twelve pogo sticks, sixteen trails — all from chests, all earned

  • No microtransactions. No purchases. None.

Made to be shared

  • Every fall is recorded automatically, ready to share

  • Every notice can be saved as an image, with seal and stamp

  • A daily challenge: the same route for everyone, new every day

Runs entirely offline. No tutorial beyond the first few minutes. It will not help you.

Good luck. The office is not expecting it.

store_data.about_the_game:
OVERQUOTA is a factory-building roguelike about turning simple machines into wildly efficient production lines.

Place Sources, Processors, and Collectors on a compact grid, then connect them into a working network. Packets move through your machines, gaining worth as they are doubled, split, sorted, combined, redirected, and converted into value.

Every Blind gives you a rising quota and a limited number of cycles to reach it. Building bigger is not always better: crowded routes can jam, strained machines can overheat, and a single misplaced arrow can bring the entire line to a halt. Design carefully, control the flow, and push beyond the quota for greater rewards.

Between Blinds, spend your earnings on new machines and run-defining relics. Adapt your layout as your collection grows, combine unusual effects, and find powerful interactions that can carry your factory through all seven Antes.

Boss Blinds introduce disruptive rules that force you to rethink reliable builds. Machines may become restricted, packets may behave differently, and once-safe strategies can suddenly fall apart.

  • Build and rebuild compact automated production lines

  • Route packets through dozens of distinct machines

  • Manage heat, bottlenecks, timing, and limited board space

  • Combine machine modifiers with powerful passive relics

  • Choose from multiple starter kits with different strategies

  • Defeat escalating Blinds and rule-changing bosses

  • Unlock new machines, relics, and starter kits across future runs

  • Chase daily challenges and discover new combinations in the Codex

Meet the quota. Break the quota. Keep the factory running.

store_data.about_the_game:
Somewhere out past the dock there is a lake that does not have fish in it. It has wax.

REEL COLLECTIBLES is a 16-bit game about fishing packs of baseball cards out of the water and filing every last one of them into a binder. Cast, fight whatever has taken the bait, tear the wrapper, flip eight cards one at a time, and find out whether you just pulled a common outfielder or the one card that decade is famous for.

Fifty years of cards. 1950 to 1999. 14,645 of them. Every player, team and card company is invented for this game, which means nobody has already written the price guide.

Fish it up

Everything in your collection came out of the water. Cast a line, wait through the fake nibbles, set the hook, then win the fight: your catch zone sits in the middle of the gauge while the hooked "?" sweeps up and down, and you press to stop it inside. Heavy catches need more hooks set and sweep faster with every one. Old cards fight harder than new ones. Miss three times and the line snaps.

How cleanly you land it decides what condition the cards arrive in. A perfect catch bumps every card in the pack up a tier. A two-miss scrape hands you a waterlogged pack.

Six pieces of water, six different ponds

Take the boat out on the lake map and pick your spot. The narrows, the spillway, the flats, the island, each one fishes differently: what bites, how long you wait, whether the deep stuff is even down there. None of them is the best one. Where you fish is a real trade, the same as which rod you bought and which bait is on the hook.

The binder

Decade, year, 3x3 pages, exactly like the real thing. New cards file themselves. Duplicates route to the trade box automatically, and a better-condition dupe swaps in and bumps the old copy out. Fifty complete checklists to chase, and every one of them has a grail card that only shows up with fireworks.

Send it off to CGA

Post a card away to the Collectors Grading Authority and wait. It comes back sealed in a slab with a number on it. A high grade is worth far more than the raw card. A low one is worse than never having sent it, and it is permanent. The grade is locked in the moment you post it, so reloading will not save you.

Twenty-five things that are not cards

The pond coughs up junk, and occasionally it coughs up something else. A chipped batting helmet. A scorched ball. A corked bottle with a 1919 contract still folded inside it. There is one of each, ever, and the best of them will not bite in the shallows at all.

428 awards on nine shelves

Finish a year's set. Collect one club's entire history. Every shortstop of the 1970s. The men who lasted twenty seasons. Each award is a real badge with a name and a place on the wall, and it turns up in a popup that will not be ignored.

Down at the dock

The lake has a small-time carnival attached to it. Spin the prize plane's wheel. Play the passing jetski's keno board, where every ball that hits one of your numbers floats up a sealed pack. Hit the barrel-boost slot machine for a timed fishing buff. Take on the travelling barge's BIG BOARD, where the light coasts five squares past wherever you pressed and a skunk takes your entire bank.

Also in the box

[list]

  • Every set has its own look, frames and colour schemes that drift decade by decade, and the wax matches the cards inside it

  • Sal's shop: better rods for a bigger catch zone and mintier cards, better bait for faster bites and richer packs

  • Sell your dupes for coins, or spend trade-box value at the counter to buy the one card you are missing

  • An auto-opener for when you are sitting on forty packs and just want the hits

  • Chiptune soundtrack, and everything on screen is clickable

All players, teams, and card companies in Reel Collectibles are fictional.

store_data.about_the_game:
Command epic mass battles in a 3D pixel-art medieval fantasy RTS. Lead one of four factions, each fighting by its own laws of war. Raise war hosts of infantry, cavalry, and siege engines, choose powerful techs, storm enemy strongholds, and fight across battlefields alive with objectives. Play solo PvE against AI, or PvP with up to 8 players.

FROM OUTPOST TO WAR HOST

The war never waits. While your soldiers hold the front, your halls are already filling with new ranks — fresh squads marching out of the gates, cavalry wheeling into line, siege engines rolling up the road. The camp you founded at dawn becomes a war host by dusk. And across the map, so does your enemy's.

POWERFUL TECHS. TURN THE TIDE.

Choose powerful techs to strengthen your forces, push your faction's strengths further, and turn the tide of battle.

THE BATTLEFIELD TEMPTS YOU

Beyond your walls, the map is full of temptation. Caravans heavy with gold crawl past your borders. Captive soldiers wait for rescue. Neutral camps sleep on their treasures. Take them and grow rich — hesitate, and the enemy will. The richest lord is the one who dares to leave home.

FOUR FACTIONS. FOUR RULES OF WAR.

HUMANS — STRENGTH BUILDS FAITH. Every soldier under the Human banner makes the Faith flow faster — and Faith feeds the war machine. A wheel that turns faster the bigger it grows. Steady expansion, disciplined ranks, an answer for every formation. Humans do not win with tricks. They win with mass, armor, and momentum.

ELVES — SEE FIRST. STRIKE FIRST. The forest watches with them. Elves fight through range, speed, and sight — they find you first, strike from strength, and never let the battle reach their lines. Where the forest still stands, their power grows; the woods are not scenery, they are walls. Come with axes, and the forest itself will answer.

THE UNDEAD — DEATH BUILDS THE ARMY. An Undead army begins fragile and ends inevitable. Spread corruption across the land, and the enemy's dead rise beneath your banner. Every battle makes the legion larger — win or lose. Make the war long. Make it costly. Drown them in the soldiers they killed.

ORCS — FURY MUST KEEP MOVING. Orc strength is fury, and fury feeds on blood. Every blow struck, every wound taken, every enemy felled makes them hit harder — and the storm dies the moment they stand still. So an Orc host never stands still. Keep pushing. Keep swinging. Give the enemy no room to breathe.

NO WAR PLAYS OUT THE SAME

Every battlefield is generated anew — its own rivers, forests, and openings to seize. And the enemy across the map fights by different laws than you do. Plans rarely survive twice. Adapt, improvise, and find the shape of this war.

KEY FEATURES

  • Four Factions, Four Laws of War — Humans, Elves, the Undead, and Orcs grow their power in fundamentally different ways.

  • Powerful Techs — strengthen your forces, push your faction's strengths further, and turn the tide of battle.

  • Epic Mass Battles — armies form fast and fights stay large. Command the war, not the waiting.

  • A Living Battlefield — caravans, camps, and rescues pull every army beyond its walls.

  • Classic RTS Warfare — build, gather, expand, defend, and break the enemy's stronghold.

  • Every War a New Map — procedurally generated battlefields.

  • Solo PvE & Up to 8-Player PvP — face the AI alone or wage war against rivals.

  • A 3D Pixel-Art Fantasy World — Lead large armies across medieval battlefields.

store_data.about_the_game:
The banner of the Taiping Rebellion is raised, and the heavens have perished. You squeeze past the talisman water stand in the market of Zhuo County and bump into a young man weaving mats and selling shoes - Liu Xuan De. The troubled times of the Three Kingdoms are no longer just a footnote in history books.

In "Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator", you are not a spectator - you are the one who rewrites the script. You can personally interact with characters from the Three Kingdoms era. The storyline of the Three Kingdoms may be completely rewritten if the sworn brotherhood in the Peach Garden does not form; Diao Chan from the Fengyi Pavilion can be set free, join the army, become a diplomat, or remain a chess piece as in the original version; the choice of fire attack, chain strategy, and east wind altar in the Battle of Red Cliffs is up to you.

This is an AI-driven story-driven strategy card RPG:

A visually immersive narrative-driven main storyline, featuring 5 major chapters and 6 turn-based boss battles against Zhang Jiao, Dong Zhuo, Lv Bu, Cao Cao, Zhou Yu, and Zhuge Liang.

There are dozens of heroes waiting to be recruited.

AI Political Discussion: Each episode features pre-battle discussions, driven by AI interpretation.

Exciting turn-based strategy game: Each general possesses a unique ultimate skill, while each boss has a choice of three tactics before battle, influencing the battle situation from multiple dimensions.

Awakening system, card drawing, equipment, store, and conquest campaign map gameplay.

The Oath of the Peach Garden, the Sea of Fire at Red Cliff, Hulao Pass, the Court of Luoyang, and the Altar of Julu - all are epic tales. Every choice you make will determine where the stars ultimately land, and you will personally write the ending of your Three Kingdoms story.

The Perfect Horror Game... is the one you made!

Horror Game Creator is a powerful sandbox tool that lets you design, customize, and explore your own liminal horror experiences. Inspired by the endless, eerie maze of the haunted, this creator gives you full control to shape unsettling worlds, craft unique encounters, and define how players survive them. Build your own levels using modular environments, connect rooms into sprawling labyrinths, and control every detail—from lighting and atmosphere to enemies, items, and lore.

Want flickering lights and empty hallways? Or a relentless chase through something that shouldn’t exist? You decide.

Features:

  • Create Your Own Levels – Design interconnected spaces with full creative freedom

  • Customize Gameplay – Choose enemies, items, lighting, and difficulty

  • Dynamic Atmosphere – Control tension with sound, darkness, and environmental effects

  • Liminal Horror Focus – Capture the unsettling feeling of being somewhere you shouldn’t be

  • Endless Possibilities – Build, test, and refine your own unique Horror  game experience

Whether you're crafting a slow, psychological descent or a fast-paced escape from entities, Horror Game Creator gives you the tools to bring your vision to life.

The only limit is how far you're willing to go.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neko Neko Shop is a cozy organizing game about bringing order back to a shop overflowing with adorable neko collectibles. Sort scattered items, restock displays, and arrange every corner until the store feels perfectly organized.

〖A Cozy Neko Collecting & Organizing Game〗

Neko Neko Shop looks like a simple little store filled with lucky cats.

But the owners are very serious about keeping the shelves full, the books balanced, and certain questions unanswered.

Now the shop is a complete mess. Find every neko, return it to the right display, and help keep this perfectly ordinary family business running smoothly.

〖When a Messy Neko Shop Falls Into Place〗

At first, the shop is overflowing with neko collectibles scattered everywhere. Pick them up, find where they belong, and slowly transform the chaos into a cute, perfectly organized store.

〖Find, Sort, and Display Every Neko〗

Explore the shop, collect misplaced nekos, and return each one to the correct display. Take your time and enjoy the simple rhythm of cleaning, sorting, and organizing.

〖Build the Perfect Collection〗

Watch empty displays fill up and messy piles disappear as every neko finds its place. Completing each area brings visible progress and satisfying little moments.

〖Skill Upgrades〗

Unlock upgrades that make organizing easier. Carry more items, move faster, find missing nekos more easily, and clean up the shop more efficiently.

〖Key Features〗

  • Cozy organizing gameplay focused on adorable neko collectibles

  • Uniques nekos to find, sort, and display

  • Satisfying progression as the shop transforms from chaos to perfection

  • Useful upgrades for carrying, movement, searching, and more

  • No time limits and no pressure — organize at your own pace

store_data.about_the_game:
"We spend our whole lives searching for that firefly from childhood, only to realize it has been living in our hearts all along…"

"I" have been having the same dream lately. This is a first-person collection, exploration, and puzzle-solving game. You will chase fireflies through a dreamcore fantasy world, catch them with different tools, and use them to light up the world. As the story progresses, you grow from a child into an adult, reliving childhood, adolescence, and adulthood, picking up forgotten memories in familiar yet strange scenes, and unraveling the knots buried deep in your heart at each stage.

Catching Is More Than Collecting

Each firefly has its own temperament: some rest quietly, some wander around, and others flee when startled.

You can swing a net for area catching, hold out your hand for them to land on, use a mini fan to blow them where you want, or record sounds with a tape recorder to attract fireflies along the trail of music. Each tool has its own rhythm and corresponding catching strategy.

Bring fireflies back to designated spots for rewards, then use those rewards to upgrade your abilities: larger carrying capacity, longer reach, more refined tools. The process of collecting is also a process of gradually understanding them—and yourself.

Explore a Dreaming World

There is no combat pressure—only exploration, puzzles, and companionship. Giant statues, empty pools, floating staircases, endlessly repeating corridors—these dreamcore scenes feel both familiar and strange, like old memories wrapped in soft light. You need to observe your surroundings, find clues, and solve mechanisms to open the next door.

A Lifetime for a Single Light

The story begins with a baby's first opening of their eyes. A mother is like water—silent yet steadfast, quietly placing freedom in your hands. A father is like a mountain—teaching you to smile even in failure. You experience every stage of life in classrooms, playgrounds, clouds, and memories, until you grow up and finally reunite with that very first firefly.

Game Features

  • Multiple catching tools: net, hands, mini fan, tape recorder—each with unique gameplay

  • Collect and grow: catch fireflies, submit them at designated spots, upgrade abilities—a relaxing growth loop

  • Exploration and puzzles: find clues and solve environmental puzzles in a dreamcore world to advance the story

  • Journey of a lifetime: from infant to adult, experiencing childhood, adolescence, and adulthood

  • Healing atmosphere: whimsical and gentle dreamcore aesthetics, immersive day/night and nature experiences, a warm and profound story

store_data.about_the_game:
It is Minesweeper, but you are not trying to clear the board. You are trying to hit

a score before you run out of Sweeps.

The unit of play is not the click. It is the Slip.

Bet on the tiles you can prove

Deduction tells you which tiles are safe. That is the easy part. Load up to five of

them onto a Slip, commit with SWEEP, and the numbers you uncover score together as a

poker hand — multiplied by the shape they made on the grid, and by how many you dared

to load.

One Bust anywhere in the Slip and the hand pays no multiplier. So the real question is

never "which tile is safe." It is "which safe tile is worth taking."

Or push it one tile further

Clear a Slip and you are offered a choice: bank the payout, or PUSH — turn one more

tile blind and rescore everything. The multipliers climb past anything a normal Slip

can reach. Bust on a push and the entire payout is gone.

Build something broken

100 Lucky Stickers. 35 single-use Tokens. 25 permanent board upgrades.

Stickers fire strictly left to right, so a x3 in the last slot is worth far more than

the same sticker in the first. Rearranging your build IS the build. Watch the chain

resolve one sticker at a time and learn exactly what you have made.

The board always plays fair

Every board is generated so it can be solved by reasoning alone. You should never have

to guess, and a Bust only ever reveals itself — one mistake never turns a solvable

board into a coin flip. If a board looks impossible, there is a deduction you have not

spotted yet.

Runs that do not stop

There is no win screen. Tickets keep coming and the target keeps multiplying, so a

build that stops growing gets left behind. Bosses arrive to change the rules for a

Ticket. Routes fork the run. Every run — win or lose — pays out Credits toward

permanent hand upgrades, Charms that change how the next run starts, and Stakes that

make it harder.

Features

  • 100 Lucky Stickers, 35 Tokens and 25 board upgrades to build with

  • Enhanced tiles — Foil, Holo, Glass, Gold, Locked, Twin and Rotten

  • Endless runs with Bosses, branching Routes and difficulty Stakes

  • Run seeds, and an autosave that picks up at the Ticket you left on

  • Full controller support, built with handhelds in mind

  • Original soundtrack

  • Reduce motion, high contrast, and a frame cap for battery life

store_data.about_the_game:
You arrive at an apartment building on the south side of the city to visit a friend you have not seen in years.

The door to Unit 305 is unlocked, but no one is home. A note has been left on the dining table. Your phone has no signal, and the hallway you just crossed no longer feels familiar.

When you try to leave, the building changes.

Explore a Shifting Apartment Building

With each new loop, its rooms, exits, and connections are rearranged. Residential units, management offices, underground facilities, and spaces that should not exist are joined together inside the same building.

Before opening a door, you can never be certain whether it leads to a familiar corridor—or to a room that was never there before.

Investigate What Was Left Behind

Examine personal belongings, documents, local reports, maintenance records, and traces of everyday life. Piece these scattered details together into Knowledge that persists across loops.

Clues can support and transform one another. An anomaly that once seemed meaningless may gain a new explanation later, while evidence you have already uncovered can improve your chances during investigations and attribute checks.

There are no objective markers pointing you toward the answer. You must decide which information to trust—and where to investigate next.

Carry Understanding Through Every Loop

When your Steps run out, or an encounter leaves you unable to continue, you return to the beginning.

Most physical items cannot be carried back. Knowledge can.

Major discoveries are converted into Insight, which can be used to strengthen your attributes and expand your ability to explore. Each loop may take something from you, but it should also bring you closer to an exit.

Decide How Much Risk to Take

Movement, investigation, and special actions consume a limited pool of Steps. Some anomalies may also damage your Health or Sanity.

Strength, Agility, Perception, and Sanity determine how the protagonist handles different situations. Equipment, clues, and evidence can affect the outcome of attribute checks—leading to new discoveries or bringing the current loop to an early end.

Your chances are shown before you commit.

Whether to proceed is up to you.

A Message from the Management Office

There is a visitor registration terminal inside the management office.

The first time it lights up, a message is already waiting:

If anyone can see this message, stay calm.

Who left it? Are they trapped somewhere inside the same building? If a message can get through, why has every other form of communication failed?

All you can do is continue investigating, and wait for another reply.

Psychological Horror in Everyday Spaces

A newspaper printed with the wrong date. A room missing from every floor plan. A phone call with no identifiable source. Another corridor appearing for an instant when the lights go out.

The building’s abnormalities emerge gradually from familiar, ordinary spaces.

The real danger may not be what waits behind the next door.

It may be the moment all of this begins to feel normal.

Key Features

  • A psychological horror adventure built around environmental observation and text-driven investigation;

  • An apartment map whose rooms and connections change with each loop;

  • Persistent Knowledge and Insight-based progression;

  • Attribute checks based on Strength, Agility, Perception, and Sanity;

  • Resource management involving Steps, Health, Sanity, and limited items;

store_data.detailed_description:
You arrive at an apartment building on the south side of the city to visit a friend you have not seen in years.

The door to Unit 305 is unlocked, but no one is home. A note has been left on the dining table. Your phone has no signal, and the hallway you just crossed no longer feels familiar.

When you try to leave, the building changes.

Explore a Shifting Apartment Building

With each new loop, its rooms, exits, and connections are rearranged. Residential units, management offices, underground facilities, and spaces that should not exist are joined together inside the same building.

Before opening a door, you can never be certain whether it leads to a familiar corridor—or to a room that was never there before.

Investigate What Was Left Behind

Examine personal belongings, documents, local reports, maintenance records, and traces of everyday life. Piece these scattered details together into Knowledge that persists across loops.

Clues can support and transform one another. An anomaly that once seemed meaningless may gain a new explanation later, while evidence you have already uncovered can improve your chances during investigations and attribute checks.

There are no objective markers pointing you toward the answer. You must decide which information to trust—and where to investigate next.

Carry Understanding Through Every Loop

When your Steps run out, or an encounter leaves you unable to continue, you return to the beginning.

Most physical items cannot be carried back. Knowledge can.

Major discoveries are converted into Insight, which can be used to strengthen your attributes and expand your ability to explore. Each loop may take something from you, but it should also bring you closer to an exit.

Decide How Much Risk to Take

Movement, investigation, and special actions consume a limited pool of Steps. Some anomalies may also damage your Health or Sanity.

Strength, Agility, Perception, and Sanity determine how the protagonist handles different situations. Equipment, clues, and evidence can affect the outcome of attribute checks—leading to new discoveries or bringing the current loop to an early end.

Your chances are shown before you commit.

Whether to proceed is up to you.

A Message from the Management Office

There is a visitor registration terminal inside the management office.

The first time it lights up, a message is already waiting:

If anyone can see this message, stay calm.

Who left it? Are they trapped somewhere inside the same building? If a message can get through, why has every other form of communication failed?

All you can do is continue investigating, and wait for another reply.

Psychological Horror in Everyday Spaces

A newspaper printed with the wrong date. A room missing from every floor plan. A phone call with no identifiable source. Another corridor appearing for an instant when the lights go out.

The building’s abnormalities emerge gradually from familiar, ordinary spaces.

The real danger may not be what waits behind the next door.

It may be the moment all of this begins to feel normal.

Key Features

  • A psychological horror adventure built around environmental observation and text-driven investigation;

  • An apartment map whose rooms and connections change with each loop;

  • Persistent Knowledge and Insight-based progression;

  • Attribute checks based on Strength, Agility, Perception, and Sanity;

  • Resource management involving Steps, Health, Sanity, and limited items;

  • An interconnected clue system that can affect later investigations;

  • Asynchronous messages delivered through the management office terminal;

  • A retro computer interface paired with 2D apartment environments;

  • Surreal abnormalities that grow gradually out of everyday spaces.

Psychological horror investigation in a retro interface: the building reassembles itself every time you lose consciousness.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Little Pond. A Hungry Cat. Lots of Fish.

A Cat’s Little Pond is a cozy incremental game about growing a tiny pond into a lively little ecosystem — all for one very hungry cat.

Start with a quiet pond and a handful of fish. As your cat collects more Mass, you can unlock and upgrade new spawners, bringing more fish, insects, treasures, and other curious creatures into the pond.

🌿 Grow Your Little Pond

Place and upgrade different spawners around the pond, from lily gardens and reed patches to sunken treasure and fallen logs.

Each one adds something new to the ecosystem, gradually turning an empty pond into a busy little world full of things to discover.

🐱 Let the Cat Do Cat Things

Your cat isn't just here to look cute.

Unlock new skills and upgrade them as you progress. Swipe at nearby creatures, pull things closer, toss fishbones, make waves, slam the water with your tail, and find increasingly effective ways to collect everything the pond has to offer.

🐟 Discover & Collect

The pond is home to more than ordinary fish.

Discover different fish, creatures, items, and relics and fill out your collection. Some things are common sights, while others may require a little luck — or the right conditions — to appear.

✨ Find Relics

Treasure can contain relics ranging from simple pond trinkets to extremely rare artifacts.

Relics can improve your Mass gain, increase your chances of finding rare loot, speed up your spawners, or provide combinations of powerful bonuses.

Find them, collect them, and decorate your pond with your favorites.

🌦️ Watch the Pond Change

Your pond keeps moving even when you're not doing much.

Day turns into night. Weather changes. Creatures swim around, insects visit the water, plants sway, and new things appear as your pond grows.

There is no need to rush.

Upgrade your pond, discover new things, watch the numbers go up, and enjoy hanging out with your cat.

It's just a cat and its little pond.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the sixth year of Zhongping reign, Dong Zhuo seized control of the capital, tearing the realm apart.

You are a destitute refugee dwelling on You Province’s northern border, with no powerful connections nor tutelage from renowned martial arts masters. All you possess is a rusted iron sword, struggling to survive amid roaming barbarian raiders, rogue soldiers and bandits that plague the northern lands.

On the brink of death, the Northern Sword Sect Founding System binds itself to you. As a nobody, you shall build your very own swordsmanship sect from nothing.

The system will not bestow peerless martial arts out of thin air. Every sword form must be forged through your own bloodied combat and battlefield insights. The system will only compile your combat experience into teachable sword manuals and techniques.

Start with an abandoned mountain stronghold and a handful of starving refugee disciples. Manage your sect grounds, reclaim farmlands, forge weapons, fend off Wuhuan plunderers and bandit assaults, and transform your ragtag crew into the formidable Northern Sword Sect revered across You and Bing Provinces.

Spear arts dominate the northern plains, with wandering spear fighters roaming every corner. Master sword techniques designed to deflect and counter spears, exclusive to the Northern Sword Sect. You will cross paths with famous figures of the late Han Dynasty, including Xu Shu and Deng Zhan, and hear tales of legendary veteran swordsmen Wang Yue and Shi A. Stand as a rival school against the spear tradition championed by Zhang Xiu, the Northern Spear King.

No sect can remain untouched by the raging chaos of the era. Gongsun Zan, Yuan Shao and Cao Cao will all extend offers of alliance to you. You may choose to shelter in seclusion, taking in displaced common folk and turning your mountain grounds into a peaceful haven of martial virtue. You could also emerge from the mountains to serve warlords, sending your sect’s swordsmen to fight across the battlefields. Or you may amass your strength to carve out an independent domain in the north, securing a foothold amid warring lords. Make fatal misjudgments, however, and your stronghold will fall, the legacy of the Northern Sword Sect lost forever to the tides of history.

Core Gameplay

  • Sect Construction & Management: Seize mountain fortresses, renovate dwellings, cultivate farmlands, erect defensive works, and overcome shortages of food, armaments and vital supplies.

  • System-Driven Martial Arts Creation: Gain insights through combat to unlock sword manuals and stances, perfect the Northern Sword Sect’s unique fighting style, and pass your skills down to disciples.

  • Recruit & Train Disciples: Take in refugees, wanderers and down-and-out warriors, tailor training for each individual, oversee your followers, and resolve internal sect affairs.

  • Branching Late Han Storylines: Critical choices unlock four distinct endings. Every decision you make shapes the rise or fall of the Northern Sword Sect.

  • Encounters with Historical Figures: Wander the untold corners of Three Kingdoms history and interact with heroes and wandering warriors. You are not the central hero of this age—only a sect leader clinging to survival in a brutal chaotic world.

store_data.about_the_game:
The house came with the study, and the study came with the circle.

Your predecessor left no notes. Only a circle drawn in chalk that does not smudge, a candle that has not gone out, and eight Sigils that are very patiently waiting for someone to notice what they do.

They do not make power. They make the thing that makes power.

AN ENGINE THAT BUILDS ITSELF

Eight tiers of Sigil, each producing the tier below it. Buy an Ember and it makes mana. Buy a Rune Stone and it makes Embers. By the time you reach the Sanctum you are eight layers away from anything you can see, and the numbers have stopped being numbers.

FIVE LAYERS DEEP

Resonance collapses your circle to redraw it wider. Transcription burns the whole Study onto a page. Ascension drops the pages. Convergence takes you above the house entirely — and Chronomancy is bought with nothing but the number of times you have torn it all down.

A PLAYSTYLE, NOT A DIFFICULTY

Commit to a Doctrine and change it whenever you like. The Quickened builds Momentum by hand and burns brightest while you are there. The Patient grows stronger the longer it is left alone. Neither is the correct answer.

ARRANGE, DON'T JUST BUY

The Constellation is a board, not a shop. Stars are worth what their neighbours make them worth, and a Bridge is worth nothing at all until it sits between two things that matter.

TRIALS

Run the Study with a rule broken. No tempo. Two Sigils. No ladder at all, so that every tier has to do its own work. What you learn is permanent.

RELICS

Something comes back with you from every Ascension, and you may only keep one. A stub of chalk. A bell with nothing in it. An hourglass that was already broken. They do not make you stronger — they change what the study does.

Offline progress. Autobuyers for everything that deserves them. Numbers that keep working long past the point most games give up. No ads, no timers, no waiting for permission to play.

store_data.about_the_game:
AETHERIA is a high-speed aerial roguelite action game set in a fully 3D space where you can fly freely in every direction.

Soar through a gravity-free battlefield and break through massive swarms of enemies attacking from all around you — ahead, behind, above, and below. Use high-speed movement and evasive maneuvers while combining automatic attacks and skills to tear through the enemy horde.

Choose from a variety of upgrades during each run and create your own build by combining attack speed, additional projectiles, homing attacks, piercing shots, area attacks, orbiting weapons, and more. Your choices can dramatically change how you fight, even when using the same character.

Face not only regular enemies, but also powerful elite foes, mid-bosses, and massive bosses with unique abilities. Navigate the battlefield at full speed, evade incoming threats, and survive intense combat in every direction.

In this world, realms that were never meant to meet have become connected through a mysterious gate, allowing enemies from other worlds to invade. Your mission is to eliminate these invaders and confront the anomaly linking the worlds together.

As you complete runs, unlock new abilities and characters, experiment with stronger builds, and take on increasingly dangerous battles. Experience fast aerial movement, large-scale combat, and constantly changing builds in a roguelite designed to be played again and again.

store_data.about_the_game:
Take control of an entire country’s economy!

Will you be able to build an economic miracle, or will your country sink into hyperinflation and debt?

Rate & State is a thrilling macroeconomic simulator where you become the chief architect of the nation’s financial system. Every decision you make has consequences. Balance economic growth with the well-being of your citizens, respond to global challenges, and prove that you’re the best crisis manager!

Key game features:

  • Macroeconomic Management: You have real-world financial tools at your disposal. Adjust the key interest rate to control inflation and set tax rates to fill the budget (but be careful not to stifle business!).

  • Investment and Development: Don’t let your money sit under the mattress! Invest public funds in infrastructure, technology, or social programs to give the economy a powerful boost.

  • Dynamic Events: The world doesn’t stand still. Prepare for random events—from unexpected technological breakthroughs that grant bonuses to global crises, natural disasters, or trade wars that will inflict severe debuffs.

  • Live Statistics: Watch how your actions affect GDP, inflation, and other metrics in real time.

Your Trusted Advisor

You have an advisor who will help you at the start of the game and suggest the best decisions going forward. By the way, his name is Daniil!

Your choices shape your future

There’s no single right path to success. You can build a strict economy with high taxes and heavy government investment, or create a libertarian paradise with minimal government intervention. Experiment, make mistakes, and find the perfect balance in Rate & State!

store_data.about_the_game:
Windowsill Isle is a small island that lives on your desktop.

It never goes fullscreen. It never asks for your attention.

It won't pop up while you're busy.

It just sits in the corner of your screen, quietly living its own life.

Look up every once in a while, and you'll find something has changed.

The sea leaves things behind

Every now and then, the tide leaves something on the sand.

A small anchor. A bottle. A piece of driftwood.

They aren't quests. Nothing is waiting on you.

It's just the sea, thinking of you.

Click, and you'll know what a place is for

Every building on the island has a name and a purpose.

Click one to see who works there,

and what the place means to the people who live here.

The islanders have names, and moods

Each one has their own job and their own temperament.

They don't wait for your orders.

They're simply living their lives.

The lighthouse slowly comes alive

At the heart of the island stands a lighthouse.

While you work, while you type, while you click,

energy gathers, little by little.

The hours you spent focused become light on the island.

The town grows on its own

A house, a park, a fountain — the islanders want to build something.

Will you help?

The island you leave today won't be quite the island you return to.

The Island Left You a Photograph

The island keeps a record of moments worth remembering.

The lighthouse, its residents, and the changing light of each day—all find a place in your island album.

The Sea Keeps the Little Things You Missed

Some events you didn’t happen to see may become messages in bottles and drift back to shore.

They aren’t notifications. It’s simply the island sharing something that once happened.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every part is real.

Foundation stones, pillars, beams, purlins, rafters, roof tiles laid from the eaves up — every piece you place exists in real Korean architecture, and the building order follows how carpenters actually worked: frame first, then roof, then walls, so the rain never soaks the timber. Sources: the National Folk Museum of Korea, the Korea Heritage Service, and the Encyclopedia of Korean Culture. What we simplified for play, we say so in game — there is a page inside that lists what we left out and what we could not confirm.

Learn — 11 guided builds.

Start with a three-bay thatched cottage. Work up through an L-shaped farmhouse and a smoke-hole house, then tiled halls: a gable roof, a hip-and-gable roof, a lecture hall and a gatehouse. Finish in the palace with a great hall, a gate tower, a two-story pavilion over a pond, and a garden pavilion. Each piece carries its real name and a line explaining why it goes where it goes.

Create — your own town.

210 pieces: thatched and tiled houses, palace halls, government offices, walls and gates, corridors, streams, bridges and city ramparts, rice paddies, market stalls, lanterns, 40 townsfolk and 8 farm animals. Drag to lay whole walls, paths and paddies at once. Double-click a placed piece to turn it, or press R before you set it down. Build a market street of open-front shops, awnings and a cattle market. Six commissions give you goals: a farming village, a market street, a nobleman's house, a village of nobles, a palace throne-hall compound, and the royal rear garden.

Walk it at four hours of the day.

Dawn mist, daylight, sunset and moonlit night — after dark the window paper glows from inside and the lanterns light the lanes. Step in and walk your own town as the king in his dragon robe: up onto the wooden floors, through the gates, into the rooms. Eleven pieces of traditional Korean music play while you build.

Build free.

In house-building mode the parts are yours. Follow the old rules of order — or switch them off and build whatever you like: a huge thatched hall, a U-shaped courtyard house, anything the pieces allow. Then place what you built into your town.

After release.

More palace buildings — the queen's residence and the crown prince's quarters — and more village life are planned as free updates.

Music: "Gugak BGM" series (#35, #44, #45, #61, #80, #81, #111, #118, #129, #199, #246) by ITN Co. (K-SOUND LIBRARY), via Gongu Madang — Korea Copyright Commission (gongu.copyright.or.kr). Licensed under CC BY tracks trimmed and volume-adjusted for the game. Font: Pretendard — (c) Kil Hyung-jin, SIL Open Font License 1.1.

store_data.about_the_game:
Generations come and go without end; the river moon looks the same year after year.
Watched or not, this world lives on.

A world that lives

No single storyline waits for you to follow it, and no NPC stands frozen in place waiting for you to arrive.
Towns keep their own days; the wilds keep their own dangers. The world moves on while you're away - and when you return, it still remembers who you are and what you have done.

People meet, people part; some rise, some fall. Your life is one passage in a living world.

Words carry weight

Promises you make are waited on. Grudges you earn are kept. Deeds you do become rumor.

A helping hand may plant a bond that bears fruit years later; a theft may call down a reckoning just as far away.
Here, speech and deed alike are debts - to people, and to heaven.

A Dao forged by walking

There is no single template for cultivation.

Seek opportunities, learn arts, befriend fellow cultivators - or take risks, seize what you want, kill, and make enemies. However you live is how your Dao grows.

And when you finally reach the gate, heaven will not ask what class you picked or what build you copied - it only looks at who you became along the road.

AI narrates; heaven keeps the books

Narrative and character responses are improvised live by AI, shaped by your choices, your relationships, and the state of the world - so different lives may unfold into entirely different stories.

But the AI is not heaven.

Stats, items, bonds, promises, wounds, causes and consequences are all recorded and judged by the game's deterministic systems.
Fine words can spin a thousand tales - only what truly happened counts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Put Back Stuff is a cozy organisation game about taking a terrible mess and tidying it up with satisfying sounds and feedback.

Pick up an item, figure out where it belongs, and put it back where you want it to be within the category. That’s it. No rushing; just thousands of misplaced objects, plenty of empty shelves, and the quiet satisfaction of watching chaos slowly become order.

Put Back Stuff is a game that has room to grow. We're launching with two initial levels - A larger supermarket map and a smaller map of a cute craft store.

A Supermarket-Sized Mess

Restore a supermarket filled with more than 5,000 placeable items over 300 unique shelves. Sort products into their correct departments, group matching items together, and gradually uncover the floor beneath the mess.

Coming soon: A Cozy Craft Store Conundrum

Note: Image shows early development of the Craft Store map. This is not representative of the final product. For updates on this, check back later.

Take on a craft store containing more than 2,000 placeable items. Sort yarn, restore the displays, and confront the important question: should wool be organised by colour or by ply or texture?

Employee Training

Organising thousands of products is a big job, but you won’t have to do everything the hard way.

Earn coins as you restore the levels, then spend them in the Employee Training Module Skill System to unlock and improve useful abilities. Summon missing objects, run faster, locate the shelves things belong on, carry more at once, and become the highly trained retail employee you were always meant to be.

Features

  • Cozy, low-pressure organisation gameplay

  • Accessibility options and fully rebindable keys, so you can play however suits you.

  • Multiple levels with room to grow.

  • Thousands of silly products in a colourful, low-poly world with pixel art textures.

  • Unlockable abilities and upgrades

  • Clear, satisfying visual progress as every shelf fills

  • No AI used in the creation of this project. Just one developer and a boat load of caffeine.

  • Family friendly. 

There’s a place for everything.

Denis is an ordinary student whose life is trapped in debt. Rent is due tomorrow morning, and working as a courier on the night shift is the only way to stay off the streets. The city sleeps, but its residential areas live their own, hidden lives. You'll pick up orders from a 24-hour diner and venture into the labyrinth of panel apartment buildings.

But tonight, something has changed. The silence in the residential areas has become too thick, and the few passersby carefully avert their gaze. Soon, you notice a pair of dim headlights flickering constantly at the edge of your vision. A black SUV with tinted windows isn't breaking the rules; it's simply following you. Slowly. Relentlessly.

GAMEPLAY

The Night Route is a psychological horror game where your main enemy is your own imagination and a real human threat.

Unvarnished Realism: There are no health or mana bars. There's only the hero's heavy breathing after running and trembling hands trying to dial the intercom code as a suspicious car slowly parks behind you.

Immersive Sound: Listen to your surroundings. The creaking of a swing in the wind, the distant barking of dogs, the sound of a car door slamming, or the rumble of an engine around a corner—sound will become your primary cues.

Stalking Effect: The black jeep isn't just a script. It behaves unpredictably: it might wait for you at the exit, drive slowly parallel to your path, or simply shine its headlights in your back without taking any action. Until then.

FEATURES

PSX aesthetics: Dirty textures, characteristic image "shaking," and low-poly models create a unique visual style that conveys the unsettling atmosphere of the late 90s and early 2000s.

Fear without the mysticism: The game proves that a real person in a dark alley is far more frightening than the most terrifying monster. This is a story about how an ordinary city can become a hostile place.

ATMOSPHERE

Experience the loneliness of the city at night. Abandoned sandboxes, trash cans, cramped entryways with dim light bulbs, and the oppressive feeling that you are just prey in this concrete jungle.

Your shift is starting. Try not to keep customers waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
The frontier will not defend itself.

Take command of Rome's defenses in Porta Westfalica, a strategic tower defense game where preparation, positioning, and adaptation determine whether your line holds or falls.

Across a campaign of handcrafted battlefields, build towers and defensive structures at key strategic positions, upgrade your forces, manage your gold, and prepare for increasingly dangerous enemy formations.

Every battlefield presents a different tactical challenge. Study the terrain, understand what is approaching, and build the right defense before the enemy breaks through.

BUILD YOUR DEFENSE

Each battlefield gives you strategic positions where defenses can be constructed. Choose which towers and structures to build, decide where your gold will have the greatest impact, and create a defensive line capable of surviving the coming assault.

UPGRADE AND ADAPT

Building is only the beginning. Upgrade your defenses as the battle develops and adapt your strategy to the enemies approaching your position.

Different enemy types and formations demand different responses. A strategy that dominates one battle may not be enough for the next.

MANAGE YOUR GOLD

Every tower has a cost.

Spend your gold expanding your defenses or invest it into upgrading the positions you already control. Choosing what to build—and when to build it—is part of every battle.

DEFEND ACROSS HANDCRAFTED BATTLEFIELDS

Fight across a campaign of distinct handcrafted maps, each featuring its own routes, defensive positions, enemy formations, and tactical challenges.

As the campaign progresses, the pressure increases and your defensive decisions become increasingly important.

HOLD THE FRONTIER

Build. Upgrade. Adapt.

Hold the line and defend Rome's frontier.
