store_data.about_the_game:
You were training to become a Summoner when a public shapeshifting demonstration ended in bloodshed, and your closest friend was killed after seemingly losing control of their form. Rather than admit that shapeshifting might not be as safe as they had always claimed, the Summoner establishment buried the truth, branded the attack deliberate, and destroyed your reputation when you refused to support their story. Exiled and unheard, you travel to a distant island to rebuild your name from nothing, hoping to earn the respect of its Summoner Masters — and eventually a Grand Master powerful enough to make the world listen to what really happened.

Developed solo by a former TaleWorlds developer.

Capture Their Souls

The creatures of SumMon are not simply recruited.

They are captured inside magical Soul Scrolls.

Carry empty Soul Scrolls into the wild, weaken creatures in battle, and attempt to bind their souls before they escape. Every successful capture becomes a permanent new summon in your collection.

You can capture multiple creatures of the same species, and each can develop differently over the course of a run.

Become Your Summons

By dividing your own soul you can shapeshift into multiple summons at the same time, controlling each forms directly in combat.

One summon might cover the battlefield in water while another freezes wet enemies. A different pairing might electrify those same puddles, spread poison across key hexes, or force enemies into burning terrain.

The strongest roster is not always the one with the strongest individual creatures.

It is the one that works together.

Build Each Summon Your Way

Every captured summon develops independently.

Learn new skills.

Unlock passive abilities.

Increase attributes.

Specialize in particular damage types.

Gain powerful bonuses.

Or evolve into a stronger form.

Items can increase certain attributes while penalizing others, forcing you to make real trade-offs instead of simply equipping whatever has the biggest number.

Fight On A Living Battlefield

Combat takes place on tactical hex-based arenas.

Elemental attacks can permanently change the battlefield during a fight.

Water creates puddles.

Fire can ignite suitable terrain.

Electricity can charge wet hexes.

Poison can contaminate areas.

Ice can freeze enemies and reshape existing elemental conditions.

Standing in the right place can improve your odds, guarantee successes on certain dice, enable new interactions, or set up another summon's attack.

Control the Dice

Your summon's attributes determine how reliable its actions are, while each skill can test those attributes at different levels of difficulty.

You cannot remove randomness entirely.

But you can build around it.

Explore A Procedural The World

Take quests.

Search for creatures worth capturing.

Hunt for equipment.

Recover in towns.

Choose which encounters are worth the risk.

Learn Before You Challenge

Every region is ruled by a Summoner Master.

And you only get one chance to challenge them.

Before committing to the fight, explore the region and collect rumors about the Master to exploit their weaknesses.

Build A Name They Can't Ignore

Your journey is not about proving that Summoning is harmless.

And it is not about proving that it should be feared.

It is about proving that mastery does not come from pretending nothing can go wrong.

The institutions that abandoned you protected their reputations by burying failure.

You will build yours by facing it.

Capture souls.

Shape them.

Learn their strengths.

Understand their risks.

Defeat the Summoner Masters.

Reach the Grand Master.

And become someone whose word can no longer be dismissed.

Capture their souls. Split your own. Become them.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your towers become the walls

TOWER TOWER is a tower defense game about stacking.

The blocks you buy fall from the top of the screen and pile up on the terrain, forming your towers. Cannons and lasers are not simply placed — they are stacked. And what you stack becomes a wall that physically bends the enemy's route.

Stack higher, and the path twists further. The shape of your defense line is your strategy.



Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out.

Attack blocks are not your only weapons. Blocks with no attack power are cheap to place and work as terrain for steering how enemies move.

・Wall them off and force the long way around

・Build a V shape and gather them into one spot

・Build a lattice and make them wander the maze

・Hit the crowd with area damage once they gather

Where you stack, and what you stack. That alone changes the difficulty of the same wave completely.

An arsenal chosen by the numbers

Every block differs in cost, attack power, cooldown, range, anti-air capability and blast radius, and every block can be upgraded. Compare the numbers and combine them according to the role each part of your line has to play.

store_data.about_the_game:
MEMORY TOWERS

All levels are randomly generated, offering a fresh experience every playthrough with mysteries of the past to uncover, natural and unnatural dangers to avoid, old machinery to fix and other climbers to talk and trade with.

Level modifiers and biomes spice it up even more, bringing different weather conditions, giant beings hunting you down, resource scarcities and unique to biomes structures and items into play

CLIMBERS

You are a sin-eater, a new life form born from the skeleton of a long gone person, using your natural agility and wings to ascend the towers in search of answers hidden in your past life.

Jump, wall-jump, long-jump, vault, glide and flap your wings to get around, watch your head and don't slip. Manage your stamina and don't let afflictions consume it.

The climb will require you to be thoughtful of your resources, your path and your surroundings.

TRUSTY BACKPACK

Every sin-eater has their trusty backpack with them. You are no exception. Space is limited; carrying too much will burden you, lowering stamina. You have to be thoughtful of what you bring along.

There are many useful items to find and trade for, so plan ahead and make choices in what you keep, be it extra food or tech parts to repair that jump pad with.

FEATURES

  • Randomly generated towers with a history to discover, 4 biomes to explore and a handful of modifiers to spice it up

  • Story and Infinite climb gamemodes, with 3 difficulties varied in mechanics and gameplay

  • Parkour with a number of different moves, a stamina to look out for and dangers to avoid

  • Useful items and resources to find and manage, avoiding over encumbrance

  • Weird and aggressive flora and fauna, waiting to feed on you

  • Survival elements with many afflictions to deal with (concussions from hitting your head too hard included)

  • Atmospheric and bumpy soundtracks by the very talented Hohenheim and Zorrio

  • 1-2 hour long story campaign to go through and an infinite climb mode

  • Cute guy with outfits to find and wear, poses to hit and a free camera for some cool screenshots

store_data.about_the_game:
One wok. One road to fame.


Wok Your Way to Fame is a cooking roguelike built around persistent synergies. Pick 1–5 ingredients for each meal, form scoring patterns, and match real Chinese dishes. Making a dish is only the beginning—the real challenge is turning your kitchen into an engine that pushes scores and multipliers higher with every banquet.

Choose ingredients and discover dishes


Build meals from 52 ingredients across seafood, meat and poultry, vegetables and mushrooms, and grains and staples. Ingredient ranks, families, order, and exact identities all matter. Create pairs, triples, five-step sequences, and family feasts—or discover familiar Chinese dishes such as Tomato and Egg Stir-fry and Kung Pao Chicken.

Build a cooking engine


Seasonings, cookware, techniques, and wild tricks trigger at different stages of cooking. Upgrade individual ingredients, expand your stove, and combine effects around ranks, families, selection order, named dishes, and multipliers. The same ingredients can become something completely different in another build.

Grow between banquets


After clearing a banquet, visit the market to reshape your build and ingredient bag before choosing the next region. Every stage asks the same delicious question: take the reliable score now, or gamble your remaining servings on a rare combination and a famous dish?

A 3D cooking stage with readable 2D decisions


Hand-drawn ingredient standees enter a 3D kitchen stage, hit the wok, score one by one, and reveal finished dishes. Your score, multiplier, build, and ingredient bag stay clear and readable, so every payoff has a visible source.

The Early Access version includes


  • A complete run-based cooking and build-crafting loop
  • 52 base ingredients and more than 300 discoverable Chinese dishes
  • 192 build cards across seasonings, cookware, techniques, and wild tricks
  • Ingredient-bag management, ingredient upgrades, markets, regional routes, and banquet challenges
  • Interface localization in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian

store_data.about_the_game:
"Are those relentless pursuers in the dark night actually nightmares or the unwilling reality we refuse to face?"

[About the Game]

"Parasomnia" is a 2D pixel-style psychological horror game. Players will delve into the inner world of a child named Sunny who suffers from "night terrors". Through the perspective of Sunny, they will experience the fear and struggles in her subconscious.

With eerie black fog and persistent pursuers, you need to find a way out in multiple stages of nightmares. This is not just an escape, but also a psychological profiling of memory - when the fragments of reality are reflected in the dreams, do you have the courage to piece together the entire truth?

[Core Features]

The game features a multi-branch outcome determination system. When the nightmare is about to end, if you are dissatisfied with the current situation, do you have the courage to go back and make different choices?

[Operation Instructions]

[W/A/S/D] - Movement and Selection

[F] - Confirmation / Interaction (such as turning valves, reading documents)

[ESC] - Pause / Return

The game was created by a group of six university students as a project during the summer of 2026. It is a game developed over two months.

Thank you all for playing!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the army. Watch it fight.

Toy Battles is a roguelite auto-battler about building a squad of toys. You don't control the fight — you win it before it starts: which toys you buy, where you place them, how you buff them.

Every toy has a job

Unlock 100+ toys, each with its own strengths and quirks. A toy that looks useless alone can carry an entire run once you find the squad that makes it click. No filler units — only combos you haven't found yet.

Formation is everything

Placement matters as much as picks. One well-placed piece can turn the whole battle around. A great build isn't a few strong toys. It's a chain where each one makes the next stronger.

The more you play, the deeper it gets

Win your runs and constantly unlock something new. Every unlock is permanent: new toys, new buffs, free rerolls, shop upgrades. An unlock isn't a reskin of something you already have — it's a new toy with its own role, opening room to experiment and combos you couldn't build before. How far can you go?

store_data.about_the_game:
Castel Valmora stands isolated high in the fog-drenched Italian Alps. When rumors reach the lowlands of a strange, unnatural affliction seizing Signore Corrado del Valmora, Maestro Severino of Brescia (a seasoned physician who survived the nightmare of the Black Death) is summoned to investigate.

Upon your arrival, the great keep appears completely undisturbed. The hearths burn bright, the guards stand watch, and Signore Corrado’s daughter, Donna Caterina, welcomes you into the pristine, stone halls. Everything seems normal.

Until the heavy iron gates slam shut behind you...

The illness rotting the mind of the lord is no ordinary pestilence. As night falls over the mountains, an ancient, demonic presence takes root within the fortress, twisting its occupants into nightmare horrors. Trapped inside a living tomb with a dynamic stalker hunting you through the dark, your mission shifts from medical investigation to pure survival: find Donna Caterina, uncover the keep's unspeakable secret, and escape alive.

KEY FEATURES

  • Relentless Stalker Horror: Outsmart an active, unpredictable demon hunting you through narrow stone corridors. Your only defense is speed, stealth, and knowing when to hide.

  • The False Sanctuary: Explore an expansive 14th-century mountain castle that transitions from a grand, peaceful noble keep into a claustrophobic, pitch-black labyrinth of horror.

  • Escort & Survival: Locate Donna Caterina and navigate the castle’s deadly traps, secret passages, and locked sectors together to find a route out.

  • Medical Investigation Turned Mystery: Inspect sinister artifacts, decipher corrupted medical notes, and solve environmental puzzles to piece together how Signore Corrado invited this evil inside.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Grand Book Archive

You are invited to contribute to The Grand Book Archive, a timeless haven preserving the books of human history. Your job is to sort the books from the year 1000BC to 1100BC. 2,990 archaic books are waiting to be shelved to their new home. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible.

Sort and Upgrade

The game combines satisfying book sorting with diverse incremental progression. Complete shelves to earn coins, which you can spend on powerful spells and upgrades that make your sorting faster and more efficient over time.

Each completed run unlocks permanent meta-progression, giving you new ways to improve your abilities and make future runs more efficient. Increase the number of bots working alongside you, multiply the coins you earn, or unlock unique triggers that let you fill multiple shelves at once. With every upgrade, you’ll become faster, more powerful, and one step closer to becoming the ultimate archivist.

Master of the Archive

Earn coins, unlock unique upgrades, and discover all new ways to streamline your sorting as you work your way through the Grand Book Archive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the night shift.

Your job is simple. Watch the security cameras, stay at your post and make it through your shift from 3:00 AM to 6:00 AM.

There’s just one small problem... You have a really weak bladder.

The building is haunted but the ghosts don’t actually hate you. They just really hate irresponsible employees who leave their post during work.

As you watch the CCTV, your bladder will slowly fill up. Eventually, you’ll have no choice but to leave the security room and search the dark hallways for a restroom.

Find the toilet, do your business and hurry back to your post before the ghosts get the wrong idea and think you’re slacking off.

Sounds simple, right?

Well… the toilet moves to a different location every time you use it. So the next time you need to go, you’ll have to search for it all over again.

As the night goes on, things get worse. Your bladder fills faster, you have less time away from your post, the building gets darker and the ghosts become less forgiving.

Find the restroom, get back to your post and survive until 6:00 AM.

And please…

try not to pee your pants.

store_data.about_the_game:
Speak the Doom

You are the one prophet every blade must answer. In DOOMSAYER you DECLARE your next act aloud — a step, a strike, a stand — and every enemy commits its reply to that word before you move. The gap between the telling and the truth is the whole game. Read their committed answers, then break your own word and leave them cutting empty air.

Bend the future

Spend Fate to rewrite the moment: PUSH and BECKON foes into fire, SWAP places, SMITE from the sky, or IGNITE the ground beneath them. Palm a FEINT to lie about your move — plant a forged token, whisper a false square to a single hunter, or speak two tells at once. Deception is a weapon with its own economy.

Swear your Doom

Every fight, wager oaths on the future you intend to make real: "No wound shall touch me." "Two shall fall in a single turn." "The mightiest falls last." Keep the oath and it pays in Fate; break it and it draws your own blood. The bolder the prophecy, the richer the reward — and the deeper the stake.

Walk the road

Choose your Speaker — five prophets, each a different voice and loadout — and set out down a branching road of fights, shrines, wayside oracles and relic reliquaries. Draft rule-bending relics, learn new tricks and words, and shape a run that no two roads repeat.

The Deeper Dooms

Clear the road and the Doom only speaks louder. Descend an eighteen-rung ladder of Deeper Dooms — each turning the screws on monsters, stakes and the closing clock — toward the Marks of Mastery. A daily Omen gives the whole world one seed, one Speaker, one decree and one shot at the leaderboard.

Features

  • Reverse-telegraph tactics — enemies answer YOUR declaration; the future is legible, and yours to break
  • Six Fate verbs and five deception tricks — a full toolkit for rewriting a committed board
  • Prophecy wagers — swear oaths on the fight and get paid for making them true
  • Five Speakers, dozens of relics, oaths, tricks and enemy "laws" to master
  • Eighteen Deeper Dooms and Marks of Mastery for the long climb
  • A worldwide Daily Omen with its own leaderboard
  • Hand-painted dark-fantasy art; no two roads alike

store_data.about_the_game:
You are his luck.

Sir Bramble descends on his own. You never move him and never swing his sword — you are the fortune that decides whether the blade bites or glances, whether the chest holds treasure or dust, whether the trap springs. In Fortuna's Ledger, luck is not random noise. It is a currency, and every point of it is yours to spend or to earn.

The Ledger

Good fortune is bought; misfortune pays you back. Spend luck to land the critical hit or turn aside a blow, and earn it by accepting the graze, the dud, the lesser prize. Your balance is a single conserved number — borrow too deep and, at the foot of every staircase, the Audit convenes: interest is charged, and the Auditor seizes your outcomes until the books are settled. Borrow boldly, but be ready to pay.

A run through the Vault

  • 24 floors across 4 acts, each closing on a boss who collects what you owe.
  • 65 relics that bend the rules — some blessed, some cursed, all changing how you spend.
  • A drifting Merchant, a Wheel of fortune, shrines, oddities, and an opening wager that adapts to your last run.
  • 4 heroes, each with their own body and their own bargain with debt.

Prove it again

Swear Vows to twist the rules against yourself, fill the Bestiary and the Cabinet, and climb 20 tiers of Audit — a stacking ascension that makes the Vault's accounting ever more merciless. The house always collects. See how long you can keep it waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Forge blades, brew potions, arm the realm

Anvil & Alembic is a cozy fantasy shop-keeping sim where you run an adventurers' outfitter at the edge of the realm. Light the forge, fire the cauldron and set out your wares — then watch townsfolk, knights, mages and nobles walk through the door in search of the gear that will keep them alive out there.

Craft it. Sell it. Send it into legend. Every blade you hammer and every potion you distil can end up on a hero bound for the frontier — and when they come home victorious, your name spreads with them.

Three crafts under one roof

  • Smithing — forge daggers, swords, axes, spears and greatswords at the workbench, forge and great forge.
  • Armouring — hammer caps, mail, plate and shields at the armourer's bench and tanning rack.
  • Alchemy — distil health, mana, strength, luck and stranger brews at the cauldron, alchemy table and alembic.
Choose your material grade on every order — from budget to masterwork — and master each recipe through Bronze, Silver and Gold for better prices and happier customers. Over 80 blueprints to unlock across a deep, multi-tier research tree.

Serve the folk of the realm

More than twenty kinds of customer stroll in, each with their own purse and taste — humble townsfolk and militia, rangers and sellswords, dwarven warriors and wandering mages, right up to knights, nobles and royal envoys. Read what they want, price your wares to steer demand, and delight the VIPs who pay double for your finest work.

Arm heroes for the road

The realm is dangerous, and heroes need outfitting. Rally adventurers and send them on expeditions with gear you forged — the better the equipment, the better their odds. Read the day's omens, provision against what's coming, and cheer a champion who survives quest after quest into Legend. Keep one alive long enough and they'll retire into your shop and repay the favour.

Build, decorate, expand

Design your workshop from the ground up with hundreds of furniture pieces, floor and wall styles, lighting, wall art and garden dressing. Buy adjoining plots to grow your floor, add an upstairs, and turn a roadside anvil into a landmark. Hire and level a crew — blacksmith, armourer, alchemist, shop hand and a minstrel to keep the queue happy.

Rise from roadside anvil to crown of the realm

  • Ten shop ranks to climb, each a celebrated milestone that unlocks new research, rooms, staff and events.
  • The Alchemists' Guild — a story questline that ends with a legendary recipe of your own.
  • Frontier campaigns & realm factions — secure the fronts, win the favour of seven factions, and fulfil exclusive commissions.
  • The Master Forge — endgame endowments that reshape how your whole operation runs.
  • Seasons & festivals shift demand and light; contracts, merchants and VIP visits keep every day different.

Cozy to play, deep to master

  • Warm, low-poly 3D world with day/night lighting and seasonal weather.
  • 52 achievements, from your first sale to Crown of the Realm.
  • Full interface localization in 14 languages.
  • Single-player, play at your own pace — pause any time, no fail states, just the satisfying loop of craft, sell and grow.

Light the forge. The realm is waiting to be armed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Descend. Mine. Survive. Escape with everything you can carry.

Venture deep beneath the surface in a 2D mining extraction roguelite where every expedition is a gamble. Leave the safety of your underground shelter, explore dangerous caverns, gather valuable ores and forgotten treasures, fight hostile creatures, and decide when it is time to turn back.

The deeper you go, the greater the rewards — but also the danger. Fill your backpack with rare resources, push just a little farther for one more valuable vein, and try to make it back alive. If you die underground, everything collected during that expedition is lost.

Back at your safe zone, sell your loot, improve your equipment, upgrade your character, unlock new weapons and tools, and expand the underground hub with new merchants and services. Every successful expedition makes you stronger and prepares you to venture deeper than before.

DIG DEEPER

Explore increasingly dangerous underground regions filled with new minerals, enemies, secrets, hidden rooms and powerful bosses.

RISK IT ALL

Your backpack becomes more valuable with every step. Escape and keep your resources, or keep exploring for even greater rewards. Greed can make you rich — or leave you with nothing.

GROW STRONGER

Upgrade your health, damage, mining speed, movement, inventory capacity, luck and more. Unlock stronger pickaxes, weapons, armor and special equipment.

BUILD YOUR UNDERGROUND HOME

Transform a small safe room into a thriving underground hub. Unlock merchants, craftsmen and new facilities that help you prepare for future expeditions.

FIND RARE TREASURES

Discover uncommon ores, ancient relics, legendary equipment and extremely rare resources hidden in the deepest parts of the mine.

FIGHT YOUR WAY OUT

The underground is not empty. Fight creatures lurking in the darkness, learn their patterns and survive long enough to bring your haul home.

Mine. Upgrade. Descend deeper. Repeat.

How far are you willing to go before turning back?

A relentless stream of refugees is flooding the checkpoint. They are desperate to escape the outbreak, but some of them are already infected. Your job is to find them before they cross the line and carry the infection into the outside world.

INSPECT EVERY SURVIVOR

store_data.about_the_game:
Ready to become the head chef in a world of living cardboard? Control magical flames, fulfill orders, and delight your furry guests in this cozy cooking game!

Welcome to Flame, Cats & Kitchen — a place where cooking becomes a relaxing and creative process. Forget about stressful timers and hardcore management. The entire game is brought to life in a unique handmade cardboard diorama style, lovingly colored with Crayons.

Here, you are not just a chef — you are the fire itself. Take control of fire spirits cooking food directly on cardboard stoves. Split into smaller sparks to gently simmer a mushroom pasta, or merge into a mighty flame to quickly sear a burger. Serve charming drawn cats, master the heat, expand your restaurant, and create culinary masterpieces at your own pace!

Key Features:

Upgrade Your Kitchen: Use your hard-earned profits and great reviews to grow your cozy cardboard eatery. Upgrade your workspace, purchase new equipment, and expand your menu to feed an ever-growing crowd of hungry kitties.

Master the Heat: Merge and split your spirits to adjust the stove temperatures. The Green spirit provides low heat for slow, safe cooking; the Blue spirit maintains a steady medium pace; and the Red spirit unleashes high heat for fast cooking—but requires your full attention!

Unique DIY Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a warm, handcrafted atmosphere. The entire kitchen, ingredients, decorations, and UI look exactly as if they were cut from real cardboard and colored with Crayons.

Adorable Customers: Your guests and ultimate food critics are cute, Crayon-drawn cats. Complete their orders, serve the perfect dishes, and collect their happy reviews.

Stovetop Strategy: Every recipe requires a different approach. Keep the heat low to avoid burning anything, or take a risk with the red flame to finish an order in record time. With no strict time limits, you can focus purely on tactical heat management instead of frantic rushing.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO TOMBSTONE, PARTNER!

The Old West has seen its share of quick draws, but in Tombstone Showdown, the fastest mind wins the fight.

Gather your posse and put your knowledge to the test in an online multiplayer trivia showdown inspired by the legendary frontier town of Tombstone. Pick your categories, choose your difficulty, and see who has what it takes to become the sharpest mind in the West.

GATHER YOUR POSSE

Host a game, share your join code, and bring your friends along for the showdown. Tombstone Showdown is built for relaxed game nights, friendly rivalries, and communities looking for a trivia game that's easy to jump into and play together.

THOUSANDS OF QUESTIONS

No two showdowns need to feel the same. Test your knowledge across a huge collection of trivia questions spanning multiple categories and difficulty levels. Choose the kind of challenge your posse wants and get ready to draw.

QUICK THINKING PAYS

Knowing the answer is only half the battle. Answer quickly to improve your Quick Draw time and fight your way up the scoreboard. When the dust settles, only one player gets the ultimate bragging rights.

CHOOSE YOUR GUNSLINGER

Pick your avatar and bring a little personality to the showdown. Your chosen character rides with you from the lobby through the match and into the final standings.

BUILT FOR FRIENDS AND COMMUNITIES

Whether you're challenging a few friends or bringing a community together for trivia night, Tombstone Showdown keeps the focus on what matters: answering questions, laughing at the ones you should have known, and settling once and for all who really knows their stuff.

So gather your posse, sharpen your wits, and get ready.

There's always room for one more showdown in Tombstone.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR NAME IS YOUR LIFE!

Most games give you a health bar. In UNSPELLED, your health is something much more personal—your name.

✂ ABOUT THIS GAME

UNSPELLED is a chaotic multiplayer party game where scissors are your weapon, your 7-letter name is your health bar, and every match turns into unforgettable chaos.

Slice off your opponents' limbs, cut away the letters of their names, steal their body parts before they can recover, and outplay everyone until you're the last name standing.

No health bars. No hit points.

Just scissors, names, and absolute mayhem.

Warning: Trust no one. Even your own limbs aren't safe.

✂ YOUR NAME IS YOUR HEALTH

Every player begins with a 7-letter name floating above their character.

Each letter represents one life.

Cut a letter away, and they lose a life.

Lose every letter, and you're Unspelled.

Example:

UNSPELL → NSPELL → SPELL → PELL → ELL → LL → L → Ghost

Simple to understand.

Terrifying when it's your name disappearing.

✂ LIMBS ARE MORE THAN COSMETIC

Every limb matters.

Cut off an opponent's leg to slow them down.

Cut off both arms and their scissor energy recovers much more slowly.

Detached limbs don't disappear—they stay in the world.

Carry them away.

Hide them.

Force your opponent to search for what's missing before they're back at full strength.

Every fight becomes a battle of positioning, timing, and sabotage.

✂ DEATH ISN'T THE END

Losing all seven letters doesn't mean you're finished.

You return as a Ghost.

Ghosts can temporarily possess detached limbs, dragging them away from living players or disrupting carefully planned strategies.

You may not be able to win anymore...

…but you can still create absolute chaos.

✂ FEATURES

• A completely unique name-as-health combat system

• Fast-paced multiplayer party battles

• Cut off limbs to weaken opponents

• Steal and hide detached body parts

• Dynamic matches where every decision matters

• Ghost gameplay after elimination

• The ever-shrinking Eraser zone keeps every match exciting

• Multiple maps with unique layouts and gameplay opportunities

• Play with friends or challenge players online

• AI Bots for solo play.

✂ FROM THE DEVELOPER

"UNSPELLED began with one simple idea: What if your name was your health bar? Everything else—the scissors, the missing limbs, the Ghosts, and the Eraser—grew from that single question. The goal is to create the kind of multiplayer game where every match leaves players with a story they'll want to tell their friends."

— Zync Studios

✂ Last Name Standing Wins. ✂

RIG THE DICE

DICE AFTER DARK is a neon-noir dice poker roguelike where you bend probability in your favor.

Roll five dice, hold what you need, and build poker hands to deal damage. Then take control of the odds yourself with Rigged Faces that permanently alter your dice for the rest of the run.

THE HOUSE HAS A FACE

Twenty floors, and someone waiting on every one of them.

A loan shark who takes your rerolls as interest. A one-eyed baron whose gaze won't let the same hand shine twice. A man called Mister All-In, who never bets until you're already bleeding.

Meet them before you fight them. Some of them will offer you a deal.

The further down you go, the less human they get.

BUILD YOUR ENGINE

Stamp dice with powerful Seals and collect Relics that change how your build works.

Turn rolls into coins, stack multipliers, strengthen specific hands, and combine effects into powerful synergies.

Every run is a chance to build something completely different.

FIND YOUR WAY TO WIN

Build around One Pair, force Straights, chase Five of a Kind, or invest in economy and grow stronger over time.

Choose from different characters with unique starting advantages and shape your strategy from the very first hand.

BEAT THE HOUSE

The casino won't play fair.

Enemies can lock your dice, bury certain faces, weaken your favorite hands, and force you to adapt your strategy.

Rig the dice. Stack the relics. Break the odds.

Make the house fold.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slice a Mountain

Kiri has one impossible dream: to slice the mountain with her katana.

Help her turn that dream into reality in a relaxing, atmospheric incremental game about patience, precision, and endless improvement. Watch objects fall into the dojo and slice them automatically as your skills grow, or take control and draw your own sword strokes with the mouse.

Cut bamboo, leaves, wood, stone, lightning, and fog into countless tiny pieces. Every slice can break the world apart, rewarding you with satisfying visual feedback and resources for powerful upgrades.

Progress through a changing journey of painterly landscapes, shifting seasons, and atmospheric weather. From warm dawns and autumn colors to winter cold, rain, and mysterious mist, each chapter brings a new environment, a new challenge, and a new step toward the mountain.

Features

  • Help Kiri fulfill her dream of slicing a mountain

  • Relaxing incremental gameplay with active mouse-based swordplay

  • Cut objects into countless tiny fragments

  • Slice falling objects automatically while earning resources

  • Draw precise sword strokes to challenge powerful bosses

  • Unlock new chapters, techniques, and upgrade paths

  • Improve Kiri’s abilities and build a faster, stronger cutting school

  • Replay defeated bosses to earn additional resources

  • Reset your progress and pass Kiri’s knowledge to a more talented heir

  • Discover permanent bonuses through the prestige system

  • Experience painterly, impasto-inspired artwork

  • Enjoy changing backgrounds, seasons, weather, and atmospheric effects

store_data.about_the_game:
A Peaceful Sanctuary Full of Discovery

Immerse yourself in our lovely adventuring RPG, offering a soothing sanctuary after a long day. Enjoy the heartwarming atmosphere of a picturesque world where there is no rush and everything patiently waits for your next step. Your mindful care is always rewarded – experience the deep satisfaction of watching the world awaken and gradually restore its lost beauty through your good deeds.

From a Serene Village to Mysterious Depths

Your peaceful days learning herbalism alongside your beloved aunt are suddenly disrupted by a devastating earthquake. While helping your neighbors recover from the disaster, you discover an injured stranger beneath a rockslide. His warning leads you into the mysterious depths underground, where you soon realize that landslides are not the only threat to your home. An unknown blight is spreading across the land, and you must elevate your humble herbal knowledge into the true art of sacred healing.

Gather, Plan, and Overcome Obstacles

Instead of frantic action, this world invites you to thoughtful exploration and cozy planning. Discover every picturesque corner, gather useful resources, and put your sharp mind to work. Overcoming obstacles and dealing with dark creatures acts as a gratifying puzzle – with a well-packed backpack of potions, tools, and determination, you can help those in need and cleanse the realm of any threat.

What Awaits You

  • Lovely Adventuring RPG: Experience a classic mix of exploration and relaxing resource management wrapped in beautiful isometric visuals.

  • A Parallel Story in a Familiar Realm: Discover events from a brand-new perspective in an adventure unfolding alongside Hero of the Kingdom III.

  • Entirely at Your Own Pace: Enjoy a stress-free journey with zero time pressure, where the world moves forward only when you do.

  • The Path to Mastery: Forage nature’s bounty and master the craft of brewing potent potions to overcome every hazard and foe.

  • The Joy of Restoration: Watch with heartwarming delight as each of your good deeds visibly heals and revives the wounded kingdom.

store_data.about_the_game:
[ Tap it, and your PumpUp Fugu puffs right up ]

Somewhere out at sea live the PumpUp Fugu — odd little creatures with one

talent. Tap one and it puffs up in a huff, shoving aside whatever happens

to be in the way.

Use that to push the Fugu Queen out through the coral wall and set her

free!

Simple to play. Once you spot the trick, a level falls in seconds — but

finding the trick is where the puzzle lives. An action physics puzzler

with far more depth than it lets on.

[ 160 hand-built levels ]

Two areas, eight stages each, ten levels apiece. 160 in all, with room

for newcomers and veterans alike.

Clear a stage and the fugu dive deeper, where stranger creatures and

stranger contraptions are waiting. Every level stays satisfying to

solve — and every level asks a little more of you.

[ Stars to collect, times to beat, reasons to come back ]

Star-shaped starfish are scattered through the levels. You never need one

to finish a stage, but they sit where only a cleverer solution can reach

them. Clear a level once, then go back for the star.

Your best time is kept for every level, every stage and every area. There

is never only one way through a stage: change which fugu you tap, and

when, and watch the clock come down.

A stage you have already beaten is still worth replaying — for the star,

or for the time.

[ When you have solved them all ]

Clear every level in Areas 1 and 2, and AREA 51 appears: stages built at

random, endlessly.

Because they are generated, some of them cannot be solved. Hit SHUFFLE

and it builds you another.

Long after Areas 1 and 2 are behind you, there are still stages waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Top Wars is a fast-paced 3D arcade game where spinning tops collide, battle, and race through colorful stages filled with obstacles and challenges.

Your goal is simple: survive the action, overcome each stage, and earn enough stars to keep progressing. Each scene brings a new challenge as you guide your top through fast-moving environments and physics-driven encounters.

Key Features

Physics-Based Action
Movement and collisions create unpredictable moments as tops crash, bounce, and battle their way through each stage.

Earn Stars to Progress
Complete a scene with at least 2 stars to unlock the next level and continue your journey.

Arcade-Style Gameplay
Easy to understand and designed around quick, action-packed stages.

Colorful 3D Environments
Battle and maneuver through bright, stylized arenas and courses.

Score Attack Challenges
Push for better performances and higher results as you replay stages.

Controller Support
Play Top Wars using a compatible game controller on PC.

Family-Friendly Fun
Colorful arcade action without realistic violence, designed to be approachable for a wide range of players.

store_data.about_the_game:
A perfect plan

Nico spent every childhood summer at his grandparents' place doing the same thing: picking up fruit. Apples, pears, plums, whatever had just fallen. He hated it. He never said so — Trudi and Klaus were so delighted to have the help that he told them it was the best part of his year, and he was, apparently, very convincing.

Years later they are too old to keep the orchard. So they give it to him, certain it is the loveliest thing they have ever done.

He thanks them. He does not mention that they have just signed over several hectares of childhood trauma. Instead he makes a plan.

Collect all the fruit, sell every last piece, sell the orchard, and never pick up an apple again.

A perfect plan. It holds for about twenty minutes.

Because somewhere between the first full basket, the first money earned, and the genuinely satisfying sight of a patch of grass with absolutely nothing left on it, something goes wrong. Nico is enjoying himself.

The orchard does not stay empty

This is where the exit plan really falls apart.

Clearing all six gardens is not the end of the game. It is the end of season one. The next one begins straight away and it begins faster — and before it does, you are dealt cards that change how it plays. A basket that holds more. A grabber that reaches further. Robots that work harder. A workshop that undercuts itself. A Frenzy that burns hotter. Twenty cards so far, and slots enough to build a season around them.

The scale moves with you. Bare hands take a piece or two at a time; by the end of a run the vacuum is lifting them by the dozen, and the gardens have grown to match. What was an afternoon of tidying becomes something you are frankly too good at.

Nico's plan was to do this once.

Two ways to clear an orchard

Both are correct.

Switch your head off. Walk, hold the button, watch a lawn empty. Nothing here has a timer, a fail state or an enemy; nothing punishes you for standing still and looking at the trees. Buy whichever upgrade looks nice. Let a robot pick away at one garden while you wander into another. You can play this badly for two hours and still finish, and it was built for exactly that.

Or take it apart. Collect without pausing and a streak builds: the pace lifts in stages, the sound climbs with it, and at the top it tips over into Frenzy. Clear a quarter cleanly and it pays a bonus for the rest of the run. Which tool suits which density, when to sell, which upgrade before which — none of that is obvious, and all of it is measured. The records screen keeps your best pick rate, your longest flow, how long you held Frenzy, how far you walked and which tool did what share of the work. The leaderboards are waiting for the moment you think you have it solved.

In the game

  • Six gardens, each with its own fruit and its own robot that keeps collecting while you are elsewhere.

  • Three tools and a workbench full of upgrades, priced so that every purchase is a decision.

  • Twelve rare finds, two per fruit, hiding among the ordinary ones, and an album that fills up as you turn them up.

  • Mastery goals for every garden, for players who want the orchard cleared properly rather than merely cleared.

  • Steam achievements and leaderboards.

  • Ten languages, each one fully voiced and subtitled, with a colour-blind mode, free key rebinding and scalable text.

And then?

"Funny," Nico says, somewhere in the sixth garden. "I thought I'd be happier to be done."

He could sell the place now. That was always the plan.

He is not going to sell the place. You both know it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into a candlelit medieval tavern and build your fortune one roll at a time. In Dicepot, every coin you earn starts with a single toss of the dice  and every choice you make about how to grow your table shapes the kind of gambler you become.

Roll, Earn, Grow

Start with a single die and a handful of gold. Click to roll, watch the numbers land, and reinvest your winnings into bigger dice, faster rolls, and richer rewards. As your table fills up, so does your fortune  a satisfying loop that's easy to pick up and hard to put down.

Dice With a Twist

  • Not all dice play by the same rules. Unlock strange and wonderful dice as you progress:

  • Clone Dice split themselves in two when the right number comes up  and keep splitting if their luck holds.

  • Heavy Dice shake the whole table on impact, setting every nearby die rolling for free.

  • Sibling Dice roll in a chain reaction, one after another, with a single click.

  • Cockwork Dice roll themselves on a timer, working the table even when you're not.

Each one adds a new layer to how you build your ideal setup no punishing risk, no forced resets, just new ways to grow.

Automate Your Table

Hire helpers to wander the tavern and roll dice on your behalf, freeing your hands for the next big upgrade. Balance active clicking with passive automation, and find the rhythm that suits how you like to play.

Upgrade Everything

Spend your gold on a growing tree of upgrades faster rolls, better odds, bigger payouts, and more dice on the table at once. Every purchase brings you closer to a table that runs like a well-oiled well, dice machine.

Rebirth and Rise Again

When your table has grown as far as it can, cash it all in for a Rebirth. Spend your prestige on a permanent skill tree richer multipliers, faster automation, and access to dice you haven't seen before. Every rebirth makes the next run faster, bigger, and more satisfying than the last.

Simple. Satisfying. Strangely addictive.

Dicepot doesn't ask much of you  just a click, a roll, and a little patience. Whether you're actively chasing the perfect combo of dice or letting your table tick away in the background, there's always another roll, another upgrade, another rebirth waiting.

Toss dice to earn gold, unlock enchanted dice with wild new rules, upgrade your table with helpers and clockwork automation, and gamble your way to a richer rebirth. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely addictive.

store_data.about_the_game:
a short story about a lovely evening

Arthur works twelve-hour shifts. He comes home to Elaine, five children, a table with seven chairs, and a jar of pills on the kitchen counter.

Take one every evening. That's all it takes. The house is warm, the kids laugh, the music box plays. A better world.

Skip one — and the house remembers something you don't.

ONE HOUSE. SEVEN NIGHTS. Each evening is a small, ordinary routine: say goodnight to the children, fix the light in the hallway, take out the trash, take your pill, sleep. Each night the routine bends a little further. Something is written on the wall at the end of the hall. A child asks you a question you don't understand. The rain outside has started to run red.

WHAT IT IS — a 2–3 hour narrative psychological-horror story · authentic PS1-era look · two endings and a verdict after both · slow-burn dread over jump scares · gamepad, cloud-ready saves, achievements (some hidden)

WHAT IT IS NOT — No combat. No inventory puzzles. No monster to run from — most of the time. This is a story about a family, and about what a person will swallow to keep a lovely evening lovely.

"They only ever made me happy. That's all I can remember."

Try the free demo — the first three evenings, up to the moment the street turns red.

Content note + music credits (in the file — the credits line is a license condition, keep it).

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the youngest son of a lesser king and you are the last in line to inherit the throne, so you asked your father your share of legacy and you received resources and silver and you left to colonize an island.

A ship brought you here with some starting resources and some colonists who wanted to join you.

You will lead your colony as a Mycenaean King during the Late Bronze Age. Your mission is to develop your colony into a prosper one and defend against pirates and enemies when needed.

To unlock buildings and items you will have to research techs, make reforms (they work like royal edicts) and set policies to govern your island.

The intention is to create a realistic immersion, therefore the game is slow paced; it will take time to develop your colony and become powerful.

To construct buildings and manage your colony you will mostly use the top down view, while handling matters as a king you'll have the third-person (we're also considering first-person) view.

Survival for colonists and you

Colonists will have to eat, drink, use firewood for cooking and heating and have shelter, and so will you.

Since you are the king, colonists will take care of all your needs: they'll cook your food and fetch your drinks, cut firewood and make sure it burns in the stove, etc. You will have to consume food and water in order to survive.

You also have your own royal residence.

Trading

Trade is an important feature in this game; your colony will extract, produce or import raw materials, craft goods and export them to merchants visiting your island with their trade ships.

In exchange for exporting goods your colony will get silver.

Your colony can also import goods, including for self-consumption, add value to your items and make profit.

Trading is automated based on import-export policies and buy and sell offers from your buildings.

Research

To unlock buildings and new items you will have to research techs in the library.

Historical concerns

This game is inspired by historical events from the Late Bronze Age.

We'll try to include as many aspects as we can, but many times we'll have to speculate about things or introduce different aspects to give some variety in the game; for example, we'll have clothing or ship designs that might not be historical accurate for this time period.

We wanted this game to be realistic and that creates immersion during gameplay, but the game should also be fun.

Alternate history

We wanted to add things that weren't invented during these times; for example we think they could have invented soap very early: you just need olive oil and wood ash.

store_data.about_the_game:
High Voltage

Build your network. Generate power. Watch the island come to life.

High Voltage is a first-person 3D incremental simulation game about building and expanding your own power network across a beautiful island.

Start with a small source of electricity and gradually build your way toward a large, interconnected energy network. Place generators, connect power poles with cables, install substations and batteries, and deliver electricity to a growing city in the distance.

Every new connection brings you one step closer to a bigger and more efficient grid.

Start Small, Grow Bigger

Your journey begins with a simple power setup and limited resources.

Generate electricity, deliver it to the city, earn money, and reinvest your profits into better equipment and larger infrastructure. Each upgrade allows you to produce more power, expand farther across the island, and unlock new ways to grow your network.

What starts as a few generators and cables can eventually become a huge electrical grid stretching across the landscape.

The more you build, the more opportunities you unlock.

Build Your Own Power Network

Your electrical grid is yours to design.

Place generators where you want them, construct power poles, connect them using physical cables, add batteries and substations, and gradually expand into new parts of the island.

Plan how your infrastructure connects and make sure electricity can reach where it needs to go.

There is no single correct way to build your network. Expand at your own pace and create a system that works for you.

Generate and Sell Electricity

Producing power is at the heart of High Voltage.

Build different types of generators and take advantage of the environment around you. As your production increases, more electricity can be delivered to the city.

The power you successfully supply earns you money.

Use your income to purchase new equipment, improve existing infrastructure, increase the capacity of your network, and continue expanding.

More power means more income.

More income means more upgrades.

And more upgrades mean an even bigger grid.

Unlock New Technology

Growing your network is not only about placing more buildings.

Invest in new technologies to unlock better generators, improved infrastructure, larger energy storage, stronger power connections, new construction possibilities, and additional tools for managing your network.

Technology gradually changes what you are capable of building and gives you new ways to improve the efficiency of your operation.

Build your way from basic engineering to an advanced island-wide power system.

Watch the City Grow Brighter

The electricity you produce has a visible purpose.

Across the water sits a city that depends on the energy supplied by your network. As your production grows and more electricity reaches the mainland, the city increasingly comes to life.

Lights appear across buildings and infrastructure as your network becomes more powerful.

Watching the world react to your progress gives every new generator and connection a purpose beyond simply making a number go up.

Explore a Beautiful Nordic Island

High Voltage takes place on a realistic Nordic-inspired island filled with forests, rocky terrain, open landscapes, changing weather and scenic views.

Explore the island from a first-person perspective while deciding where your next piece of infrastructure should go.

Instead of managing your grid from a distant menu, you are physically there.

Walk between your generators.

Follow your cables across the landscape.

Stand beneath the turbines you built.

And watch your network spread across the island around you.

Build at Your Own Pace

High Voltage is designed around satisfying progression without constant pressure.

There are no armies to defeat and no race against the clock.

Take your time, explore the environment, experiment with different layouts, improve your infrastructure and enjoy watching your network become larger and more productive.

Whether you want to carefully organize every connection or simply keep expanding until the island is covered in power infrastructure, the choice is yours.

Grow Your Energy Business

Every successful expansion makes your operation more valuable.

Produce electricity, earn money, reinvest your profits and continue growing.

Upgrade your generators.

Increase your network capacity.

Unlock new technology.

Build larger infrastructure.

Expand into new areas.

And turn a small local power setup into a thriving energy business supplying an entire city.

Key Features

  • First-person 3D gameplay — physically explore and build across the island.

  • Incremental progression — generate power, earn money, reinvest and grow.

  • Build your own electrical grid using generators, poles, cables, batteries and substations.

  • Multiple energy technologies to unlock and develop.

  • Resource and infrastructure management without overwhelming complexity.

  • Technology upgrades that expand what you can build and improve.

  • A reactive city that becomes brighter as you supply more electricity.

  • Open-ended sandbox construction with freedom to design your own network.

  • Realistic Nordic-inspired environments to explore.

  • Relaxing progression focused on building, optimization and satisfying growth.

  • From a tiny grid to a massive power network — watch your infrastructure gradually take over the island.

How far can you expand your grid?

Explore the island from a first-person perspective while deciding where your next piece of infrastructure should go.

Instead of managing your grid from a distant menu, you are physically there.

Walk between your generators.

Follow your cables across the landscape.

Stand beneath the turbines you built.

And watch your network spread across the island around you.

Build at Your Own Pace

High Voltage is designed around satisfying progression without constant pressure.

There are no armies to defeat and no race against the clock.

Take your time, explore the environment, experiment with different layouts, improve your infrastructure and enjoy watching your network become larger and more productive.

Whether you want to carefully organize every connection or simply keep expanding until the island is covered in power infrastructure, the choice is yours.

Grow Your Energy Business

Every successful expansion makes your operation more valuable.

Produce electricity, earn money, reinvest your profits and continue growing.

Upgrade your generators.

Increase your network capacity.

Unlock new technology.

Build larger infrastructure.

Expand into new areas.

And turn a small local power setup into a thriving energy business supplying an entire city.

Key Features

  • First-person 3D gameplay — physically explore and build across the island.

  • Incremental progression — generate power, earn money, reinvest and grow.

  • Build your own electrical grid using generators, poles, cables, batteries and substations.

  • Multiple energy technologies to unlock and develop.

  • Resource and infrastructure management without overwhelming complexity.

  • Technology upgrades that expand what you can build and improve.

  • A reactive city that becomes brighter as you supply more electricity.

  • Open-ended sandbox construction with freedom to design your own network.

  • Realistic Nordic-inspired environments to explore.

  • Relaxing progression focused on building, optimization and satisfying growth.

  • From a tiny grid to a massive power network — watch your infrastructure gradually take over the island.

How far can you expand your grid?

store_data.about_the_game:
Grab a marshmallow. Grab a stick. Cause absolute chaos.

Marsheez is a candy-coated party brawler about squishy little marshmallows called "marshees" that shove, skewer and toast each other across a world of chocolate, candy canes and gingerbread. Play solo against bots, or pile up to 8 friends onto one couch, then take the mayhem online.

Easy to pick up. Impossible to put down.


One stick to move, one button to dash, one to throw. That's the whole game, and it's plenty. Bump a friend into the campfire, snatch a falling spear out of the air, morph into a candy cane to hide. Every round is 60 seconds of giggling, screaming, sugar-rush mayhem.

A dozen sugar-fueled modes


  • BBQ'D: Shove everyone into the fire. Last marshee un-toasted wins.

  • SKEWERED: Grab a candy-cane spear and poke your friends into oblivion.

  • STICK STORM: Sticks rain from the sky. Snatch one, fling it, dodge the rest.

  • STICKY TRAIL: Ooze goo everywhere and paint more floor than anyone else.

  • TORCH TOAST: Hog the flaming torch the longest without getting bonked off it.

  • GROWTH SPURT: One marshee balloons into a giant and flattens the rest, then it's your turn.

  • FLAG DASH: Grab the flag, hold on, and run for your sugary life.

  • HIDE & SEEK: Disguise as a candy prop and blend in, or hunt down the fakes.

…and more, with fresh modes rolling in.

Make your marshee yours


Pick from a whole tray of pastel colours, then deck your marshee out in hats and cosmetics you unlock as you play. Level up, earn Swirls, raid the shop.

Couch chaos or online showdowns


  • 1-8 players local: keyboard, gamepads and Joy-Cons all welcome. Two players can even share one keyboard.

  • Online multiplayer: matchmake into quick 2- or 4-player games in seconds.

  • Party Mode: a random gauntlet of modes, first to 5 takes the crown.

  • Teams: pink vs. white, pick your side.

Features


  • Drop-in couch multiplayer for up to 8

  • Online matchmaking

  • A dozen+ chaotic party modes

  • Bots to fill any lobby — or play solo

  • Deep marshee customisation: colours, hats, unlockables

  • Squishy, bouncy, juicy game feel from top to bottom

  • Full controller support

Sweet on the outside. Savage on the inside. Grab your friends and get toasting. 🔥

Remember — every choice matters.

It gives you a choice — and leaves you to decide whether you made the right one.

store_data.about_the_game:
BET BEFORE YOU FIGHT

Before every round you choose how much to risk. Low stakes, safe payout. High stakes, better weapons and buffs, and a much worse penalty when you go down. Nobody makes you bet, though. We respect your free will (Punishments may apply).

SHOOT, STAB, GAMBLE

Top-down action against 10 enemy types and one mini boss, each one of them willing to tear you apart just to pay their own debts. With over 42 guns, 20 melee weapons, 30 buffs, 25 consumables and lots of chips, there is no shortage of options to defend yourself. Though, what you can bring with you depends on what you are willing to lose.

TOP TEN BIGGEST DEBTORS

Somewhere, there's a list of the ten biggest debtors on Earth, filled with the names of gambling addicts, killers, victims of the system, and people who want to end the cycle of bloodshed using even more bloodshed. Your name is John Gambling. And you are the biggest debtor in the world.

The list belongs to System, a strange woman who owns all the money there is in the world. Every debt in every country is owed to the same person, and the ten people who owe the most have been invited against their will to a casino-coliseum to pay it off.

EVERYONE DOWN THERE OWES SOMETHING

There's a price on your head, and it's exactly large enough to clear the debt of whoever collects it. People from six factions come into the arena, and each one of them is fighting for the same reason you are, to pay their debts with other people's blood. 

But to be honest. In the end, no one really cares about paying their debts.

Blood is money. And money means one more bet on 19. 

Available languages: English. Spanish.

store_data.about_the_game:
A strategic roguelike about building bee colonies. Spend daylight gathering honey and growing the hive, then hold the line when hostile insects raid after dark.

  • Hatch specialised bees: workers, soldiers, gardeners, and nurses.

  • Found hives across 10 distinct biomes with unique hazards and native predators.

  • Adapt and optimise with 60 talents and 32 rewards.

  • Survive raids from 30 enemy types and 10 elites.

  • Claim victory with the Queen Rite, and push yourself to the limit with endless mode.

Colony Automation

Your bees have their own behavior and goals. Workers seek out flowers and gather honey, gardeners tend to flowers to keep them blooming, and nurses patch up the wounded and cure the sick. When invaders attack, your soldiers intercept them and fight to defend the hive. As Hivekeeper, your role is deciding which castes to hatch, which talents to unlock, and what rewards augment your build best.

Roguelike Rewards

After fighting off a raid or defeating a powerful elite, you are rewarded with a choice of 3 unique augments from a pool of 32.

The Talent Comb

Hive upgrades run through a hexagonal board of 60 talents. Unlock them all to gain access to the Queen Rite. The board layout partially randomises for each hive, keeping each run fresh and testing your ability to adapt.

Day and Night Cycles

During the day, worker and gardener bees busily make sure there is an incoming flow of honey. When the sun sets, raids begin. Enemy swarms move toward the hive from map edges or burst through underground tunnels. If defenders fall and invaders breach the core, the colony collapses. Surviving a night grants a choice of three randomised tactical rewards.

Beautiful Environments

10 biomes to call home, each with their own set of challenges to overcome.

  • Fragrant Meadow

  • Dark Forest

  • Winding River

  • Murky Swamp

  • Summer Islands

  • Mushroom Cave

  • Scorching Desert

  • Snowy Arctic

  • Furious Volcano

  • Starlit Expanse

About This Game

Your build grows during the run. Your arsenal grows after it.

Mow down waves of monsters with auto-firing weapons, grab an unidentified weapon from a treasure chest, and make it home alive. Whatever you carry back can be appraised at the guild and taken into your next expedition — a survivors-like where the loot outlives the run.

Cut through the horde

  • Your weapons fire on their own. You handle positioning and survival

  • 15 weapons transform as they level, until the strongest fill the screen

  • Combine them with passive skills to build a different loadout every run

Carry unidentified loot home

  • Weapons from chests come unidentified. Rarity and enchantments stay hidden until appraised

  • Pay the guild to reveal what you found. Seven rarity tiers decide how far a weapon can grow

  • 45 unique enchantments, tailored per weapon — the same blade plays differently depending on what it rolled

  • Fall in the ruins and you limp home with half your haul. Reach the escape gate and you keep all of it

Descend with a party

  • Choose one of 15 characters to deploy, each with their own weapon affinities

  • Companions join your roster as you progress and reinforce you mid-run

  • The enchantments on a companion's gear work for them, not for you

  • Take guild contracts to unlock new classes, passives, and drops

The ruins do not wait

  • Each stage brings its own weather and terrain hazards — darkness that blinds, moving machinery, walls that close off ground

  • The longer you last, the heavier the horde, until the master of the ruins arrives

  • The deeper you go, the better the loot sleeping there

store_data.about_the_game:
Sherlock Holmes: Sex & Secrets is a story-driven adult visual novel that reimagines the world of the legendary detective as a dark Victorian mystery filled with conspiracy, romance, psychological tension, and explicit adult content.



London, 1894.

A mysterious black glass chess piece arrives at 221B Baker Street alongside a photograph predicting the death of a wealthy banker. By the time Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson reach the scene, the victim is already dead, the room appears impossible to enter or escape from, and a message has been left specifically for Holmes.

What begins as a single locked-room murder soon reveals something far larger.

A trail of black glass chess pieces, coded brass mechanisms, hidden passageways, murdered custodians, and carefully constructed crime scenes leads Holmes toward the Nocturne Society, an exclusive secret organization buried beneath London's aristocratic world. Its members include politicians, financiers, nobles, and other powerful figures whose private lives are protected by an enormous archive of secrets.

Someone is systematically killing the people connected to that archive.

And every crime has been designed for Sherlock Holmes to solve.

The investigation becomes even more complicated when Evelyn Blackwood returns to London.

Elegant, intelligent, dangerous, and impossible for Holmes to treat as simply another source of information, Evelyn shares a complicated history with him that began years earlier in Paris. She also knows far more about Nocturne than she initially admits.

Their reunion forces Holmes to confront something far more difficult than a murder investigation: trust.

As the case develops, Holmes and Evelyn infiltrate private clubs, masquerade balls, hidden chambers, underground railway passages, aristocratic estates, and the forgotten tunnels beneath London. Every new discovery brings them closer to the truth while exposing more of the unresolved tension between them.

Sherlock Holmes: Sex & Secrets combines narrative-driven investigation with character-focused adult romance.

Throughout the story, you will examine crime scenes, uncover clues, question suspicious circumstances, and make deductions using evidence already discovered during the investigation. Major deduction sequences allow you to reconstruct murders and expose contradictions without turning the game into a traditional puzzle adventure.

Choices throughout the story influence Holmes's tone, investigative approach, and relationship with Evelyn while preserving a focused cinematic narrative and a single canonical conclusion.

The relationship between Holmes and Evelyn develops across the entire investigation. Their attraction is closely tied to their history, distrust, rivalry, and growing dependence on one another rather than existing separately from the mystery.

The game features multiple fully animated NSFW scenes between Sherlock Holmes and Evelyn Blackwood, appearing throughout the story as their relationship develops. These sequences are integrated into the narrative and reflect different stages of their emotional relationship, from unresolved attraction and dangerous pretense to trust, vulnerability, and genuine intimacy.

An unlockable gallery system allows you to revisit adult scenes and other unlocked content after discovering them during the story.

Features include:

Story-driven adult visual novel set in Victorian London.

A complete mystery centered around the Nocturne Society and its hidden archive of secrets.

Sherlock Holmes and Evelyn Blackwood as the central romantic pairing.

Locked-room murders, staged evidence, secret societies, coded mechanisms, underground passages, and conspiracy.

Interactive deduction sequences based on clues discovered during the investigation.

Meaningful dialogue and investigation choices that shape Holmes's personality and relationship dynamics.

Multiple fully animated NSFW scenes.

An unlockable gallery system for previously discovered adult content.

A large cast including Dr. John Watson, Irene Adler, Inspector Lestrade, Dr. Alaric Harrow, and other figures connected to the conspiracy.

Detailed cinematic CG artwork inspired by Victorian mystery, gothic romance, and psychological thriller aesthetics.

A single complete canonical storyline with a defined conclusion rather than multiple disconnected romance routes.

Every secret leaves evidence.

The question is not whether Sherlock Holmes can uncover the truth.

It is what he will do once he has it.

5132900.name: 300 MILES TO HER: Every Hitcher Lies

store_data.about_the_game:
300 MILES TO HER: Every Hitcher Lies

The phone rings at 3 AM. It is your wife. She is screaming something about zombies, nukes, or the literal end of the world. The exact details do not matter. She is 300 miles away and you need to go right now. You grab whatever random junk you can carry from the house, jump in the car, and hit the dark highway.

Now there is nothing between you and her but an empty fuel gauge and the desperate strangers waiting on the shoulder.

THE PASSENGER SEAT

You are not playing a standard racing game. You are living inside the cabin. Rummage through the glovebox, light a cigarette, and watch the headlights cut through the panic. It is just you and the open road. At least until you spot someone in the dark.

EVERY HITCHER LIES

The apocalypse brings out the weirdos. You will find hitchhikers begging for a ride and picking them up is a massive gamble. A talkative stranger might hand you the exact supplies you need to keep moving. Or they might lead you straight into an ambush. Listen closely because every single person is hiding something.

YOUR POCKETS DECIDE YOUR FATE

Remember that stuff you grabbed from the house before you left? That was not just set dressing. The specific items you bring completely change the game. What is in your pockets dictates which hitchhikers spawn, what encounters trigger, and how your night unfolds. Choose poorly and your run ends at a bloody gas station.

MANY WAYS TO DIE

This road trip takes more than one try. You will get robbed. You will run out of gas. You will absolutely die a few times before sunrise. But if you play your cards right, read the lies, and manage your cabin well, you just might make it to her.

CRISPY RETRO PARANOIA

Wrapped in a nostalgic low poly aesthetic that feels like a late 90s fever dream. The visuals are warm and pixelated but the dread is very real.

Turn the key. She is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chessplosion reinvents chess around a brand-new piece: the Giant Pawn.

Occupying a 2×2 area, the Giant Pawn changes movement, captures, and traditional chess strategy. It can become a major threat on the board, but destroying it can also trigger an explosion that completely transforms the position.

When a Giant Pawn is captured, its explosion creates four pawns that can eliminate pieces occupying their squares. If it reaches the opposite side of the board, it can give rise to two Amazons, powerful pieces combining the movement of a queen and a knight.

The familiar foundations of chess are still here, but you'll need to rethink how you use them.

KEY FEATURES

• Challenge the computer across multiple difficulty levels, from accessible opponents to demanding AI.
• Play against another player locally or online.
• Watch two AI opponents battle each other in computer-vs-computer mode.
• Solve increasingly challenging checkmate puzzles.
• Customize special Giant Pawn rules to dramatically change how matches play.
• Customize board colors and visual options.
• Browse your game history and replay moves to analyze previous matches.
• Choose between different time controls to adjust the pace of play.

In Chessplosion, a familiar position can change in just a few moves. Protect your king, keep an eye on the Giant Pawn, and consider the consequences of every explosion before launching your attack.

store_data.about_the_game:
Machines that actually work

Pressure Works is a machine-building sandbox running on a real pneumatic simulation. Place parts on a snapping grid, run hoses port to port, and open a valve, pressure floods the network, cylinders stroke, motors turn, and the thing you bolted together starts to move.

Nothing is faked. A cylinder pushes because pressure reached it. A wheel turns because a crank drove it. When a machine doesn't work, the answer is always somewhere in the plumbing, and finding it is the game.

Air is the wiring

Steam and air run on the same simulation, so a pressure line is both muscle and signal. Buttons, 5/2 directional valves, bistable latches, AND and OR valves, and a NOT valve give you a functionally complete logic set, enough to build latches, timers, oscillators, and sequencing circuits out of nothing but moving air.

Cap a line with a regulator. Slow a stroke with a flow restrictor. Cut the cord entirely with an air tank. Put a gauge on the far end to find out why nothing's happening down there.

We also have colored light nodes, so for the madmen out there, build a functional computer if you wish.

Real parts, real consequences

Beams, plates, blocks, axles, and wheels bolt together with pins, cross-pin for a rigid weld, round-pin for a free hinge. Gears mesh by geometry and belts span the gaps, so gearing down a winch genuinely makes it harder to turn, and a heavy enough load will stall the piston driving it.

Machines are rigid groups connected by joints, so what you build holds together like real structure. Build a crank engine, a lifting rig, a walker, or a cart, then take a seat and drive it in first person.

Ways to play

  • Sandbox — no goals, no limits. Parts, space, and an idea.

  • Puzzles — solve a problem with a restricted parts list and a part budget. Restriction is where the depth is.

  • Time trials — build a vehicle, ride it, chase author times and medals, and race the ghost of your best run.

  • Challenges — open-ended scores. Build the tallest tower, launch something the farthest, haul fragile cargo without shattering it.

Build once, keep it forever

Save slots, named blueprints, full undo and redo, copy and paste. Any machine, or any sub-assembly of one, can be copied to your clipboard as a shareable code and pasted straight into someone else's game. Build a good crank engine once and stamp it into every machine you make after.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Nymphos! Nymphos! Nymphos everywhere! There are way too many nymphos—AAAAAAAA!!!!!!!!!!!!”

Burdened by a curse that has haunted your family for generations, you stopped loving others and gave up on ever being loved.

You thought you would spend the rest of your life alone—until one day, the legendary Dark Witch returned from the dead.

The world is plunged into crisis once more, but with it, a glimmer of hope for breaking your curse finally appears before you.

And so, you resolutely set out on a journey.

For love, for freedom, and to break the tragic fate that has repeated itself through generations. Find a way to survive the ever-growing hordes of Nymphos and make it to the end alive!

Thus begins an epic journey of love, adventure, curses, the Dark Witch, and a whole lot of Nymphos!

Lia

“Wait, I’m not a Nympho!”

Your childhood friend, and the strongest member of one of today’s wealthy families of exorcists.

She once worked up the courage to confess her feelings to you. However, afraid that your curse might affect her, you ultimately chose to reject her.

She loves bickering with you and always calls you “Big Brother.”

Incidentally, she adamantly denies being a Nympho herself.

Seriously. If she says she isn’t, then she isn’t. Probably.

Hienn

“What the hell are these things...?”

The CEO of the amusement park, as well as Lia’s childhood friend.

Mature and composed, she exudes a sophisticated feminine charm completely different from Lia’s.

Yet when the “Nympho Curse” suddenly sweeps across the entire amusement park, her reaction seems almost too calm.

As if... she somehow knew this day was coming all along.

Hennie

“U-Um... I’d like to keep a little air of mystery, so I went ahead and censored it with a mosaic for now.”

(The person depicted has consented to the upload of this edited image.)

A mysterious woman about whom very little is currently known.

Vanya

“At last, I can once again engrave the sight of your eyes upon my heart, forevermore.”

Always wearing a melancholic yet elegant expression, she speaks to you in an almost poetic manner.

Does she truly wish to help you, or is she leading you step by step toward an ending that has already been prepared for you?

store_data.about_the_game:
LINER/TRACER is a stylish 2D action game controlled with a combination of mouse and keyboard inputs.

Move and jump with the keyboard, then use the mouse to perform high-speed dashes, create platforms, and attack enemies. Break through waves of bullets and dangerous terrain as you close the distance and look for an opportunity to strike.

Landing a dash attack on an enemy activates time stop, freezing enemies and incoming bullets. While time is stopped, move the cursor to guide your character and pass through the same enemy repeatedly to perform a series of attacks.

Trace shapes such as an X, triangle, or square with your attack path to activate powerful special attacks. You must plan your route within the limited time available and decide whether to continue attacking or retreat to safety.

Drag with the right mouse button to create straight platforms. Use them to reach higher areas, build routes through bullet patterns, and create new ways to approach your enemies.

Race through a neon world glowing, combining movement, evasion, platform creation, and attacks to defeat your enemies.
