store_data.about_the_game:
Incremental Bowling is exactly what it sounds like. Shove bowling pins into the score area, buy upgrades, and automate the whole lane to score more and more points!

It starts with one ball. Soon you'll have pins flying in every direction.

Knock them down

Send a ball down the lane and watch it plow through whatever is in its way. Pins scatter, and no two throws ever break the same way.

Every pin you drive into the score area pays out, then reappears somewhere on the lane for you to knock down again.

Build a lane that plays itself

Fans that keep the balls rolling forward. Chargers that make pins pay out many times over. Machines that swallow a ball and fire it back out whichever way you point them.

Watch the lane turn into something that feeds itself, balls looping around, picking up charge, coming back through the pins again.

Chain them together

Score fast enough and the pins start chaining. The longer the chain runs the bigger it pays.

Watch it grow

Win a tournament to grow everything. A wider lane. More pins on it. New machines and new upgrades to spend your winnings on.

Then sit back

Producers speed up. Fans and chargers stack. Before long the lane is throwing, charging and scoring entirely without you, and the points just pile up.

Features

  • A tournament ladder, each rung unlocking new machines, new upgrades and a bigger lane

  • Fans, chargers, producers and redirectors to buy, place and switch on, several with their own settings to tune

  • Upgrade tracks for pin value, throw power, ball capacity, charge power, combo time and more

  • A lane that grows from a narrow strip to a screen full of colliding pins

  • Physics on every ball and pin, whether you threw it or a machine did

  • Chunky low-res pixel art

Can you clear the last tournament?

store_data.about_the_game:
Football, Sex & Glory is a story-driven adult visual novel set inside the glamorous, ruthless world of elite professional football.

You play as Nico Vale, a 23-year-old British superstar whose talent has already made him one of the most talked-about players in the game. After a sensational €118 million transfer to London, one of the richest and most ambitious clubs in the country, Nico arrives at The Crown with one goal: prove that he is worth every headline, every expectation, and every cent.

London has dominated domestically, but the club has spent twenty-seven years waiting for continental glory. Nico is supposed to be the player who finally changes that.

At first, everything seems to go his way. Goals arrive. Supporters adore him. The media cannot stop talking about him. Nightclubs open their doors. Sponsors want his face. Every great performance makes Nico more certain that talent can solve anything.

But being brilliant with a football is only part of becoming truly great.

As the season unfolds, Nico must deal with demanding coach Marcus Vega, respected captain Elias Kane, striker Malik Reyes, an increasingly unforgiving media spotlight, and the consequences of his own arrogance. Success, fame, discipline, rivalry, nightlife, and team loyalty begin to collide as London fights for domestic and continental trophies.

Away from the pitch, Nico's life becomes just as complicated.

Selene Varga is a glamorous nightlife entrepreneur and international DJ who understands fame better than most people around him.

Naomi Reed is an intelligent football journalist and documentary producer who refuses to become another person impressed by Nico's reputation.

Isla Navarro is a fiercely competitive professional footballer who reminds Nico what the game feels like when nobody is watching.

Their relationships reveal different sides of Nico and accompany his journey through triumph, humiliation, temptation, pressure, and personal growth.

Football remains at the heart of the experience. Major matches are presented through cinematic story scenes, including rivalries, dramatic comebacks, cup battles, championship pressure, and the pursuit of the Continental Champions Cup. Nico's journey is not about losing his confidence or becoming someone completely different. It is about learning when individual brilliance is enough — and when greatness requires trusting the people around him.

The game includes player choices that shape dialogue, character reactions, and relationship moments while preserving a complete cinematic season narrative with a single canonical ending.

Football, Sex & Glory also includes animated adult scenes featuring the game's main romantic characters. These sequences are integrated into the relationships and story rather than existing separately from the season narrative.

An unlockable gallery system allows you to revisit adult content and other unlocked material as you progress through the game.

Expect a mix of professional football drama, celebrity culture, luxury nightlife, romance, rivalry, humor, mature themes, explicit adult content, personal failure, redemption, and high-stakes sporting glory.

Nico Vale already knows he is talented enough to become a legend.

The real question is whether he can learn what being one actually requires.

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on the Fire Up Together Adventure With Your Friends!

Set out from the fire station, connect your hoses to hydrants, and carry your water supply as high as possible. Extinguish the fires in your path, overcome challenging obstacles, and climb as high as you can with your friends!

Play Solo or With Friends

Take on this crazy adventure alone or form a team of up to four players.

Master Physics-Based Hose Mechanics

Your hose is powered by a physics simulation: it wraps around platforms, stretches, and swings. Swing from wherever it gets caught to keep moving, or let a teammate grab onto your hose and climb up. But be careful—a tangled hose will eventually become your problem too.

Rise With the Power of Water

The pressurized water blasting from your fire hose isn’t just for putting out fires. Use its recoil to launch yourself into the air, reach platforms, and climb higher.

Of course, you can also turn your hose on your friends. Teach troublesome teammates a little lesson and enjoy sending them tumbling back down!

The Firefighters’ New Favorite Sport: HoseBall

How about playing a little HoseBall at the fire station before setting off on your adventure?

In this game, you don’t kick the ball—you blast it with pressurized water! Control your hose, line up long-range shots, and send the ball into the goal before your friends do.

store_data.about_the_game:
Some secrets are better left in the dark.

State Of Fear: The Final Shift is a first-person, narrative-driven psychological horror game that embraces an authentic low-polygon aesthetic. Designed as a focused, bite-sized terror experience, it trades cheap jump scares for a heavy, lingering atmosphere and a slow-burn mystery where every office shadow hides an unsettling question.

You are drawn into an isolated retro office environment where the truth feels entirely out of reach. To survive the psychological tension, you must rely on exploration, environmental storytelling, and piecing together fractured dialogue to figure out just what is happening around you before it's too late.

Key Features:

  • Retro Office Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in authentic low-poly environments styled after classic horror, complete with nostalgic styling and vertex snapping.

  • Slow-Burn Mystery: Experience a narrative-focused journey where the core of the horror lies in uncovering a creeping, unsettling mystery step by step.

  • Bite-Sized Terror: A tightly paced, highly focused micro-horror adventure designed to deliver a complete and memorable jolt of dread in a single sitting.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate a tense retro workplace built entirely around environmental storytelling and psychological dread.

store_data.about_the_game:
The sky is the clock

Kansys is a match-3 game where standing still is the mistake. Take too long between

moves and a twister forms over the board, shows you exactly which lanes it is coming

down, and then comes down them. Anything still sitting in that path when it arrives is

gone — and on a timed run it takes five seconds off your clock on the way out.

The path is the whole game

Every twister telegraphs a 2 to 3 lane path before it moves — occasionally four, when

the sky is feeling generous with itself. From that moment the board splits in two:

the safe part, and the part that is about to be worth a great deal more than usual.

  • Match in the path and it pays double. Every run you pull out of the lane, while
    the funnel is still bearing down on it, is worth twice what it would be anywhere else.

  • Clear every match in the path and the storm is SUPPRESSED. The funnel gives up
    and fades out, and the entire path pays triple instead. This is the play the game
    is named after and it is not a gimme — you are racing a funnel moving at a speed you
    do not get to know in advance.

  • Let it through and you watch the bill. Swept tiles spiral up into the funnel
    and the run tallies exactly what those matches would have been worth. Lost points, shown
    as lost points.

Storm Season

Let three twisters through and the weather turns. Storm Season runs 42 seconds, doubles

every point on the board, and shortens the fuse — twisters now form after six seconds of

hesitation instead of ten. It is the punishment and the payday at the same time.

Charge the herd

Chain matches quickly and the STAMPEDE meter fills. When it is full your next match sends

the herd charging down an entire row or column, flattening everything in the line.

Runs that swing wider than the line

Four in a row doesn't just clear four. The corral swings out and drags a neighbour in

with it. Five takes two or three. Six takes everything of that animal touching the run.

An 11x11 board with eight animals leaves enough on the table that a six is something you

spot and set up, not something you wait to be handed.

Three ways to run it

  • Go! 100 — most points in 100 seconds. Twisters cost you five of them.

  • Go! 150 — the long sprint, and where Storm Season really bites.

  • Endless — no clock. Just you and the sky.

Steam leaderboards

Every mode has its own global and friends board. Your best run posts automatically when

it beats your previous best.

What it isn't

No energy meters, no lives to wait out, no in-app purchases, no ads, and no separate

account to make. It is one executable, and it plays offline — only the leaderboards

need Steam.

An 11x11 board with eight animals leaves enough on the table that a six is something you

spot and set up, not something you wait to be handed.

Three ways to run it

  • Go! 100 — most points in 100 seconds. Twisters cost you five of them.

  • Go! 150 — the long sprint, and where Storm Season really bites.

  • Endless — no clock. Just you and the sky.

Steam leaderboards

Every mode has its own global and friends board. Your best run posts automatically when

it beats your previous best.

What it isn't

No energy meters, no lives to wait out, no in-app purchases, no ads, and no separate

account to make. It is one executable, and it plays offline — only the leaderboards

need Steam.
store_data.short_description: Match the herd before the sky takes it. Dawdle and a twister picks its lane across the board — matches in its path pay double, and clear every one of them and it dies on the spot for triple. Three timed modes, one 11x11 board, no filler.

store_data.about_the_game:
DESCEND ELEVEN FLOORS.
Dario works in a warehouse. The game starts the night his mind gives in. Floor by floor you descend through his life: the shift, the night offices, the break room where nobody saved him a seat, the commute, the house that went quiet. Further down, the rooms he never reopened. Every enemy used to work there. The bosses are the managers who made his life hell, and one of them never takes the punch clock off his neck.

THE PILLS ARE THE ECONOMY.
The same pills that hold his mind together are the only currency the warehouse accepts. Every purchase costs a piece of him. Nineteen weapons, each named after a kind of workplace damage: the Bare Minimum, the Grudge, the Double Bind. Any two can fuse, 171 hybrids, 16 of them signature fusions with their own behavior. Fusion is a bet, not an upgrade button: there is no undo, and regret needs no tooltip. And the descent leaves marks: run after run you unlock the Fragments of Dario, versions of him from other falls, each one playable.

TWO ENDINGS.
The bottom is always the bottom. What changes is who arrives: how much of his mind you managed to keep decides what happens when there's nothing left to descend. One ending is reached by falling. The other must be earned.

MADE TO MEAN IT.
Made by one person, after work, about work. Every boss and mini-boss is being hand-drawn in ink by my best friend. Every sound in the game was recorded from the game itself: not a single note is AI-generated. This game exists because some things are easier to say with a warehouse full of monsters than out loud.

store_data.about_the_game:
You've just started a new job — as a 911 dispatcher.

Your first shift should be simple: sit down at the computer, take calls, listen carefully to people, and decide whether a police unit needs to be sent. At first, everything seems ordinary. Suspicious individuals, fights, noise complaints, domestic incidents — the usual dispatcher's work. But then a call comes in from an unknown number. A frightened girl begs for help and gives an address. Your colleague insists it's just an old system glitch. According to him, this call is connected to a case that was closed many years ago. But something about this story won't leave you alone. You decide to check the address yourself.

An ordinary night shift gradually turns into a grim investigation, where one strange call leads deeper and deeper into a story everyone thought was long over.

Features:

  • First-person psychological horror

  • Working as an emergency dispatcher

  • Decisions: send a police unit or close the call

  • Atmospheric dialogue and staged scenes

  • A short, intense horror adventure

store_data.about_the_game:
GAME OVERVIEW

Dragons Invasion is a 2D horizontal shooter, playable solo or in local co-op. Master the Dash and Color Swap — slay dragons or absorb their shots to charge your power gauge. Match their color. Unleash your power. Destroy them all. Be tough. Be skilled. Save the land.

ARCADE SPIRIT

Grab a friend. Take on a sky full of dragons. Share the glory. 2-player local co-op available at launch.

STORY

The kingdom is under attack by dragons. It's up to you to set it free! Choose one of four unlikely heroes and fight your way across the entire kingdom — from the devastated city to the haunted mines, through mysterious swamps and all the way to the castle.

HERO — THE ROOSTER KNIGHT

His blade never stops. Unleash sword volleys that evolve from a single precise strike into a devastating four-blade cross barrage.

ARROWEN — THE ARROW BREATHER

Riding her trusty owl, Arrowen strikes with deadly precision. Fire straight shots, diagonal spreads, and homing arrows. At full power, she unleashes a gigantic arrow that stretches across the entire screen.

GAMEPLAY - 3 magical colors, red, blue, green. Match the enemy color to kill it.

  • Swap Colors → autoshoot destroys enemies

  • Power Gauge (5 levels): your color halo absorbs matching fire → fills your gauge  → boosts your shots. Get hit → gauge and powers drop

  • Dash: multidirectional agility skill

  • Piercing Attack: hits in front of you during a dash (hits all enemies, even colorless)

  • Roll: invincible move ending with a finishing strike (hits all enemies, even colorless)

  • Invocation: A priest gives you a scroll that lets you summon a powerful warrior spirit for a devastating attack.

  • Rewards: Defeat a boss, pick one of three items to power up your current run: faster movement, quicker attacks, raw power, and more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Veinward is a first-person mining incremental game. Mine ores, haul them up, sell them, upgrade your character and your pickaxe, then go deeper and faster.

Grab a pick and get:

  • Kilometers of procedurally generated depth. Each layer has its own ores, rock, and cave layout, from narrow tunnels near the surface, to large open caverns further down, to strange and eldritch shapes at the bottom.

  • A full ore progression, from simple stone to rare and precious ores.

  • Loads of upgradeable pickaxes. Craft them from the ore you mined, or buy them.

  • A long list of passive and active skills to help you become a better miner.

  • A jetpack for vertical movement, because climbing back up is boring.

  • Throwable explosives, from small hand-made dynamite to nuclear blasts that leave craters.

  • A town that grows with you. Sell your ores raw or smelt them for more profit, upgrade your pickaxe at the forge, fill in your compendium as you discover new things, or set up an auto mining operation and idle while your machines mine for you.

  • When progress starts to slow down, rebirth your character and get much stronger, PERMANENTLY. Every run goes deeper, faster, and richer than the one before it.

Numbers that go up. Very large ones.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gather Tiny Resources

Every match starts with a handful of pawns and a fresh island no one has ever seen. Fell the woods, dig the gold, hunt the flock — or pen it — and haul it home. Your pawns level up as they work, and every one of them rolls a trait: a Gold Digger, a Glass Cannon, a Class Clown. Learn their names. Get attached. Send them war to and hope they return.

Build Tiny Kingdoms

Plant your castle and grow outward: houses to shelter more hands, a barracks and archery range for the fight, a church for those who'd rather heal than harm, watchtowers you can crown with a cannon. Or hand a fistful of resources to Thrak, the one goblin merchant everybody likes, and let him turn your surplus into coin.

Train Tiny Armies

Veterans walk into the school as pawns and walk out as knights, lancers, archers and monks. Set a rally point and watch your host assemble at the gate. Every soldier keeps the name, the level and the trait they earned in the fields.

Go to Tiny War!

Rival kingdoms build, scheme and march — and they play to win. Some raid, some defend, some boom. They remember the towers that broke their last wave and pick a softer target next time. Field a balanced army, each unit type has its strengths and weaknesses against others.

Be the Last Tiny Banner Standing

When a castle falls and its last soldier is gone, the whole kingdom crumbles. Take every keep on the island — or hold yours until the last banner but one has fallen.

The island has plans of its own

The Gold Rush — a mother lode surfaces mid-map, and every kingdom races for it while thieves stalk the roads home.

The Skeleton Surge — the dead rise at a place of power; who farms the bones farms the glory.

Cave Lairs — packs of venomous beasts guard hoards and rare traits. Clear the den, claim the prize.

And more world events planned!

Play it your way

Single Player against 1–3 CPU kingdoms with distinct personalities and three different difficulties

Multiplayer over Steam for up to 4 banners — free-for-all, or Team Wipeout with allied sight and shared victory

Every island procedural: highlands, meadows and lowlands, staircases carved into cliffs, forests, and gold veins — the world you admire on the main menu is the one you'll play on

In single player save anywhere across five slots, with pause and rally points to keep it cozy

Tiny Banners is a small game with a big heart, built by one developer. Every knight has a name. Try not to lose them

Veterans walk into the school as pawns and walk out as knights, lancers, archers and monks. Set a rally point and watch your host assemble at the gate. Every soldier keeps the name, the level and the trait they earned in the fields.

Go to Tiny War!

Rival kingdoms build, scheme and march — and they play to win. Some raid, some defend, some boom. They remember the towers that broke their last wave and pick a softer target next time. Field a balanced army, each unit type has its strengths and weaknesses against others.

Be the Last Tiny Banner Standing

When a castle falls and its last soldier is gone, the whole kingdom crumbles. Take every keep on the island — or hold yours until the last banner but one has fallen.

The island has plans of its own

The Gold Rush — a mother lode surfaces mid-map, and every kingdom races for it while thieves stalk the roads home.

The Skeleton Surge — the dead rise at a place of power; who farms the bones farms the glory.

Cave Lairs — packs of venomous beasts guard hoards and rare traits. Clear the den, claim the prize.

And more world events planned!

Play it your way

Single Player against 1–3 CPU kingdoms with distinct personalities and three different difficulties

Multiplayer over Steam for up to 4 banners — free-for-all, or Team Wipeout with allied sight and shared victory

Every island procedural: highlands, meadows and lowlands, staircases carved into cliffs, forests, and gold veins — the world you admire on the main menu is the one you'll play on

In single player save anywhere across five slots, with pause and rally points to keep it cozy

Tiny Banners is a small game with a big heart, built by one developer. Every knight has a name. Try not to lose them
store_data.short_description: A charming pixel-art RTS. Gather wood, gold and meat, raise a village, train units, and go to tiny war against rival banners on a fresh procedural island every game — solo against cunning CPU kingdoms, or with friends over Steam. Be the last tiny banner standing.

store_data.about_the_game:
PULL ME UP!

Climb. Slide. Jump. Don’t fall. Reach the top!

Pull Me Up! is a 2–4 player chaotic platforming and parkour adventure where you and your friends must overcome challenging obstacle courses, explore unique worlds, and make your way to the top!

🌍 EXPLORE UNIQUE WORLDS

Your adventure begins at a peaceful camp beside a waterfall. From there, you’ll board an airship and travel to a Lost Village, where the real climb begins.

Make your way through the village using jumping, climbing, sliding, and grabbing mechanics while overcoming challenging obstacles. Hammers, moving platforms, slippery sections, and unexpected hazards will test your timing and movement skills.

As your journey continues, you'll discover completely different worlds:

  • 🏘️ Lost Village – A mysterious village surrounded by mountains, waterfalls, and challenging parkour courses. Climb through the village and find your way higher and higher.

  • 🌊 Scrap City – A massive city built from old metal structures and scrap floating above the sea. Navigate rooftops, platforms, pipes, and towering structures while trying not to fall into the water. And when you need a break from the climb, head over to the football field and play a match with your friends!

  • 🕯️ Mysterious Cave – Enter a dimly lit and mysterious cave filled with sealed doors. Complete the parkour in one area to activate the mechanism and unlock the next section. Explore deeper into the cave until you reach a massive pit standing between you and the path ahead.

  • ❄️ Frozen Lands – Reach a world covered in snow and ice. Slide across frozen surfaces, navigate slippery obstacles, and keep your balance as you make your way through the icy parkour courses.

👥 PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Bring 2–4 players together and take on the adventure as a team. Help each other overcome difficult sections, compete with your friends, and enjoy the chaos that comes when everyone is trying to reach the top.

🧗 CAN YOU REACH THE TOP?

Every obstacle course brings a new challenge. Time your jumps, control your movement, and stay focused. The higher you climb, the more painful the fall.

Pull Me Up! — Gather your friends, step onto the course, and start climbing!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Oreia

The cave is rich, unstable, and on the clock. Drop in with a pick and a contract, build an automated mining operation worth defending, and be gone in twenty minutes - everything you can't ship out stays buried.

Swing the pick, read the wall

Every tile can pay out or blow up. Iron, silver and gold sit next to gas pockets that vent creeping clouds, buried traps on a half-second fuse, and unstable rock that brings the ceiling down. Mining fast is how you get rich. Mining carelessly is how you watch your ore burn.

Then put the pick down - deploy the robots

Your arms don't scale*. Miner robots chew through the veins you mark, trucks haul ore home over roads you lay, builder robots keep the base growing while you plan the next dig. And robots break down out there in the dark - a dead miner pings your map, and heading out and making field repairs is a rescue worth making.

*Choose the mining-focused Vanguard class and your arms definitely DO scale.

Refine everything - every step multiplies the payday

Raw ore is the floor, not the price. Crush it, separate it, leach it, smelt it - a full processing chain turns a truckload of ore into five times the credits. But refined cargo still has to be shipped before it counts, and a smelter running mid-raid is a promise you have to defend.

The cave notices

The richer your operation gets, the harder it hits back. Raiders come for your robots, your buildings, and your unbanked ore - and every minute spent fighting is a minute not spent mining. Keep the trucks rolling, build walls, security droids and turrets to automate your defense.

Twenty minutes. Then it's gone.

Instability climbs from the moment you land. Meteors hammer your dig sites, the map's edges collapse inward, and when the timer dies the site dies with it - along with everything you didn't ship. Call the extraction and run the gauntlet, or push one more vein and risk facing the Miner Recovery Tax™.

Back at the Corporate Hub™

Between contracts, spend your earnings on permanent upgrades, identify relics discovered during the mission, unlock new building blueprints, and pick your next job on a procedurally generated frontier. Richer contracts, nastier caves.

Prefer to dig in peace?

Sandbox mode: no timer, no collapse, just you, the robots, and a cave that never bites back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Learn the tricks of the trade

Being a new ghost is harder than it looks. Nobody gives you a handbook when you become a ghost. Thankfully, you’ll meet helpful entities along the way who can teach you the basics. Learn to curse and commune with ordinary objects, merge into furniture, and discover new ways to interact with the world of The Living.

Spook The Living

A good haunting is more than a simple scare. Experiment with the objects around you and learn how different supernatural disturbances affect The Living. Use your skillset to move objects out of place, make ordinary things behave strangely, mess with power sources, and pull a variety of other tricks to combine strange occurrences into elaborate hauntings that are impossible to ignore. The Living respond to different styles of spooking, so you’ll need to learn what makes them tick and fine-tune each haunting based on what you observe. The key is to spook The Living just right!

Solve eerie puzzles

Each house contains supernatural puzzles that must be unraveled to push a haunting forward. Explore rooms, uncover the backstories of The Living, and experiment with the objects woven into their lives. Some hauntings require the right sequence of strange events while others ask you to recreate a meaningful moment, reveal a buried memory, or discover what a resident truly fears. Solve these mysteries to open new paths and deepen the haunting.

Explore Mysterious Buildings

Every building has its own secrets. Drift through forgotten rooms, find hidden passages, and uncover the strange past of the places where The Living reside. Look closely, an ordinary object, a sealed door, or a quiet corner may reveal a new path or a story waiting to be remembered.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to a town where everyone wants the same thing:

Get rich. Get out.

How you accomplish that is entirely up to you.

Heist to Meet You is a multiplayer social-deduction extraction game built around a living, player-driven economy. Earn a fortune honestly, manipulate the market, steal from your neighbors, uncover the Bandits hiding among the townsfolk—or become one of them.

The Wild West is the game's first setting, but the chaos isn't meant to stay there. Future maps are planned to bring the same core gameplay of money, deception, heists, and extraction into completely different themes. The next map currently being developed is Pirate's Cove.

GET RICH. THEN GET OUT OF TOWN.

Making enough money doesn't automatically make you a winner.

Once you've built up enough wealth in the bank, you still have to escape with it.

Multiple extraction routes around town offer different risks, costs, and requirements. Some are loud. Some require preparation. During this time you will be racing the clock before someone tries to take advantage of all your vulnerable cash.

Leave by yourself, or escape alongside another player you trust.

Just remember that your interests only align for as long as you both decide they do.

There doesn't have to be only one winner. As long as extraction remains available, the round continues—and another player may still have a chance to escape.

CIVILIANS AREN'T A TEAM

Just because someone isn't a Bandit doesn't mean they are on your side

Every Civilian is building their own fortune for their own escape.

That mean another Civilian can be your business partner one minute and your economic rival the next. You might cooperate, compete, trade, bargain, or deliberately undercut each other.

A PLAYER-DRIVEN ECONOMY

Price for Resources at the general store have gone sky high.

It's up to the players to trade directly with one another and decide what their goods are worth

Need wood immediately? Find someone with the axe to trade or request an offer at the Trade Center.

Have something everyone suddenly needs? Name your price.

Supply, demand, desperation, alliances, and greed can turn every round into a different economy.
Every time money moves through town, the town gets a piece of it.

THE TOWN GETS RICHER TOO

Money earned and spent throughout the round is taxed, causing the Town Treasury to grow.

When a player is elected Mayor, they can use that tax money to pass bills that may help—or hurt—the town.

But every dollar added to the Treasury creates another problem:

the richer the town becomes, the more tempting it is to rob.

THE HEIST

This is where everything the town has built throughout the round becomes a target.

Bandits are hiding among the townsfolk, earning money, making deals, and pretending to belong while waiting for an opportunity to strike.

Rob the bank. Crack safes. Steal valuables. Use dynamite. Hide your identity. Recruit somebody you think you can trust.

The longer the town thrives, the more there may be to take.

But getting into the vault is only part of the problem.

You still have to survive the Sheriff.

And if you actually get away with the money...

you still need to get out of town.

THE LAW

The Sheriff and Deputy are responsible for figuring out which players are actually behind the town's crimes.

Detain suspects, uncover identities, escort players to jail, investigate what happened, and decide when you have enough evidence to act.

But the badge doesn't give you unlimited power.

The town has Town Trust, and wrongful arrests can destroy confidence in the law.

Accuse the wrong cowboy and the criminal you're looking for might be standing right beside you.

PLAYER ROLEPLAY

There are no NPC townsfolk filling the streets.
The workers, merchants, criminals, politicians, gamblers, witnesses, and suspects around you are all other players.

That makes information valuable.

Who suddenly has a lot of money?

Who can craft guns?

Who bought dynamite?

Who was near the bank?

Why is that player trying so hard to convince you they're innocent?

Who are you willing to leave town with?

DEATH IS FINAL... MOSTLY

If you die, your run is over.

No respawn. No second chance to rebuild your fortune. No escaping town as a winner.

Instead, you return to the streets in a slightly less dignified form:

a town chicken.

Follow the surviving players around, watch their terrible decisions unfold, and silently judge everyone who managed to stay alive longer than you.

RUN THE TOWN

The heist isn't the only thing happening.

Run for Mayor. Give campaign speeches. Vote in elections. Pass laws. Work jobs. Farm. Mine. Repair buildings. Trade resources. Play poker. Drink at the saloon. Play the piano. Pick fights. Break someone out of jail.

The town creates opportunities.

The players create the chaos.

And eventually, somebody realizes there's an awful lot of money sitting around.

Build your fortune. Control the market. Trust carefully. Rob the town.

Then get out before somebody else does.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every masterpiece begins with a single log — and every successful workshop begins with a good decision.

Timber & Fortune  is a workshop management and progression game set in a hand-painted forest. Begin with a modest camp, gather your first timber, and gradually build a complete woodworking business. Process raw materials, craft furniture, fulfill customer orders, invest your earnings, and turn a small operation into a respected workshop.

Your choices shape the pace of your progress. Do you spend your money on a larger warehouse, unlock a new production method, improve your tools, or save enough to cover the next maintenance payment? Every expansion creates new opportunities — and new expenses.

From Timber to Fine Furniture

Harvest pine, oak, and mahogany, each with its own value and gathering time. Process logs into boards, prepare the materials you need, and craft chairs, beds, tools, and other useful goods. Better materials and improved craftsmanship lead to more valuable results.

Build the Workshop Your Way

Construct and upgrade eight specialized buildings, including a Drying Kiln, Production Workshop, Storage Warehouse, Research Lab, Market, Artisan Studio, and Showroom Gallery. Each new facility expands your options, improves efficiency, or helps your growing business reach the next stage.

Take Contracts — and Protect Your Name

Customers need timber, furniture, and reliable work. Choose contracts, study their requirements, and finish them before their deadlines. Successful orders bring money, experience, research points, and reputation. Late or failed work can damage your standing, while fast, high-quality results earn better rewards.

Develop Your Craft

Explore 15 research projects and invest in 14 skill upgrades. Unlock advanced carpentry methods, improve gathering and crafting speed, increase efficiency, reduce costs, and develop the expertise needed for demanding commissions.

Run a Real Business

Buy and sell resources and finished goods, manage limited storage, plan around building maintenance, and keep enough money available for your next investment. Expanding too quickly can put the entire workshop at risk — careful planning is just as important as fast production.

Complete Your Journey

Progress through four campaign chapters, grow from an unknown beginner into an accomplished carpenter, and prove yourself with a prestigious final commission. After completing the campaign, you can continue developing your workshop in endless mode.

Key Features

  • Gather pine, oak, and mahogany with different values and production times.

  • Turn raw timber into boards, furniture, instruments, and trade goods.

  • Construct and upgrade eight workshop buildings.

  • Complete varied contracts with requirements, deadlines, bonuses, and penalties.

  • Improve furniture quality and build a lasting reputation.

  • Unlock 15 research projects and 14 skill upgrades.

  • Trade resources and finished products through a dynamic workshop economy.

  • Balance income, investments, storage, and recurring maintenance costs.

  • Benefit from offline progress when returning to your workshop.

  • Finish a four-chapter campaign, then continue playing without an ending.

Can you transform a quiet forest camp into a workshop known for true masterpieces?

store_data.about_the_game:
"I found a small celebration!!"

Blue Hawaii Aniki, a self-proclaimed film director, moonlights as the host of a radio program for pocket money: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration. Together with veteran FM DJ Cathy Kojuku and Bonto Taira, the show's overeager scriptwriter, he reads out the "small celebrations" sent in by listeners.

This is a visual novel you read the way you would listen to a single full episode of a radio show. As the broadcast rolls on, the lives of the people on the other side of the airwaves slowly come into view.

■ Features

- Roughly 22,000 characters of text; about 40–60 minutes of playtime

- A single linear route with no choices — meant to be enjoyed like radio playing in the background

- Includes parody commercial breaks and jingles between segments

- The third entry in the series, fully enjoyable as a standalone work

store_data.about_the_game:
START YOUR ACADEMIC CAREER FROM NOTHING

You're unemployed. Ahead of you lies a long academic career shaped by hundreds of decisions.

Search for open positions at universities, submit your applications, and attend interviews. Get accepted, sign your contract, and take your first step into academia.

Advise your students, supervise exams, grade papers, and fulfill your academic responsibilities.

Prove yourself, and more prestigious universities may start to take notice.

  • Apply for positions at universities

  • Attend interviews and sign contracts

  • Build your academic reputation

  • Receive opportunities from more prestigious institutions

  • Rise from research assistant to professor and even department chair

IN THE EXAM ROOM, CATCHING CHEATERS ISN'T ALL THAT MATTERS

What truly matters is making the right call.

The moment you enter the exam room, the responsibility is yours.

Observe students from a first-person perspective. Walk around the room, watch their behavior, and look for anything suspicious.

Phones, hidden notes, wandering eyes on someone else's paper, and much more...

But things aren't always as simple as they seem.

Not every suspicion is justified. Not every situation has one right answer.

Accuse a student, let something slide, or choose another way to handle the situation. Your decisions can affect your relationships with students, your reputation, and the career you've spent years building.

STUDENTS ARE MORE THAN JUST NUMBERS

Academia is about more than lectures and exams.

Advise your students, listen to the problems they face, and let the choices you make throughout their academic lives define what kind of academic you become.

Will you be strict and authoritative?

Or will you become someone who builds strong bonds with their students?

As the years pass, new students will arrive, familiar faces will graduate, your career will evolve, and new opportunities will emerge.

Some decisions will have immediate consequences. Others may return to you years later.

EVERY DECISION SHAPES YOUR CAREER

Every university may be just one chapter of your story.

Pursue opportunities at more prestigious institutions, or remain at the university you've dedicated years of your life to.

Your performance, academic reputation, relationships with students, and the decisions you make will shape the opportunities that come your way.

  • Gain academic experience

  • Build your reputation

  • Unlock new career opportunities

  • Move to more prestigious universities

  • Climb the academic ladder

Rise from research assistant to professor. Succeed long enough, and one day you may even earn the opportunity to lead your own department.

How far you rise won't be decided by time alone, but by the choices you make.

BUILD YOUR CAREER. LIVE YOUR LIFE.

There's a life beyond the university.

What you do with the salary you earn is entirely up to you.

  • Upgrade your home

  • Buy new furniture and belongings

  • Own a car

  • Improve your standard of living

  • Build your savings

  • Explore different investments

Spend your money, save it, or try to grow your wealth through Bitcoin, silver, and other investment opportunities.

Your career success can shape your finances, while your financial decisions can change the options available to you in the future.

THE YEARS WILL PASS

Students will arrive.

Students will graduate.

Universities will change.

New opportunities will emerge.

Your career will move forward.

And one day, you'll look back and see how hundreds of small decisions became an entire academic career.

The students you once advised may be long gone. You may have left the university where you spent years of your life. The entry-level position where everything began may feel like a distant memory.

But the story created by your decisions will remain with you.

THIS IS YOUR ACADEMIC STORY

EXAM WATCH! isn't just about catching students cheating on exams.

It's a life and career simulation where you build your own journey through academia—from unemployment and your first job application to your first interview and signed contract, from the relationships you form with students to the professorship you may reach many years later.

Every decision leaves a mark.

Every year becomes part of your story.

Universities may change. Students may graduate. Years may pass.

But the academic legacy you leave behind is entirely your own.

"What Lies Beneath" is a first person horror game, where you play as a submarine pilot, capture and analyze fish, and report your findings to base, all while exploring an atmospheric and ambient underwater environment.

Plot

store_data.about_the_game:
Mow the lawn

It's a big lawn. Fill the catcher, walk it home, empty it out, do it again. The grass gets taller and meaner the further out you go, and so does the weather.

Buy something worse for the grass

You start with shears. You will not end with shears. Every upgrade cuts wider, holds more and lasts longer, and the job never changes, only how ridiculous you look doing it.

There's treasure under there

Ore you can see. Chests you can't. The only way to find one is to mow over it, so the boring bit and the good bit are the same bit.

In short

  • A lawn that gets weirder at each biome.
  • Tools that escalate until they're barely legal
  • The grass is your nightmare and your comfort zone.
  • Find buried treausures in each biome marked with an "X".

NO AI ART HAS BEEN USED IN THIS GAME

All the 3D and 2D assets are bough from asset stores or custom made for this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neko Room Days is a cozy 2D pixel-art room-decorating sim where you create a home for cats and unwind to mellow lo-fi music.

Care for your cats, arrange furniture, or use the music and built-in timers while you work. Whatever you are in the mood for, spend your time in the cat room your own way.

A Home Full of Little Cat Moments

Your cats roam freely around the room, eating, drinking, playing, and curling up in their favorite spots. Pet and brush them, get to know each cat on their own terms, and watch friendships grow as they spend time together.

　　　　　

Make the Cat Room Your Own

Your life together begins in a compact studio apartment. Collect and arrange more than 20 types of furniture, including cat beds, towers, tunnels, toys, and a cozy kotatsu.

As your level rises, new places to live become available, including a traditional Japanese room, a high-rise apartment, and a resort villa. Each of the six rooms takes on a different atmosphere in the morning, afternoon, and at night.

Lo-Fi for Focus and Relaxation

Choose from six albums featuring 60+ lo-fi tracks. Skip to the next track, shuffle playback, or turn on repeat.

The Pomodoro timer and stopwatch run independently of the music and can be used at the same time. Let the cats and music keep you company while you work, study, or read.

Everyday Moments Become Memories

Your first time caring for a cat, the changing atmosphere from morning to night, discovering new rooms and furniture, and seeing two cats grow closer—these moments can all be recorded as Memories as you reach milestones throughout the game.

Let your cats take on part-time jobs and wait for them to come home, or hide the UI and simply enjoy the room and music. There is no need to rush. Spend time with your cats and make memories at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake on a road with a notebook, a hand-drawn map and nothing else.

The map is honest about which side of the road a town is on and vague about how far away it is, which is what a map drawn from memory is like. North is where somebody said it was.

Stay alive first. Hunger and thirst are the easy part. Warmth is the argument — night, rain, a river you waded rather than walked around, what you are wearing and whether anything is burning near you. A hot meal is the cheapest answer to a cold night there is, and a fire that nobody feeds goes out.

Then build something worth coming back to. Work up from your hands to a stone axe, to a workbench, to iron, to a forge and steel. Knowledge is researched or found written on a schematic rather than unlocked by levels. Raise walls that pick a face or an end-on view from their neighbours, so a sealed room looks sealed.

The threat is other people, and they keep count. Three factions hold the towns, and each keeps its own ledger of what you have done to it — provoke the Wardens and the Wardens come, and the Reapers stay where they were. Raiders hear you through anything and see you only in front of them. They arrive in parties that surround rather than queue, and they march on the camp you sleep in rather than on wherever you happen to be standing. A storm is cover, because weather masks noise and shortens sight for everybody.

Up to five, with nobody's address on the wire. Coop runs over Steam's relay network: you join through a friend's lobby, and no player in the session ever learns another's IP address. One persistent world per save, hosted by whoever started it.

The road east ends two ways. Neither of them is the good one.

store_data.about_the_game:
Night-Shift Nowhere is a first-person action-horror game set inside Nowhere Medical (a remote and deeply questionable medical facility) where your first night on the job goes spectacularly wrong!

You came here for a security shift. Instead, your boss is nowhere to be found, something has gone horribly wrong inside the facility, and getting through the night has suddenly become a very hands-on responsibility.

Explore the halls of Nowhere Medical, search restricted areas, piece together what happened, and uncover the truth behind the facility's increasingly disturbing medical practices. When exploration isn't enough, grab whatever you can find and fight your way forward with firearms, improvised weapons, and good old-fashioned workplace violence.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

What begins as a routine first shift quickly turns into a fight to stay alive! Scavenge for weapons, ammunition, equipment, and anything else that might give you an advantage!

EXPLORE NOWHERE MEDICAL

Offices, treatment areas, laboratories, restricted rooms, and places that probably weren't on the employee orientation tour are waiting to be explored! Search carefully. The deeper you go, the less sense the facility starts to make.

FIGHT YOUR WAY OUT

Sometimes running is the right answer! Sometimes the right answer is an axe. Use a mixture of firearms and melee weapons to deal with whatever stands between you and the exit.

UNCOVER WHAT HAPPENED

Documents, abandoned rooms, and environmental clues reveal pieces of Nowhere Medical's history and the events leading up to your shift! Whether you actually wanted to know any of this is another question.

WELCOME TO NOWHERE MEDICAL

The pay is terrible.
Your boss is watching your every move. 
Workplace safety has officially gone off the rails.

Whatever happens, it's officially the worst first day on the job.

BUILT WITH UNREAL ENGINE 5

Every night shift is different. Objectives relocate, weapons, light, and supplies appear in different places, and even the dialogue can change from run to run. Adapt to what you find and make it out alive.

THE FACILITY DOESN'T OBEY THE LAWS OF SPACE

Explore shifting corridors, impossible rooms, and a non-Euclidean maze that treats basic geometry as a suggestion.

BREAK THINGS. IT'S YOUR FIRST DAY

Shatter select environments, blast apart destructible objects, and send physics props flying when subtlety fails.

DARKNESS IS PART OF THE PROBLEM

Switch between flashlights and night-vision goggles while managing limited power and deciding which horrors you would rather see.

BULLET TIME

Trigger bullet time to line up devastating shots, react to impossible situations

BUILT TO BE REPLAYED

Escape in a focused horror-action run, then return to face a different arrangement of threats, resources, and objectives.

WALLS ARE ONLY A SUGGESTION

Hear something moving on the other side? Don’t bother opening the door. Punch rounds through select walls and surfaces to hit whatever is lurking behind them.... before it gets a clean shot at you.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Panic! At the Jigsaw” is a cozy organizing simulator where you fit jigsaw puzzle pieces scattered across the floor to restore a painting. The countless puzzle pieces gradually transform into that famous painting that everyone has seen at least once.

Classic Jigsaw Puzzles

Puzzles of various sizes are available, ranging from easy to challenging.

(15 pieces, 50 pieces, 100 pieces, etc.)

Use the shape, color, and pattern of each piece to identify its correct position and fit it into place.

Perhaps starting with the edge pieces is the best strategy?

Useful Skills

Completing a puzzle unlocks new skills.

You can increase your carrying capacity to hold more pieces at once, or highlight the exact spot on the frame where your currently held piece belongs.

You will find strategic joy in combining steady, methodical progress with these powerful skills.

Famous Paintings

Mona Lisa, Girl with a Pearl Earring, Munch’s The Scream... etc.

Enjoy the satisfying process of watching these world-renowned masterpieces gradually come together.

Gameplay Features

You will feel a deep sense of accomplishment as you pick up countless pieces cluttering the floor one by one, place them into the frame, and watch the chaotic pile shrink.
There are no time limits or game-over screens. Just sit back, relax, and lose yourself in the quiet joy of assembling puzzles.

store_data.about_the_game:
Contest the Shared Battlefield

Both players act simultaneously on the same grid. Deploy Protocols with different shapes to claim territory, contest energy tiles, cut off enemy routes, or trigger reaction effects through encirclement and special formations. When scoring resolves, your effective coverage becomes your Tactical Score—and the score gap translates directly into hull damage against your opponent's mech. Every turn demands trade-offs: claim more ground, restrict your opponent's options, or save resources for the turns ahead.

Plan Every Protocol Placement

Protocols aren't traditional cards with damage, defense, or buff values—each one has a unique shape, grid footprint, energy cost, and deployment effect. The same Protocol can swing a battle or waste a turn depending on its orientation, placement, and relationship to your front line. Deckbuilding is no longer just comparing stats; it's about deciding where the next tile goes, which route to sever, and whether a short-term advantage is worth spending resources you'll need later.

Navigate Branching Runs

Choose your path through procedurally generated branching maps, encountering standard battles, elite fights, shops, rest sites, supply caches, and random events on your way to a chapter boss. Safe routes provide steady accumulation; high-risk nodes offer build-defining rewards. Every choice reshapes which Protocols, Components, and Supplies become available downstream.

Build Your Combat System

Acquire new Protocols throughout your run. Remove, modify, or fuse existing ones at shops, rest sites, and events. Combine Protocols with mech abilities, Component effects, and consumables to assemble a combat system tailored to the resources you've found this run. Commit to rapid low-cost chains, or lean into energy stacking, heavyweight Protocols, area denial, or defensive layering—there's no fixed answer, only the build that emerges from the run itself.

Master Every Mech and Run

Different mechs come with distinct abilities and starting Protocol affinities. The same Protocol pool can branch into entirely different strategies depending on which Components you equip. Push through blockaded zones under limited hull integrity and resources, adapt your deck on the fly, assess the risk, and take down the boss. Completing runs progressively unlocks new Protocol pools, Component slots, and build options—letting you explore even stronger, more distinctive tactical combinations.

Key Features

  • Turn-based tactics roguelike blending territory control with deckbuilding

  • Multi-tile Protocols deployed directly onto a shared battlefield

  • Rotation, placement, coverage, blockades, and encirclement

  • Procedurally branching routes with varied encounter nodes

  • Deep synergy between Protocols, Expansions, Components, and Supplies

  • Multiple tactical archetypes: rush, stack, denial, defense

  • Randomized rewards and enemy compositions for high replayability

  • A near-future corporate war story about technology, labor, and control

Setting

A near-future world dominated by megacorporations. In the race to militarize, corporations pushed automation hard enough to replace both laborers and soldiers — technology that demanded vast energy reserves and rare materials. The scramble for resources escalated into a corporate energy war, with mechs as its main instrument. Years after the fighting ended, military technology was repurposed for civilian production. But automation didn't make workers any safer — it only made them easier for corporations to replace and control. The war redrew corporate power, while the cost was still paid by the people who worked the line. You play a freelance technician scraping by across the city's lower sectors, repairing industrial equipment for a living. store_data.detailed_description:
Contest the Shared Battlefield

Both players act simultaneously on the same grid. Deploy Protocols with different shapes to claim territory, contest energy tiles, cut off enemy routes, or trigger reaction effects through encirclement and special formations. When scoring resolves, your effective coverage becomes your Tactical Score—and the score gap translates directly into hull damage against your opponent's mech. Every turn demands trade-offs: claim more ground, restrict your opponent's options, or save resources for the turns ahead.

Plan Every Protocol Placement

Protocols aren't traditional cards with damage, defense, or buff values—each one has a unique shape, grid footprint, energy cost, and deployment effect. The same Protocol can swing a battle or waste a turn depending on its orientation, placement, and relationship to your front line. Deckbuilding is no longer just comparing stats; it's about deciding where the next tile goes, which route to sever, and whether a short-term advantage is worth spending resources you'll need later.

Navigate Branching Runs

Choose your path through procedurally generated branching maps, encountering standard battles, elite fights, shops, rest sites, supply caches, and random events on your way to a chapter boss. Safe routes provide steady accumulation; high-risk nodes offer build-defining rewards. Every choice reshapes which Protocols, Components, and Supplies become available downstream.

Build Your Combat System

Acquire new Protocols throughout your run. Remove, modify, or fuse existing ones at shops, rest sites, and events. Combine Protocols with mech abilities, Component effects, and consumables to assemble a combat system tailored to the resources you've found this run. Commit to rapid low-cost chains, or lean into energy stacking, heavyweight Protocols, area denial, or defensive layering—there's no fixed answer, only the build that emerges from the run itself.

Master Every Mech and Run

Different mechs come with distinct abilities and starting Protocol affinities. The same Protocol pool can branch into entirely different strategies depending on which Components you equip. Push through blockaded zones under limited hull integrity and resources, adapt your deck on the fly, assess the risk, and take down the boss. Completing runs progressively unlocks new Protocol pools, Component slots, and build options—letting you explore even stronger, more distinctive tactical combinations.

  • Multi-tile Protocols deployed directly onto a shared battlefield

  • Rotation, placement, coverage, blockades, and encirclement

  • Procedurally branching routes with varied encounter nodes

  • Deep synergy between Protocols, Expansions, Components, and Supplies

store_data.about_the_game:
Hold the FengSui. Survive the frontier.

FrontierBallad is a survivor-style action game inspired by Tang frontier warfare and military culture. Choose a character and enter a battlefield that never stops moving. Dodge, dash, attack, and turn mid-battle upgrades into a build capable of breaking through the enemy tide.

Build a Tang-inspired combat style

Combine the MoDao, Tang Strong Crossbow, Fire Arrow, MingGuang Armor, Six-Flower Formation, Six Steeds, drums, and military tallies. Each option changes how you attack, protect yourself, summon support, or control space. Adapt your loadout to enemy density, elite threats, and the flow of each battle.

Defend more than your own life

Some encounters call you back to a FengSui beacon. Enemies can damage the structure directly, forcing you to balance survival with area defense. Hold the position for rewards; let the beacon fall or remain outside the defense zone for too long, and the mission can fail.

Carry progress between battles

Return to the armory to manage equipment, strengthen persistent abilities, complete achievements, and open new options for the next expedition.

Uncover military heritage through play

FuBing and MuBing, MoDao, MingGuang Armor, Six-Flower Formation, FengSui, JieDuShi, and other cultural elements appear as characters, skills, enemies, objectives, and cards. Revisit collected entries in the Heritage Library and connect the mechanics you use with the historical ideas that inspired them.

store_data.about_the_game:
Little Magic Fish Story is a pixel-art life sim and party-based action RPG. Crops you grow, meals you cook, fish you catch, and animal products you collect become supplies for the next expedition. Materials and equipment recovered from dungeons help your farm, skills, and party grow in return.

Live your days in Anyu Town

Till, sow, water, and harvest. Lay out barns and cooking stations, then turn each season's bounty into meals, quest items, and expedition supplies. Seasons, weather, and elemental changes you trigger affect crops, animals, gathering spots, and fishing waters. Life skills improve through use, while surplus goods earn the gold needed to expand the life you are building.

Command companions with distinct roles

Take quests from the Adventurers' Guild and fight alongside five companions. Queue movement, attack-move, and skill commands for individual party members as weak-point breaks, floating blade arrays, mana cycles, and dedicated support reshape each encounter.

Forge your own playstyle

Customize your character's appearance and history, then mix and match skills freely. Chain rapid melee attacks, unleash spells from afar, or find your own balance between offense and defense. Deepening bonds with townsfolk and companions unlocks skills they can teach, while gear affixes, skill specializations, and set bonuses shape a build of your own.

An adventure under your command

Direct your party with command-queue micro: kite, attack-move, and issue orders unit by unit. After the story is cleared, your companions will even organize dungeon runs on their own, gearing up from the Shared Chest to grow stronger — and you can join them anytime.

The seasons turn, and each brings its own harvest.

Different waters hide different fish. Weather can trigger Elemental Activation and push your yields beyond expectations.

A mystery in the Silent Forest

Life in Anyu Town is warm and busy, but a scorched device fragment whose serial number was deliberately erased proves that the disturbance in the Silent Forest is no ordinary monster outbreak. As the investigation deepens, the Little Magic Fish Adventurers follow a trail left by Sandao Tech, while each companion must weigh the so-called optimal choice against the reasons that truly matter to them.

Current Demo Content

- Several hours of main story content covering farming, shipping, cooking, fishing, and triggering elemental changes in the environment.

- Animal raising and the Boss Gauntlet as optional activities.

- Life skills that improve through use and can reach level 10.

- Affection and gift-giving, including the first two tiers of skills taught by NPCs.

- An Adventurers' Guild quest board with hunt and collection quests.

- Five Silent Forest dungeons, each culminating in a boss battle.

- First-clear equipment, random drops, set bonuses, and special gear affixes.

- All five adventurers introduced, with their daily lives and expeditions continuing after the Demo story.

Bring your daily life into adventure, and bring adventure home.
Add the game to your wishlist and play the Demo.

store_data.about_the_game:
Take a Spear and Enter the Underwater World

Carefully close the distance, line up your aim, and strike with your spear. Experience the tension of first-person spearfishing and the satisfaction of returning to the surface with your catch safely secured.

Study the Behavior of Each Fish

Every species behaves differently. Some swim in schools, some defend territories among the rocks, and others hide beneath the sand or in secluded shelters. Approach carelessly and they may become alert and escape. Observe how they move and where they live, then adapt your strategy to each target.

Prepare for an Ever-Changing Sea

Water temperature, turbidity, and wave conditions never remain the same. As the seasons progress, the marine environment changes, affecting visibility and diving conditions even within familiar fishing grounds. Manage your oxygen and body temperature carefully—and know when it is time to return to land.

Choose the Right Equipment

Spears, spear tips, fins, wetsuits, and lights each offer different advantages. Dive deeper, close the distance more effectively, or retain body heat in colder waters. Prepare the right equipment for your destination and target species, and develop a spearfishing style of your own.

Bring Home Your Catch and Explore New Waters

Sell the fish you catch at the harbor or deliver them to fulfill requests. Use your earnings to purchase new equipment and fishing permits that unlock additional fishing grounds. Fish brought back safely are recorded in your encyclopedia. Explore different seas and continue your search for species you have yet to encounter.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dungeoneers Idle is an endless idle RPG about building a party, not steering one.

Assemble a team from twelve hero classes, hand them skills and gear, and send them into procedurally generated dungeons. Combat resolves itself, while you make the decisions that actually matter: who goes, what they carry, which skills they bring, and when to reset everything for a stronger start. Early on you make those calls manually. Later, you buy the automation that makes them for you.

It keeps going when you don't. Close the game, come back tomorrow, and the party will have been working for you. Real offline progress, leveling up, equipping gear, clearing dungeons and much more.

It doesn't run out. Hero levels have no cap, the depths keep scaling as fast as your party does, and every prestige measures you against your own deepest run rather than a fixed target. This is an idler built for months, not for an evening.

Build a party, then let it work

  • Twelve hero classes — Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Cleric, Ranger, Pyromancer, Druid, Necromancer, Barbarian, Ninja, Electromancer and Bard. Five are yours from the start.

  • Hand-authored skills, unlocked and levelled with gold. Each hero carries only two (at first) into a dungeon, so a loadout is a real decision rather than a checklist.

  • Start with room for two heroes and earn your way to four.

Dungeons that build themselves

  • Five dungeon types — Crypt, Cave, Fortress, Temple and Frost — generated fresh every time, each with its own themed enemies.

  • An overworld of eight biomes to push outward through, from plains and forest to volcanic wastes.

  • Combat with status effects, elites, bosses and summoned minions.

Loot worth sorting

  • Five rarity tiers with rolled stat pools, Common through Legendary.

  • Special effects that change how a hero fights: on-hit status procs, passive regeneration, area-of-effect, last stand at low health and more.

  • Loot filters and auto-equip rules you unlock and configure, so sorting stops being your job.

Automate yourself out of a job

The dungeoneering runs itself from the first minute. Your party explores, fights and hauls loot home whether you are watching or not.

The managing doesn't, though. Not at first. Early on you level your heroes by hand, spend their attribute points, pick their gear and decide what's worth keeping. Then you start buying that work away. Auto-level, auto-attributes, auto-skill-levelling, auto-equip, loot filters: every one of them is a job you do for the last time.

Progress that carries over

  • Gold replaces experience. Everything the party earns is also everything you spend.

  • Prestige when the depth stops giving, and convert the run into permanent progress.

  • A branching meta tree with themed branches and one for every class: automation, economy, alchemy, party size and more.

  • Multiple potions to unlock, collect and use.

No finish line

Dungeoneers Idle is an infinite idler. Hero levels are uncapped, dungeon depth stops scaling politely and starts compounding, and there is no last dungeon waiting at the end of it.

Plenty of idle games are built to be finished over a weekend. This one is built to still be handing you decisions months from now.

Idle on your terms

  • Buy it once. No microtransactions and no premium currency.

  • Offline progress. The simulation catches up on the time you were away.

  • Playable with the mouse alone. No timed input anywhere in the game.

  • Three named save slots.

Dungeoneers Idle asks for a few minutes of decisions and gives you back the rest of the day.

You have no fixed form. What you refine will shape what you become.

LIANYAO: The Formless One is a first-person deckbuilding roguelite inspired by Chinese folklore and strange tales of the wild.

Venture into haunted mountains, confront beasts, spirits, and corrupted creatures, and refine the souls of defeated monsters into powers of your own.

But refining a monster does more than give you another card.

The powers you choose will gradually shape what you become.

Turn Your Enemies' Powers Into Your Own

The monsters you fight are the source of your build.

Defeat different creatures, claim their souls, and refine their signature abilities into skills you can use yourself.

Different enemies open different combat directions: defensive retaliation, relentless pursuit, rapid multi-hit attacks, and stranger powers drawn from corrupted spirits and demons.

Rather than assembling a pre-made archetype, your deck grows from the creatures you encounter and the abilities you choose to take from them.

Let Your Build Shape Your Form

Your abilities determine more than how you fight — they gradually transform you.

As you continue refining different kinds of power, new supernatural forms begin to emerge, reinforcing the combat style you have built throughout the run.

You do not choose a fixed class at the beginning of an expedition.

What you eventually become depends on which creatures you encounter, which powers you refine, and how you combine them.

You do not choose a build first and search for the right cards.

Your build takes shape naturally through the act of refining monsters.

Take Shape Anew on Every Expedition

Every journey into the mountains brings a new combination of battles, events, blessings, relics, and monster souls.

Sometimes you will find the core of your build early. Other times, a newly acquired power may push you in an entirely different direction.

Adapt to what the expedition gives you, combine abilities and relics into powerful interactions, and gradually complete a combat style unique to that run.

There is no single path to follow.

What you encounter, what you refine, and what you leave behind will determine the shape of each expedition.

Face the Creatures of a Strange Eastern Wilderness

Enter battle from a first-person perspective and confront creatures inspired by Chinese folklore, mountain legends, and tales of wandering spirits.

Observe enemy intentions, balance offense and defense, and find openings through careful combinations of abilities.

Wild beasts are only the beginning.

As you travel deeper into the mountains, familiar creatures begin to change, unnatural forces spread through the wilderness, and far more dangerous beings reveal themselves.

Defeat them.

Refine them.

Then carry their power deeper into the unknown.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every scarce essential has two values: what a desperate customer will pay for it — and what it could do for you after dark.

RUN THE SHOP BY HAND

Order stock, carry the crates in from the supplier's truck, and place every item on the shelf yourself. Set your own prices, then work the register and close the sale.

SELL — OR SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Gas, batteries, water, food and medicine sell well. They're also what keeps the bunker under your shop warm, lit and stocked. When the shutters close, you live on what you didn't sell — and hunger, thirst and freezing nights are all waiting for one bad call.

LISTEN TO THE RADIO

The radio is your only source of news — and it runs on batteries. Droughts, fuel crises, incoming storms — if it moves the market, you hear it on the radio first. Listen closely and you stock up before the crisis hits; miss it, and yesterday's profit becomes today's shortage.

FILL THE CONTRACTS

Customers pin order lists to the contract board. Gather what they ask for and deliver it — in return you get paid, and you receive parts you won't find anywhere else. Those parts unlock new systems for your shop.

REBUILD THE LAST STASH

Repair the workbench and start crafting scarce goods like medkits yourself. Keep the generator running, install new shelves — bring the shop back piece by piece. And that covered bench in the corner... its turn will come.

You can sell everything. Surviving the night is another matter.

store_data.about_the_game:
You died in the tower. Again.


An apprentice mage is trapped in a tower that resets every death — but never takes back what you
earned. Unlocked floors stay unlocked. Banked gold stays banked. Only your run ends.

Survive each floor, kill the floor boss, climb. Then do it better.

You only move. The spells handle themselves.


No attack button. You dodge, position, and choose — the tower does the rest.

  • Pick 1 of 3 on every level up: a new element, an upgrade, or a stat
  • Survive the timer and the floor boss appears — beat it to climb
  • Every 10th floor is a gate boss with its own signature attack pattern and a hard time limit

8 elements. Only 4 per run.


  • Fire — AoE on impact, then burn
  • Ice — multi-shot and slow, freezing at higher levels
  • Lightning — arcs between enemies with huge damage variance
  • Poison — leaves toxic pools that stack
  • Earth — instant AoE under the target, with petrify
  • Wind — no projectile at all; whirlwinds hunt enemies down
  • Light — heals, shields, and a holy nova
  • Dark — a black hole that pulls, curses, then implodes

Light and Dark are spirit contracts — you may carry only one of them.

Matching elements fire synergies on their own: Melt, Venom Burst, Overload, Shatter, Judgement,
and Wind-carried storms that spread another element across the floor.

Awakenings — the real build decision


Push an element deep and it awakens twice: a passive at Lv4 that rewrites your normal attack, and
an ultimate at Lv8 that fires by itself. 8 elements x 2 stages = 16 awakenings.

You only ever hold 4 elements. Deciding what to abandon is the game.

Growth that survives death


  • 35 relics — elites drop a choice of 3, but you carry only 3 per run. Opposites never appear together
  • 14 artifacts — permanent, bought only with coins that gate bosses drop. Gold cannot buy them. They change the rules: piercing shots, orbiting orbs, revival — and they upgrade
  • 14 engravings and 4 spirit contracts — long-term specialization between runs
  • 4 spirit creatures that fight beside you, each with its own bond and role
  • 5 seal tiers — replay cleared floors under harsher rules for a better leaderboard crest
  • 73 titles — earned through deaths, conquests, depth, and broken seals

The Abyss


An endless descent that opens as you climb — a floor boss drops in on a timer, and every fifth
depth pays an artifact coin. How far down can you go before it buries you?

Included, not sold separately


The Steam version has no ads and no in-app purchases. All 16 mage skins and 15 creature
skins are unlocked as part of the game.

Leaderboard


Ranked by highest floor first, then by Abyss depth. Your crest reflects the seals you have broken.
The whole game is playable offline — the leaderboard is there when you want it.

Controls


WASD or arrow keys to move. Attacks are automatic. P to pause, M to mute.
New here? How to Play on the title screen is a five-page illustrated guide.

Welcome to the “The Midnight 21” Night Lounge

There’s no better way to spend a Saturday night than alone in a night lounge filled with wine, coffee, and also… blackjack?

A night full of blackjack and not just blackjack

Play classic blackjack, just as you know it. And what exactly is at stake? Only the most valuable thing of all.

After some time playing blackjack, you’ll have another task: figuring out whether anything has changed. This night lounge is far from ordinary. Things often go missing, sometimes it’s as quiet as the grave, and other times, something appears that absolutely shouldn’t be there—and that must always be reported to the lounge management!

Do you dare to make it through the entire night and manage to “not lose”? Good luck.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Strike With Everything at Stake


In Mile High Walkout, you play as Rowan Petrak, a veteran Nimbus Air purser and elected president of the Cabin Crew Federation's Local 14. Three years ago, he convinced 4,200 crew members to accept a Bridge Agreement that saved jobs while leaving unpaid time uncounted. Now the contract has expired, the membership has walked out at midnight, and 200,000 stranded passengers are demanding answers.

Across twenty-four volatile days, hold the strike together through public pressure, media framing, negotiation, financial hardship, and divisions inside the membership. Your choices shape Rowan's credibility, the future of Local 14, and one of three romance routes.

Meet the Cast



Noelle Auger — The Room
A top crisis strategist hired by Nimbus Air to win the public fight and neutralize or flip Rowan. Noelle reads every room, applies pressure with precision, and blurs the line between professional strategy and personal interest.


Meredith Lowry — The Table
The National Conciliation Service's senior conciliator is calm, experienced, and bound by strict neutrality. Any private contact with Rowan risks her professional code and career.


Rae Villanueva — The Armband
A 26-year-old cabin crew member working two jobs and facing eviction, Rae becomes Rowan's strike captain. Their mentor-and-mentee dynamic changes as she grows into a public leader in her own right.

Key Features

  • Three distinct romance routes built around different power dynamics, with one pivotal choice.
  • Lead a collective strike as an elected representative whose mandate can disappear overnight.
  • Navigate public opinion, media framing, financial pressure, and negotiation.
  • Experience grounded conflicts involving unpaid time, food banks, strike funds, rosters, and exhaustion.
  • Reach multiple endings shaped by romance, leadership choices, and what the membership believes.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.
