store_data.about_the_game:
Draw a ladder. Get a noodle.

You draw what you need on a 32-pixel grid. A neural network inside the game looks at it and decides what you meant.

It is not very good at this.

That is the game

The game never checks what you drew — it checks what the thing can do. You need something to stand on: a bench works, a couch works, an anvil works, and so, it turns out, does the noodle.

So when your careful ladder arrives as a hot dog, the question stops being how do I draw a better ladder and becomes what can I do with a hot dog. The answer is usually: something.

Every stage has at least three ways through. It has to — the game cannot assume you got the object you asked for.

100 objects, all with opinions

Every object you use is something you drew a moment ago. It arrives with its own weight, its own physics and its own uses.

  • Ladder — throw it and it locks where it lands. Climb it, or bridge a gap with it

  • Anvil — heavy. Pins a pressure plate, and you can stand on it

  • Watermelon — explodes on impact when thrown, or on a one-second fuse if you set it down

  • Umbrella — a grappling hook. Swing from a ceiling

  • Leaf — let go of it and it rises instead of falling

  • Boomerang — flies straight, ignores gravity, and comes back

You will get some of these on purpose.

Ink

Drawing big costs ink, and the price climbs faster than the size does. The tank refills slowly. So: a bridge all the way across the gap, or one small platform to jump from? Worth thinking about before you spend half a tank on something that comes out as a pretzel.

What's in it

  • 25 stages across five caves

  • 100 drawable objects, each with its own behaviour and its own uses

  • 21 achievements, most of them for solving something the stupid way

  • Two-player co-op — room code or Steam friend invite. One ink tank between you.

  • A stage editor, and Steam Workshop to trade what you build

  • English, 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский

The model runs on your machine

Recognition ships inside the game. No account, no API key, no server, no waiting. The only place a drawing ever travels is your co-op partner's screen.

A small robot announces each drawing out loud as it appears. Sometimes it hedges. It should hedge more.

"Ah. Couch. Obviously." — on being shown a bench

Music by Kevin MacLeod , licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0.
Doodle recognition trained on the Quick, Draw! Dataset by Google Creative Lab, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
Full license notices are in the game: Esc → Credits.

store_data.about_the_game:
Femboy & Futa Maidmare is a story-driven psychological horror visual novel set during the night shift of an old neon-lit motel.

What starts as a simple job quickly becomes something much stranger.

Meet the motel staff, complete your nightly duties, explore different parts of the building, and make choices that shape your relationships and the way events unfold.

At first, the motel seems quiet.

Then small things begin to feel wrong.

A room looks different from the way you remember it.

A conversation doesn’t match what happened before.

A familiar hallway suddenly feels unfamiliar.

The longer the night continues, the harder it becomes to decide what is real — and who you can trust.

Survive the Night Shift

Femboy & Futa Maidmare combines character-driven visual novel storytelling with psychological horror, mystery, dark humor, and mature themes.

Each shift brings new conversations, new situations, and new reasons to question what is really happening inside the motel.

Build relationships with the staff, uncover hidden sides of the people around you, and decide how far you are willing to go when the motel starts pushing back.

Your choices can influence how characters react to you, which scenes you encounter, and what parts of the story you discover.

Some decisions bring you closer to the truth.

Others may leave you wishing you had never looked.

Features

  • Story-driven psychological horror visual novel

  • Fully first-person presentation

  • Dialogue choices and branching interactions

  • Relationship-focused character routes

  • Mystery and supernatural elements

  • Multiple motel locations explored through story scenes

  • Neon-inspired 2D anime visual style

  • Dark humor mixed with psychological tension

  • Adult themes and mature character relationships

  • Different outcomes based on your decisions

Your shift starts after dark.

Choose who to trust, uncover what the motel is hiding, and try not to lose your grip on what’s real before morning comes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism.

Investigate Objects

A mysterious atmosphere shrouds Manwoldang. Inspecting objects will lead you to puzzles, memories of the past, or even the severed facial features of the dead...

Witness Past Memories

Awaken your spiritual senses and channel the consciousness of the deceased. Unraveling these lingering memories will guide you toward the end of your journey.

Solve Puzzles and Minigames

Hide from the Mudang. Evade deadly threats. Pretend nothing is amiss—a child should be fast asleep at night. The greater the risks you take, the closer you get to the truth.

A Story Rooted in History

Yeommae is inspired by the historical record of Yeommae Godok (염매고독, 魘魅蠱毒), found in the Seongho Saseol (《성호사설》 제5권 〈만물문〉) from the Joseon Dynasty.

Back then, this forbidden dark sorcery was strictly outlawed by the royal court.

To escape a merciless famine, twin sisters set foot inside a shaman's house. As the heavy gates slam shut, their tragedy is set in motion.

Untangle the twisted threads of fate and bring light to the darkness of Manwoldang.

Deliver under pressure. Survive the chaos. Laugh through the mess.

store_data.about_the_game:
Type Your Way Into the Dungeon

Dungeon Typist is a typing-driven dungeon roguelite.

Type the words on the floor to move, type the word at an enemy’s position to attack, and enter commands to use abilities.

Every word you type becomes an action.

Typing Is Combat

Every tile in the dungeon is tied to a word.

Close in on enemies, find the right angle to attack, or retreat before danger reaches you. Typing speed matters, but choosing the right word matters just as much.

Read the situation, pick your target, and type your next move.

Enemies Won’t Wait

Combat happens in real time. Enemies keep moving, chasing, and attacking.

Fight while retreating, wait for enemies to enter your range, or interrupt them at the last moment.

The faster you type, the more room you have to act.

Build Your Fighting Style

Find different weapons, armor, footwear, and active abilities during each run.

Extend your attack range, change how you move, strike multiple enemies, or turn a dangerous situation around with the right ability.

Different equipment changes how you fight and helps shape your build.

Venture Deeper

Explore different rooms, face enemies and bosses with unique behaviors, collect rewards, and strengthen your build along the way.

Use typing, positioning, and equipment combinations to find a way through.

Type faster. Think faster. Go deeper.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tile Blast

Welcome to Tile Blast, a relaxing yet highly addictive block puzzle game that challenges your strategy and decision-making skills.

Place colorful blocks on the board, complete lines to clear them, and keep the playing field open for as long as possible. Every move matters, and a single mistake can quickly fill the board. Plan ahead, think strategically, and aim for the highest score.

Whether you're looking for a quick break or hours of satisfying gameplay, Tile Blast offers a simple experience that's easy to learn but difficult to master.

But there’s more than just solo play…

Duel Mode - Face Off Against Real Players

Think you’ve mastered the board? In Duel Mode, you go head-to-head with another player in real time. Every move becomes a battle of wits, where one smart placement can turn the tide and one mistake can seal your defeat.

Outplay your opponent, block their strategy, and survive longer to claim victory. The pressure rises with every turn, and only the most focused players will dominate the arena.

Are you ready to prove you're better than the rest?

Key Features

  • Endless block puzzle gameplay

  • Real-time Duel Mode against other players

  • Easy to learn, challenging to master

  • No time limits - play at your own pace

  • Smooth and satisfying line-clearing mechanics

  • Clean visuals and relaxing atmosphere

  • Track your best scores and challenge yourself

  • Optimized for both short sessions and long playtimes

Test Your Strategy

Success in Tile Blast isn't just about placing blocks - it's about planning several moves ahead. Manage your space carefully, create opportunities for large clears, and see how long you can survive.

In Duel Mode, every decision becomes a weapon. One clever move can trap your opponent… or leave you with nowhere to go.

Can you set a new high score, defeat real players, and become a true Tile Blast master?

store_data.about_the_game:
A DOG DAYCARE. YOUR FRIENDS. ONE MOP.

Kennel Chaos is a co-op simulator about being the people who actually do the work. No staff menu, no spreadsheet. You're the one holding the scoop. Bring your friends, split the jobs, and watch the plan survive roughly ten minutes.

THE DOGS ARE THE CHALLENGE

Twenty-one breeds and every one of them has a habit:

· The Escape Artist is testing every gate right now. She will find the one you forgot.

· The Sneaky Pooper waits until you're facing the other way, and picks a corner.

· The Shaker waits until it's out of the tub and next to you.

· Zoomies doesn't care what's in the way, including you.

· Rolls In It has already found the mess you were about to clean.

· The Poop Eater solves that problem in the worst possible way.

YOU CAN CARRY ONE THING

A dog, or a tool. Never both. Tools live on the racks you bought and put somewhere. So "somewhere" turns out to be a decision you'll think about a lot, usually while jogging back across the building holding a wriggling beagle.

SMALL PROBLEMS COMPOUND

A fresh poop takes two seconds to scoop. Ignore it and somebody walks through it. Now there are paw prints down the corridor. Ignore those and they dry, and dried needs a scrub. This is how a nice afternoon becomes a Code Brown.

BUILD THE PLACE FIRST

Start with an empty building and a small pile of money. Buy runs, tubs, grooming tables, food prep, play equipment. Paint the walls. Hang wallpaper. Put a clock up. Then open the doors and find out which of your decisions were stupid.

THEN PAY FOR ALL OF IT

Takings in, upkeep out, stars up or down depending on whether every dog actually got what its care card promised. Spend what's left before bed. Do it again tomorrow, but with more dogs.

FEATURES

· 1–8 player online co-op. It is significantly funnier with friends

· 21 dog breeds with traits that genuinely change your day

· A mess system with actual consequences => fresh, stepped in, tracked, dried

· Build and decorate your own daycare, room by room

· First-person, hands-on, no menus doing the work for you

· Dogs that are extremely good and extremely bad at the same time

store_data.about_the_game:
The hotel is closed for the winter. You have the keys.

A seaside hotel on a coast nobody comes to between October and March. The owner is away until spring. Her rules are pinned above the desk in her own handwriting: no guests, no exceptions, the boiler runs at four. The season has an instalment to make and the boiler eats oil, so an empty house is not safe — it is bankrupt. The first thing this game tells you is that obeying the rules loses.

Then somebody knocks.

Off the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking, and a reason they would rather not give. Nobody comes to this coast in winter without one. You can ask — but you are a stranger behind a desk at night, and every question you ask is one they now know you wanted answered.

You decide who gets a key. And which room.

Four answers, and none of them is yes or no.
  • Give a key. They are in the house tonight. Their money is in the box, and so is whatever came with them.
  • Refuse. The last bus has gone. Refusing costs something, sometimes before morning.
  • Give a particular room. The one that matters.
  • Take the money and leave the night out of the book. The cash is yours, not the house's — and the register never says they were here.

The rooms are not interchangeable, and the house teaches you that slowly.

3 looks over the road — you can see who arrives, and so can they. 7 and 8 share a wall, so whoever sleeps in them hears each other. 12 is the only room with a line out. 19 is top floor, at the end, where nobody hears anything at all. A refusal is one bit of information. A room is a sentence: the man who asked about the road went in 19, and the woman who kept looking at the door went in 12, so she could call someone.

A full house is bad.

You cannot take every night's money and stay safe, and you cannot turn everyone away and stay solvent. Cash is the currency of danger — the more a stranger pays, the more it is worth asking why. And the rules above the desk are not stupid and they are not right. They are what somebody wrote in September about a February she will not be here for.

The register remembers, and so does room 24.

Pages are missing from the book on the desk. The town's list and the register disagree about who was here last winter, and the disagreement is legible if you keep both. The board still has the key to 24 — the previous caretaker's room. You can open it on the first night. What is in there does not stop the season; it changes how you read every knock after it.

What's inside

  • A season of nights — arrivals, rooms, money, and the morning the ledger closes.
  • A hotel you walk — the desk, the corridor, the rooms you let, in cold painted first person.
  • Guests who stay — a key given is a key out. The board fills up, and the quiet room may already be holding someone.
  • Consequences that arrive late — what you let in comes back at the house, not at the guest.
  • A thread you assemble rather than solve — the register, the town's list, and the room nobody has opened since last winter.
  • One season, one thread — it closes the way it was always going to close, and what changes is the last page of the register: who wrote it, and what they left out.
  • No death, no failure that erases a run. You get dismissed, or the season ends with a room you never opened.

content_descriptors.notes: The Off-Season is a psychological horror game written for adult players. It is set in a closed seaside hotel in winter, and its pressure comes from isolation, unease and moral compromise rather than from anything shown on screen. You play the caretaker: you decide who is given a room, and you can take a guest's payment without entering the night in the register, which is a theft from the hotel's owner. The season's single thread concerns the previous caretaker and what he left out of that same book. Settings are bleak and dark and some scenes are meant to be frightening. The game contains no violence, no gore, no blood, no on-screen death, no sexual content and no nudity, and there is no fail state in which anyone is killed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the World of Street Racing

Motor Sport Unbounded is an open-world arcade racing game that captures the spirit of classic street racers from the early 2000s while combining them with modern visuals and smooth, accessible gameplay.

Explore a sprawling nighttime city, discover new races, unlock cars, customize and upgrade them, and climb your way to the top of the Street Crown leaderboard.

Features

  • A large open-world nighttime city to explore.

  • A story-driven career featuring comic-style cutscenes and SMS conversations.

  • The Street Crown ranking system with 15 unique bosses.

  • A wide variety of race types:

  • Circuit

  • Sprint

  • Checkpoint

  • Drag

  • Drift

  • Speed Trap

  • Time Trial

  • Elimination

  • Highway Battle

and many more.

Arcade driving physics inspired by the golden era of street racing games.

Deep visual vehicle customization.

Upgrade your engine, transmission, suspension, and brakes.

Multiple vehicle classes.

A dynamic messaging system that drives the story forward.

A vibrant nighttime city filled with neon lights and atmosphere.

Become Number One

Every victory brings you one step closer to the top of the Street Crown leaderboard.

But the road to the top is filled with more than just fast rivals. Betrayal, loss, risk, and revenge await those determined to reclaim what was taken from them.

Defeat all 15 bosses, reclaim your car, and prove that you deserve to become the new king of Street Crown.

store_data.about_the_game:
Snap. Build. Repeat.

Pick a shape and start placing tiles. Bring one near another and it pulls into
place with a satisfying click — edge to edge, perfectly aligned, every time.
There's no wrong way to put them together.

An endless canvas

The board never runs out. Zoom in and your tiles are stitched patchwork; zoom
out and the whole thing becomes a mosaic. Build something small and neat, or
keep going until it fills the screen and then some.

Three shapes to build with

  • Hexagons tile together like a honeycomb
  • Triangles alternate point-up and point-down
  • Diamonds lock into a lattice
Each puzzle uses one shape, so every piece always fits.

Color it your way

Cycle through color schemes as you build, or open the color wheel — shaped like
whichever tile you're using — and pick any shade you like. Painted the wrong
one? Recolor tiles you've already placed.

Nothing to lose

No timers. No scores. No levels to fail. Nothing chases you and nothing runs
out. Left click and right click do exactly the same thing, so younger builders
never have to remember which is which — and undo is always one key away.

Your work saves itself

Every puzzle saves as you go. Come back later and pick up exactly where you
left off, or keep as many separate builds as you like.

Made for younger builders

Simple enough for small hands, calm enough to lose an hour in at any age.

store_data.about_the_game:
TimeKov is a third-person survival action game set on the unknown planet Ananke, where time is your life.

Prepare for each expedition from the safety of your base, then step outside the protective barrier to explore dangerous areas while your remaining time continues to decrease. Fight hostile creatures, gather resources, collect time energy, and decide when to return before your core runs out.

The resources you bring back can be stored, processed, and converted through your factory. Build and operate production facilities to craft charge kits, core upgrade materials, energy resources, and spaceship repair parts. Every successful return strengthens your base, expands your factory, and prepares you for deeper expeditions.

Time is not just a limit. It is your survival resource, your energy source, and the key to completing your mission on Ananke.

Key Features

- Third-person survival action where time is your life

- Explore dangerous areas and return before your remaining time runs out

- Real-time melee combat using combo attacks, skills, dashes, and stamina management

- Fight normal monsters, elite enemies, and regional bosses

- Gather resources and time energy during expeditions

- Process recovered materials through factory facilities and production recipes

- Craft charge kits, core upgrade materials, energy resources, and spaceship repair parts

- Upgrade your core to improve survival time, recovery, and exploration potential

- Expand your base and factory to reach more dangerous and distant areas

- A risk-and-reward loop built around exploration, combat, production, and returning alive

Hope, more than this vessel's name, it's a reminder not to give up. Humanity needs us to push through the debauched trials ahead. As reality gives way to an intoxicating mist, one goal remains: FILL THE ENGINES. Easy enough, if not for the fact that the only fuel source on board is your semen.

As the only man aboard, only you can ensure the mission's success. Fortunately, your coworkers are here to help , and with humankind on the line, they're prepared to give it their all. Getting home isn't about luck anymore. It's about how far you are all willing to go behind locked doors.

                                                                                         Meet the Crew


  • Arianna (left): The commanding captain who kept you alive long before this voyage started, now forced to choose between strict protocol and survival.

  • Kathlyn (right): The crew’s fearless prodigy scientist whose radical discovery holds the key to the engines... if you're willing to help her run the experiments.

A Living, Evolving Vessel 

Roam freely from the high-tech bridge down to private quarters and steamy bathrooms. Track the crew across dynamic daily routines that shift as your relationships deepen and as The hope warps to the constraints of the mist; unlocking new areas and collapsing social boundaries.


Escalating Intimacy 

Engage in progressively lewd scenes where patience and boldness yield vastly different rewards. All hands on deck to fill the critical fuel cells.


Search for Secrets

Scour the decks for spicy photos, rare collectibles, and hidden erotic opportunities. Mist-induced delusions or not, they're worth every second.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stay on the path, Little Red.

A liminal fairy-tale anomaly horror game.

You are Little Red, journeying through a cursed forest to deliver a basket of goodies to Grandma’s cottage. But the woods don't seem to end. The trails loop, and the area grows more oppressive with every step. Worst of all, something is watching you.

The Rules of the Woods

Look carefully at your surroundings before you commit.

If everything appears normal, press forward.

store_data.about_the_game:
You’ve accidentally transmigrated into another world, only to find the Demon King’s army already at the city gates. Despite being hailed as the "Hero," you possess no special cheats or overpowered abilities; your only recourse is to rely on the command skills you honed in past video games to lead a motley crew of unreliable locals in the city's defense.

Unreliable Teammates: There are hardly any seasoned warriors here—most are just random adventurers and villagers pressed into service. Don't count on them for consistency; it’s perfectly normal for them to wander off for a smoke or a spot of fishing mid-battle, or to unleash skills that blast friend and foe alike.

Then again... are the locals here a bit *too* strong?

Unreliable Gear: Most of the village's equipment was crafted by a legendary dwarven master smith and possesses incredible, magical power. However, because the smith could only see the bottom half of the forging manual, the gear is... quirky, to say the least. Shoes that make you run backward, a longsword that heals the target you strike... who knows if these things are actually usable?

Staring at this bizarre, chaotic assortment of oddities, our new Hero asks the question that cuts straight to the soul:

"Can we actually win?"

Welcome to the Nude Cafe — where tomorrow never comes, and today is yours to control.

You are trapped in a 24-hour time loop at an isolated retro-futuristic diner in the middle of the desert. The staff, the guests, the locals — everyone lives by a strict, unchanging schedule. Every minute is predictable, every action is destined to repeat.

But you have one ultimate weapon: you remember everything.

This is not a traditional adult game; it’s a time-manipulation sandbox. The setting stays the same, but the rules are entirely yours to break.

THE BUTTERFLY EFFECT Here, there is no random AI behavior. Every character follows a 100% deterministic routine. Your goal is to find the cracks in their perfect day. What happens if you wake up to your alarm and decide not to visit the waitress in her trailer for your usual morning "routine"? She gets mad, refuses to show up for her shift, and the entire diner's ecosystem collapses. A stolen key, a broken spark plug on a motorcycle, a deliberate power outage behind the bar — one tiny sabotage triggers a massive cascade of new events, forcing NPCs into hidden scenarios and unlocking highly explicit encounters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pickup Point Chaos is a first-person parcel pickup point management simulator.

Receive a constant flow of packages, scan them to generate pickup codes, sort them onto the shelves, and find the right parcel before your customers lose patience. As packages pile up and the line gets longer, can you keep your pickup point under control?

  • Receive, Scan, Organize

Packages of all shapes and sizes arrive at your pickup point in batches every day.

Scan each package, generate its pickup code, and place it on the shelves according to its number and location. Make good use of your limited storage space and leave room for the next delivery—the better organized you are, the easier it will be to find each parcel later.

  • Find the Right Parcel—Fast

Customers will arrive at the counter to collect their packages.

Check their pickup information, locate the correct parcel among shelves packed with boxes, and complete the handover as quickly as possible. Your speed, accuracy, and customer waiting times will all affect customer satisfaction and your results for the day.

  • Carry More, Risk More

You can carry several packages at once by stacking them in your arms.

Place the larger boxes at the bottom and the smaller ones on top, then move carefully. Sudden stops, sharp turns, and sprinting will make the entire stack wobble. Stack them too high or move too quickly, and the boxes on top may come crashing down.

  • Handle Special Packages with Care

Regular packages are only the beginning. You will also handle fragile, flammable, refrigerated, frozen, high-value, and liquid-filled packages, each requiring a different approach.

Fragile items cannot withstand a fall, refrigerated and frozen packages cannot be left out for too long, and dangerous packages may even explode after a heavy impact.

One careless move could cost you more than a single parcel.

  • Get Through a Chaotic Day

New packages arrive in batches while the line of waiting customers continues to grow. You will need to switch quickly between receiving, scanning, organizing, finding, and handing over parcels while deciding what to deal with first.

At the end of the day, your completed orders, earnings, customer satisfaction, and damaged packages will determine your final rating.

Scan. Shelve. Find. Deliver.

And try not to blow up the pickup point.

store_data.about_the_game:
Luna wakes up in an unfamiliar base.

Inside, life is peaceful. She eats, sorts her gear, and prepares for the next expedition. Outside, however, abandoned facilities, forgotten belongings, and dangerous creatures await.

TunaSweeper is a top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions into the outside world.

Head Out, Loot, and Make It Back

Explore different areas outside the base, search for useful supplies, and fight off enemies along the way.

Choose what equipment to bring before heading out, then decide what is worth taking home once you're in the field. You can risk staying longer to fill your inventory, or return early to protect what you've already found.

What you bring, what you take, and when you decide to head back all matter.

Life Goes On Back at the Base

Make it home safely, sort through what you've collected, and prepare for your next expedition.

Spend time with the others who live at the base, or simply take a moment to rest. Unlike the dangerous world outside, life at the base moves at a quiet, relaxed pace.

Combat and exploration are only part of TunaSweeper. Making it home safely and returning to everyday life is just as important.

Discover the World at Your Own Pace

The game won't tell you everything about this world or what happened to it from the start.

Old facilities, strange machinery, forgotten objects, and subtle changes in your surroundings gradually reveal more about the world as Luna explores it.

Key Features

  • Top-down PvE shooting combat

  • Exploration, looting, and inventory management

  • Venture into dangerous areas and return safely to your base

  • Peaceful everyday life between expeditions

  • Cute, stylized 3D visuals

  • A world that gradually reveals itself through exploration and environmental details

In epic, colorful battles, play as little Piou and put an end to Midas's reign. And don't fear Death — she'll be your only ally, at least as long as you keep paying her enough.

Game Features

  • A playable cartoon — Hand-drawn backdrops, characters animated cartoon-style: every showdown plays out on a vivid canvas that Midas is busy turning to gold.

  • Dodge, jump, strike back — Attacks rain down from above, sweep across the floor and cut clean through the arena. A dash, wall jumps and wall slides are your only defense.

  • Several bosses per run — Bringing Midas down isn't enough. Every run pits you against a succession of foes, each craftier than the last.

  • Stack the odds — From one run to the next, upgrade the Death's Gambit itself: its draws, its prices, and what it deigns to put on display.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the year 19XX, a disgraced TV executive places a bounty on his head before retreating to his personal fortress. The attempts made to claim this bounty are broadcast in the most explosive game-show on television: CA$H CLAMOR

Clamor: Bounty Hunter Pinball is an arcade game that has you battle your way through waves of enemies. It blends elements of traditional pinball tables with a variety of video game features. Including:

  • 12 types of ball - Ever wondered what a rubber ball would be like in a pinball table. What about an pool ball. Of course there is the classic steel ball.

  • Tilt Powers - Each ball has a unique ability that activates when tilted at full strength. Some make it easier to keep the ball on the table, some increase damage dealt to enemies.

  • 2 Game Modes - There is the classic Score-Attack mode. There is also Survival mode, in which you progress through 4 stages. Survival also offers you the chance to upgrade your balls between plays.

  • Randomized Tables - Tables are randomly generated from 100+ table segments. No two runs are the same.

  • Active Enemies - You have to deal with wandering enemies as well as gun turrets. Take them out before they mess up your shots.

Some useful tips to remember:

  • The key to scoring big is to increase your multiplier, before collecting jackpots

  • Tilting can help stop the ball from going out-of-play, you can tilt 3 times before exhausting your tilt strength

  • If in doubt what you should be doing, aim for the flashing lights

You accidentally opened a corrupted file.

The loading progress stopped at 98%.

A permission transfer that should have been completed was interrupted by an anomaly, splitting the unstable network into multiple isolated permission domains.

Then, a program that had been suspended for a very long time sent you a message.

“Access established.”
“…Welcome back.”

You don’t know why he seems to recognize you.

But the system has already identified you as a new challenger for its permissions.

You want to know what happened here, so you choose to go deeper—break through the personality instances blocking your path and seize the permissions that should be yours.

Once you control everything, you can learn everything.

《ERROR》 is a strategy game combining 1010-style block placement combat, Roguelite module building, and interactive romance designed for a female audience.

■ Place. Compile. Break Through His Defenses.

Battles take place on an 8×8 structural grid.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a turn-based strategy RPG that combines elevation-based battles, monster raising, squad building, and territorial conquest.

Choose one of several factions and lead it in a campaign to unite the continent.

■ TURN-BASED BATTLES WITH ELEVATION

Battles take place on three-dimensional maps built from stacked blocks.

Elevation and line of sight affect movement routes and which positions can be targeted.

Before confirming an action, you can check its hit chance, estimated damage, and whether it is expected to defeat the target.

■ SEIZE ENEMIES AND ADD THEM TO YOUR ARMY

Weaken an enemy and use Seize to add it to your side.

A newly seized monster can be controlled during the same turn.

Assign classes to monsters, raise them, and meet the conditions required to evolve them into new forms.

You can also fuse two monsters to create one that inherits abilities and skills.

The game includes at least 100 monster forms, including evolutions.

■ DEMON GENERALS AND SQUAD BUILDING

Promote a trained monster to a demon general and organize a squad under its command.

Squads can be assigned to invade, defend, or remain idle.

A battle is lost if its commanding demon general is defeated.

■ TERRITORIAL CONQUEST

Rival factions act independently, invade strongholds, and expand their territory.

Decide which squads to send on invasions and which strongholds to defend as you expand your own faction's territory.

* This game is currently in development. Systems, values, and screenshots are subject to change.

store_data.about_the_game:
Andrea Shattered Two Hundred Years Ago

They call it the Severance. Three primal forces tore loose from the collapsing leylines and warped the land, its creatures, and everyone left standing.

Survivors have lasted this long on Runes dug out of the rubble — fragments of power frozen at the instant of the Severance, each one holding somebody's obsession, or the memory of some place.

But the Severance never ended. It is still spreading.

You are a Traveler. Your job is to walk toward its source, find out what lies underneath — and put a stop to it.

How far you get depends on the decisions you can't take back.

What Drops Is Fine. What You Build Is Yours.

Gear still falls off enemies. You just don't get a say in what rolls on it.

Elites and Area Bosses leave Blueprints — a piece of gear before it has a shape. Fit material Tiles onto the crafting board; every placement buys you Malleability, and you spend it deciding which Affixes go in and which ones get pushed further.

The Tiles come off a shuffled deck. The board is different every time. The same Blueprint can become two completely different weapons.

You're not waiting on luck. You're negotiating with it.

You Will Never Walk the Whole Map

The dungeon unfolds under fog, and it always offers more paths than you have time for.

Every fight, every crafting stop, every visit to the shop burns time you can't get back. And the longer you take, the stronger the things ahead of you become.

Detour to uncover what's out there, or go straight for the Area Boss? Stop and finish that weapon, or push on while you can still win fights?

When the time runs out, the map closes in — and there's only one path left, between you and whatever is waiting at the end of it.

The Same Tree Never Grows Twice

Every character has their own Talent tree, and that tree regrows every run.

Some nodes are still blank when you reach them. This run they hand you critical strikes and life steal; the next they might grow poison and spread. Even the Capstone at the far end is no exception.

Your points only cover a fraction of it. Sigils come in four colors, and whichever ones you pick up along the way decide which core nodes will open for you. Try to have everything and you'll reach none of it.

And there's no respec. Every step counts.

Nobody Is Born a Traveler

They came out of the forges of the Iron Curtain Workshop, the corridors of the Silent Academy, the songs of the Windsong Plains — each of them left the place they came from, and none of them will say why.

Now they walk the same road: into the deepest warped ground, and back out again if they can.

Each one brings their own Talent tree, their own Runes, their own way to fight.

Clearing It Is Not the End

Win once and the Andrea Cycle turns to the next page.

The rules get rewritten: costs climb, enemies get meaner, and some thresholds stop being optional. Every character tracks how deep into the Cycle they've made it, on their own.

You think you have this continent figured out. The Cycle disagrees.

store_data.about_the_game:
Save the Princess: Cards & Chaos

Build your deck. Fight your way forward. Survive the chaos. Save the Princess!

Save the Princess: Cards & Chaos is a humorous roguelike deckbuilder featuring turn-based combat, strategic card management, and plenty of chaos.

Choose your Hero and face an endless series of monsters, bosses, and increasingly dangerous encounters. Build your strategy, upgrade your character, manage your cards, and try to survive for as long as possible.

⚔️ Turn-Based Combat Without Mana

Forget energy and mana. Every playable card in your hand can be used during your turn.

At the beginning of each turn, draw 5 cards and decide how to use them. Attack enemies, heal your Hero, gain armor, activate powerful effects, or combine your cards to create your own strategy.

But don't get too comfortable. Every decision matters when your only goal is to stay alive.

🃏 Build Your Deck Your Way

Your deck is made up of different types of cards, each serving a specific purpose:

  • Skills — Attack enemies and unleash your Hero's abilities.

  • Items — Consumable cards providing healing, armor, and temporary effects.

  • Equipment — Permanent upgrades that strengthen your Hero throughout the run.

  • Passive Cards — Automatically activate when their conditions are met.

  • Wounds & Scars — Not every card in your hand is helpful...

Manage your deck carefully, take advantage of synergies, and adapt your strategy as your run progresses.

🛡️ Master the Armor System

Survival isn't just about dealing damage.

Use Temporary Armor to absorb incoming attacks, then rely on Permanent Armor to reduce the damage that gets through.

Understanding how these two armor types work together can mean the difference between surviving another round and losing your entire run.

🩸 Every Wound Has a Cost

Taking damage can leave more than just a dent in your Health.

Open Wounds occupy space in your hand and increase the direct damage you take. Multiple wounds stack their effects, making an already dangerous run even harder.

Heal at the shop to remove them — or take the risk and let them become Scars. But be careful... a Scar can reopen.

💥 Critical Hits

Deal devastating critical hits — but only when your attack actually breaks through the enemy's defenses.

Some enemies can reduce critical damage, while powerful foes such as bosses may be completely immune to critical hits.

Know your enemy and choose your attacks wisely.

😂 Save the Princess... Seriously?

The mission is simple.

Save the Princess.

The rest... is chaos.

Expect a light-hearted adventure filled with humor, memes, references, and plenty of unexpected situations.

Key Features

  • 🃏 Turn-based roguelike deckbuilding

  • ⚔️ No mana or energy system

  • 🛡️ Strategic temporary and permanent armor

  • 🩸 Wounds and Scars that can affect your entire run

  • 💥 Critical hit mechanics

  • 👹 Monsters and bosses that grow stronger

  • 🛒 Shop system with free cards and upgrades

  • 🦸 Multiple Heroes with unique abilities

  • ♾️ Infinite Mode

  • 😂 Humor, memes, references and pop-culture nods

  • 🎯 Steam Achievements

  • 📖 Story Mode with branching paths planned for the full game

  • 🎮 Single-player experience

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Spin the grid. Bend the odds. Survive the dungeon.

Slot Rogue is a dark fantasy roguelite where every turn begins with a slot spin. Match symbols, build powerful combos, and turn lucky rolls into devastating attacks as you battle through a cursed world.

Choose from 5 distinct hero classes, each with their own playstyle, skills, and ways to manipulate the slot grid. Will you overpower enemies with raw steel, twist fate with magic, or gamble everything on one perfect spin?

Fight through 5 Acts of dark fantasy danger—ancient iron dungeons, frozen crypts, drowned vaults, gilded ruins, and the blood-moon eclipse beyond.

Collect powerful upgrades throughout every run. Grow your slot grid from 5×5 to 9×9, strengthen symbols, unlock new skill uses, raise your maximum health, and shape a build that can survive the next fight.

Every icon changes the battle:

  • Sword symbols deal direct physical damage.

  • Flame symbols ignite enemies with burning damage over time.

  • Bolt symbols unleash lightning damage and explosive chain effects.

  • Shield symbols block incoming attacks and protect fragile builds.

  • Heart symbols restore health and keep a run alive.

  • Scatter symbols reveal valuable items, relics, and unexpected rewards.

Build around the symbols you find, manipulate their odds, and chase the combinations that can turn one lucky spin into a run-breaking combo.

  • Turn-based roguelite combat powered by an expandable 5×5 to 9×9 slot grid

  • 5 playable classes with distinct abilities and builds

  • 5 Acts filled with enemies, elites, bosses, and escalating danger

  • Upgrade symbols, stats, grid size, skills, and slot-machine odds

  • Find items and relics through Scatter rewards

  • Build synergies, adapt to every run, and challenge fate

Enemies have their own traits and combat abilities:

  • Iron Guard: Critical hits or Bolt matches shatter the enemy’s Guard.

  • Blood Rush: Consecutive attacks build Rage, empowering the enemy’s Heavy Attack. Match Shields to calm it.

  • Hex Thread: Locks slots and inflicts Weakness; Heart matches cleanse the Hex.

  • Fortify: Builds protection that can be broken with a 4+ symbol match.

  • Infernal Rhythm: Burning the enemy weakens its Heavy Attack.

  • Soul Debt: Heavy attacks devour your Shield. Let Debt reach 3 stacks and suffer a burst of damage; use Shield matches to repay it.

  • Fading Light: A marked symbol changes during battle. Match it to deal bonus damage.

  • Refrain: Repeated curses build power; break the refrain with a 4+ match.

  • Collect Debt: Dealing 15+ damage builds Debt. At 4 stacks, its next Heavy Attack becomes stronger.

  • Siphon: Drains your Shield; if there is no Shield to drain, the enemy heals instead.

  • Rust: Heavy attacks build Rust, which Bolt or Critical matches can remove.

  • Undertow: A curse creates a dangerous tide that forces Skull symbols onto the board; clear it with a Critical or big match.

  • High Tide / Storm Tide: Every third round, a Heavy Attack washes away all your Shield.

  • False Jackpot: A 3-symbol match gives bonus damage, but a 4+ match gives the enemy Guard.

  • Tribute: The enemy builds Tribute while guarding. Land a Critical to claim its Gold and clear the stacks.

  • Interest: Curses build Interest, making Heavy Attacks stronger. Shield matches clear it.

  • Appraisal: Striking a guarding Royal Executioner with Sword symbols causes a counterattack; use Bolt or Flame instead.

  • Golden Debt: The boss enters escalating Debt phases. Use 4+ matches to reduce its stacks.

  • Shadow Memory / Mirror Stance: Repeating the same combat approach triggers retaliation—switch between damage, Shield, and Burn.

  • Null Field: Corrupts the board with Skull symbols. Break the field with Burn or a 4+ match; Hearts cleanse corruption.

  • Hunger: Failed counters build Hunger. At 2 stacks, the enemy’s Heavy Attack heals it; use Critical or strong Bolt matches to stop it.

  • Eclipse Crown: The final boss tracks whether you have used Critical, Burn, and Shield. Its battle changes across multiple health phases.

Every enemy can also telegraph an Attack, Heavy Attack, Guard, Curse, Summon, or Heal intent—so every spin is a decision: attack, defend, cleanse, counter, or gamble for a stronger combo.

store_data.about_the_game:
Short Description

Command a mercenary mech company in a turn-based tactical RPG. Plan every move on a hex battlefield, manage heat and localized damage, develop veteran pilots, repair battered machines, and carry the consequences of each mission into the next.

About This Game

Meridian Strike is a turn-based tactical mech RPG about winning battles — and living with what they cost.

Command a small mercenary company across dangerous contracts where positioning, heat, armor, terrain and pilot skill determine who comes home.

Plan. Commit. Survive.

Battles take place on tactical hex battlefields. Choose your positions, line up firing solutions and queue orders before committing the round.

Movement, range, cover, line of sight and terrain all matter. A good position can turn an inferior machine into a threat. A bad decision can leave an expensive mech exposed, overheated or crippled.

Every machine takes damage differently

Armor and internal structure are tracked by location. Lose an arm and you may lose the weapons mounted there. Leg damage can reduce mobility. Severe damage can leave a machine out of action until your company can afford to repair it.

Heat is just as important as armor. Push your weapons too hard and systems begin to lock down. Sometimes the right decision is not to fire.

Your pilots are not disposable

Pilots gain experience, improve their skills and develop into veterans over the course of the campaign.

They can also be injured — or lost.

The pilot who survives a desperate battle today may become the person you rely on several missions later.

Run the company between battles

Victory does not reset the board.

Repair damaged machines, manage injuries, choose salvage, watch your funds and decide when your company is ready to deploy again.

Every battle leaves a mark on your pilots, your machines and your finances.

Build the right lance for the mission

Choose which machines to deploy and which pilots should command them. Different chassis, weapons and pilot strengths reward different tactical approaches.

A fast scout can exploit a flank. A durable frontline machine can anchor a chokepoint. Long-range platforms need clear firing lanes. Hot-running weapon systems demand careful heat management.

There is rarely one correct answer.

Tactical battles with campaign consequences

  • Turn-based hex combat with plan-then-resolve orders

  • Localized armor and internal damage

  • Heat management and weapon trade-offs

  • Persistent pilots with experience, injuries and progression

  • Persistent machine damage and repairs

  • Company finances, salvage and campaign time

  • Terrain, line of sight, cover and positioning

  • Multiple missions and tactical objectives

  • Custom scenarios for additional battles

Win the contract. Keep the company alive. Bring your pilots home.

store_data.about_the_game:
HUNDRED THOUSAND

A roguelike survivor where the horde is not a figure of speech. You drop into an open

arena with a single weapon, it swings on its own, and the enemies never stop coming.

Survive, grow stronger, and cut down as many as you can before they bury you.

A HUNDRED THOUSAND ENEMIES. AT ONCE.

Most survivor games count enemies in the hundreds. Hundred Thousand puts a hundred

thousand of them on the field at the same time — all moving, all swarming, all coming

for you.

At full density you cannot see the ground. Your weapons carve a clearing around you,

the clearing collapses, and you carve it open again. The shape of that clearing is the

shape of your build.

FEATURES

  • Pick your character. Each one starts with a signature weapon that can never be swapped — only sharpened — and plays nothing like the others.

  • Build from a deep pool of skills and runes. Claim new weapons as you go and stack stats that reshape how you fight. No two runs hand you the same set.

  • No level caps. Everything stacks without limit. Cards arrive at different rarities, so what you are offered is never quite what you would have picked.

  • Raise the ceiling yourself. The crowd does not simply swell on a timer. Claim the altars scattered across the arena and put down what they summon — succeed, and the world grows denser. A weaker build does not fail the check; it just takes longer, and every second it takes is growth you are not earning.

  • Face the boss. The run ends with something far larger than anything else on the field, and the hundred thousand are still there while you fight it. Bring it down, or be buried with everything you built.

HOW FAR CAN YOU GET?

One run is one sitting. Survive, stack your build, and see how many you can put down

before the horde closes in.

store_data.about_the_game:
The most satisfying peel in gaming

Somebody stuck 250 stickers to everything you own. Peel them off and get rich doing it.
Grab an edge, pull with care, and feel the vinyl lift. Pull too fast and it tears.
Press it back down and it wrinkles. Ride the fold just right and land a Perfect Peel
for a big bonus. Easy to learn, weirdly hard to put down.

Collect them all

  • 250 hand-crafted stickers across 10 themed sets, from cozy animals to deep space
  • 6 rarity tiers, from Common all the way to Mythic
  • Holographic variants with animated rainbow shine and multipliers up to x1000
  • 8 finishes including foil, glitter, transparent and iridescent
  • Vintage stickers, Golden stickers, Mystery stickers, Glitched stickers, and one or two secrets nobody has found yet

Build your sticker empire

  • Upgrade your tools, from a better fingernail to a heat gun and a jeweler's loupe
  • Peel across 7 surfaces and travel to 9 locations, from your bedroom to a moon base
  • Play the sticker market: demand shifts, so hold your pulls and sell on the spike
  • Hire workers and unlock industrial machines that peel while you sleep
  • Retire and prestige for Peel Points, then do it all again, but faster
  • Daily goals, live events, boosts, and offline earnings

A game you can feel

Every sticker is a real die-cut shape with a real fold. Thin limbs tear if you rush
them. Stubborn adhesive fights back. The backing peels away exactly like the sticker
sheets you remember. It is the fidget toy you did not know you needed, with an
economy bolted on.

Try the demo

The free demo includes 40 stickers across 4 sets, with its own separate save.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the bottom of this dungeon

You are born as something weak. Your sight is short. Your reach is shorter.
Whether the thing moving down the corridor outranks you or not — reading that, in the half second you get, is the only real skill here.

You don't kill it. You eat it

Weakened prey ends one of two ways.
Devour it — your wounds close, your hunger drops, and its blood is written into your record.
Bind it — no healing at all. Instead it stands in front of you from now on.
There is no taking it back. What you ate will never follow you; what you bound will never feed you. That single choice, made over and over, is the shape of a run.

What you eat is what you can become

Any species you have devoured even once can be born again as you, in a later life.
Pick a bloodline, start as a hatchling, and spend that whole life climbing its evolution tree.
The next branch always reads "???" until you reach it.

What you bind, you carry home

Mid-dive you can plant a nest — not at a checkpoint, but on the exact tile you are standing on. Four of them, at least five floors apart, and the deeper you build the more it costs.
Bound kindred move in. You build a hatchery, a warren, a palisade, a watch, and each one changes what the nest can hold and how well it survives being away from you.
Choosing where to sink one is the only decision in this game you make while something is still hunting you.

Pair them. That is where the blood thickens

Two kindred housed in the same nest can be paired, and the pairing lays an egg.
The egg carries a generation, a leaning, and a species — and the game shows you all three before you spend a shard on it.
Pair the same bloodline and the generation does not move. Thickening the line means bringing a root home that your clan does not already have, which means going back down. New blood only comes out of the labyrinth.

The egg is your next body

You do not breed. Your clan does — and when you die, you are born out of one of the eggs it laid.
So a life does not begin from nothing. It begins from whatever your line has become since the last one.
Die in a body that came from an egg and the blood does not thicken; that is what the pairing was for. Die in a feral body — one the labyrinth grew, before you had a nest — and it thickens the old way.

Retreat is not the same as dying

Die, and the body is gone, and so is every kindred that was walking with you — permanently.
Walk out alive and the body waits for you at the nest, at the level you grew it to, and you can take it straight back down.
Either way the kindred you left at home are still alive; pay in soul shards and they will sign on again.
And a nest can be raided while you are away. It loses integrity, and if it falls it takes the eggs and everyone living in it with it.

The deeper it runs, the higher the rank

Every tenth floor has a warden.
Floor 1, and every twentieth floor you have reached, is somewhere a new life can begin — which is not a shortcut. It is a bet that a bare hatchling can survive being born in the middle of things that outrank it.
There is a throne on floor 100. What sits on it is for whoever gets there to find out.
And the dungeon does not stop at 100.

  • Range-and-rank command combat. Close the distance, hide behind your front row, or cut the range and run
  • Perception grows. A hatchling sees the next tile. Something older feels what is breathing behind the wall

  • You want to crawl a first-person grid again — Wizardry, Etrian Odyssey — without the graph paper
  • You enjoy asking "is that thing above me or below me?" on every single step
  • You like roguelites where dying is how you make progress
  • You want a base that is a real place with real stakes, not a menu between runs

store_data.about_the_game:
Fishing Spot is a relaxing fishing game about discovering new waters, learning what lives beneath the surface, and fishing entirely at your own pace.

Every fishing spot is different. Create locations by choosing and adjusting their biome components, then discover the unique mix of fish waiting there. Different spots have their own species, activity patterns and bait preferences — so arriving somewhere new means learning how that particular place works.

Discover Your Fishing Spots

Instead of travelling through a large open world, you create the places you want to fish.

Choose a biome, customize its components and generate a new 3D fishing spot to settle into. Each location creates a different fishing experience, with its own selection of species and conditions to figure out.

Return to your favorite spots, adjust them, or create something completely new.

Learn What's Biting

Catching fish isn't only a matter of waiting.

Experiment with different baits and pay attention to when particular species become active. Learn the patterns of each fishing spot and gradually uncover everything living there.

Track the species you've discovered both globally and for each individual spot, hunt for personal records, and see what you can find next.

Fish, Collect and Progress

Keep your catch and sell it for money, or release it to reduce fishing pressure and earn additional experience.

Level up to unlock new baits and expand the ways you can approach different species. Spend your earnings on bait and cosmetic equipment, including rods, bobbers, lines and buckets, and make your fishing setup your own.

The fishing itself is deliberately approachable. Fish can get away, but mastering the catch isn't meant to turn a peaceful fishing trip into a stressful one. The deeper challenge comes from understanding your fishing spots, choosing the right bait and chasing better catches and records.

Fish Your Way

Fishing Spot is designed to be as easy to pick up as it is to put down.

Sit back on the couch, leave it open while you're at your desk, or give it your full attention. The game is designed around simple controls and can be played entirely with a mouse or entirely with a keyboard, alongside traditional controller support.

No sprawling world to navigate. No pressure to rush.

Pick a spot. Cast your line. Discover what's there.

store_data.about_the_game:
DEATH IS ONLY THE BEGINNING

Necrotone is a dark fantasy strategy auto-battler where your army fights on its own- but the outcome of every battle depends on your magic.

Summon the undead, harvest the souls of the fallen, and intervene with powerful spells when your warriors can no longer hold the line.

DON'T CLICK A SPELL. PLAY IT.

There is no hotbar filled with spells waiting to be clicked. Every spell is a sequence of four runes that you must perform yourself.

While your warriors hold back the enemy, recall the right sequence and cast it in real time. The better you know your magic, the faster you can react to the battlefield.

YOUR GRIMOIRE IS YOUR WEAPON

Forgot a spell? Open your grimoire.

It contains the spells you've learned, their rune sequences, and their costs. But true mastery begins when you no longer need to look- when your spells become second nature.

WHEN YOUR ARMY ISN'T ENOUGH, USE MAGIC

Your skeletons fight on their own. You decide when to change the course of the battle.

Raise the dead, summon reinforcements, or tear through enemy ranks with Bone Spikes. The right spell at the right moment can turn a battle on the verge of defeat into a massacre.

DEATH FUELS YOUR POWER

Your enemies are more than obstacles. Every death brings you souls, and souls give you the power to keep fighting.

The longer you survive, the greater the battle becomes- and the more death a necromancer has to work with.

YOUR BATTLE. YOUR ARMY. YOUR SONG.

Learn your grimoire.
Raise an army of the dead.
Survive the onslaught of the living.

And make death sing.

Devil on My Shoulder

You tried to end your life. You failed.

Now you're trapped in a coma, somewhere between consciousness and the world you've left behind. But your mind isn't empty. Everything you've experienced—the pain, trauma, regrets, and memories you've tried to bury—has taken on a life of its own.

As you descend deeper into your subconscious, the devil inside you becomes your only guide. He knows what you've been through, and he's determined to get you through it.

Every part of this strange world is a reflection of your past. To wake up, you'll have to face the things you've spent your life running from.

Sometimes, the only way out is through.

  • Use your many movement abilities to stay mobile and avoid the relentless attacks of the dead and demons.

  • Destroy them with an arsenal of incredibly powerful weapons, each with multiple available variations.

  • Soak yourself in their blood to regain health and keep fighting.

After the Great Dissociation shattered the compounds holding the world together, the chemical elements awakened as independent beings.

Carbon comes to in the Organic Canopy, a once-thriving forest now losing its stability. Free radicals tear through weakened bonds, water vanishes from the streams and an ancient metallic guardian is slowly consumed by aggressive rust.

store_data.about_the_game:
Become a rock that starts out small and heavy and ends up as an unstoppable boulder crushing gnomes. It won't be easy: as long as you're not big enough, the gnomes will come for you.

Grow to crush

You start small and vulnerable. Crush smaller gnomes to earn gold, grow, and get faster. Once you outmatch your enemies in size, the tables turn: now you're the danger. Make yourself so big that nothing can stop you.

Hunt the gnomes

There are many kinds of gnomes, each with its own behavior and reward.

5 worlds with unique mechanics

  •  Forest : mushrooms that make you hallucinate. 

  •  Desert : sand vortexes that suck you in.

  •   Snow  : snowballs that freeze.

  •   Cave  : darkness, you'll need candles to see.

  • Volcano: fireballs that shrink you.

Your toolkit

  • Shrink Ray: when a giant gnome is too big to crush, shrink it with your ray until you can. Upgrade it for more range, more power, and a shorter cooldown.

  • Auto-Move: let go of the controls and your rock will head straight for the nearest crushable gnome on its own. Perfect when you're so strong you just want to watch it wreak havoc, you decide when to take back control.

  • Stone Fragments: small stones that orbit you and crush gnomes for you. Add more fragments to widen your radius of destruction without lifting a finger.

Upgrades and prestige

Spend your gold on speed, size, and fragments. Fill your boost bar to become even faster, bigger, and farm more gold. And when you hit a limit, prestige: it will reset the run, but in exchange you'll earn Ancient Stones that you can use to unlock permanent talents that will make you stronger every run.

Hay has been piling up in this old barn for far too long. Somewhere beneath all of it, a tiny needle is waiting to be found. There’s only one way to get to it: start clearing.

You won’t have to do everything by hand forever. Pick up a rake or unlock more powerful tools capable of clearing huge amounts of hay at once.

At first, every handful counts. But as you upgrade your tools and improve the way you work, mountains of hay that once seemed endless will start disappearing faster and faster.

Don’t let all that hay go to waste. Gather it up, feed it into the baling machine, load the finished bales onto your truck, and sell them for money.

Use what you earn to unlock new equipment and upgrades, then head back into the barn even better prepared than before.

Bit by bit, the barn gets cleaner. New corners are uncovered, piles disappear, and the impossible starts to feel a little more possible.

After all, the needle has to be in there somewhere...

store_data.about_the_game:
The Odyssey: Threads of Fate is a story-driven adult visual novel that reimagines one of Greek mythology’s greatest journeys as an epic tale of survival, desire, fate, war, and the long road home.


Troy has fallen, but Odysseus' greatest struggle is only beginning.

As he leads his surviving men across a dangerous and unpredictable sea, the journey back to Ithaca becomes entangled with gods, monsters, ancient curses, impossible temptations, and forces that seek to decide the fate of mortals before they can choose it for themselves.

Poseidon’s wrath follows Odysseus across the sea, while a mysterious supernatural Thread begins connecting his choices to powers far greater than any mortal kingdom. What first appears to be another divine gift soon reveals something much more dangerous: a struggle over whether human lives belong to the gods, to fate, or to the people living them.

Across his journey, Odysseus encounters legendary figures including Athena, Circe, Calypso, Penelope, and other powerful women whose lives and desires are intertwined with his own. Each relationship has its own emotional identity, conflicts, temptations, and consequences. These women are not simply rewards waiting along the road. They have their own ambitions, responsibilities, loyalties, and reasons for either helping or challenging Odysseus.

The story moves from the ruins of Troy to cursed islands, divine sanctuaries, violent seas, forgotten realms, Ithaca, and eventually a confrontation with the very forces that claim authority over mortal destiny.

Choices allow you to shape Odysseus' personality, conversations, flirtation, emotional responses, and the way important relationships develop. The game follows one complete canonical narrative, allowing the story to remain cinematic and carefully paced while still giving you control over how Odysseus responds to the people and challenges around him.

The Odyssey: Threads of Fate combines large-scale mythological spectacle with intimate character drama. Battles, divine confrontations, political tension, supernatural mysteries, romance, betrayal, temptation, and moments of quiet vulnerability all form part of the same journey.

Adult relationships are fully integrated into the story rather than existing as disconnected bonus content. The game features explicit NSFW scenes with animated adult sequences, built around the relationships and emotional progression of the characters.

A dedicated gallery system allows unlocked adult scenes and artwork to be revisited after discovering them during the story.

Expect cinematic visual novel presentation, detailed character artwork, mythological environments, dramatic event CGs, animated NSFW content, romance, plenty of sex, gods and monsters, and an increasingly large conflict over the meaning of freedom itself.

Odysseus began his journey believing that returning home was enough.

By the end, he must decide what home, loyalty, love, and freedom actually mean when even the gods believe they have the right to choose his fate.

The war for Troy is over.

The war for his destiny has just begun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dreadgence

The Atlas is not a map. It is an autopsy.

Every level is a wound in the body of a dead god and none of them have closed. You are the Blank Leaf: a single page cut out of the Atlas and given a body. The wounds remember every creature that ever died inside them. They do not remember you. That absence is the only weapon you have.

You do not fight. You prepare.

Dreadgence is an autobattler with one honest promise: a run is a pure function of your preparation. You choose your monsters, arm them, and deploy them into a wound and then you watch. No clicking, no steering, no last-second saves. Every death on the field was decided the moment you committed the loadout. Winning is being right in advance.

Steal the dead. Make an argument.

Pacts: Every monster is an extinct life agreeing to be remembered in your margin. You take its Last Name at the instant of its defeat. Deepening a Pact recovers more of its true history, until the complete name rewrites how it behaves.

Rites: Repeatable sentences torn out of a wound. Attach two to a Pact to fundamentally change its role on the field.

Relics: Physical evidence that contradicts the Atlas's official account. Rank them up to awaken the clauses sleeping inside.

Readings: A perfect simulation. The past is fixed, so the same seed always returns the same outcome. A composition that clears a wound produces an answer its memory cannot refute.

Every wound is a puzzle with a real answer.

A map is not beaten by the strongest roster it is beaten by a loadout tailored against what the map does. Experience twenty-four wounds, each with its own horror and unique solution: salt that preserves extinction as liturgy; a chapel that drowns without water; a garden that functions as a single, sleeping circulatory system. Conquer three deepening ranks per wound, with a guaranteed Certain Rite waiting for you if a wound refuses to open.

Swarms, watched.

Witness hundreds of bodies on a single floor, each expressing a singular behavior. Face cowards that flee in blind panic, enemies that split upon death, and bosses that heal more than they hurt. We prioritize legibility over cleverness: if you can't tell why a creature did something, it didn't. The whole run is a performance, and you are its only audience.

Built to be left running.

Automation: Hand repetitive Readings to the game to let it automatically clear, buy, and redeploy.

Offline Progression: The wounds keep bleeding while you're away, greeting you with a Welcome Back reckoning upon your return.

The long mystery is personal.

Someone removed the Blank Leaf on purpose. The wounds each keep a phrase from the excision. Close all 72 Readings and the record admits what it was built to hide: you were..

You were its..

Read the blood. Close the wound.

The game world is the autopsy of a dead god; every level is a "wound," monsters are dissected identities, and combat is stylized creatures being destroyed in large numbers. store_data.about_the_game:
Expediente Herodes es un escalofriante survival horror donde el fin del mundo no emergió del infierno, sino que nos observaba desde el cielo

En el año 2007, el descubrimiento de un antiguo mapa en la tumba de Herodes reveló las coordenadas de una anomalía en el espacio profundo: la perturbadora figura de un ojo gigante provisto de alas.

Los astrónomos que lo observaron sufrieron un destino aterrador: en su propio torrente sanguíneo comenzaron a engendrarse bacterias con forma de ángeles bíblicos, mutándolos desde adentro en criaturas extremadamente agresivas. Aquel brote logró ser controlado en secreto... hasta ahora

Es el año 2010 y el virus ha regresado al corazón del Distrito Federal. Apenas un par de horas antes de que las autoridades sellaran la colonia Asturias y sus instalaciones subterráneas, declarándola una "zona muerta" bajo estricta cuarentena, tu hija fue secuestrada y arrastrada al interior del abismo.

Eres policía, pero la placa ya no significa nada. Mientras tus compañeros intentan inútilmente contener el caos, tú vas en contra de la corriente. En este apocalipsis, tú no eres un héroe ni buscas la salvación de la humanidad. Impulsado por la desesperación, tu única motivación es usar tu entrenamiento para adentrarte en la cuarentena y recuperar a tu hija a toda costa

Características principales:

  • Terror urbano y subterráneo: Explora las oscuras y aisladas calles de la colonia Asturias y sobrevive a los sofocantes pasillos de estaciones reales como La Viga.

  • Perspectiva inmersiva: Siente la tensión en cada esquina con una jugabilidad de cámara al hombro clásica, diseñada para mantener la adrenalina al límite

  • Sobrevive a tu manera: Usa tu instinto policial. Los recursos son escasos y el entorno está en tu contra; gestiona tu munición, enfréntate a las aberraciones o evítalas. Solo importa seguir avanzando

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

An older sister and her younger brother have been taken by a mysterious witch to a strange and eerie wilderness.

There are no familiar roads here, and no one they can rely on.

To survive, they must explore the wilderness, search for food and water, gather useful materials, and gradually craft more practical tools.

You can switch between the brother and sister as the lead character, guiding them as they explore the environment and struggle to survive.

Explore the Eerie Wilderness

Lead the siblings through this unfamiliar wilderness.

Search for edible fruits and mushrooms, gather materials scattered throughout the environment, and stay alert for dangers lurking nearby.

What secrets does this wilderness hold?

Why did the witch bring them here?

Perhaps, as you explore, you'll gradually uncover the answers.

Survive

Both siblings must manage their health, hunger, and thirst.

  • Find food

  • Obtain water

  • Gather resources from the wilderness

  • Manage both characters' survival needs

  • Make difficult choices with limited resources

Gathering & Crafting

Many things in the wilderness can become essential resources for survival.

Explore your surroundings, gather resources, and craft useful items to unlock more tools, equipment, and ways to survive.

Game Features

  • Two-Character Survival

  • Explore the Wilderness

  • Gathering & Resource Management

  • Cooking & Crafting

  • Pixel-Art Adventure

store_data.about_the_game:
The Haunting Game is a co-operative social deduction game where you meet objectives, interact with other players and the board, and try to figure out who is your friend and who isn't. No two runs are the same. Shop items are randomized, positions are unique, and special events trigger responding to specific player input. As of this beta, you play as one of two roles: villager or stalker.

Villagers

As a villager on this vast board, you need to collect objective stars scattered around the map. Along the way, you can interact with board spaces that have different special properties - teleport you to a new location, grant you a star to spend in the shop, roll an extra dice, trigger objectives, and much more. But you're not alone in this game. Although you can't see any other players on the board, you can hear hurried footsteps when someone chooses their "sprint" option, you can use proximity chat to yell to nearby players in the dark, or use items like a map or a rope. Be careful who you bring closer though, you never know who you're calling to.

Stalkers

Stalkers walk the board as well. With increased dice rolling and a greater vision, stalkers hunt down and eliminate as many players as they can while not blowing their cover. Choose between convincing villagers of your good-nature and accuse others at the town hall, or go on a murderous rampage across the board with your own custom shop items. The more villager hearts you claim the better items you can buy. Storekeepers have a special stash for you in the back of their store with items the villagers aren't supposed to know exist.

The Board

Many spaces on the board have unique properties to them. Letting you collect resources, pick up items, roll again, take shortcuts and more! While as a villager, your star will be somewhere on the board, sometimes it's worth going to long way around from some extra goodies that can tip the game in your favor.

Town Hall

Stalkers can't just go around killing freely. There are consequences to your actions and the villagers can notice this. Villagers can call a town hall and if they find you suspicious, they might vote you out. Deflect blame, clear yourself, and persuade your friends if you want to survive in this game.

Special Events

Each map has a secret special event tied to it. Depending on which team triggers it, the board will respond accordingly. While hard to trigger and rare, the reward is surely worth it.

Items

Move faster, teleport across the board, protect yourself, sabotage others, and even hold the powers of life and death in your hand. The Haunting has 20+ unique items that are randomized in the shop. Items marked red are stalker only and green are only for the villagers. The more expensive they are, the stronger their abilities. Stalkers pay with villager hearts (self-explanatory) while villagers use the stars they collected (stars collected are already added to objective total and can be spent freely). Both stalkers and villagers start with one of each currency to spend and can pick up more on the floor.

Victory

Villagers collect enough stars for their objective, or stalkers kill the villager team before they can. Either the old-fashioned way or use the town hall to your advantage. There are other ways to win too, which you'll find in game.

Interact with the board, communicate with other players, test your luck, and scheme; your social skills and board presence are what will win you this game. Make your game nights memorable with The Haunting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hirelings is a turn-based tactics roguelike fused with an auto-battler shop. Hire, reroll, and merge mages, vampires, and others to form an overpowered party of mercenaries... then outsmart every enemy on the grid.

Auto-battler shop + Turn-based tactics

Between every fight you're in the shop. You manage, hire, and reroll characters, and when you have 3 duplicates of a character of the same level, you get a level-up. A levelled up character unlocks new abilities and is stronger overall.

When the fight starts, it doesn't play automatically. You activate every ability, move, and attack, when it's your turn.

Experiment with builds

Every character has 2 classes. For example Rogue Skirmisher is a Rogue, getting extra evasion, and a Skirmisher, getting extra movement, initiative, and a leap ability.

The more of the same class you have in your party, the stronger it becomes. Trying out different combinations of characters and classes makes for a different experience every run.

Position matters

If you move out of the reach of an enemy melee character, they get an attack of opportunity at you. If you position your melee fighters next to enemy casters and ranged units, you get an attack of opportunity anytime they try to cast a ranged ability. In other words, pay attention to how you position your characters in battle.

Abilities are like puzzles

Area-of-effect attacks are something both you and your enemy are capable of. Circumstances in the game will force you to think about how to tactically use these abilities to deal the most damage to the enemy.

One run, 18 rounds

The structure of the game consists of 18 battles. Every 3rd battle you fight a stronger enemy, a boss.

Losing a battle does not mean you lose the game, you start with 2 retries and can replenish them in the shop for gold.

There are 3 thematic chapters in the game: the forest, the bandit ruins, and the undead dungeon.

Rewards

When you beat a boss fight you get to pick an item. Items have unique passive effects, which can change the way you play the game and the direction of your build.

Features

  • Turn-based tactics

  • An auto-battler-style shop between fights: hire, reroll, merge, upgrade

  • 18 rounds across 3 chapters, with a boss every third round

  • 26 items that change how you play the game

  • 34 characters, each combining two of 17 classes

Experiment with builds

Every character has 2 classes. For example Rogue Skirmisher is a Rogue, getting extra evasion, and a Skirmisher, getting extra movement, initiative, and a leap ability.

The more of the same class you have in your party, the stronger it becomes. Trying out different combinations of characters and classes makes for a different experience every run.

Position matters

If you move out of the reach of an enemy melee character, they get an attack of opportunity at you. If you position your melee fighters next to enemy casters and ranged units, you get an attack of opportunity anytime they try to cast a ranged ability. In other words, pay attention to how you position your characters in battle.

Abilities are like puzzles

Area-of-effect attacks are something both you and your enemy are capable of. Circumstances in the game will force you to think about how to tactically use these abilities to deal the most damage to the enemy.

One run, 18 rounds

The structure of the game consists of 18 battles. Every 3rd battle you fight a stronger enemy, a boss.

Losing a battle does not mean you lose the game, you start with 2 retries and can replenish them in the shop for gold.

There are 3 thematic chapters in the game: the forest, the bandit ruins, and the undead dungeon.

Rewards

When you beat a boss fight you get to pick an item. Items have unique passive effects, which can change the way you play the game and the direction of your build.

Features

  • Turn-based tactics

  • An auto-battler-style shop between fights: hire, reroll, merge, upgrade

  • 18 rounds across 3 chapters, with a boss every third round

  • 26 items that change how you play the game

  • 34 characters, each combining two of 17 classes
store_data.short_description: Turn-based tactics roguelike fused with an auto-battler shop. Hire, reroll, and merge mages, vampires, and others to form an overpowered party of Hirelings... then outsmart every enemy on the grid.
