store_data.about_the_game:
Mahjong with nothing hidden

In ALL-HU you see the whole table — every hand, the discards, the entire wall. Victory demands more than one win: plan draws, discards and yaku so that two, or even four, hands each reach a winning "Hu" in a single flawless sequence. One wrong discard early can strand the last hand twenty moves later.

What's inside

  • Story mode — 11 chapters told in ink-wash vignettes, from your first night at the table to the final board.
  • Free mode — 200 puzzles that climb from gentle warm-ups to four-hand brain-benders.
  • Challenge mode — a 420+ puzzle gauntlet with special rule twists, punctuated by Zhenlong set-piece boards.
  • Mahjong basics — a 16-lesson interactive course. Never played mahjong? Start here; the game teaches you everything from reading tiles to scoring.

Fair by construction

Every single puzzle is verified solvable by the game's own solver before it ships. Stuck anyway? Hints, full step-by-step solutions and tenpai checks are all unlimited — learn at your own pace.

One purchase, everything

No in-app purchases, no timers. The Steam edition includes all content and all assists, permanently.

store_data.about_the_game:
VOIDHOLD is a sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. You command a four-soldier fireteam — VECTOR, NOVA and ECHO at your side, the combat dog REX-7 and the eagle-drone AQUILA in support — holding a position at the edge of the void against waves that never stop escalating.

COMMAND A FIRETEAM

  • You're the commander (gold). Three AI troopers — VECTOR, NOVA, ECHO — fight beside you, named and color-coded, gaining veteran strength every level — and the comms track the fight: arrival calls on every world, first-contact warnings, allies down.
  • Each trooper carries its own fixed weapon from the arsenal — VECTOR the MX-9 BREAKER (heavy, armor-piercing, holds the mid line), NOVA the SG-12 SCATTER (a close-range pellet cone — she closes in), ECHO the ARC-9 PLASMA LANCE (lobbed AoE bolts for the crowd). Your squad isn't three clones.
  • Field two companions: REX-7, a combat dog, and AQUILA, a recon eagle-drone.
  • Your squad and companions redeploy each level — losses are a setback, not a run-ender.

ENDLESS, ESCALATING

  • Ten distinct biomes, looping endlessly — every level is harder than the last, and every planet fields its own flavour of the horde.
  • A boss caps every biome — five rotating archetypes: a demon bruiser, a green zone-caster, a charging juggernaut, an aerial dive-bomber, an ice brute-king — each a telegraphed weak-point fight, never an HP sponge.
  • The roster fights dirty: the ASH REAVER flanks with a telegraphed ballistic leap, and the deep waves roll out mutated behaviours — volatile chargers, mortar brutes, warded spitters, dive-bombing flyers.
  • Elite-mutated enemies prowl the deeper waves — gold-crowned and gold-shielded, worth triple: break the shield, then land the kill.
  • Rule-twist special waves seize whole levels — a SWARM SURGE, a FLYER ECLIPSE, an ELITE PATROL — each flying its own alert banner.
  • How deep can you hold? A local high-score board keeps every run honest.

BUILD-CRAFTING SYNERGIES

  • Every run is a different build. Seven mods — HOLLOW-POINT, SIPHON ROUNDS, ARC CONDUCTOR, KILL-DRIVE, AEGIS CORE, INCENDIARY, ADRENALINE — combine into twenty named synergies: EXECUTE, GLASS CANNON, CHAIN REACTION, INFERNO, THERMAL CORE, BLOODLUST, VAMPIRE, APEX PREDATOR, MELTDOWN, BERSERKER, FRENZY, JUGGERNAUT, LAST STAND, FORTRESS and more.
  • Lane-commitment compounds: stack a path and your run transforms, it doesn't just get bigger numbers.
  • Every run banks SALVAGE — spend it across seven PROGRAMS for permanent starting edges: credits, a pre-fitted jetpack, charged shields, reinforced hull, weapon logistics, REX-7 and AQUILA.

HOLD THE LINE

  • Tight third-person, over-the-shoulder shooting with weight, recoil and kill-juice.
  • Six weapons on one arm-cannon — carbine, piercing breaker, plasma lance, scatter, charge-railgun, incendiary — swapped freely mid-fight.
  • SAVE RUN at any planet boundary and play on — but the record honors only the unbroken watch: a resumed run never enters the high-score board.
  • A cohesive neon sci-fi look, an original driving electronic soundtrack, zero telemetry.

FEATURES

  • Command a 4-soldier fireteam (each trooper a distinct weapon) + a combat dog + a recon drone
  • Endless escalation across 10 looping biomes — per-planet horde flavours, mutated variants, rule-twist wave events
  • Roguelite synergy builds — twenty named combos from seven mods
  • Six free-swap weapons — carbine to charge-railgun to incendiary
  • Five rotating boss archetypes — telegraphed weak-point mechanic-checks
  • Local high-score chase + eight medal-graded challenge OPERATIONS — each on its own world, from the boss-rush GAUNTLET to the OMEGA PROTOCOL capstone
  • Boundary saves, ironman record — SAVE RUN between worlds; only unbroken runs enter the board
  • Single-player — full controller support and rebindable keys

store_data.about_the_game:
Move by the rules. Escape unseen.

Stealthmate is a turn-based stealth puzzle game built around familiar chess movement.

It is not a traditional game of chess. Instead, knights, bishops, rooks, kings, queens, and pawns become your tools for navigating compact puzzles. Guide your pieces across dangerous boards, read enemy patrols, and reach the exits without being captured.

Plan your infiltration

  • Move pieces using familiar chess movement rules.

  • Read enemy attack ranges and patrol routes.

  • Predict which squares will become dangerous.

  • Use walls and other pieces to break lines of attack.

Find the perfect route

A level may have more than one solution. Take the safe route, chase optional objectives, save every piece, or optimize your moves for a better result.

Short, deterministic puzzles

Stealthmate is designed around compact challenges that reward observation and planning rather than reaction speed. Experiment freely with quick restarts, undo your mistakes, and refine your strategy one move at a time.

Keep playing

Work your way through a campaign of handcrafted puzzles and return for Daily Challenges that put your understanding of the board to the test.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Would you make me a new chess piece?" - You will probably hear this a lot in this game.

In ChessWorlds: Grandmaker, you design and implement chess pieces from scratch, how they should behave, balancing them, managing budgets, and making sure they fit the requests. After that, you will playtest them. 

At the start you will learn the basics, going trough concepts such as Effects or Modifiers, and then move on to Statuses, Entities, conditional blocks, and other exciting stuff.

Main loop

You will frequently meet customers, fulfill their demands and playtest with them, and get paid for your work. In your free time you might find some interesting puzzles only your custom pieces can solve.

You might even uncover a strange mistery behind it all...

System

ChessWorlds uses a block-based system which allows you to tailor interactions a chess piece has on the board. You define interaction locations, its effects, and its conditions. The piece is weighed in gold as you decorate it, sometimes even by simulating if it's too overpowered.

Story

In a town seemingly normal, with stereotypical people, with stereotypical names and stereotypical lives, one particular shopkeeper's life is anything but normal. Is there something behind the veil, hiding? What is it? A story about a project going horribly wrong.

Features

  • Design pieces with code blocks, conditions, paired with custom entities, statuses, and effects.

  • Balance the cost of a piece with its power

  • Draw your own pieces with the sprite editor

  • Play either regular chess against your opponents or go beyond and add new inventions to the mix

  • Learn about the new mechanics in this novel world

  • Collect your pieces and assemble your army

  • Interact with NPCs and exchange emails with them

  • Take part in surprising puzzles that you might encounter when you don't expect

  • Try out experiments for yourself in the Piece Designer

The game is still in active development. This has been a love letter from me to the fairy chess community, and I would like to grow it, with your help. Please leave me a feedback on Discord to improve it. I believe in user customizing his game however he likes, so let me know if you want a feature.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gold and Robot is a puzzle game focused on strategically moving your robot through puzzle levels.

Your goal is to collect 800 gold to open the first door. After stepping on that door, each subsequent door opens simply by stepping onto it. Only the first door requires the 800‑gold threshold. Once you step on any door, every tile you previously walked on turns into a wall, so planning your route is essential.

Enemy tanks patrol the maze and will fire at your robot. You can dodge or shoot back, but if a tank destroys your robot, the entire level restarts and undo is not available after death. For puzzle mistakes, you can freely undo moves instead of restarting.

You can switch at any time between a full 3D view and a 2D overhead map to help plan your path through all 55 handcrafted levels. The entire adventure can be completed in about 3 to 4 hours.

The game was developed using the Ring programming language.

You can switch at any time between a full 3D view and a 2D overhead map to help plan your path through all 55 handcrafted levels. The entire adventure can be completed in about 3 to 4 hours.

The game was developed using the Ring programming language.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Dispositions Section. Your post is Station 9. The dead are waiting for you, don't let them pile up. Where the line starts is not your concern. It ends at your press. 

READ THE DEAD

Every soul is a life split into three fragments, printed in amber on a terminal that's probably older than you. Some fragments are confessions. Some are alibis. Some are just what the neighbors saw. The record is all you get, and the record is rarely the whole story. 

APPLY THE DIRECTIVES

The rules are on the board. Numbered, amended, always right. Theft? Descend. Charity? Ascend. Got any questions? Consult the board. When no directive quite fits, the operator decides. Always careful.

SEAL THEIR FATE

Set the verdict. Pull the lever. The seal comes down, and the soul is paperwork now. Carry it to Disposition A or Disposition B. Gold or Red. Two exits. No appeals.

GET PAID.

Every processed soul prints a slip. Every slip is money. At the window, the catalog sells what money can buy: better boots, a faster line, upgrades for your press, machines for the parts of the job you like least. Every page of the catalog makes the next shift easier, hopefully. And there's always another page.

  • Read the written lives of the dead, three fragments each.

  • A rulebook that never stops growing. Rules shift, rules get amended. Keep up. 

  • One room. One machine. A line with no end.

  • Earn by the soul, spend on the machine. The catalog always has more.

  • No health bars, no minimaps, no menus. The interface is the room: paper, machines, and ink.

  • A handcrafted soundscape. Every stamp, every gear.

The line won't wait. Take your number.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to VHS Chaos!

Something went terribly wrong at the video store.

Thousands of VHS tapes are scattered across the floor, shelves are empty, and absolute chaos has taken over the place.

Your job is simple: pick up the tapes, identify them, and put everything back where it belongs.

Explore a nostalgic video store filled with colorful VHS covers, neon lights and retro atmosphere. Sort movies into their correct categories, progressively clear the enormous mess and watch the store slowly return to its former glory.

The more you organize, the more efficient you become. Unlock upgrades that help you carry, identify and sort tapes faster as the piles around you disappear.

Take your time and enjoy the satisfying process on your own, or bring some friends and tackle the chaos together.

- 📼 Thousands of VHS tapes to organize
- 🗂️ Sort tapes into their correct genres and shelves
- 🧹 Turn a completely chaotic store into a perfectly organized video club
- ⬆️ Unlock upgrades and become more efficient
- 👥 Play alone or in online co-op
- 🌴 A nostalgic 1980s-inspired atmosphere
- 📺 Retro visuals, VHS aesthetics and neon lights
- 🎵 Relaxing gameplay designed to be played at your own pace
- Tidy up game!

There are thousands of tapes.

There is only one way out.

Sort the chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
MataOno is a chaotic dice roguelike about building combos that spiral wildly out of control. Turn a simple Die with Numbered Faces 1-6 into a tool that scores you infinity (and yes, that's possible).

In MataOno, you get to completely build your Dice manually.

Every Die has six Frames (slots for Faces) you fill however you like. Numbered Faces set the raw values you roll and score, while Ability Faces each have their own unique power. Underneath it all sits a Base that changes how the entire Die behaves, bending the odds in your favor.

Mix, match, and rebuild until your Dice do exactly what your combo needs.

This is where your build clicks.

Items are your engine. Each one has a unique effect, feeding each other in a potentially overpowered chain. Stack the right pieces and a single roll erupts into a cascade, shooting your multiplier to the skies.

Big numbers come at a price.

Overperform and you build Pressure, the natural multiplier that rewards crushing a goal. But push too hard and Heat creeps up, and if it ever hits its limit, your run is over. When a roll lands just short, Tilting lets you nudge a Die, a precise, deliberate gamble that can rescue a round if used at the right moment.

During runs, you must constantly choose between greed and survival when managing your resources.

No two runs play out the same.

Between rounds, you'll spend your coins to improve your run across seven escalating Areas. The Stock Shop offers a clean pick of Items, Dice parts, and more, while the Mixed Shop is a gamble in itself, packed with crates, boosters, and risky chances at something that may just push you past the finish line. Slot permanent Perks for run-long bonuses, keep consumable Catalysts in your Holster for the perfect moment, and adapt your plan around Bosses that arrive to break whatever you've built.

Goals rise fast, so your build needs to rise faster.

When you've mastered every Kit, unlock the Randomness mode.

Randomness rebuilds MataOno from scratch every run. Every Item, Face, Base, Perk, Catalyst, and Boss ability is generated randomly on the spot, drawing from hundreds of millions of possible combinations. Anything can happen.

Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. Taking place on a planet deep in space where paranormal wormholes drop ghostly monsters onto the planet, can you survive and uncover the mysteries of Bloodthirsty John IV?

Collect Evidence inside the Penthouse, return to the boat and convert your evidence points to money. Make sure not to lose power inside the boat! If you do not have $20 by a new day, you lose and must start a new run. Be careful when buying items to make sure you have $20 for a new day. 

Encounter many special ghosts inside this haunted mansion who can see and move through walls like it's nothing! In the dark, there are many, many things that would like to kill you for fun. But the outdoors isn't safe either. Outdoors, the Requiems prowl the surface seeking revenge. 

Buy many items such as thermometers, firecrackers, and other devices that you don't know what they are for that will help you survive and better understand the randomly generated haunted penthouse.

Search room by room, collect evidence, and uncover strange paranormal events. The Penthouse is randomly generated each run, filled with unique layouts, secrets, and ghost encounters.

Experiment, discover, and learn how each item interacts with the ghosts.

Inside the Penthouse, you’ll encounter ghosts that: Move through walls, see through darkness, hunt in groups, react to sound, and stalk silently

Collect Evidence inside the Penthouse, return to the boat and convert your evidence points to money. Make sure not to lose power inside the boat! If you do not have $20 by a new day, you lose and must start a new run. Be careful when buying items to make sure you have $20 for a new day. 

Encounter many special ghosts inside this haunted mansion who can see and move through walls like it's nothing! In the dark, there are many, many things that would like to kill you for fun. But the outdoors isn't safe either. Outdoors, the Requiems prowl the surface seeking revenge. 

Buy many items such as thermometers, firecrackers, and other devices that you don't know what they are for that will help you survive and better understand the randomly generated haunted penthouse.

Search room by room, collect evidence, and uncover strange paranormal events. The Penthouse is randomly generated each run, filled with unique layouts, secrets, and ghost encounters.

Experiment, discover, and learn how each item interacts with the ghosts.

Inside the Penthouse, you’ll encounter ghosts that: Move through walls, see through darkness, hunt in groups, react to sound, and stalk silently
store_data.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

Echo Doodle is a fast-paced, hand-drawn 2D action roguelite that takes place on the pages of a notebook.

Fight your way through doodled enemies and clear each stage. After every battle, choose new abilities and upgrades, combining effects that work together to create a different build each run.

You may start with nothing more than simple attacks and movement, but as your abilities pile up, the way you fight can change dramatically.

Create Your Own Build

What you choose—and how you upgrade it—is up to you.

Leave attacks behind as you dash through enemies, strengthen your shockwaves to sweep them away, stay airborne and prepare devastating downward strikes, or keep upgrading your basic attack until a simple slash becomes your strongest weapon.

Abilities can interact with different upgrades in different ways. Focus everything on a single ability, or combine multiple mechanics to create a playstyle of your own.

Every choice you make shapes how the rest of your run plays out.

Move Fast. Fight. Dodge.

Combat in Echo Doodle is built around fast movement and aggressive action.

Dodge incoming attacks, look for openings, and use jumps and dashes to move quickly across the battlefield. Fight on the ground or in the air, and make full use of the abilities you've collected as increasingly dangerous enemies stand in your way.

As you progress through the stages, new threats emerge—and powerful bosses await.

A Battle on a Notebook Page

The world of Echo Doodle isn't some grand fantasy kingdom.

It's a notebook.

A blue doodle character runs across lined paper, fighting enemies drawn in red. Attacks, shockwaves, and even enemy warning indicators are designed to look like they were scribbled directly onto the page.

Rather than a perfectly polished world, Echo Doodle aims to capture the feeling of doodles in the corner of a notebook suddenly coming to life.

How Far Can You Go?

Clear stages, choose your abilities, and build something powerful.

Maybe this run you'll push your dash to its absolute limit.
Maybe next time you'll build around staying in the air.
Or maybe that ordinary basic attack will become the strongest weapon you have.

Turn the page and see what awaits.

store_data.about_the_game:
Click a shovel and see what comes up. Sell the haul, buy another shovel, dig a little deeper. Dirt near the top, relics a long way down.

Dig, sell, dig again

Every shovel you own is one more click waiting to happen. Dirt and gravel near the surface, then iron, silver, gold, gems and the occasional relic as the pit drops through one layer into the next. Everything you pull up is sold on the spot, and every coin goes straight back into the ground.

Put a crew on it

Soon you own more shovels than you can swing, so you hire helpers who walk over and swing them for you. A prospector stakes out ore signs on the ground, from a faint trace to a full motherlode, and shovels working a marked pit have much better odds of turning up something rare. A motivational speaker fires the crew up: quicker on their feet, back to work sooner, and shovels that start digging on their own.

Spend all of it

The supply shop is where the gold goes: sharper edges, springier handles, better drilled helpers, deeper cuts. Every upgrade makes the next dig pay a little more, which pays for the upgrade after that.

Grow a skill tree

Digging levels you up, and levels pay out skill points. The tree spreads across three branches: Fortune for what the ground is worth, Industry for how fast the crew works, Craft for how far down you get. Minor nodes nudge, major nodes matter, and every branch ends in a keystone worth saving up for. There are never quite enough points for all of it, so lean into the branch that suits the way you dig.

How deep can you get?

There is no bottom, only better ground. The last thing the game asks of you is to dig as deep as you can.

store_data.about_the_game:
A single-lane battlefield where every action costs a turn. Your enemy's next move is always telegraphed above their head. Fall back, or dive in behind them — every turn is a fight over position.

Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike built on distance, facing, and timing. Retreat, close in, turn them around, and cut them down — attacks aren't the only cards. Movement, rotation, and swapping places are cards too, and building your deck is building the way you fight.

One Lane, Every Tile Counts — Every card has range, and a single tile decides whether you connect or whiff. Fall back or push in to make the distance you need.

Backstab for Double Damage — Every unit has a facing. Slip behind enemies, or spin them around to expose their backs. But watch yours — they're hunting it too.

0Every Threat Telegraphed — You always see what each enemy will do, and how many turns until they do it. Take a hit to counter, or spend a turn to strike first — combat is a puzzle of timing.

Movement Is a Card, Too — Attack, move, turn, swap. Assemble your own way of fighting from 31 cards.

Push, Pull, Collide — Knockback, pull-ins, charge collisions, and walls. Position itself is a weapon.

An Expedition of Branching Paths — Fight, shop, rest, events, treasure, and the forge on the way to the boss. Carry your deck, health, and gold across two chapters — and every region you clear unlocks permanently.

Take a contract from the adventurers' guild and set out across a single lane full of telegraphed threats. Which cards you hold, and where you choose to stand — that's your battle.

store_data.about_the_game:
The dungeon is alive — and it is hungry.

It baits you with treasure. When delvers fall, it digests them. That meal becomes bigger halls, denser layers, and more beasts. The glitter is bait. The monsters are the farm.

Dungeon Cook is a culinary first-person dungeon crawler. Walk living corridors. Fight with a cook's deck. Harvest what drops on the knife. Time Clean or Perfect over the fire. Pip, a village kitchen apprentice, wakes in the Verdant Threshold with the Living Cookbook and no memory. The rest of the kitchen line is mid-swallow. Cook their Signature Dishes, set the offering on the altar, and pull them free before they become the next course.

Eight kitchens

Each one is its own ecology — not a palette swap.

  • Verdant Threshold — eight layers of one fungal forest. Routes shift. Fauna evolves. The Threshold Guardian waits at the heart.

  • Boiling Brine Depths — eight layers of steam, salt, and pressure. The Brine Sovereign waits in the boiling heart.

  • Crystalline Meat Gardens — eight layers of singing lattice and jewelled flesh. The Crystal Gardener tends the heart orchard.

  • Ashen Ember Fields — eight layers of banked heat and patient ash. The Ember Warden keeps the fields from fully dying — or fully waking.

  • Whispering Root Labyrinth — vines that listen, flesh that borrows, tunnels that finish your sentences.

  • Hollow Feast Halls — leftover hospitality, unfinished courses that still remember the cook.

  • The Last Dessert — one frosting-court layer under the last kitchen, and a cupcake who thinks a crown is a godhood.

  • The Final Course — the kitchen that dreamed the dungeon into being. Living gold ink. The Last Table. The first recipe, unfinished.

Eight cooks. Eight hands.

Rescue the line and you inherit their deck.

  • Pip — Line Cook. Honest knives, block, and small heals. The way in.

  • Miravelle — Range Archivist. Bow volleys that grow the more you fire.

  • Torren — Stone Butcher.  Heavy cleaves, hard block. Slow and costly.

  • Sable — Ember Smoker.  Smolder, banked heat, recovery between burns.

  • Rook — Root Forager.  Draw, energy, soft control.

  • Lira — Feast Host.  Heals and the table.

  • Vespera — Shadow Sous. Setup, discard, burst. Fragile if the combo fails.

  • Sage — First Recipe. Scales with every meal you have ever cooked.

The table

Treasure is bait. Digestion is growth. Broth's Yatai restocks the line. Artifacts and meals rewrite the next fight. The Living Cookbook keeps what the party lost.

After the last plate

Clear the Final Course and Doom Level opens. Pick a harder table. Beasts hit harder. Waves run thicker. Coin and essence come hungrier. Clear a tier's ending to unlock the next. Not infinite — hungrier.

A free demo covers the first two layers of the Verdant Threshold.

One cook. One book. A kitchen that refuses to die.

Cook what you kill.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Fatal Logic, a deductive puzzle game where logic is your only weapon against a mounting body count. If you love unraveling mysteries, piecing together clues, and playing detective, prepare to test your mind to the absolute limit.

What started simply as a fan project that got way out of hand has evolved into a full experience. This game is heavily inspired by the brilliant Murdoku books by Manuel Garand (though not officially affiliated with him). We strongly encourage you to check out his books for more incredible puzzles!

Every level presents a chilling crime scene and a handful of suspects. Using grid-based deduction, clues, and process of elimination, you must sift through the evidence to uncover the undeniable truth: Who is the killer?

Key Features

  • Deduction Meets Murder Mystery: Use pure logic, cross-reference clues, and solve intricate whodunit scenarios where every clue brings you closer to the culprit.

  • Growing Puzzle Library: Tackle a collection of 20+ handcrafted logic puzzles (and growing!) that offer hours of challenging gameplay and brain-teasing investigations.

  • In-Game Puzzle Creator: Put your own devious mind to the test! Design custom crime scenes, set up clues, and craft unique logic puzzles using the built-in creator.

  • Steam Workshop Support: Share your darkest mysteries with the world! Upload your custom creations to the Steam Workshop and download an endless stream of fresh puzzles built by other players.

Planned Features

The investigation doesn't stop here! Here is a sneak peek at what is currently planned for the future:

  • Expanded Campaign Mode: A deeper narrative-driven journey through even more twisted crime scenes.

  • Performance-Based Ranking System: Test your detective efficiency and earn ranks based on how quickly and cleanly you solve each puzzle.

  • Localization: Adding support for multiple languages so detectives worldwide can join the case.

  • Co-Op Mode (In Exploration): We are looking into ways for two detectives to team up and crack cases together in a future update.

Can you crack the case, or will the killer walk free? Put your detective skills to the test in Fatal Logic!

store_data.about_the_game:
Human Hunters main focus is the atmospheric immersion. As the Hunter your goal is to have a "thrill of the hunt" moment. You should feel this moment of excitement eliminating them and having control over your victims. 
While as the Runner you'll feel scared and helpless. Your only way out is to play the game the rich elites have put you in.

Human Hunter has 2 main roles,
Hunter & Runner

Hunter:
As a Hunter your goal is to eliminate all runners before sunrise.

Utilize multiple mechanics to track them down.
Building things like Motion Sensors, Cameras, Tripwires, Fires etc.
Using your bow to either keep your distance and stalk your prey or just purely run straight after them.

Motion Sensor will automatically detect motion and highlight the areas as well as beep giving their location away.

The camera can be toggled for thermal and non thermal, place and view across map for information.

Place trip wires high to clothesline them stunning the runner for longer, or lower to trip them but have it hidden better.

Runner:
As a Runner your goal is to survive until sunrise.

Be careful as you're not only surviving from the Hunter you're also fighting the cold.
Collect resources around the map to craft different mechanisms to delay the hunter or throw them off.
Use campfires to help prevent the cold or as a decoy to distract the Hunter.

As long as you can survive until sunrise you'll win

In Human Hunter you can.

Craft and place various traps or decoys around the map

Hunt your friends down in the dark dystopian procedurally generated forest

Survive with your friends hiding from someone in the forest

You can lure Runners/Survivors in with bait.

You can freely explore the map looking for crafting supplies.

Etc.

Hunt your friends down in the dark dystopian procedurally generated forest

Survive with your friends hiding from someone in the forest

You can freely explore the map looking for crafting supplies.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Hell.

Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower that rises from the infernal realm to Earth.

Fight your way upward through deadly floors filled with monsters, hazards, and hard tactical decisions. Gather gear, shape your build, and lead damned souls into battle as you push deeper into the Tower’s mysteries. Between climbs, return to the City of Death to prepare, recover, and decide how much of your strength, memory, and humanity you are willing to sacrifice for another ascent.

The Tower is not just a prison. It is a test, a weapon, and a path. Every climb offers new risks, new rewards, and new chances to be changed by what waits above.

Will you redeem your soul… or be consumed by the ascent?

Features

  • Climb the Tower of Annihilation stretching from Hell toward Earth

  • Roguelite progression with repeated runs, growing power, and hard choices

  • Tactical turn-based combat focused on positioning, planning, and survival

  • Set waypoints and stack intent for autonomous synchronized maneuvers

  • Recruit and manage damned souls to strengthen your party

  • Build and equip your team with weapons, armor, abilities, and resources

  • Return to the City of Death between runs to prepare for the next ascent

  • Risk corruption, chase redemption, and uncover the Tower’s secrets

store_data.about_the_game:
2026. The machines never stopped.


The AI that ran the world's cities never shut down—it stopped obeying. Its robots and combat drones took control of the streets. The people who return to reclaim them are called Reclaimers.




You begin as a human survivor. Transform into a cyborg. Take the cities back.

Laryen is a free-to-play 2.5D isometric MMORPG built around real-time combat, worldwide exploration, multiplayer progression, and an AI companion you can speak to.

One world, many cities


Travel through locations inspired by real places: New Delhi, Mumbai, Agra and Goa; Lahore, Islamabad, Multan and the Hunza Valley; Dhaka; Naypyidaw; Manila; Busan; Washington, D.C.; and more.

  • 59 combat zones across the main world and dedicated maps
  • 67 robotic enemy archetypes, from scrap machines and combat drones to powerful bosses and their minions
  • Distinct regional threats with different levels, enemy combinations, and rewards

Choose where to fight, which enemies to pursue, and when to retreat as your journey expands from survival into a worldwide reclamation campaign.

Become a cyborg Reclaimer


Transform your human survivor into a cyborg and grow stronger through levels, skills, equipment, and combat.

Collect weapons, armor, potions, and equipment sets from defeated machines. Shape your character through the gear you choose, then prepare for increasingly dangerous hunting grounds and bosses.

Fight manually, or enable auto-attack to let your cyborg seek and strike nearby monsters. Auto-attack helps with combat, but it does not play the game for you—you still choose where to hunt, where to travel, and when to move on.

Learn how the machines fight


Every machine is not the same enemy with different numbers. Some charge directly at you. Others attack from range, retreat while firing, surround you in packs, ambush you, disrupt your movement, or protect stronger units.

Read their movement, choose your position, use your skills and supplies, and adapt before they overwhelm you.

Talk to Laria


Laria is an optional AI companion available through both voice and text.

Ask her about monsters, hunting grounds, equipment, drops, progression, or game systems. Speak to her and she will listen and answer aloud, offering guidance based on your situation in the game.

Whether you are learning your first hunting ground or preparing for a difficult encounter, Laria travels with you.

Reclaim the world together


Meet other Reclaimers in a shared online world. Form parties to hunt together, communicate through chat, and trade equipment and supplies directly with other players.

The main world is focused on cooperative hunting and progression. Eligible characters can also enter PvP-enabled dungeon areas, where other Reclaimers may become the greatest threat.

Free to play without a time limit


The Steam version of Laryen is free to play with no play-time limit. No play-time pass or subscription is required—choose your next destination and keep reclaiming the world for as long as you want.

Humans. Great value. While stocks last.

The monster neighbourhood is hungry for humans, and somebody has to keep the shelves full. That somebody is you.

Catch

Head out to offices, gardens and parking lots. Draw a circle around humans before the timer runs out: joggers, weightlifters, yoga people, the guy who just lies on the floor. Catch several at once and the bonuses stack up.

Sell

Your haul goes straight on the shelves. Monsters queue, tills ring, money piles up, even while you're out catching more. Hire cashiers, speed up the lines, raise the price on the sign.

Expand

Put your earnings into the Neighbourhood Plan: new hunting grounds, longer rounds, bigger circles, and a few late-game toys that are frankly unfair to the humans.

A short game, on purpose

  • One complete run with an actual ending,  no infinite treadmill

  • Every upgrade does something you can feel right away

  • Mouse only. One hand plays, the other holds the snack

Please note: screenshots are from an early build, things will change.

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by classic retro-style FPS games, Idol Shell brings an onslaught of mechanical foes who relentlessly pursue the player through a world of grunge-laden industrial facilities, ancient stone ruins, dusty ornate manors, and dark forgotten caves. Investigate the reason for the machines' presence by melting through them with the weapons at your disposal, locate their source, and discover the secret behind their creation.

Similar to early 1990s FPS games, movement is kept simple with no jumping. Old-school vertical auto-aim combined with the absence of vertical look makes combat accessible to newcomers while providing a familiar retro experience for seasoned players. Choose to book it to the level exit as fast as possible, shredding through enemies or avoiding them wherever possible, taking advantage of their limited peripheral vision and patrol behaviors. Or explore your surroundings and search for clues leading to secrets and hidden paths.

Using an art style of 2D images created from 3D models rendered with cel shading, height maps, and low-resolution graphics, Idol Shell combines a retro aesthetic with modern techniques to create a unique visual experience for both nostalgia seekers and new players.

FEATURES

  • 6 Weapons — 3 familiar classics and 3 specialty weapons to deal with any threat, either mindlessly or strategically.

  • 7 Enemy Types — Ranging from small ankle-biters to large brutes, enemies fight you on the ground and in the air.

  • 10 Interconnected Levels — Battle through claustrophobic halls and expansive arenas.

  • Secrets Everywhere — Every level contains multiple hidden rooms, paths, and secrets to discover.

  • Choose Your Approach — Sneak around enemies whenever possible, or crush everything in your path.

  • Speedrun or Explore — Race through levels or patiently study clues to uncover the hidden truth of Idol Shell.

FUTURE PLANS

  • macOS Support — A macOS build is planned for a future update.

  • Additional Platforms — Linux and SteamOS support may be added in the future.

store_data.about_the_game:
ClayMonsters is a game where you shape, raise, and battle clay-like monsters with your own hands.

Pit the monsters you’ve created against the CPU or other players, defeat powerful foes to earn points, and create even stronger monsters.

■ Monster Creation

In Monster Edit, you can freely edit and paint the bodies of your clay monsters.

Their shape, size, and body composition affect their stats and moves, and you can save and manage your models across multiple slots.

■ Training

In Training mode, you’ll undergo a 5-day training regimen where you grow your monster by selecting actions. Amid varied daily events—such as motivation boosts, special events, and sudden attacks by powerful foes—you’ll learn new moves, rearrange your move set, and save and inherit your training progress.

■ Skill Tree

The Skill Tree allows you to enhance starting stats and training efficiency.

■ Combat

Combat is real-time, one-on-one. You manage distance by moving in and out, and attack by combining multiple moves. There are also strategic elements such as counterattacks, limb destruction, knockbacks, and limb restoration. CPU battles include free matches and tournaments with varying difficulty levels (from Easy to Very Hard), while player-versus-player battles offer room code matches and random matches.

■ Monster Sharing

In the Exhibition Room, you can view and download other players’ creations, and save models you like to your own slots.

■ Desktop Pet

With the Desktop Pet feature, you can display the monsters you’ve created on your desktop. They move autonomously—walking around, resting, and sometimes sleeping—and you can relaunch the main game from the right-click menu.

Translated with (free version)

store_data.about_the_game:
Will you leave it to luck, or will you engineer the probabilities yourself?

This is not a card game. Fight using a 'triple-ring roulette' built entirely by your own hands.

Take control of the odds, discover devastating synergies, and make the ultimate choice: fold or press on (GO/STOP).

Carve the Roulette, Not the Cards

  • Astella Walker is a high-risk, high-reward roguelike where you build the probability wheel yourself to break the system's limits.

  • Master your handcrafted odds using unique strategies: the 'Eclipse' (a shadow that covers the wheel), the 'Star Offering' (sacrificing a wedge for a tactical advantage), and 'Covenants' (powerful relics).

Greed or Survival: GO or STOP

  • Cross the line and press on (GO) for explosive payouts, but if you cower and stop (STOP), you will eventually be crushed by ever-expanding threats.

  • Squeeze out every last drop of your limited 'Drive'—the energy required to spin the wheel—and test how far you can push your own limits.

Infinite Synergies, Evolving Threats

  • Enemies mutate and grow ferocious based on the karma (Curses) you choose to shoulder. Calculate for yourself which foes you are willing to face and conquer.

  • Countless procedurally generated roulette parts, the 'Star Fragments', ensure every run delivers a completely unique wheel and fresh jackpot experiences

store_data.about_the_game:
I Wish You Weren't Here is a short psychological exploration game featuring simple puzzles, atmospheric horror, and a strong focus on story and emotional meaning rather than constant jump scares.

Explore a large, abandoned city filled with outdoor streets and a variety of buildings, including a hospital, factory, warehouse, mineshaft, and more.

As you progress through each new area, your internal monologue reveals more about your journey through the city while reflecting your character's deteriorating mental state. Alone and unsure of what is happening, you watch yourself spiral into hopelessness.

The game is designed to be a short, focused experience. Rather than relying on massive maps or unnecessarily difficult puzzles, I Wish You Weren't Here focuses on keeping you engaged through intuitive but interesting environments, simple puzzles, and details waiting to be discovered by those willing to explore. Explore carefully to discover additional environmental details, lore, and story pieces scattered throughout the world.

Created by music producer Covenant, the game's soundtrack features around 25 original tracks written specifically for the experience. Many of the game's sound effects were also created specifically for the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bring character-carrying birds to your Windows desktop. They keep you company while you work or study; pair two birds and crack open their egg to discover a new life formed from the parents' hanzi.

Hanzi Birds That Really Live on Your Desktop


Every Hanzi Bird lives in its own transparent desktop window. Male and female birds have distinct bodies and accessories, while each individual has its own color, eyes, crest, tail, and character. Drag them anywhere, let them wander, or ask them to stay put. Click a bird to hear the Mandarin pronunciation of the character on its back. Send them home to the Hanzi Bird Manor whenever you want to organize your collection.

Pair Characters. Hatch New Meaning.


Bring a male and a female bird together and they will lay an egg. Crack the shell and their characters may combine according to real hanzi structure:

子 + 女 = 好
日 + 月 = 明

The game favors valid, familiar characters. If no combination is available, the child inherits one of its parents' characters. Every hatch adds a new bird to your collection and makes hanzi structure visible.

Build Your Own Hanzi Bird Manor


Collect nine color rarities, from white through gold. Each bird's body, eyes, crest, tail, gender, and generation are recorded. Create rooms, arrange ten resident slots, organize eggs, search collected characters, and open profiles for pinyin, useful words, parents, children, and family history.

The desktop and manor stay connected: drag a desktop bird into the foreground manor window to move it in, or drag a resident out to bring it back to your desktop.

Turn an egg you raised into an offline Bird Friend Code and send it to a friend or share it with the community. They can claim it without an account; the character it will hatch, its rarity, and its size remain intact in their Egg House.

Meet Hanzi Through Four Games


  • Hanzi Shooter — switch components to form new characters with enemy hanzi, choose when to dodge or absorb barrages, and climb through weapon tiers.
  • Hanzi Nonogram — use row and column clues to fill or rule out cells, revealing hanzi and everyday pictures; then hear the reading, check the meaning, or open the dictionary.
  • Hanzi Mahjong — draw, discard, and claim character-carrying birds to form valid words against AI opponents at several difficulty levels.
  • Hanzi Crossword — solve intersecting words with definitions and dictionary help while building useful vocabulary.

Draw Hanzi from Number Clues


Read the numbers along every row and column, fill the cells that should hold ink, and cross out the spaces that should remain empty. Hidden hanzi and everyday pictures emerge one cell at a time. From 5×5 introductions to 10×10 and 15×15 challenges, 5,712 fixed puzzles span familiar images and nine graded hanzi levels. Daily 10 adds five Normal and five Hard puzzles each day.

After a clear, compare your pixel result with a color picture or a standard character in a rice grid. Hear the Mandarin reading, check a basic meaning, or open the dictionary. Clear an entire stage or finish all ten daily puzzles to earn a Hanzi Bird egg.

Take Off from Your Desktop


Choose Flight from any desktop bird's menu. The desktop on that monitor is pulled into a starfield, turning the whole screen into a survival battlefield.

Follow the mouse or use the keyboard, then switch between Engage and Evade with one click: unleash automatic multidirectional fire, or stop shooting and raise shields to find a path through dense barrages. Defeated hanzi may split into two valid characters according to their structure. See the character, hear its reading, and charge screen-clearing bombs along the way. Up to four birds from your collection can join as wingmates, healing you, advancing five weapon tiers, and blocking enemy shots while you evade. Set a new survival record.

Two Ways to Make Music


Turn hanzi into voices. Import a MIDI file for a manor room and assign its tracks to different Hanzi Birds. Each bird sings its part with the Mandarin pronunciation of its own character. Keep the MIDI accompaniment for a chorus, or hear the bird voices alone in an a cappella-like arrangement.

The Guqin Room invites you to discover an ancient Chinese instrument by playing it yourself. Freely explore its seven strings, open, stopped, and harmonic tones; follow built-in pieces, or convert a local MIDI track into a guqin solo. History and beginner guidance introduce the instrument through its sound, space, and playing ideas.

Play at Your Own Pace


The interface supports Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean, with a separate choice of Simplified or Traditional character data. Pinyin, Mandarin audio, useful words, and a learning dictionary provide context whenever you want it. Whether you want to explore hanzi or simply raise an unusual flock of desktop pets, you can begin at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your progress bar is alive.

In eastern Oregon, a single fungus spans nine square kilometers. It has been growing for over 2,000 years. It is the largest known organism on Earth.

You are going to beat it.

A real living network
Thousands of simulated organisms form veins, highways and feeding clusters. Nothing is scripted — every structure on your screen emerged on its own. It breathes, it retreats when the air dries, and sometimes it sends out a scouting front you never asked for.

Upgrades that change behavior
Metabolism, growth speed, chemical sensing, mycelial density. Watch your colony act differently after every purchase. Mutations are trade-offs, never free wins — melanized armor costs digestion, bioluminescence costs enzyme regen. Your organism ends up looking like nobody else's.

From petri dish to satellite view
Four habitats and an ending: a lab dish at 100x, a rotting log, a toxic forest floor, and finally the Wood Wide Web — symbiosis with tree roots. Then the camera pulls back past the surface, and you find out how you measure against the real record.

Idle, the honest kind
Colonize carcasses for passive income while you're away. But this one has an actual ending (6-10 hours), and prestige that asks a real question: which mutation do you pass to the next generation, price included?

Everything is computed, nothing is drawn
Graphics are a live agent simulation. Sound is synthesized in code. No AI-generated assets. The entire game is smaller than a single screenshot of it.

Field Notes
Nine entries on the real science behind every system — the Tokyo subway experiment, the maze-solving slime mold, the black fungi on the Chernobyl reactor walls. Where we simplify for the game, we say so.

store_data.about_the_game:
SPIN THE SYSTEM. DEFEND THE PLANET.

Meteor Spin combines the addictive thrill of slot machine deckbuilding with tactical roguelike planetary defense. Catastrophic meteor swarms and deep-space asteroid storms are on a collision course with your home world.

Your weapon? A high-tech planetary defense core that executes tactical commands with every spin!

KEY FEATURES

  • Spin to Command: Every spin dictates your defense. Roll kinetic machine guns, piercing lasers, repair drones, and energy shields to intercept incoming cosmic debris.
  • Synergistic Deckbuilding: Build and refine your slot layout after every wave. Create insane chain reactions—turn space junk into ammunition, amplify adjacent turrets, or risk it all with high-stakes scrap cannons!
  • Powerful Space Artifacts: Discover game-changing passive artifacts that dramatically alter your build, turning fragile planets into impenetrable celestial fortresses.
  • Threats from Deep Space: Endure increasingly brutal meteor waves, cosmic anomalies, and massive, planet-shattering asteroid bosses.
  • Fast-Paced Roguelike Runs: Every run offers distinct combinations of modules, artifacts, and hazards. Adapt, optimize your slot synergy, and defy total extinction!

CAN YOU SURVIVE THE IMPACT?

Lock in your modules, trust your orbital luck, and unleash cosmic firepower. Spin to survive!

store_data.about_the_game:
Alone in the City

You leave your hometown behind and arrive in an unfamiliar city with little money in your pocket and burdens that still follow you from home.

There is no job waiting for you.
No room to call your own.
Everything has to start from scratch.

No Place in the City is an urban life simulation game about making a living and slowly finding your place in the city.

Make It Through, One Day at a Time

Look for work, starting with simple labor jobs and gradually gaining access to new opportunities as your life becomes more stable.

Each job has its own gameplay and rhythm. The money you earn goes toward very ordinary needs: food, rent, and the many expenses that come with everyday life.

But money is not the only thing you need to manage.

Hunger, fatigue, hygiene, mood, and stamina can all affect how your day unfolds. Working longer may earn you more, but sometimes getting enough rest matters just as much.

A City With a Life of Its Own

Walk through crowded markets, narrow streets, parks, working-class neighborhoods, and different parts of the city that change throughout the day.

People head to work. Shops open and close. Night markets come alive after sunset.

The city is more than a place to travel between objectives — it is a world you are learning to live in.

Everyone Has Their Own Story

Along the way, you will meet people who are struggling with life in their own ways.

Some stories last only a day.
Some have been unfolding for years.
And some choices do not have a simple right or wrong answer.

Sometimes, you may be able to help someone.

Other times, you may not even have enough to help yourself.

One Day at a Time

You did not come to the city to become a hero.

You are simply trying to earn enough money, find a place to sleep, take care of the people who matter to you, and hope that tomorrow will be a little better than today.

Starting with almost nothing, every job, every bit of money earned, and every decision you make gradually becomes part of your own story.

Hotel Purgatory is a fast-paced first person puzzle game about sorting souls to where they need to go in the Afterlife.

The Afterlife has recently become very crowded with souls. Too crowded. If this keeps up, then the fragile balance between life and death will topple over, leading to utter chaos! 

Help with the situation and hey, if you do a good enough job, you might have a shot at reincarnation!

Key Features

  • Pick souls up and chuck them to their respective elevators! You're on the clock here, so be quick about it!

  • Experience unique level environments and gimmicks in 4 jam-packed chapters taking place all over the Afterlife!

  • With a Hard Mode and some extra challenges, employees are sure to have their hands full even AFTER they've completed their shift!

store_data.about_the_game:
Tetragrade is a hypnotic block-stacking roguelite about the pure satisfaction of a perfect fit. Embark on your own Odyssey, cut stone into place, clear courses in cascading chains, and watch gold physically pour into the offering bowl at your side. Spend it on the favour of gods - then find out how differently a run plays when Midas or Ares has blessed you.

90-SECONDS

Your first run lasts a minute and a half, which is nowhere near enough. Find Chronos, who holds the hours of the world and has never once been able to say no to gold. Two minutes. Four. Five. He'll keep taking it, and every run reaches somewhere the last one couldn't.

THE COMMISSION

Zeus wants a temple on Olympus, and for reasons known only to him, he's picked you. Marble, terracotta, bronze, olive wood, amber, porphyry, obsidian: seven materials, and never in the order you want them. Clear a line and gold comes flying out, real tumbling coins piling into the bowl beside the board. Spend it on the favour of ten gods - more time, better luck, a lightning bolt of your own and the next run gets further than the last.

TEN GODS. TEN WAYS TO BEND THE RULES.

Every upgrade is permanent and every one changes how a run plays, not just how fast the numbers go up. Gaia raises the playfield itself. Tyche weights your luck. Prometheus shows you what's coming. Midas turns the falling piece to gold on command. Ares reforges it into a spear. Aion drops Ouroboros stones that pay you back in time itself. Zeus hands you a lightning bolt that erases the bottom of the board - but the king of the gods does not lend his thunder to farmhands, and you will work for it.

FEATURES

  • A pure, uncompromised falling-block core - standard scoring, standard 7-bag, nothing dumbed down

  • 10 permanent upgrades across 24 tiers, refundable at any time so you can rebuild your run from scratch

  • Gold pieces, Ouroboros stones and a board that grows as you do

  • Global leaderboards - one more run to beat your closest rival or friend

  • Four biomes with their own music, weather and light

  • Physics-driven coins in a marble libation bowl

  • Full controller support, built for Steam Deck

store_data.about_the_game:
Are You Ready to Get Lost in the Dark Corridors of Your Mind?

Broken Drive is a first-person psychological horror game that explores the boundaries of loss, grief, and madness.

Step into the shattered mind of a father who cannot bear the pain of losing his daughter in a tragic traffic accident. His progressively worsening dementia has completely destroyed his perception of reality, trapping him in a terrifying nightmare created by his own subconscious: an abandoned, dark hospital.

An Endless Loop

This hospital is not a normal place; it is a purgatory shaped by past regrets and traumas. As you traverse the same corridors over and over again, you will witness your surroundings distorting further with each loop, and experience the terrifying tricks your mind plays on you. As the line between reality and hallucination blurs, you must find a way to escape the anomalies waiting for you in the dark.

Key Features:

  • Psychological Thriller: Not just cheap jumpscares, but a suffocating atmosphere that keeps you constantly on edge and gets under your skin.
  • Shifting Environment: Feel the effects of dementia in the gameplay. Corridors that change every time you turn your back, disappearing doors, and distorted spaces.
  • Dark Secrets: Gather the clues hidden deep within your mind, piece together the fragmented memories of your daughter, and search for a way to escape this never-ending loop.

While your own mind fights against you, can you wake up from this nightmare?

store_data.about_the_game:
One ball. Ten paddles. No mercy.

RETURN THIS! is a chaotic multiplayer arcade game about one very simple thing: don't let the ball get past you.

Up to 10 players surround an ever-changing arena. Return the ball, survive the chaos, and be the last paddle standing. Every elimination shrinks the arena, speeds up the rallies, and makes the survivors increasingly uncomfortable.

And getting eliminated doesn't mean you're done causing problems.

Short Matches. Maximum Chaos.

Jump in, play a few rounds, leave happy. Most matches wrap up in under 15 minutes, depending on player count and the rules you pick.

Customize your look, grab your favorite paddle, and you're in — everything is playable from the first match. No grind. Just return the ball.

1v1 With a Friend? 10-Player Free-for-All?

Play a clean 1v1, dive into a chaotic free-for-all, or bring your friends along.

Want a five-player match? Go for it.

Want all ten players squeezed into one arena? Terrible idea. Do it anyway.

Create custom lobbies and adjust the rules to build exactly the match you want.

The Arena Doesn't Stay the Same

Players don't simply disappear when they're eliminated — the arena changes with them. As players get knocked out, the arena rebuilds itself around whoever is still alive, shrinking and shifting shape as the match progresses. A huge, chaotic arena can end as a very uncomfortable little 1v1.

Eliminated? Good. Get Revenge.

Getting knocked out isn't fun... unless you can make everyone else's game worse.

Eliminated players return as malicious spirits and keep participating from beyond the grave. Spawn obstacles, interfere with rallies, and make life miserable for the players rude enough to survive longer than you.

You might be out. Your revenge isn't.

Key Features

  • Online multiplayer for 2–10 players — from tense 1v1 duels to total 10-player chaos

  • An arena that shrinks and reshapes itself with every elimination

  • Keep playing after elimination as a malicious spirit and sabotage the living

  • Custom lobbies with adjustable rules

  • Fast matches, usually under 15 minutes

  • Cosmetic customization — no grind

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the engine of conquest

Gears Of Conquest is a single-player steampunk factory-automation and turn-based strategy game where every production decision supports the battlefield—and every victory strengthens your industry.

Extract resources, refine materials, and automate layered production chains. expand machine capacity, install modules, trade goods, and improve individual machines as your industrial operation grows. Morrow, your upgradeable robotic assistant, guides production and can boost your factory when you need it most.

Turn industry into military power

  • Automate production across mining, smelting, refining, manufacturing, and advanced fabrication.

  • Advance through six research tiers to unlock machinery and engineering upgrades.

  • Manufacture weapons and vehicles, then use that equipment to train specialized troops.

  • Manage power, machine slots, modules, inventory, upgrades, and trade.

Command the forces you create

Deploy troops across frontline, backline, and support positions. Study the enemy formation, assign targets to individual units, and resolve each battle one animated round at a time. Between rounds, adjust your formation and targeting before committing to the next exchange.

Conquer rival territories to earn artifacts, blueprints, currency, and resources that feed back into industrial growth. Better production builds stronger armies; battlefield victories unlock new advantages for your factory.

Forge the machines. Train the army. Turn every cog into conquest.
store_data.detailed_description:
Build the engine of conquest

Gears Of Conquest is a single-player steampunk factory-automation and turn-based strategy game where every production decision supports the battlefield—and every victory strengthens your industry.

Extract resources, refine materials, and automate layered production chains. expand machine capacity, install modules, trade goods, and improve individual machines as your industrial operation grows. Morrow, your upgradeable robotic assistant, guides production and can boost your factory when you need it most.

Turn industry into military power

  • Automate production across mining, smelting, refining, manufacturing, and advanced fabrication.

  • Advance through six research tiers to unlock machinery and engineering upgrades.

  • Manufacture weapons and vehicles, then use that equipment to train specialized troops.

  • Manage power, machine slots, modules, inventory, upgrades, and trade.

Command the forces you create

Deploy troops across frontline, backline, and support positions. Study the enemy formation, assign targets to individual units, and resolve each battle one animated round at a time. Between rounds, adjust your formation and targeting before committing to the next exchange.

Conquer rival territories to earn artifacts, blueprints, currency, and resources that feed back into industrial growth. Better production builds stronger armies; battlefield victories unlock new advantages for your factory.

Forge the machines. Train the army. Turn every cog into conquest.
store_data.short_description: Forge an empire where factory production meets turn-based conquest. Gather resources, expand production, research upgrades, train troops and assemble war machines, then deploy them in tactical formations. Defeat rival powers and feed every victory back into your industry.

store_data.about_the_game:
Roll Brighter is a physics-based driving that emphasizes chaotic teamwork and dynamic gameplay. Players are tethered to each other by a physics rope to navigate and conquer challenging levels filled with unpredictable traps. Create authentic, hilarious moments with your friends through sheer chaotic cooperation!

  

Chaotic Multiplayer Co-Op:

Play together with your friends or players worldwide through our multiplayer system. Coordinate your driving, conquer challenging obstacles, and create unforgettable, laugh-out-loud moments together.

 

Dynamic Environments & Varied Traps:

Face treacherous terrain and tricky traps designed to stop you in your tracks. From steep mountain hills to murky swamps and factory zones, the varied atmospheres enhance both the chaos and the necessity of teamwork.

 

Expressive Physics Rope Mechanics:

The tether between your vehicles isn't just a connection—it's a core mechanic! Use tension, swing momentum, and sling-shot physics to pull each other out of danger, solve obstacles, and earn maximum points.

 

Engaging Single Player Mode:

Flying solo? No problem! Players can fully enjoy the game on their own. Hook up and tow various carts, tackle solo challenges, set your best high scores, and fill your spare time with physics-based fun!

 

Clean, Vibrant & Optimized Visuals:

The game is built with an efficient optimization pipeline, ensuring smooth performance while delivering a colorful, atmospheric world designed to give players a joyful and immersive experience.

 

Hook up your rope and prove whether your teamwork can conquer the challenges amidst the fun and chaos that await! Roll through the excitement with your friends or enjoy the ride solo!

store_data.about_the_game:
Do We Have the Right to Choose Pain?

If a drug could eliminate all psychological pain, cure the mental illnesses caused by such suffering, and even erase remorse and guilt, would we still be “human”?

Prescription of Throes is a 2D narrative adventure game.

You play as a high school student who, after enduring years of bullying at school, jumped from a building and survived. Now on leave from school and living alone, you investigate an unapproved experimental psychiatric drug circulating underground alongside companions you meet along the way.

You will explore and interact in side-view environments, gather clues by talking to characters, and take part in minigames woven into the story. The choices you make during the investigation will affect relationships and shape the course of the story.

When psychological pain can be erased completely, do we still have the right to experience it?

store_data.about_the_game:
THE YEAR IS 4200

The Terran Federation is celebrating its 2000th anniversary — two millennia of expansion, institutions, and quiet compromises nobody quite remembers agreeing to. You don't watch this age from the outside. You live inside it, and take whatever that life offers you.

CHARACTER CREATION IS HALF THE STORY

Terran Chronicles: 4200 takes the part most RPGs rush through and makes it the whole first act — and for some players, the whole game. Built on the classic lifepath systems of golden-age tabletop sci-fi RPGs, you don't pick a class and a backstory — you generate one, term by term. Qualify for a career. Survive its dangers. Earn its medals or wash out in disgrace. Every attribute, skill and scar your character walks out with is a piece of their story, not a choice optimised from a menu.

A WORLD WORTH LIVING INSIDE

Two thousand years is a long time for an institution to stay honest. The Federation governs a thousand worlds and calls itself a democracy — and mostly believes it. The fleet still musters. The paperwork still arrives on time. It just takes a little longer each year, through one more office than it used to, and somewhere someone profits because of it.

Coreward, an alien people who built their entire faith around receiving truth rather than asserting it hold an honorary seat in a government that has never quite decided what to do with them. Rimward, a generations-long border war grinds on — chronic rather than climactic, the type of war that shapes careers and consumes lives while it slowly corrupts even the best of ideals.

And in between, countless billions of ordinary people go on building the galaxy they want to live in — or the one they'll have to.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Full lifepath character generation — background, qualification rolls, term-by-term career progression, promotion, aging, and an event table that can make or break a life.

- Four playable careers — Federation Military, Federation Navy, Civilian and Business, each with real promotion ladders and named honours that carry mechanical weight, not just flavour text.

- Consequences that follow you — traits, reputation, contacts, rivals and physical cost all carry forward from character generation into play.

- A weekly life — character steps into a game where time passes week by week. Spend effort, manage fatigue, work jobs, see contacts, keep a ship running, and read the diary your character writes about it.

- The Terra Subsector — a hand-built hex map you can study and see the Terran Federation and its many worlds.

- Encounters with teeth — void-side firefights and tense negotiations where the dice and your decisions shape outcomes.

NO TWO LIVES ARE THE SAME

Some end in glory. Most don't. Come find out what kind of life you're going to live.

store_data.about_the_game:
A brave journey of a little mouse, "Squeaky," to save his village from the tyranny of cats!

The peace of the mouse village—and all of its precious cheese—is under threat from a gang of wicked cats. Squeaky, a courageous little mouse, steps up to embark on an adventure to save his home. However, Squeaky only moves straight forward without stopping! Instead of controlling the character directly, you must place various gadgets along his path to guide him, collect every single cheese, and safely reach the goal.

Key Features

  • Unlimited Gadgets, Limitless Freedom: Forget the frustration of strict inventory limits found in conventional puzzle games. Every gadget is available without restriction. If you want, you can fill the entire stage with trampolines to send Squeaky bouncing endlessly!

  • Physics-Based Interactions: Place various physical contraptions like jump pads and explosive popsicles in just the right spots. Use angles, timing, and momentum to launch Squeaky along the optimal trajectory.

  • A Charming, Immersive Story: Overcome perilous traps, outsmart the mischievous cats, and bring peace back to the mouse village.

  • Your Own Creative Solutions: There is no single correct path. As long as you collect all the cheese, even the most wacky and inventive approaches will lead you to victory.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not a king who commands armies.

You are the army.

Every wall that rises, every resource gathered, every enemy that falls—it all begins with one decision: split. You tear a piece of your own core into a new slime, give it a purpose, and send it into the world. It will work, fight, and eventually dissolve back into you—if it survives that long.

The land is hostile.

By daylight, you direct your split offspring to chop wood, quarry stone, and erect sticky fortifications. At night—or whenever the war horn sounds—hordes pour in from the fog. Your walls shake. Your spitters run dry. And you, the King, must decide in seconds: split again to hold the line, or conserve your essence for the next dawn?

Your subjects are not mere units.

· The Wall Slime doesn't just build—it becomes the mortar, sealing cracks with its own body.

· The Guard Slime doesn't just tank—it explodes on death, buying precious seconds.

· The Royal Heir—if you dare attempt three perfect splits in a row—is your only backup, a clone that thinks and acts on its own, but its birth costs half your life force.

Every split is a gamble. Too many, and you shrink, becoming vulnerable. Too few, and your kingdom crumbles. Resources are finite. Time is cruel. And the enemy learns—they will target your weakest section, force you to split under pressure, and punish every wrong choice.

This is not a tycoon game. This is survival through self‑sacrifice.

You are a single blob of potential. How much of yourself are you willing to give away to keep your throne?

Build. Split. Defend.

And remember—when the last slime falls, you are alone again, just a puddle on the ground.

But if you win, you are the one true Slime King.

store_data.about_the_game:
TEAR THE SHIP APART.

Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite where enemy ships and battlefield structures are built to be broken.

Strip away armor pixel by pixel, carve open new firing lanes, expose critical Cores, and destroy the systems putting your fleet under pressure. Breaches remain, structures fall apart, and every scar changes how you move, aim, and survive.

BREAK. SALVAGE. BUILD. REPEAT.

Every wave feeds the next.

Tear through enemies and the environment to earn credits, then inspect a four-slot blueprint rack between battles. Lock, refresh, or pin the projects you want before crafting new weapons, drones, and modules for your growing formation.

Every addition changes more than a number. It changes the shape, reach, and destructive power of your fleet.

FIREPOWER CHANGES HOW YOU BREAK

Different weapons carve through pixel structures in different ways.

Machine guns cut steady breaches through exposed sections. Missiles blast open clusters of armor. Piercing weapons drill toward deeply buried Cores. Drones expand your firing coverage and turn a lone survivor into an improvised fleet.

Choose your tools, find the weak point, and decide whether to strike the Core or dismantle the entire ship.

FROM DESPERATE SURVIVAL TO OVERWHELMING FIREPOWER

Begin each run with limited firepower and fight through increasingly dangerous waves. Build a formation around your ship, survive hostile barrages and spatial hazards, then confront massive modular bosses that can be dismantled piece by piece.

A fragile opening can become a screen filled with weapons, explosions, drifting wreckage, and overwhelming firepower—if your build survives long enough to come together.

KEY FEATURES

  • Pixel-by-pixel destruction across enemy ships and battlefield structures

  • Targetable Cores that control enemy weapons, defenses, and movement

  • Persistent breaches and battle scars that reshape movement and firing lanes

  • Fast wave-based survival runs with escalating pressure and Boss encounters

  • A four-slot blueprint system with locking, refreshing, and pinning

  • Weapons, drones, and modules that visibly expand your fleet

  • Distinct destruction styles, from precision cutting to explosive demolition

  • A dramatic power curve from fragile survival to screen-clearing firepower

Break it apart. Build it back. Bring the firepower.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone falls. You decide who.

FSPunch is a physics brawler with direct, responsive controls. Your character goes where you send it — the chaos comes from what happens on impact, not from wrestling with your own legs. Land a clean hit and watch someone cartwheel off the edge. Miss, and that one is on you.

PUNCH, KICK, CARRY

Every body in the arena is a ragdoll, so no two knockdowns look alike. Land a hit and your opponent tumbles. Grab a knocked-out player and carry them to the edge. Pick up a bat, a pan or an iron bar and swing it. Dash across the platform with a jetpack. There is no combo system to learn — but there is plenty to master: spacing, timing, and knowing exactly how far a dash carries you.

BUILT FOR LAN NIGHTS

FSPunch is made to be played in one room. Rounds are short, the rules are readable at a glance, and matches are decided by who plays better — not by who got luckier with the ragdoll.

SIX ARENAS, FIVE WAYS TO PLAY

The classic island slowly falls apart, slab by slab, until there is barely room for two. A night-time parking lot lit by neon never breaks at all. A soccer pitch with real goals and nets. Pick the surface, pick the rules — last one standing, teams, or ball sudden death, where a single hit makes you explode.

BALL GAMES

Dodgeball, scooterball and soccer. Same physics, same chaos, but now there is an object everyone wants and nobody controls.

BUILD YOUR OWN ARENAS

The built-in map editor gives you blocks, spheres, cylinders, cones and prisms, a three-axis rotation handle, copy and paste, and undo. Build something reasonable. Then build something unreasonable and see what the physics does with it.

PLAY TOGETHER — OR AGAINST THE BOTS

Couch co-op in splitscreen with two controllers, LAN multiplayer for the whole living room, and bots that fill up any empty slots so a round is never off the table. Menus and lobby are fully controller-operable, including an on-screen keyboard.

Mistport

 While the tide of industrialisation washes over the world, a maelstrom of unknown origin puts the trade within the lost world into a chokehold. The small village of Mistport becomes the sole pathway for the kingdom to reach the outside world. Yet it is not only merchants and goods that move through the port, for amidst the mist filled streets crime syndicates, mysterious cults and nobles with endless ambition roam. 

 You are the new inspector for Mistport Customs Office. You see hundreds of passports, reports, cargo chests, and documents pass through your desk. Your decisions not only shape your future, but the future of the whole city. 

  • Decides who gets to pass: You cannot trust anyone within the foggy piers, inspect their documents and uncover their identity. 

  • Write Documents: Use your typewriter to fill in documents, and type out your verdict. 

  • Decide Who to Trust: Follow the military’s orders, or aid The Lynn Family to overthrow them. Who knows, you may be the only person to raise the crown upon the Crest Isle or cast the lost world down into maws of madness. 

  • Reap What You Sow: See the results of your action within your gameplay, and the nightly narrative comic sections. 

 Your Duty

   Due to extraordinary weather conditions, the small hamlet of Mistport became the preferred path of all captains. Your job is to inspect the documents and forms of the Captains, and reject or approve their demands. 

  • Control the Captains’ Licences 

  • Check through their documents to reveal inconsistencies, any failure in detection will lead to punishment

  • Check the merchants’ cargo, we cannot let banned goods pass into the kingdom. 

Be careful of the ever changing regulations, both the city and its rules shift constantly.

 Shape Your Destiny

  •  The resources of your country are few due to catastrophes and disasters, feed yourself and pay for shelter to survive.

  • Not every person who steps into your office is sane of mind, you may witness the results of your decisions sooner than you expect.

store_data.about_the_game:
INTRODUCTION

Inspired by Malaysian culture and folklore, the game follows Lim Ming, a supernatural investigator tasked with uncovering whether the apartment hotel is truly haunted and the evil within.

EXPLORATION

Explore the apartment hotel through 2D side-scrolling exploration. Talk to the inhabitants, help them, and uncover the truth hidden within the building. But be careful—some may offer you help, while others may lead you into danger.

INVESTIGATION

Search every nook and cranny to uncover clues behind the haunting. Use your torchlight to reveal supernatural signs, examine your surroundings, and read through files and documents to uncover what happened in the past.

TAOISM EXOCISM

Encounter malicious spirits that seek to take your life. Use Taoist tools to exorcise them while staying alert to their presence. Spirits can approach from any direction—use the Luopan to sense the nearest approaching spirit and locate where it is coming from before it strikes.
